title: Useless
review: I used to like Facebook especially when I used to be able to advertise my services (I’m a hair stylist) on Marketplace but then back when they changed the policy late last year, I now can’t let people know I have openings in the salon. A lot of my clients came from Facebook and now because of their new policy, it created a drastic change in my books. Sure, there are other ways but in such a competitive industry it’s nice to have social media as a way for other people to view your work. Of course, they would LOVE for you to pay for their advertising which essentially doesn’t work especially when you get shadow banned for no reason. My own friends hardly see my posts anymore. Mostly it’s just the same people. I’m also sick of the political censorship, it’s adorable how they have to censor facts by using their own “fact checker.” Facebook used to be a great tool to use and now I realize it’s just being run by a bunch of tools.

title: Ability to delete in batches
review:
I wish Facebook was more user friendly. 
1)I cannot delete profile or timeline pics in one batch like you can do with albums. You have to manually delete pics-one by one...which would take forever. 
2) You cannot delete convo in messenger like you can with texts. Super creepy. I hate using messenger for this reason.
3) More privacy options, like maybe more categories of groups as not just close friends and friends. Maybe being able to make certain posts unseen to “work friends “ or “family “ as a group instead of excepting people as individuals. 
4) Having a snooze button for certain people seeing your posts. Everyone has that one friend from high school or wherever that is constantly commenting on your posts or says awkward things. Occasionally snoozing their ability to see your posts would avoid drama.

title: Worst social media app ever followed by Instagram
review: They really don’t care about their users. I got restricted 3x because of comments, the last 2x i was extremely confused because nothing in my comments were vulgar or explicit or rude. When you are restricted you get an option to ask for a review if you think they made a mistake. Once you choose the option they will tell you they don’t have enough people to review your case. Both Facebook and Instagram invade your privacy by listening in on things you talk about through your phone to give you ads on those things (so creepy). Oh & i got banned the last time for going off on a p*dophile (I didn’t use vulgar or inappropriate language at all) and Facebook decided to ban me for a whole week yet the p*do who did say explicit and vulgar things comments were not taken down at all. Facebook has some serious issues, so glad I deleted both Facebook and Instagram. If your reading this stay away from these gross platforms.

title: An Unfortunate Characteristic of Facebook.
review: Facebook offers a great opportunity to connect with long lost friends and acquaintances and make some new ones as well. Unfortunately they have taken on a responsibility we never gave them reason to pick up and that is to censure information their owners and managers do not agree with and label it as incomplete, partially factual or unsubstantiated. Apparently they do not trust their users to exercise their own critical thinking skills and determine if what is being posted is factual, accurate or true. No one knows all truth, no institution, government or company. Unfortunately Facebook has decided it has something in common with an Omniscient God and does know all about everything. I encourage Facebook to stick with its strengths and drop its censure policies.

title: One star because the ads are helpful, but UI is not friendly at all.
review:
How is it that FB on Safari works better than the app? 
1) People suggestions are always up in my face and they never change even when I remove them. 
2) The fact checkers were a great idea at the beginning then the little tag at the bottom became the most annoying thing in 2020. It makes me dread even going to FB. There needs to be a more discrete fake news message. 
3) Is there anyway I can turn off having to see posts that my friends liked or commented on? Most of it is irrelevant. 
4) It's kind of a bummer to go on a website with bad reputation for banning people. What is this so called FB jail? Is it a thing at all? 
5) I have set up "See First" on some of my friends' posts but as it turns out, I don't see ALL of their posts on my feed. I'd like a "See ALL" button. 
6) I would like to delete my FB account but keep the messenger app, which is honestly the best thing off of FB. The thing is, human beings can be annoying and rude but the app has been created in a way that enables this behavior such as all the emojis used to react to posts. Like, it's weird to have the angry reaction on a post about knitting/crochet. All encouraging negativity. Very annoying. People aren't this way in real life. 

I do like that the ads are well-catered to me and the groups are great like little communities. The livestreams from good friends are also a plus.

title: Facebook Reactions
review:
People prefer a quick, easy way to leave feedback. Facebook reactions allow users to access animated emoji to quickly express a reaction to a post. This is a feature I enjoy, nevertheless, with the new addition of the ”Care” Facebook reactions, I have discovered a predisposed tendency to use the first three animated emoji options. I hypothesis this is due to the fact that I don't have to adjust the position of how I am holding my phone to reach the first three icons. With the new ”care” icon, I find that I now use the ”HaHa” reaction less because it requires more work. I know I sound lazy but, I was thinking in a future update you could allow people to control the order the reactions appear.
If you are able to do this, make a video tutorial, I'm tired of driving to my mom's house to teach her how to use Facebook.

title: Are you serious?
review: First of all, the exhausting People You May Know section is enough to make anyone delete the app. I’m really not sure why it’s such a focus. We already have to deal with the plethora of ads and poor UX/UI, which is more than enough. I hate how I have to click a video, click another button to make it a focus, then struggle to get out of it just to watch a ten second clip. It’s 2019. Make everything easy and able to be swiped away. I’m not sure why a company so deeply rooted in technology has such trouble figuring out an interface people want to use. And then, you update the app to this AWFUL and lazy white and blue design that is honestly the worst design on an app I’ve seen since the App Store launched with the first iPhone. Like, how did this get approved? Just to unfollow someone is now a procedure like everything else on the app. To make a great app, it should be easy to use and simple. You continue to go the other direction, which astounds me. Please fix it immediately.

title: Facebook overall for me personally & advice.
review:
Facebook is a good app. It’s fun, entertaining & you can connect with anyone easily. It keeps you updated on what’s new also. I did however give 4 stars because whenever I report something nothing happens to the post nothing ever gets removed and no ones page ever gets deactivated. But overall it’s fine I use Facebook a lot just like most people do. I don’t really have too big of an issue with the app it works fine for me.

Be smart, keep yourself and your friends/ family safe. Do not give out personal info, do not answer someone you do not know, etc..

title: Worst social media app
review: It use to be the golden example of social media a few years back but now it’s perhaps the worst social media app there is. There is way too many trolls, trumpers, negativity, and false information spread with zero accountability or action from the company. The interface is extremely touch sensitive with far too many options/ selections to click on. You will literally get lost in the app trying to figure out where to find that video you just liked lol. There’s just WAY too much going on there with the options. Plus the stories never load properly and they only let you upload 26 seconds of videos which is absolutely ridiculous. Then when you upload it it’s always glitchy and loses quality of picture. The whole app is an overstuffed hate filled glitchy MESS. The only reason I stay on is to keep up with a few family and friends. Other than that it wouldn’t be worth it at all!

title: Facebook
review:
I love Facebook. It is a huge help with depression!! I’ve met so many like minded people that have become hugely important in my life. If I’m sad I can always go on and laugh at my friends memes. 

I do wish Facebook would lighten up on the Community Standards!! I repost something I got from Facebook and I get a ban or restriction. I also think they should stay out of Messenger. Other than people talking about blowing something up, most are having “private” conversations and aren’t hurting anyone! 

Facebook is the only contact I have with my family members. It’s instrumental in keeping us in touch. All in all, Facebook is a source of joy. I love it. It has its faults, as does everything, but the good far outweighs the bad. ♥️

title: Locked from my account
review: I have been a Facebook user since I was 17 and I can honestly say they have the worst customer service of any company in the world. If anyone from Facebook that sees this might help me PLEASE reach out to me and help me out PLEASE

title: Probably the most poorly designed app ever
review:
You could write a book on all the things wrong with this app.

Let’s say you come across a post, and you’re unsure whether what it says it’s true.  You minimize Facebook to search the internet to find an answer, and you learn it’s completely untrue.  You return to Facebook to warn others that the post is misinformation, but Facebook has decided by itself to refresh the entire app.  You’ll never find that post again, because of Facebook’s terrible sorting algorithm (which is more a site problem than an app problem).

Next, if you ever receive a comment response and click on the notification, you’ll see a preview of the response at the bottom of the post. When you click the preview, this app brings you to ALL responses not directly to the one addressed to you. You might need to scroll through 1,000 or more comments to find the thread related to your notification.

title: Not a FB subscriber? Walk away. So many problems and they get worse and more more more
review:
Latest… I can’t save my avatars to my photos anymore. That’s frustrating. 

I admin many groups on FB and I can’t get any help with all the problems. 

I keep getting banned from FB for posts in my groups that the FB bot is misunderstanding and then I can’t manage my groups. They’re medical support groups. It’s impossible to give support to my group members when FB bans me. I’ve tried to appeal only to not be heard. 

I have my support group network AND a business page for it. I also have a real business on FB and when they ban me and lock me out of my stuff, they literally take money out of my pocket. 

Why do they allow us to even have a business on FB … AND PAY THEM MONEY FOR ADVERTISING (yes, I had an ad running when they banned me) … when they ban us. They treat us like we’re children. 

There are bugs bugs bugs in the groups and pages and other parts of the program. FB doesn’t fix them. 

This platform has us by the short hairs. With a monopoly in the market, and no one else with a platform like this, we’re stuck. I can’t just leave. Not with my support groups. 

I tried to figure out how to get help tonight with the broken avatars … to no avail. So I’m using AppStore reviews to express my dissatisfaction. 

If you’re not yet a FB subscriber … just say no.

title: Overwhelmed with adds
review: So how about this; try putting my friends in my feed? Literally every other post is a useless add. It’s ridiculous. I’m not following some of my friends list, but most all of them I do not see ANYTHING from unless I manually go to their page. ALSO; marketplace is over run with scammers. It’s obvious who and which ones they are. I would sell my left foot before I EVER transferred money through Facebook and that’s only one reason why. AND; I don’t need your suggestions for groups and marketplace crap you THINK I would be interested in. Me and everyone else knows how to find groups and market place without it taking up space in my MINIMAL feed that’s totally overwhelmed with adds. I almost can’t even stand Facebook anymore. Probably just going to start using other social media instead. I’m sure you know there are PLENTY MORE OPTIONS…..Adds adds adds adds adds adds adds adds suggestions adds suggestions adds. Ugh.

title: Mobile App Doesn’t allow me to see my old photos
review:
Today I was trying to show some people my emo phase based on some hilarious memes that constantly flood my timeline, and I made a shocking discovery; YOU CANNOT ACCESS YOUR OLD PHOTO ALBUMS IN A STRAIGHTFORWARD WAY! 
The old app version was nice, you could click the menu, and there was a Photos tab. That option is no longer available. I tried everything. review:
The app continues to reload webpages in an ever repeating loop - even though the content I went to see is visible and readable. If you cannot fix it, at least offer a prompt so I can say when to begin the reload - and make the prompt small so it doesn't cover up what I am reading.

title: Worst choice for social media I’ve ever experienced
review:
Only giving one star bc at least I can stalk people if I know their name, through this app. 🙄

title: What on earth happened??!
review:
Facebook messenger used to be okay. But with the recent update it’s just rubbish. They’ve taken half the features away that made it somewhat useful, so for example I used to be able to change font when putting text on an image. Now there is just one font. Why did they take away all the other fonts? There’s still more that’s disappeared. I used to be able to change my paint brush size to small, medium, large - but now it’s just one size. Why??
The feature they’ve taken away which is by far the worst decision yet, is you now can’t see who you’re sending a photo too. It used to say the person’s name or picture on the send button. Now it’s just send. Whilst this may seem harmless, it’s easy to forget and easy to mess up. I’ve sent many messages to people to whom the message is irrelevant. 

Why take perfectly good features away? Messenger is just a bare bones version of its prior self. Dissatisfaction 100.

title: So much messed up
review:
Seems like every time y’all fix one thing in the app something else ends up being messed up. I don’t know if this happens on just the app but I’ve noticed when I see posts from different like pages it will say the post has X amount of comments but when I actually click on the comments they don’t show. And this only happens on like pages, not on anyone’s personal pages. Also I wish the app wouldn’t automatically refresh itself every time I click out of it. title: Problem viewing Notes w/Facebook App
review:

The same is true if viewing the Note on my iPad either with the Safari browser or the Facebook App. I also have no problem viewing the original Note on my iPhone with either Safari or the Facebook App. The problem comes in when I Share the original Note to a Facebook group to which I belong or to a Facebook page that I administer. Viewing the Shared note on Chrome, Safari (either on iPad or iPhone) or the Facebook App on my iPad shows text and pictures perfectly. It’s when I attempt to view the Shared Note on my iPhone’s Facebook App that only the text is displayed – no pictures. Does anyone know why? Thank you.

Charles Byrd

Highly disappointed!!!!

title: Marketplace--an invasion of privacy and waste of time

title: Horrible Customer Service
review:
I have been a valued member of Facebook for over 10 years and never encountered a problem until recently. Under a new name policy I was asked to change my Facebook name because it did not meet community standards. A name I had for over 10 years and am now acquainted with on all social media outlets. After not wanting to change it and explaining why my account was placed on review with no access until the situation is resolved....... 

That was over THREE MONTHS AGO. 
It still says my account is under review when I try to log in. With no customer service number I am unable to resolve my issue and I have not gotten responses through the help center (which required me to make a new profile to use) 
I just want to return to my normal active Facebook life and communicate with my friends again to plan events. Please resolve the issues and if that is unavailable, please fix your service options so the process isn't nearly as strenuous or long.

title: Poor identification recovery
review: Your so called famous place to visit friends and family is ruined. You try to get back in because you had a mishap with your phone. Forgot password had to change phones even numbers. And you provide your Divers license to prove who you are and it becomes an even bigger mess with a new Facebook account I don’t want and a repeat password change over and over I want to give up BUT if a hacker can get this to work out for them logging in to my account I will to. I refuse to go down and loose all my memories because your company is negligent in fixing any errors in a proficient and easy way. I don’t even have this much trouble getting into my bank app when loosing my password. Come on who do you have working for you??!! If they can get in to my Facebook so easily why can’t I!!!????

title: Slow moving and must start over to get to the next message received every time you open one
review: As I try to look at posts made by friends, the app reloads all the posts and you have to start at the beginning of all the posts and scroll down to where you left off every time you leave one post to move on to another! Very time consuming and annoying!  It would be nice to just close the previous post and move on to the next!  If you have not looked at post in a few days this becomes very annoying and  time consuming !  It wasn’t always like this.  There was a time when everything ran smoothly and Facebook was much more enjoyable!  I’m looking for another social media network that runs like Facebook once did!  I don’t think Facebook has kept up with the amount of people using it.  It’s so large that they can’t keep up!

title: spam, scam, and fake accounts.
review:
Hello all, just as a heads up, any time i report an account that is obviously fake or an attempt to scam someone, phish someone, just overall fake accounts ran by bots, or REAL accounts that were hacked and is now spewing spam. every single one of these accounts i’ve reported have not been taken down. If it’s obvious to me, my family, my friends… it should be taken down, since these elderly people and the youth (within the age of access) on this app fall for these scams to gain access to their account. THE COMMUNITY GUIDELINES IS A JOKE.

SOURCE: I moderate multiple groups. If they’re private it’s an easy vetting process (they do still get through). However if the group is public, there is nothing we can do to stop or prevent these scammers every single day except delete them and block them as we see them. for the groups we manage, we don’t have the time to do facebook’s job for them on vetting accounts as fake, scam, spam.

title: Ridiculous
review: I have been using Facebook since 2011. And since this pandemic they’ve gotten really stupid about what content gets your account restricted. I can comment or even write in a caption with a post I share to my friends, not public. I can be joking or using words metaphorically and Facebook takes them as a threat or intent to cause harm! I’m not harmful by any means and seriously mean everything in a non threatening, joking manner. I only have friends (I know personally) and family on my friends list. They all know me well enough to know I am genuinely joking. This is the third time this year and frankly as someone who has been around for MySpace, and the upcoming of Facebook. This is ridiculous!!! I’m about to leave and choose another platform to use and take all my friends and family with me. They have all been effected by this insane community standards. Ridiculous!!!

title: Out of control
review:
Facebook has become out of control, by becomng too controlling.  I hate the way they decide what/who I see.  And now with all their one sided fact-checking.  I understand they are a private company, but they have established themselves as a public forum.

And I discovered they tapped into my work computer, even though I never signed into FB on my work computer.  I did some internet searches at work for items from Graingers that we needed for work. That night at home, when i signed onto my home computer and opend Facebook, there were Grainger ads for the exact items I had looked for at work.  The only way I figured they did it was thru my work email, which I would periodically access at home.  They backtracked somehow thru  that to my work computer, and snooped.

BLM and orher left leaning pages seem to have free rein, yet anything remotely right is reined in.

title: Altering My Dark Mode Setting?!?
review: I’m not sure if this is happening to anyone else, but I have my device on dark mode, therefore I prefer its look and applied it to Facebook as well. However, it seems that when Facebook has a new update, they change the theme settings on my app, and all of a sudden it won’t allow me to switch to dark mode; it stays on light mode, and if I choose “on” for dark mode, it continues using the light theme anyways. This only gets fixed when I update the app, which is concerning because of privacy and security reasons, and they know I update the app because the light theme bothers me. This is really irritating, especially coming from someone who hates to update apps, and has the automatic update feature turned off on my iPhone. Why does Facebook continue to do this “bug” in order to force me to update the app for dark mode? Why do they want me to update the app so badly? This is concerning and disappointing.

review: I joined Facebook because of a business that I wanted to see their products.  I went ahead and used their marketplace to try to sell 3 items and tried to use their Messenger app to communicate with potential buyers.  The only way I could communicate to potential buyers was via Facebook online.  I could sign on online but the apps for Facebook and for Messenger would not allow me to sign on.  I use a lot of apps so I am accustomed to using apps.  It is ridiculous the time wasted to try to work with these apps.  At one point, Facebook wanted me to submit legal documentation to prove who I was to log onto the website. That is when I quit.  The information that it states is incorrect.  It will tell me no internet when clearly I am online.  It will say I have not used a certain browser before when I know I have used that browser.  Horrible app for a company that should have their act together.

title: Facebook is out of control
review: My 10+ year accoint was banned for no other reason other than “you are ineligible to use Facebook”. No reason given. Appeal got left unheard and unanswered. I’ve lost countless contacts made over the years and invaluable photos of friends and family who have passed. Anything that was signed in via Facebook i.e Instagram, COD Mobile and and other game on Apple Market was also lost and unable to log in or regain access to any paid content or app used with Facebook. Get rid of the app and start going back to parties and get together and the age of “you gotta know someone who knows someone”.

Facebook has become hostile to conservative voices and to truth. They seem to have a vested interested in alienating millions of users by their intolerant, and communistic tactics. From censored free speech, to biased agenda pushing politics, Facebook has fallen from grace in the eyes of the majority who utilize its app, myself included. review:

All I posted yesterday on my Facebook was Roses, yes the FLOWER. Then a few hours later I am able to LIKE or COMMENT again until it just happens again a few hours later!

title: I would appreciate it if I could read the replies I’m getting
review:
I get notifications about a reply, but clicking on it doesn’t bring me to the comment. I have to dig through comments to find the one I’m looking for. Some are filtered out completely. I’m assuming they’re offensive, so I’m not too upset about that. 

I also hate when I’m on a page and swipe right and end up losing the article. I hate when I press the home button on accident and lose my spot. I hate that when the app gets restarted due to what I assume is iOS poor ram management, my home page looks completely different. Then I go to my ad history to see if I can find the article I was reading and half the time it isn’t there. If it’s something I’m subscribed to and I don’t remember what the source was, I have no way of finding the article again. 

Also, I heard I might not be getting updates from all my friends, people I was subscribed to. Buzzfeed rarely works as intended; pictures won’t load.

Sometimes the app stops loading altogether and I can’t see any more posts. I hate that you have to click on videos and as soon as you do there’s an ad. 

Edit: more to add. I just tried pausing in the middle of a video to read something and the video showed me the first frame.

I’ll give 2 stars instead of one because I’m addicted to it despite of all its issues.

title: Still lots of bugs
review: I’m frustrated with the roll out of the new Facebook and its integration with Facebook Business Suite and the inability to still download the Facebook Page App that is still being supported. This directly impacts the problems with managing Facebook as a Facebook user when you are also a manager. Specifically, when trying to share content from a page that I manage to my personal page, the switching option does not toggle correctly all the time. It used to be much easier to switch between a manager of a page and using as a Facebook user while in the Facebook app. This is a very basic function of Facebook that needs to work and must be fixed. And once and for all, you have to start offering support. It’s sorely lacking for those who are using Facebook for business. UPDATE: AND FIX NOTIFICATIONS! I get notified on post comments even though I’ve selected “turn off for this post” and I don’t get them for posts I’VE commented on. ANNOYING!

title: Disappointing
review: I used to use Facebook all the time, for literally hours a day watching videos, looking at memes and just catching up with family/friends. Now, I barely ever use Facebook. First off, the ads on videos are so annoying, but I know that’s just how it is in the world now but I definitely use other apps to watch videos now. Then they added this new thing when you’re looking at a photo where it goes to a screen where you can’t swipe through the photos, annoying! And now, I get notifications CONSTANTLY from all of these other tabs I don’t even USE! I don’t use the marketplace, the watch tab, or the group tab and I get so many notifications from them every day! Facebook has turned into a big disappointment and unless I’m really bored and have run out of other things to do, I will continue to use insta and twitter over Facebook.

title: GIF Status Updates
review:
Dear Facebook,

Just about every week, there is an update. Yet, I have yet to see the option to post a GIF as a status. Every social media website/app does it... except Facebook. Its good you can use them in comments but some people can make a simple post just off a GIF alone to show their mood. I know this next suggestion may go on blind eyes and dead ears but can you stop playing ads in the middle of videos. I can see before or after but in the middle is just annoying. Especially when its done on every single last video every user posts. That's really annoying as if someone is constantly poking you trying to ask you a question. There are ads all over Facebook, I'm quite sure posting the ads before the video plays is not going to stop revenue.

Facebook needs to get it together I’ve wanted to post a profile video for THE LONGEST TIME but I haven’t been able to because the videos in my gallery doesn’t show when I select profile video, it only shows the photos which gets me so mad because I’m not very photogenic which means I have more videos at first I thought it was my account so I logged out deleted the app but it was the same thing I even tried it on my friends phone (didn’t work) and I’ve tried to message Facebook help center but nothing . review:
Facebook is supposed to connect families, friends, businesses, and communities with each other and be a place if open communication and expression. How can it be an effective app and safe for users is Facebook is listening in on conversations, disregarding privacy with ads tailored on something you looked at online like a month ago, and now classifying people as “Hate Agents”?

title: Same phone different app??
review: My husband and I have the EXACT same type of phone. We both got the 156.0 update and even before this update, his app had features mine did not. Looking at the pictures on what the app will look like, you know, the ones before you download it and you swipe to make sure it’s what you want, mine doesn’t have all the features. My husband and I both went to our settings and have COMPLETELY different options for THE SAME APP. To top it off, now when he watches videos, it is only that video. Gone are the days that you could watch a video and then it would go down to the next one, then the next and so on. But again, only his phone but the same app. This isn’t making any sense to either of us and it is quite annoying. I’m not sure how two people have the: same phone, same carrier, same Wi-Fi, same app, same updated version, BUT have two different sets of features.

title: Constant “suggested” (dare I say) propaganda
review:
First of all, I haven’t been able to open the app on my phone in weeks, even after updates. Even before that, I was on the verge of leaving.
The problem is that FB is constantly “suggesting” pages to me. I recently changed this, but I previously had my political view listed on my profile as “conservative” and my religion as Catholic (don’t ask me why I did this; I was 14 when I got one). Starting about a year and a half or so ago, I’ve constantly gotten suggestions for posts bashing Christians, pages for LGBT or pro-choice groups, condom and birth control ads, and incessant lingerie ads. The closest suggestion, which shows my religion was definitely be looked at, was “Birth control even the pope would approve of!” for some NFP app. I asked them to stop showing me these sorts of things several times but it didn’t stop. Since I noticed and got rid of the political view and religion listing, it has stopped (except the lingerie ads). What the hell?

title: Later update broke scrolling
review:
I can see how elements of the feed now load dynamically as you scroll, presumably to make the feed load faster. However this has made scrolling the feed, and therefor using the app, incredibly frustrating. Now when scrolling the feed randomly expands in spots as content loads so the feed is now jumping around while scrolling. Also, touching the feed while scrolling in order to stop on a post to read it now doesn’t work 50% of the time, presumably because touching an area where content is being dynamically loaded no long registers as a touch. This means I keep seeing stuff show up while scrolling and then when I put my finger down to stop scrolling it just keeps going and I have to tap again and then scroll back to see what I missed.

The app is basically unusable now, or at best massively frustrating to use.

Do better.

title: FACEBOOK OFFERS ABSOLUTELY NO CUSTOMER SUPPORT
review: I’ve had Facebook for many years with no problem.  Then while on vacation my account was hacked and taken over.  I was locked out while they wreaked havoc on my two business pages as well as my personal page. They then started running Facebook ads that were charged to my PayPal account.  Rather than helping me retrieve and recover my account, Facebook sends me a message and said my account has been disabled because I went against their community standards, what?  I tried for two weeks to contact Facebook and report that my account was hacked and got absolutely no help.  Then I got messages stating that I disagreed with them (?) and their decision cannot be reversed, and that I could no longer have Facebook.  My business pages are still visible to the public and I can’t control them.  Shame, shame, shame on you Facebook for not having any kind of customer support whatsoever!!!

title: Terrible
review: Someone hacked my account and was trying to sell a car.  People was messaging me about the car and I was quickly messaging back stating it was a scam and attempted to change my password at the same time.  In the process, the hacker was able to delete my phone number from the account, my email, and ultimately, delete my FB account of 12 years. No Facebook help, nothing to help fix this problem.  Once I got over that (loosing all of my memories, pictures, videos, and people who I’ve kept up with for years), I attempted to make another account, which was a headache itself. Once I successfully made another account (mistake), it logged me in as a April Davis.  Which is definitely not my name I had set to be logged into the account. I have no idea where it even got this name from.  Facebook has became a joke and I’m over it before something worse happens like my bank account of something get hacked bc of Facebook.

title: Just don’t download Facebook.
review: This app uses inflammatory posts to keep users engaged. If someone has posted something negative that may upset the user, you can be sure that post will pop up first on your feed. If you have dated someone in the past and they’ve recently posted and you’ve been an inactive user, you might expect to see more of that person's activity on your feed. Basically whatever keeps a user engaged the most, will be utilized here. Most of the time negative posts or fake news will engage people the longest, and pitting people against eachother in that way makes for even more engagement. Facebook is hardly about socialization anymore. If you want to socialize virtually, text someone. Make a group chat with your family, send a text to someone you haven’t talked to in awhile. The level of psychological manipulation this app has managed to reap on the world the past few years is astonishing.

title: Censoring a Cancer Warrior donating masks?!
review:
The day we all agree is the day fascism wins. Let us share opposing beliefs and stop censoring those that don't fit your agenda. 

May 2020 I decided to sew homemade masks to keep me occupied while I was healing from my 2 year breast cancer battle. I decided to only donate them, specifically to frontline workers in need. The demand was huge, because there was a shortage of masks due to the pandemic. I decided to set up a Business Page on FB to help with the ordering process. This works great for a few weeks until I wake up one morning with a warning from FB saying that I violated its community standards for trying to profit off of a crisis. They put my personal profile on a YEAR LONG RESTRICTION ghosting all of my posts. Making it so that many friends and family were no longer getting updated on my cancer journey. I attempted to appeal to no avail. I'm only here to blow up the truth now! Which FB is doing everything possible to cover up!

title: WORST APP!  WONT WORK AND FB WILL NOT HELP
review:
Have spent years building up an account.  As of about a month ago, my mobile app will not log me in.  Constantly tells me there was an error and to “try again”.  I have deleted and reinstalled the app.  Updated the app.  Reset network settings.  Updated iPhone. Cleared cache...etc.

My profile when accessed from a desktop works just fine, but the mobile app is used for work to post from the phone regarding real estate.  So now it’s pointless. 

When I check my history regarding disciplinary actions or suspension, there are ZERO negative marks (just in case I was unable to access for committing the Facebook violation of not praising the opticians they prop up).

I have also emailed Facebook, an estimated 10 times now by way of direct email to marketing/advertising as well as help submissions.  All requests have been ignored.  Not a single person has reached out in ANY way.  

Facebook used to be a way to connect with friends, family, and clients... now it’s just a face of an old program that focuses entirely on stifling differing views and pushing social causes.  They care about yo advertising dollars IF you’re politically in line with them.  Otherwise, they could care less if you just want to advertise your business or connect with the people you spent years getting back in touch with.  

I’d be embarrassed to work for a company like this these days.

title: Fix my notifications!!!!!!!!
review: For 2 days now my notifications are not showing up in the facebook app. The bell at the bottom does not show the number AND when I click on the bell icon to pull up the notification screen it will not load or refresh to show any new notifications. The last ones it shows is from a day ago. Now, if I go to my personal page (not my feed) and look at things I posted etc, I can see if there are likes and comments- which there are! They just do not show up as a number on the bell or on the notification page. I can post and share all day long….. but doesn’t really matter if I can’t receive notifications and I have to go hunting on my page to look! I have also check every setting, restarted phone, offloaded app, deleted app, reinstalled app, checked as much as I can think of! Nothing- FIX THIS FACEBOOK

title: Unreliable when checking facts
review:
The app appears to monitor opinions as facts, items for which there are clear distinctions. Being a social platform, the app tends to treat statements from Conservative users as if they are always being stated factually rather than as the opinion of the poster. 
Once that is done, the app has a tendency to auto-post arguments which, themselves, are opinions in nature but stated as facts by the app. 
Unfortunately, this prevents fluid use of the app for actual “socializing.” The pop-ups slow the process of my connecting with my online friends. It defeats the purpose of actually even HAVING the app a a “social” platform.
New, ACTUAL fact-checkers (those who have performed supporting research) would be a definite upgrade. However, the problem is not being addressed and and incident seem to be exponentially increasing the longer the social platform is used by the general public.
It’s good for a laugh, but is more like censorship of speech in many aspects. There ARE better platforms out there.

title: Censorship!
review: This app is awful. Why? Because the manipulate you. How many times do we have to hear about things like changing the algorithm for some users to show them only negative things to see their reactions, personal information gleaning for nefarious purposes and now filtering news? Who is sick of seeing their memes filters as fake news by fact checkers? Why are we to Karan this of our posts being amended to add a link to media prediction of elections results when the election has yet to be certified? Why are we ok with Facebook and unknown fact checkers filtering what is ok to see and what isn’t?  This is censorship’s and it’s a very dangerous game. Read history. Learn about times when entities controlled the information the public had access to. This is NOT ok!  We need to demand that Facebook be a fair platform. A place where truth and honesty can live. A place where we can learn all sides of a situation, but just the side that Facebook wants you to see. Until that can happen, this app is crap.

title: Like moving into a police state
review:
This app used to be ok.  They have now decided that it is their job to check all of your opinions and comments to see if they violate the liberal orthodoxy of the moment.  If they do, you are either fact-checked or suspended.   I don’t get it.   People voluntarily are your “friends” on this app.   They can “unfriend” you any time that they would like.   Why does Facebook feel it necessary to “protect” your friends from your opinions?   It is insulting and ridiculous.  
Additionally, they recently decided that what you REALLY want to see are paid advertisements and group posts.   Warning: Don’t become too fond of the groups that you are in.   They are likely to disappear at any moment.  Someone in the group may write about one of the forbidden topics (Hunter Biden or election fraud) and the group will be gone down George Orwell’s memory hole.
If you want to be told what to think and how you should say it- move in with your Grandmother.   There is no reason to go on Facebook.

title: My fb account was removed for no reason.
review: So on October 1st fb changed their terms and on October 12th they removed my whole account. I had not posted anything that went against their terms. The only thing that would have caused this is being in a group that supports right wing thinking. This is censorship at the highest level. I have tried contacting them, and no way to do so. Everything is now gone. No fb jail, no warning, nothing.... pictures of my kids over the last 11 years are gone. Pictures of my family over the 11 years gone. We do not have freedom of speech. I will be joining a class action law suit against the company. This app has taken away our first amendment. That’s against the law. Heads up people. Do not put your personal pictures on here because they will take it away if you join a group of freedom thinkers. I along with many of my friends are in this boat. They will also be joining me in the class action law suit.

title: No Support
review: I’ve had FB for years. It was hacked and stolen through another app. I followed all FB recovery methods several times with no luck, no support, no replies. I sent my acct info, the info the hacker changed everything to, verified friends and still nothing from FB. FB doesn’t care. I’m disappointed and angry that FB took no interest in retrieving my acct for 2 reasons. 1. My home burned down and the only photo’s and memories I have are there. My kids are grown and my parents passed. So, thank you FB for allowing some guy from the Ukrain to take that away from me and keep it. 2. While I know nothing is safe these days, I thought at the very least, there would be support to assist in fighting thieves. But FB doesn’t provide anything past promoting their own agendas and being the most popular social media platform in the world. There needs to be more to it than just being popular. You also need to be helpful and care about your sheep once you’ve herded and corralled them.

title: I can’t see comments
review: Why can’t I see my own comments? Why can’t I see comments I’m tagged in? I use to be able to click on a notification that I was tagged in a comment and be directed right to my friends comment. Now I’m in the dilemma that when I click the notification it takes me to everyone else comments and not my friends. The setting is on most relevant and has not changed. I turn it to new and still nothing so I have to use messenger to tell her I saw her comment. I have to click newest and if it’s an older comment and a lot of people replied I can’t access it. I’ve reported this everyday. I need help. If most relevant says I see my friends comments and top why am I not seeing theirs. Why does it say see friends comments on most relevant and I can’t see mine. IVE BEEN SENDING IN A REPORT EVERYDAY THESE PAST TWO MONTHS AND HAVENT GOTTEN ANY HELP. it’s on my laptop and my mobile devices.

title: Facebook makes me ill.....
review: Both mentally and physically (more than I already am/was before facebook) Right now I am deactivated..... (probably won't last long).... I wish facebook was never born. If facebook was a baby? Then it should have been aborted because it's an abomination. I normally like things that most people would deem as "evil".... but this? I just can't get behind it.... it's not "evil in a cool way".... it's actually evil in a lame way... Deactivation Day is on June 15th if anyone cares. That's a day where I'm trying to get the entire world to deactivate Facebook for 24 hours. Though I feel like Don Quixote. Give it a shot maybe? Lets get some of our humanity back..... Anyone out there resent Facebook like me? I mean the "Legacy Contact" cornering when you choose to "deactivate". The "30 friends limited newsfeed" etc..... the list goes on and on. They are trying to make us define our own sense of mortality and human communication with Facebook. We are mortal, we will communicate without Facebook.

title: App continuously has bugs
review: When trying to access admin functions for a group on a specific post, you are presented with functions for no -admins (such as reporting the post to the group admin). If you view the post in the actual group (and not from search results or in your feed) then admin options are available. Facebook profiles of friends and non-friends continue to be cut off here and there. The cover photo will be very short and underneath the “friends” you see blank. Viewing these same profiles from a desktop there are none of these issues and all posts are available so this is not a “restricted” thing. The answer Facebook seems to have is uninstall and reinstall but I feel like that’s a lazy cop out. Fix your app. UPDATE: Uninstalling and reinstalling does not fix this issue.

title: Chp
review:
Constantly getting account restrictions because I started a new account from an old account and constantly getting restricted for posting likes and comments. This is beyond excessive with restricting speech and interaction with my friends. Facebook, why don’t you go after porno pages and people, pages and people who condone violence , animal cruelty and bullying. 
Even if you try to call their 800 number hotline, you’ll get someone who has a heavy accent and you can not understand what they’re talking about. Next that agent will tell you to get Anydesk app to get resolved. Right! Then on your iPhone they will tell you to open your iPhone wallet. This to me is highly suspicious. title: Facebook will be history soon if they keep restricting accounts for no good reason
review: I am a longtime legitimate user. I now have a group with 6K followers. I am constantly communicating with my members in my group. I am so tired of being restricted and banned for hours and days for sending over 100 messages daily. And now worse yet. Facebook is bias, and not allowing me to even communicate with my own members in messenger if we’re not Facebook friends. Additionally they are restricting me from communicating with my members by messenger even when we are friends, but haven’t communicated for a while via messenger. In other words, I can’t get a messenger message through to my own friends & members unless they send me one first. I am so tired of it. I am already in the process of using new platforms. I am sure others will too. Wake up facebook or you’ll end up being history. Meanwhile, I’ll expect you to unrestrict my account now. Thank you

title: Two-Face book
review: I enjoyed Facebook for a number of years until Donald Trump became our President. Since that time Facebook has begun censorship of just about anything and as old at 8 years or more to block us from posting our true thoughts and actions. Now it’s just for liberal people who fill our feed with hateful comments that NEVER go against community standards. I was put in jail there twice for the same picture which never should have been rejected. Then all of a sudden, the same picture is fine by them. Facebook is probably okay if you have nothing to say unless but if you have thoughts, unless it praises the Leftists , you will at the very least be censored or put in Facebook jail. There are glitches all over that are not corrected. I’ll be posting real thoughts and values on another social media platform. You know the one and in invite you to join me on that site which begins with a “P”.  Good luck to us all.

title: And the way you’ve harassed me…..
review: You got into a bad habit of restricting me. And now, that’s what you’re doing to my messenger too. I spend more time restricted from these apps than I spend enjoying them. I admit- 2 times I said something I shouldn’t have. Years ago. Since 2020 it’s been back to back to back… I’m a legally disabled single parent, I don’t get out much esp since covid. To some of us, our social media connections are extremely important as they're the extent of social interaction. Everything I do is connected to my Facebook, that’s how I wanted it. But not now. The latest? You’ve now restricted me for a month for wanting to share with my following, the statistics on fatal road rage incidents in my country. It’s better serving my community to make them aware. And my followers wld rather know than not know. That said, do you think an average person wld roll the dice with one of her 3 connections to the world, in times of pandemic? Hard pass.

title: Fact Checkers Book
review: Let’s be realistic. If a company as big as Facebook gets ultra political and treats people poorly, those people aren’t going to be happy about it. I’m sick of them pushing propaganda news articles in my feed and then censoring ANY and all Republican friends and family of mine. I want to see what my friends have to say. NOT Buzz feed, MSM and 100 different Adds. I kept the app for now but am using it less and less. TikTok, parler, telegram, Slyde, clouthub.. just saying. There are other options out there. We don’t have to put up with how they treat us. Just this week I was censored from sending a video on their messenger app. So I created a telegram group with those same friends and moved. Like I said, using it less and less. You should too! Do not recommend. (Not to mention, they have allowed child porn pages that I’ve reported but then delete “save the children pages” that I was a part of. Now you know where they stand. )

title: Violation of privacy and not fully accessible
review:
The app will expose you to trolls who want to hack your account and steal your information and get your grandmother to send them all their money to a foreign account. You’ll report them and they’ll tell you this doesn’t violate their standards. You’ll see paid advertising promising you amazing products that are falsely advertised.  You’ll report them and get a reply that they too do not violate their standards.  
But if you post your opinion or even some facts that go against anything that they see fit, they will delete your account, and you will lose access to everything you saved there. Your photos and memories are all gone. 
There are functions you can only do on Facebook on a computer and it would be great if this app would be the same across the board. I can’t add apps to a group, that’s one small example. 

I have to grab a computer and have that handy al the time.

title: Facebook has lost its relevance
review: There are too many updates that add features I don’t want. Too much censorship—someone I know was threatened with Facebook jail because she talked about a game she plays with her pet attacking it’s stuffed toy—silly and wholesome, not a threat to anyone. Too little control over what I see and what I don’t see. Completely inappropriate ads, not mistargeted, just vulgar and gross. And even though I have blocked access to my phone data, somehow Facebook always knows what I’ve looked up online and starts feeding me crap related to it. If I see someone post about a place, food or disease I have never heard of, exit Facebook and look it up, suddenly I’ll be flooded with junk on it. Even though I clicked nothing on Facebook. There is no respect for users, their preferences or beliefs. I’m honestly tired of being told what to do, who to friend (almost all strangers) and where my interests should be, especially when it comes to really filthy content they let people advertise.

title: Facebook = The Ministry of Truth
review:
“Who controls the past controls the future. Who controls the present controls the past.”

Facebook had decided to take not a page from 1984 but the entire novel and treat it as a how-to-guide as they exert powers of censorship and unpersoning people determined to be guilty of thought crimes by faceless, nameless judges. 

There is a lot of talk about repealing section 230 and it’s a shame President Trump didn’t do anything about it when he had a chance.  But that doesn’t go far enough,  social media platforms have be one the new public square and denying someone access can destroy a life or business.

Social media platforms need to be designated as public utilities by the federal government and remove any legal right or power social media companies have to deplatform, ban, and shadow ban people with criminal penalties for violations.   If people don’t want to be exposed to certain ideas or thoughts, allow them the power to individually mute people.

But these digital oligarchs deciding who can or cannot speak and decide who can be members of the public sphere is absolutely unconscionable.  This will in no way help the current state of affairs in America.  This will only further Balkanize people and create deep seated grievances among people and inflame the situation. 

People are calling President Trump a dictator.  A dictator can not be censored. The one doing the censoring is the dictator.  This censorship can not stand.

title: Notifications and Feed
review: Notifications and the feed have been broken on iOS for a couple months now on my iPad Pro 11. Updates with no noticeable differences.  I’ll see the same post higher up in my feed for days or a week at a time.  The notifications are even worse. Definitely not getting them in real time and I can check one then go back to check the rest and they will be completely missing and in a different order like I had seen earlier in the day. Then it will show me a correct list of notifications randomly after.   It’s not so much about algorithms, I truly believe it’s censorship software causing issues.  Try and tell me their developers can’t address this in an instant.  I also believe the growing advertising boycott is about censoring in favor of agenda.   A completely rebuilt interface with a transparent security/data section is needed to save what’s left.   Change is good.

title: Dark Mode for Main App
review:
It’s infuriating that Instagram (owned by FB) and Messenger (owned by FB) both have functional dark mode options, but the main app doesn’t. For those of us with photosensitivity, it’s an accessibility/disability issue that needs to be addressed immediately. Yes, I am aware that I can invert the colors for my whole device, but that’s not the point, nor is it a good solution because it causes other issues for the photosensitive. The worst thing for me as an extremely photosensitive chronic migraineur is going from one app that is in dark mode to another one that does not support it nor have the option to turn it on and off within the app. 

Facebook clearly knows how to implement this technology because they have done it very well for Instagram and Messenger. So please get on the ball with the main app ASAP! Those of us with disabilities related to photosensitivity and/or vision are very tired of waiting for you to catch up!

title: Absolutely Horrible
review: Their lack of care for security and their users in general is honestly sickening. They have no customer service email, a phone number that has you stay on the line just to say they don’t provide mobile customer support, and no online support in general — only a useless “help center” in which they answer generalized questions. I got my account stolen by a hacker who changed all of my information and even when I went through the long process of identification with three friends, I never got the text to my original phone number helping me regain access. I tried every other way to contact, even via a last attempt Instagram message, but still no response or even acknowledgement. I have heard plenty other stories similar to mine, but this happening to me personally has opened my eyes. They don’t care about their users safety, privacy, or well being in general. Be careful where you are putting your information.

title: Worse and worse
review: This is so ridiculous. Notifications never take me to the post mentioned, can’t ever find anything. Can’t sort my newsfeed like other sites. Cover photo is hidden by profile photo. Don’t get me started on how bad messenger search is right now. Why is it the biggest companies have the worst products and people just keep using them anyway? Thank goodness this is free or I’d be gone in a flash. Volunteering for an animal rescue is what keeps me here for now. Update COME ON Facebook! Fix the iPad app. I can no longer share anything to groups or any other than “share to friends”. Now I can’t select a friend’s name to go to their page from a group because all you show me is the group posts they’ve made and no option to see their actual page. I keep wondering how it can get worse. Thanks for answering that. If I didn’t work with a dog rescue, I’d be so done

title: You guys don't care anymore‼️‼️‼️
review:
1) because people have been using FB since the beginning of Internet.. You have accumulated quite the following. Is that the goal here? Numbers? Because I see a lot of people that are really unhappy and I also see nothing people mention is getting fixed. Plain careless.
2) when I open Facebook..I see hundreds of ads. It's hard to read between each friends post when they're all ads between almost every post I want to see. Can't the ads go somewhere else not in the feed? I'm not sure how it is set up on a PC or laptop but I phone is set up terrible. Ad world.
3) as mentioned by several others..I also despise seeing mixed up posts. One from 2 weeks ago following one from 2 minutes ago then another ad then a post from 1 week ago... That's rediculous. Between the feed time frames and ads it's just more of a issue to use FB then a pleasure. 
4) lastly... I've been a FB user since the beginning. Over the years I've accumulated a big chunk of " likes and things/people I follow" 
So wen I'm going thru the list of all this trying to  UN-follow.. Why can't we just be able to do that by highlighting a bunch at once not having to go to each page to unfollow? It is such a pain in myass!!! 
**FB is no longer fun" that's my opinion. 
Snapchat, Twitter and Instagram have a much better platform. Learn from your reviews that people want change.

title: Pathetic
review: I’ve used Facebook for many years. Now after all these years Facebook decided my family name isn’t appropriate for their network. Let me say that again OUR LEGAL LAST NAME IS NOT ALLOWED. We have had this last name for generations, and should not be questioned. We have dealt with harassment about our name our entire lives and now “professionals” are harassing us. This is inappropriate and unacceptable as a social platform who claims to be accepting you don’t even allow our legal last name? Facebook claims we HAVE to send them photos of our ID’s which not everyone is comfortable with sending a photo of their identification to a platform that is likely to be hacked and has been involved in controversies. If our profiles are very obviously real people with many relatives (with the same last name mind you) how would we be assumed to be fake? My entire family is considering leaving the platform and taking a stand due to this. Everyone we talk to about this is saying the same.

title: Crashtastic, yet again
review:
Latest update (July 2018) repeats exactly the same problem as in February 2016 (below), though now on iPhone 8+. Does nobody test this app?

Update again: Latest update (Feb 5, 2016) has made the app nonfunctional on 6S+. It starts to load, then closes. Repeatedly. I've restarted the phone, deleted and redownloaded the app, still the same. Basically, they released an update that doesn't work. Anybody ever heard of testing? Neither Facebook nor Apple should have let this update through. 

Update: Latest update (update for iOS 9) makes the app freeze constantly. Since iOS 9 was available in beta for weeks, there's no excuse for this. Plenty of time to test and fix the app, but that apparently wasn't done. 

Previously: The most recent update feels like a giant step backward: the app is now excruciatingly slow and freezes up regularly. Pictures take a long time to load or often won't load at all. Photos I post take a long time to show up, or occasionally don't show up at all. Not sure what they did that constituted an update, but these downgrades in functionality are very frustrating.

And the app still changes my news feed to "top stories" despite my choosing "most recent." I am not interested in Facebook's idea of what I should want to see; I want a chronological feed. When I choose that option from the settings, I would like it to stay chosen.

Seriously what is going on with this app? I literally updated my Messenger and Facebook and it literally logged me out of my own account. I can no longer login to my own Facebook account. I have tried to verify my account through my mobile number and it’s still not working. I’ve never had this problem I’ve never been logged out of my own account. No, I obviously haven’t been hacked, but the fact that I still can’t get into my account even through my mobile number since this new update is completely frustrating. Any update has went back to the old update where it takes so long to try and log into your account I was literally on a spinning, frustrating cycle for less than three or four minutes before I was able to even know it wouldn’t let me log into my own account. I honestly don’t know what is going on with these updates, but please stop messing with messenger 😔

title: Needs so much work
review:
Whenever I am in the middle of commenting on something, if someone starts talking to me, I put my phone down, then when my pick up my phone to finish commenting, Facebook reloads and I’ve lost my comment and the post that I was commenting on. Forget about ever finding it again because any posts you’ve seen won’t show up again. Also, get rid of the stupid fact-checking! Someone will dispute anything even if all that’s wrong is something as stupid as someone’s hair color! And it is all so one-sided. The only thing fact checked is anything that doesn’t line up with liberal views.

Update: several of my friends have been hacked by clicking on a “just died” link. So I decided to warn all my friends not to click it and guess what Facebook does!? They RESTRICT me!  Now I can’t post photos or comment on certain groups for a week. And there’s nothing on my account that says why I was restricted.

title: Horrible!
review: I have tried every which way to change my password for an account and I CANNOT!! I’ve tried logging out and it tells me the email cant be found with an account when it is linked to it. Type in account name and it says choose method to login, enter password is the only option. I click forget password and instead of allowing me to change the password it takes me back to enter password. In my account settings under privacy there isn’t even a change password option. I went to the account center and got as far as change password and it said “Try current password” in order for me to change it, after I already clicked forgot password on the previous page where it asked for current password. It keeps asking for the old password when I obviously cannot remember it and I’m trying to change it. This is not accessible, annoying, and unorganized!

title: Unpublished and unable to promote my page
review: I posted a State Journal article that was in the state paper written about my business’ Grand Opening last week and Facebook unpublished my page, it came back online but I am unable to like, post, update photos, events or respond to customers. Facebook has zero customer support at all to resolve the issue and gave me no fair warning prior to my post that they would take this action. In the meantime my ads that were set for a 14 mile radius were being charged for responses and imprints from as far away as South Carolina, Florida, Connecticut. of the over 8000 only 350 were even from my home state:(  I have since cancelled all of my advertising campaigns and boosts until there is an explanation and resolution for this absolute fraudulent behavior by Facebook. Namely refund me my advertising dollars asap. Maybe this review will bide attention from anyone at Facebook or Meta that cares about its users… Not Happy😡

title: DEACTIVATING ACCOUNTS AMERICA
review: The worse social media app ever. They using biometric data, Name and face recognition to target it’s consumers. Facebook DTPA (Deceptive Trade Practices Act) violators, constitutional violators of religious beliefs and freedom of speech. title: Why Facebook is bad

Facebook is a platform that has faced significant backlash in recent years due to concerns about user privacy, data breaches, and the spread of misinformation. In addition, Facebook has been accused of promoting addictive and harmful behavior by creating algorithms that prioritize engagement over user well-being. Critics argue that this has led to a toxic online environment that is rife with harassment, hate speech, and other forms of online abuse.

I don’t even realize they are posting bc all I see are ads and group posts, even when I tell Facebook to unfollow groups, they keep showing up. Update: It has gotten even worse. This week, the majority of the posts I see are “Suggested for You,” one after another after another. I keep selecting “show less,” and the suggested posts dominate my feed. I have hundreds of friends in Facebook, follow several active groups, and all I see are suggested and sponsored pages. It is terrible. It won’t be long before I stop using this platform if this is all I see. I want to see my friends’ and groups’ posts.

Comments are automatically Top Comments or most recent, which is aggravating because i jest want to see them all. And almost all the posts i see are 2-4 days old. The team door Facebook truly need to make an update that focuses on these issues because although it says they are improving bugs and glitches, it feels like it is creating more. Not a good experience with this app any longer.

It gets posted to my feed that I updated my banner, but I still see the old one at the top of my home page. 

Other than annoying glitches, I appreciate having access to such a comprehensive social media platform!

title: Major Data Security Issues
review:
Over the years, Facebook has been involved in numerous data privacy and security controversies. The most notable one was the Cambridge Analytica scandal in 2018, where it was revealed that a political consulting firm had gained unauthorized access to data of millions of Facebook users without their consent. The data was then used for targeted political ads during the 2016 U.S. presidential election.

In addition to the Cambridge Analytica scandal, Facebook has also faced criticism for various other data privacy and security issues. For instance, in 2019, it was reported that Facebook had stored millions of user passwords in plain text, which meant that the passwords were easily accessible to Facebook employees.

Moreover, Facebook has been accused of sharing user data with third-party apps without users' knowledge or consent. In 2021, it was reported that personal data of over 500 million Facebook users was leaked online, including phone numbers, email addresses, and other personal information.

Overall, Facebook's history of data privacy and security issues has raised concerns among users and regulators worldwide. While Facebook has taken steps to improve its data privacy and security practices, it remains important for users to be cautious about sharing their personal information online.

The constant barrage of political posts and arguments has made Facebook an exhausting and divisive platform, with users often finding themselves more frustrated and isolated than connected. title: Facebook collects more data than anyone, why is Tiktok under fire?

Facebook has been a controversial platform for years, and for good reason. While it claims to connect people and build communities, it has become a breeding ground for hate speech, misinformation, and polarization.

One of the biggest issues with Facebook is its impact on privacy. The platform collects vast amounts of data on its users, often without their knowledge or consent, and uses this data to target advertising. This raises serious concerns about how this data is used and who has access to it.

Moreover, Facebook has been criticized for its role in spreading fake news and propaganda, which can have serious consequences for individuals and society as a whole. The platform has been used to influence elections, incite violence, and spread harmful conspiracy theories.

Facebook's addictive design is another major concern. The platform is designed to keep users hooked by using algorithms that show them content they are likely to engage with, even if it is not true or healthy. This has led to increased rates of depression, anxiety, and other mental health issues among users.

Overall, Facebook's negative impact on society far outweighs any potential benefits. It's time to reconsider our use of this platform and explore alternative ways to connect and communicate online.

It's 2020 and the below gripe still holds true and now I have an additional one (I know, so demanding) but when exactly do you plan on supporting a dark mode that's easier on the eyes? I don't expect this to be answered nor do I expect actual, release-specific detail on your updates sadly.

Horrible platform! I’m slowly downloading what I can and am soon deleting everything FB related.

title: Honest review

Facebook has become a major disappointment in recent years. What was once a platform for connecting with friends and family has turned into a breeding ground for negativity and hate speech. The site's algorithms seem to be designed to show users more of what they want to see, regardless of whether it's accurate or not.

The rampant spread of misinformation on Facebook has led to real-world consequences, from the manipulation of political elections to the spread of dangerous conspiracy theories. The site's lax policies on fact-checking and content moderation only exacerbate the problem.

Furthermore, Facebook has become a haven for cyberbullying, with users frequently attacking others behind the anonymity of their screens. Despite the company's efforts to combat this issue, it persists and continues to harm countless individuals.

Privacy is another major concern on Facebook, with the company's track record of mishandling user data well-documented. From the Cambridge Analytica scandal to countless data breaches, it's clear that Facebook puts profit over its users' privacy.

Overall, Facebook has become a toxic environment that has done more harm than good. Its negative impact on society cannot be ignored, and users should seriously consider whether the benefits of the platform are worth the risks.
