I can’t pause any live videos, and I get plagued by the bug I just mention above. This is very annoying. I feel like this is also intentional because no one wants to watch their ads 1/10th of the way in of a video. Cause the ads will still play with this. 

Among others, the scrolling has slight issues.  I could keep going on. It even a hassle to view pages. Please remove this new addition. Bugs may be features, but not all features are good.

title: Version 253
review: I’ve been having a lot of problems ever since the update to 253: I can only scroll about 10 posts on my newsfeed and it won’t load anymore. If I refresh (when I can actually get it to refresh), it loads the same 10 posts at the top, but suddenly it loads 10 more posts toward the bottom. 80% of the time, it won’t connect to Facebook itself and says “Something went wrong, please try again”. I close out the app, give it an hour or so, and open again—The same 10 posts show up! Honestly, I thought it was my WiFi, but it does the same over LTE. I’ve uninstalled, reinstalled; closed all other programs when running; made sure no one else was running anything over our WiFi; etc. My husband has the exact same phone, but he’s running the previous version still and has 0 problems. I urged him to not update until it’s fixed, and I urge you to do the same.

title: Privacy settings
review: Every few updates privacy updates revert. Why is my active status always turned back on. Why do they come up with a new or different version of the same setting in each version that if you don’t check Every. Single. Time. You’re bound to be giving your info somewhere. Shady practices as usual. The norm for FB. Just use fake info that’s really the only way to keep your profile “private” but know you’re information is never “secure”. Their security, marketing and ad changes are never listed in the updates page and as soon as you click update they can glean a whole new fresh batch of info about you to sell and share without your knowledge. Standard FB “best practice” “you privacy matters” what a joke! Do yourself a favor delete now avoid the lame marketing and ads, fake news, privacy violations and just go SEE your friends, invite them over for game night, call them.

title: Way too many ads and petitions on my page so much spam!!!! Also the saved option is horrible!!!!!!
review:
Way too many ads and petitions on my page so much spam!!!! Also the saved option is horrible!!!!!! What I mean by that is that over the days month years I have saved many many things and I would like to delete most of them but having to delete it one by one is annoying and frustrating and most of the time when I do delete some it’s has a malfunction and and it’s actually not deleted!
Can you pleaaaaaase fix this! Make a option where you can delete all the ones you want kind of like when you check all the ones that you want to delete with your email make a option where you can check all the ones you want to delete!
Also I barely ever see my friends post because all the spam like ads and petitions and a bunch of pages I may or may have not liked!

title: Unhappy mother of 3 and one to be
review: I used to like FB... and then I had children! I have asked my friends and family members to not put my children on FB because anyone can have a Facebook page no matter if they have a past not conducive to see children or not. Of course most of my family members respect my wishes but there are some that do not and still put my children on their FB pages, and what a joke it is to get those pictures taken off. The FB process never allows you to speak to ANYONE and guess what FB wants all kinds of information-personal information- to even go through the process of having the pictures removed and THEY NEVER ARE REMOVED!! So be careful what you allow ur friends family and even urself to post of FB bc it will be there until that person removes it, and that usually never happens. Anyone can have a FB page and in our world that’s scary!! If I could give FB no stars I would!

title: Deactivation/Deletion is bugged.
review: Facebook was kinda lame for replacing MySpace when I first joined. Some years later it became probably the most successful social media website. Things became fishy once it switched to timelines and cover photos. The more customizable feature of cover photos seemed like it would begin to become more customizable like MySpace. Despite not having a customizable webpage, Facebook was pretty good. Now my feed is clogged with ads that aren’t even commercial. I am a multiple account user and have deactivated and deleted past accounts. Coming back to a worse Facebook than ever, I am trying to deactivate/delete my open account, and am writing a review hoping the update enables me to do so. I am having trouble deactivating/deleting what will likely be my final account unless there is an emergency.

title: Now I see
review: The other day I went on an arbnb site away from Facebook on another device and upon me searching Facebook popped up with suggestions of Airbnb you guys might not share our info but definitely get it from somewhere else and it’s so unsettling I use Facebook to laugh and catch memes but am considering calling it quits and enjoying real life. You guys have turned into your worst enemy and nightmare. This platform was suppose to be controlled by the user and not the other way around anyways hope more and more people can follow this and live a Facebook free life. Because let’s me really do we really need that invasion of privacy. Or do I really need to reopen my app every 2 minutes because your developers aren’t up to par with usage. Naaaa Facebook was taken to the stand for a reason if only there were people who understand it a little more asking the question instead of these old timers that were chosen

title: Fake news and the legalized theft and misuse of your private information
review:
Interested in seeing disturbing photos themes and memes blindly published and republished by your friends without them reading them, understanding them or even knowing where they originated from? Thats what buttbook is all about. Its not about seeing any original posts actually written by your friends, photo sharing, and keeping up with their lives. Nobody has time to create posts like that. And there is a cost. Every third post you see in your feed is a clever advertisement disguised to look like a post that is actually interesting or meaningful. 
Mark Zuckerberg created the leader of the new world industry based on the idea of making you believe they are providing you a service while actually they are taking advantage of you with the help of your friends and family in order to make money.
Congratulations Mark, you are a genious.

title: Absolutely hate the new video playback
review: I hate having to click on a video that’s already started autoplaying, to go to the discovery page(where it hasn’t stopped autoplaying,) and have to tap on the video a second time just so I can hear the sound. Why try to fix something that was never broken? Now I have to rewind back a few seconds just to get it to play from the beginning. It’s not a big deal, but it has me scrolling past videos more due to the annoyance of having to tap it a second time after the next screen loads. Maybe have it go full screen so it plays with sound and then bring you to the discovery page after swiping away from the video? Either way, double tapping just to get sound on a video is tedious when we didn’t have to before.

title: Glitches on market place need to be fixed.
review: I’ve been trying to sell two of my handbags on market place for a month now, it remains at one view no matter what I do. I’ve tried deleting it and reposting it, yet no one can see it. I’ve asked friends to search it and nothing comes up. At first I thought maybe FB thought they were counterfeit, so I wrote a report to them explaining my situation, and that I posted the labels and numbers that are on my bags to prove they are real. Haven’t heard back, and still having issues. It let me post a backpack, and an old laptop since then. Yet my two handbags remain unseen and it’s very frustrating. I’ve sold all my used handbags or items on market place with no issues, so I have no idea what’s going on. Regardless, it needs to be looked into and fixed.

title: Comments in progress disappears
review:
There has been an issue for a long time, when the app refreshes, it loses track of a comment being typed.   With the latest update, I can’t even scroll back to see the original post without it losing the input box.  Some times I can get it back by clicking the left arrow (on the post) and then click “comment”.  Some times it is simply gone.  Out of four posts I’ve tried to respond to today, one was completed after “recovering” about 5 times and typing my response twice (a little different after the first text was lost, of course).  Another only took four recoveries, and two I just gave up on after losing the text multiple times.

There are plenty of other irritations, but the above issue is what prompted me to post this review.

title: Atrocious App
review: First of all, Facebook is dead. No one uses Facebook anymore, it’s always been such a confusing platform to navigate around, I’ve never liked it, never will. Everything about Facebook is entirely dated, and if you’re planning on treating it like any other social media platform, you’re going to get the worst engagement of all of them. Unless you want to pay your way to get people to see and interact with your content, that is the only way you’ll find some traction being on here. The Meta entirely just misses the point of social media. Social media is meant to engage the viewer, show the viewer exactly what they enjoy seeing and making the app easily navigable. But of course, Facebook and Instagram and geared towards pushing out content to those who are willing to pay for it. I’ve uninstalled Facebook for a while now, I never intend on ever going back on here.

title: Newsfeed
review:
The newsfeed option of most recent being changed to recent and favorites really just means there is no option to choose to see the most recent posts first. Nothing chronological about it. 
Then there is the fact that everything that doesn’t fit into facebook’s little box gets flagged by “fact checkers”. No real information provided as to why or what exactly was incorrect in the articles or posts just that “some information” is not accurate or been proven incorrect by other fact checkers. Or similar information had been proven incorrect by fact checkers. I want to see actual studies or links with the information being proven to be false not just something saying it’s not accurate based on what anonymous fact checkers are saying is true.

title: FB review
review:
There was a time when FB was interesting. A time where people could speak truth and not be censored. The bots  and algorithmic policies were not controlling content. There were no labels slapped on posts. There was no FB jail. I don’t ever look forward to it now. I open it to see if my grandkids have some pictures. It’s not a real place for communication. It’s a whitewashed fantasy land where everyone and everything has to be happy. A sort of Stepford Wives fake reality. 

What I am getting active on is twitter hoping this is a space worthy of my time. 

While I’m writing this to help you out I doubt it will be read by a human or considered as a real opinion. So look at your stock and layoff’s (which truly makes me sad for real people) and maybe you will make the changes necessary to be a place of true reality and conversation., even if you don’t like what we are talking about.

title: Horrible
review: Has Facebook been completely taken over by mindless bots? The censorship, the slaps on the wrists for really idiotic misunderstandings with grammar and context, the inability to like comments, the inability to upload videos or edit photos in stories, I could go on and on and on. Everyone hates Facebook but we have to use it because there’s not another option… yet. As soon as someone with a clear conscience who actually cares about a fair and user friendly experience, Facebook will be rendered completely obsolete. Look at all the horrible reviews. No one in my family and none of my friends actually like Facebook. It is now just a tool for personal agenda, everyone knows it and nothing is being done to fix it because it’s such a big company they don’t have to. Just another corrupt greedy company who does not care at all about it’s users.

title: I don’t understand
review: Besides basically our full life, as you already have to AOL, xanga, MySpace. This app is ideal for Facebook interactions. You have full control of what you getNotified for all privacy settings etc. formed with meta-there are more things that you can do and control ultimately you pay a price to have full control but I don’t understand the issue knowing that you’re On social media a public domain. Facebook is great on browser and app and I prefer the app because of the updates I prefer the browser because of the old formation that is still available that very much helps with networking. Give it a chance🙃

title: Refreshing unnecessarily
review: My news feed keeps refreshing like crazy!!! I can be in the middle of reading a post & all of a sudden it refreshes, back to the top so I can’t finish what I was reading/watching. So I started clicking “into” a post so I could actually finish it but then when I back out of it, the feed has refreshed again so I miss out on continuing to scroll to see what else is there. This is EXTREMELY frustrating. I understand refreshing if I close the app for an extended time or if I do it manually. But automatically doing it after no more than 2 minutes at times is annoying. Not much is posted in that short time so now I have to look through everything I’ve already seen, by the time I get to the new stuff at the bottom, it refreshes again!!! This has made me use the app much less than I usually do. Please fix this.

title: Face social interaction
review: I thought this was a great app to connect with friends and people all over the world. The messenger is great also allows us to talk or call each other. The privacy is excellent concerning who can see your profile or not is based on you and what you set your profile to either public or private. Over all I was very satisfied using this to communicate with people globally. Also family and friends can be set to private if you don’t want people stalking you or your family. There’s a little button called block users and that helps to avoid any crazy people and keep your family safe.

title: Dictated
review: Honestly could not be so unhappy with an app. The people running the app dictate everything that is seen and heard. You cannot have any opinion that differentiates from their view without having things censored, removed, or marked incorrect by what they call the Facebook fact-checkers. They prevent views on my market place page because I have Christian artwork posted. I’m completely over how controlling this app is. Not to mention the the quality of photos and videos when posted has taken a huge decline. You can no longer have good quality photos on your Facebook account. Overall, highly disappointed with how this app is ran and what part they are deciding to play in society today. Do better cause this is not acceptable and I know that multiple other people are unhappy with it too. Step up before you lose a big portion of business.

title: What happened?
review: Like many said, the platform used to be good and you were able to communicate with friends and or strangers with no real issue. But now if something is posted that goes against anything they think “goes against community standards” your comment or post will be blocked, fact checked, hidden, or you will be silenced or account suspended. The political views of the platform are also very easily shown and if you oppose them then you will be silenced. Lastly, the random issues, glitches, or hacks have been getting ridiculous. Maybe if they spent more time and money on actual Facebook then politics and silencing opposing viewpoints then things would be better. Really only use it for marketplace but I’ve had random issues with getting banned there because of glitches. I don’t see things lasting much longer before it’s the next MySpace.

title: Keeps crashing notifications do not work.
review:
I’ve reported so many issues with FB and it just non stops crashes and notifications do not work. So now I’m here writing a review because it seems like each update they do makes the app worse. Still no resolution or fix to any of these bugs I’ve mentioned and it keeps getting worse. Every time I open the app a minute later it crashes. When I comment on a post it crashes. My notifications don’t work at all for any groups I follow. When I comment on a post the notifications also don’t work for anyone who comments after. Overall it’s been awful to use and there has been no updates to make any betterment/changes to alleviate these bugs and app issues. I’ve also deleted and reinstalled the app, nothing seems to work.

Every new update seems to make it worse and worse….

title: Facebook management is a disaster
review: I have been a user forever it seems. Facebook was my favorite platform. You should be so disappointed with yourselves and the way your company is run. I have seen posts deleted from both myself and friends. These happened to be political posts. You have no right to decide what  should be censored. We live in America where every voice counts. No one has the right to silence my voice. Your fact checkers are a joke, forcing their opinions instead of doing proper research. I hold multiple degrees and that alone qualifies me as an expert on many topics. In a post I wrote I even cited 3 different sources to prove to a fact checker that they were incorrect. My post ended up being deleted. I am done with you and your platform. You need to change or you will spiral out or existence. I will also be writing a negative rating on Instagram as well.

title: Freedom of speech
review: Dear Facebook team, You are our first and most favourite application and members since the foundation of the App but recently we start live the frustration while watching you playing a big rule in the Palestinian-Israeli conflict standing with one side against the other, blocking accounts for people supporting Palestine or posting things about Jerusalem or Gaza ,where is the freedom of speech ? Where is democracy? Where is neutrality? Once you are Biased you will lose our trust ure uonlt be er Arcade Gaza ,where is the freedom of speech ? Where is democracy? Where is neutrality? Once you are Biased you will lose our trust and of course won't be sorry to remove you from our life and move to other alternative social media applications. Facebook, we like you and care about you Therefore please act now and change your policy before you lose more and more members and supporters. Thank you

title: Garbage
review: Well, Facebook used to be such a better place, but ever since I became blind, it was really good in the beginning and everything with the accessibility and stuff, it’s become very unacceptable, and does not work a lot! Plus, messenger also be the same way, what is the point of being in a conversation, and it saying an active now with the person, or active four hours ago. What is the point of having the tab active. If that’s what you’re going to make it too. I’m got a fix me now, I can’t even go on my profile, or somebody else’s with my voiceover, and go through it, because all it pronounces button, instead of what the text field and the picture actually says. I also can’t even go on Facebook dating no more, because it doesn’t even work on there right now!

title: Sad times
review: I have always loved Facebook. I loved how it kept me in touch with family that lives far away and how you can share photos and watch each other’s kids grow up. I love how I can get ideas for adventures from friends adventures. I love how we can share in each other’s excitement and grieve together in times of sadness. But the censorship and the fact checking is so horrible. You can’t have an opinion without it being fact checked or flagged as false news! It takes away from all the good Facebook can be. It really is sad times! Just because you believe differently you are constantly told you are wrong. I really hope Facebook will see so many people don’t like the censorship, so we can go back to sharing the things that really matter with our friends and family, how people can share their their own opinions without being told they are wrong for believing the way they do!

title: Boycott Facebook
review: I use to enjoy Facebook when I was 12, hop on after school chat with friends make plans for the weekend. I understand Facebook is the fastest growing social media platform out there. But lately this year 2020 so much censorship has been going on. It’s not freedom of speech anymore! It’s extremely easy for your account to get deleted, without warning. I see people post pornographic photos and then someone else post a breastfeeding photo and they go into Facebook jail! That makes no sense to me at all. To top it off all the conservatives, military, police and trump lovers are getting censored. Why?! I don’t see the other party very censored at all. Facebook has promoted bullying to kids and adults. It use to be a fun place. Also when you make a post on your own wall it says it’s being sent to a moderator! What in the world! This is absurd! Boycott Facebook. Wimkin is the new and improved Facebook! Without censorship.

title: Facebook is a disgrace....well maybe.
review:
I hate to admit it but I will credit you for this.....I was going down through the reviews and saw right wing radical idiots complaining and then saw left wing radical idiots complaining.  I guess if you’ve got extremist idiots from both sides complaining you must be doing something right anyway. 

I can’t count how many apps I have that have started doing something like this after an update.  For smaller companies it might be more understandable but for a company like Facebook to push out an update that makes their app DOA, disgraceful.  This couldn’t have been tested, at least not on ipads.  I guess I shouldn’t be surprised, under Zuckerbergs continued leadership Facebooks policies have become disgraceful so I guess I shouldn’t expect any less.  Anybody found a viable alternative to Facebook?  I’d like an app that’s not as intrusive and actually lets you have full control over your account.

title: Avatar???? Censorship????
review:
So the ability to create an avatar came out a few days ago. I have tried literally every tip and trick that I read about.... I updated and multiple times, deleted the app and reinstalled multiple times, clicked the three dots, and the see more...aaannnddd... nothing. There isn’t even anything on my app that would remotely resemble creating an avatar. Why is this option not available for everyone at the same time??? Either your offer it for everyone, or you offer it for no one.  Also don’t try to post anything that is about Coronavirus, anything conservative republican, anything anti Democrat, anything Pro Republican, or anything that shows you have a brain and can think for yourself, or anything that goes against Mark Zuckerberg’s opinion of how things should be.  It will be removed. Seriously???? Censorship at its best.

Update...  two weeks later and still no avatar. Seriously????

title: Removing old Facebook pages and information about me on them
review: I have tried so many times to get rid of old Facebook accounts and I have been unsuccessful in every way and it puts me in a bad place for the day. I end up on other pages and then it don’t stop there I end up messing up my phone with my computer and I don’t know what to do. I have either lost phone numbers or forgot the information to get back into Facebook and I have to make a new one.. I am annoyed with this app because I can’t continue to do anything about this. I don’t have any patience for this anymore I would like to know how to delete all my Facebooks and only have one.. I’m sick of searching the whole web to figure out how to stop this.. it cause more problems with this other apps. I am not good with the computer or my phone and I have a bad memory problem I wanna know how to do that so this  is one less problem. Thanks

title: Hacked every day for weeks, multiple times
review: FIX THIS NOW! So many people are having the same problem, and if you all at Facebook don’t take it seriously enough to act with a sense of urgency, it’s clear that you’re just as guilty as the hackers. I’m extremely angry and frustrated that my account gets hacked several times each day, which started 2 months ago; nothing I have done to protect my account has been successful. It’s not only having my personal information exposed to thieves that’s the only major issue such as identity theft, etc... having someone take over my account and lock me out of it in real time feels extremely violating on a very personal level. There are so many people who have had their account compromised, there must be some kind of legal action that can be taken to hold Facebook accountable for allowing such negligence; which the consequences fall unfairly on their customers.

title: Has my account been remotely taken over?
review:
I scrolled through my checkin wall and suddenly my photo appeared.  I have received 2 forwarded emails from 2 “Friends” who say my photo appeared on their walls.
A few months ago I opened an attachment in an email from an acquaintance and discovered my email was “hacked”.  I have received emails saying that this person placed a “remote administrative tool” on my account and demanded a large amount of money.  I changed my passwords on AOL Google Apple platforms and signed up with AOL security privacy Norton product.  Their scan showed my phone was free of viruses/ malware.  Then I experienced what I described on FB.
Can you suggest anything else?
Lynn Mahoney
Apple Iphone 7 and MAC user

title: Good design, privacy problems
review: I use facebook since 5 years and it has never really changed. It’s the best app to communicate with family/friends. The MAJOR problem is that they keep all that you post, record or even say without recording. It’s like a virtual Google Home. They know everything about you and sell your informations to advertisers. Every time I scroll my timeline I find advertisements about things I am looking for but never googled it... There is also in-app games which is very attractive. TOO MUCH ADS !!! I scroll the posts: ad, I watch a video: ad, I play: ad. Ok, I think that’s it.. So I advise you to use Snapchat : More privacy ! Do not download: facebook, instagram, whatsapp (there is an app called Signal which is way better and there is messages encryption). Thanks and have a nice day

title: A lot of spam, features options change without notice
review:
Getting a lot of spam friend requests from new accounts of people I don’t know. It would be good to have a way for people to have to put in a keyword or password I select for them to be able to send me a friend request. It would filter out a lot of spam and scammer accounts.

Also I don’t like how features and settings randomly get changed. If I want to read the comments on an article I want to be able to read all of them not the “Most Relevant”. And I have to change it on every article. Why can’t I permanently set the comments to “All Comments”?

Oh and the group notifications pop back on randomly and not being able to shut off all event notifications for all pages at once is irritating too.

title: They ban people unfairly
review:
I was banned for educating people on the use of slurs. The post had slurs in it and the harsh ones were censored but they were not being used to attack others, they were with definitions and used to explain to a page how said slurs are used against our community. 
I have now been banned from Facebook and they give absolutely no way for you to plead your case to a real person! 

This is not the first time. I was also banned for a day when I showed pictures from a message of someone se*ually harassing me, instead of the person who was doing it being banned, I was and was never able to tell them that I was warning my friends to block the person.

Facebook does not care about its users, it’s algorithms do all the content watches, no real people actually look over your content. And when you request a review it takes about .02 seconds meaning no person ever looks at it the algorithm just scans for key words. 
Facebook also has no help line or no way to contact anyone in the company. 

I will be pulling all of my photos from Facebook and trying to go down my profile and collect any needed posts for memories and I will be finding a new social platform.

Facebook DOES NOT care about its users and will sooner just ban the victim rather than ban the offender...

title: Disabled Account
review:
I’ve been using this app over the years both on my pc and on my mobile phone but I had the worst experience when I was chatting and all of a sudden I was logged out of my account and was asked to login using safari then I did that and was notified that my account has been disabled just because I changed my name. I uploaded a documents showing that I’m the rightful owner of the account and also the change of name document. My certificates, bank statement of account and also pictured of my debit card showing my names yet I was notified that I didn’t provide enough proof for my account to be deactivated again. 

Honestly I felt so devastated for that. I created that FB account as earlier as 2010 and just because of change of my own name I lost my account and all the memories I have saved there. I’m really heartbroken for this.

title: Annoyed.
review: A couple weeks ago I logged off my Facebook account on the app and when I tried logging back in it didn’t let me, it kept saying “error, please try logging back in” I kept trying and it kept saying the same thing it’s been almost a month now that it’s been saying that. But when I go on safari and on a computer I have no trouble what so ever. I have deleted and installed it multiple times and I’ve restarted my phone as well at deleting the data app and trying it again, none of those methods worked. I’ve turned in a help ticket on Facebook and they responded with “this feedback will help other users” but they didn’t give me no explanation on how to fix this issue. I’ve also contacted Facebook through Twitter and still haven’t heard back. I’m extremely disappointed because this is keeping me from being in contact with family I no longer see.

title: Fix your Notifications
review:
For at least the past year, I do not get half of my notifications when people comment on posts. I only get them sometimes, and on random posts I won’t get a single notification from a comment. This is not just me, I have spoken to all of my friends and this is a consistent issue with everyone. How has this still not been resolved? 

Furthermore, on multiple Samsung products, people lost their Share button for posts and cannot share anything anymore. My partner has had this on his phone for half a year now.

I feel like if you have time to prance around petitioning the ban of TikTok, you have time to fix your own app first, Zuckerberg. For a multi-billion dollar company, you’d think you could fix issues that weren’t always there in the first place.

title: Crashing
review:
I buy clothes from this online boutique and they don’t live feeds showing the clothing that they’ve restocked or the new arrivals of the day. Whenever they go live, it starts freezing and skipping (seconds into the live feed) and then a few minute in it will just stop and say broadcast interrupted causing them to start a new video; which after is fine till they’re done. But this has been going on for 2 or 3 months now and Facebook has done nothing to fix the problem or even attempt to fix the problem. Doesn’t matter if I watch on my phone or desktop/laptop it still does the same thing. Please fix this. 

Thanks.

title: Stickers keep resetting
review:
I was hoping that you guys would be aware about this issue a long time ago, but apparently nothing to fix this issue yet, so I guess you didn’t. 
Whenever there’s an update, the sticker sets will be all deleted and reset to Meep and Pusheen sets. This is very annoying since you offer lots of sets there and I use many of them, which means I have to download all of them again and again every time that an update comes out. Plus, without a convenient way to keep track of which sets were previously downloaded, it’s kinda pain in my behind to go though allllll of them again every time to find what I used or I have to type in the name of the sticker sets in the search box one by one to find them, again not very convenient.

title: UNLESS SUPPORT CENTER
review: I don’t really get it when Facebook added the help center or so called “help support “ which has been unhelpful at all. My account has been locked since 8th of this month for no reason without an option to do the verification which I can’t find any “Get started” and I have chatted the support severely and they kept saying same thing over and over again, saying click on the “get started” 🤦‍♂️ meanwhile I have clearly told them that I can’t see that section because I’m totally stocked at the Lock Screen… I don’t even know why you guys added those people there. Wait are they there to chat with me or what because if I needed to Make a chat then my family and friends are available to chat with…. Try resolve this nonsense because it’s not helping out .. and my account still remains locked with no option to unlock it

title: HACKED
review: I’m so disappointed in Facebook right now. I’ve had my account for 13 years. I had so many memories and photos in that account. I got hacked and the hacker is trying to scam my friends and family. I’ve tried to let everyone know that I’ve been hacked, but it is impossible because Facebook was my number one source of communication. What started as a dating site had turned into a life-changing way of connecting with people who lose their phones, lives, or ability to connect in other ways. 

When people pass, the page stays up and people can still write their condolences. 

It’s helped with my career too. If I see someone I look up to and we have mutual friends, I can connect with them on a personal level and the mutual friends often can show our credibility. It’s also exciting to see how many ways people are connected!

title: “Community Standards” Needs To Go
review:
I’m going to keep this as short as I can. The “Community Standards” algorithm is broken. Because it’s nothing more than a computer program, and a pretty bad one at that, far too often, people are punished for comments made with no regard to context while actual user reported hate speech goes unpunished. The appeal process, if you can even call it that, is a useless joke. Maybe if Zuckerberg wasn’t wasting billions on the Metaverse that literally no one asked for instead of firing 11,000 people, there might be the potential to actually get this problem fixed. 

 Then again, the solution is simple. Disable the auto-flag and let the algorithm only pick up user reported content. Right now, the process is nothing more than an internal police investigation. 

 Auto-Flag: punishes. 
User: disputes the punishment. 
Auto-Flag: We investigated ourselves and found we did nothing wrong. 

Of course, it doesn’t think it did anything wrong. It’s an algorithm of if/then statements with zero critical thinking. Maybe now, my critiques won’t fall on deaf ears. This does not work the way you think it does. It does more to punish dark and/or subversive humor than actual hate speech and threats of violence.

title: Unprofessional Behavior from a man throwing an adult Tantrum
review:
I am giving Facebook a 1-star review because of the recent revelations regarding Mark Zuckerberg's unprofessional conduct and questionable lobbying efforts. Here are my main concerns:

Backhanded Deals: It's been reported that Mark Zuckerberg has engaged in backhanded deals to promote Facebook's interests. This type of behavior is not only unethical but also undermines the integrity of the platform.
Lobbying for TikTok Ban: The fact that Mark Zuckerberg has lobbied Congress to ban TikTok, a competitor to Facebook, raises serious concerns about the fairness of competition in the social media space. This move not only stifles innovation but also limits consumer choice.
General Distrust: These actions contribute to a growing sense of distrust towards Facebook as a company. Users should be able to rely on social media platforms to act ethically and transparently, but Mark Zuckerberg's actions call into question whether Facebook is living up to these expectations.
I am deeply disappointed with the direction Facebook has taken under Mark Zuckerberg's leadership. The platform has the potential to be a powerful tool for connecting people, but these actions have cast a shadow over its future and it's users deserve better.

Privacy concerns: Facebook has faced scrutiny from lawmakers over its handling of user data and privacy practices. In particular, the company has been accused of mishandling user data and sharing it with third-party companies without users' consent.
Antitrust concerns: Facebook has been accused of engaging in anticompetitive practices by acquiring smaller companies and competitors, such as Instagram and WhatsApp, to maintain its dominance in the social media market.
Political influence: Facebook has been accused of allowing foreign actors to use the platform to influence elections and spread disinformation. The company has faced criticism for not doing enough to prevent such interference and for its role in spreading misinformation during the 2016 US presidential election.
Content moderation: Facebook has faced criticism over its content moderation policies and practices, with some lawmakers accusing the company of not doing enough to combat hate speech, harassment, and other harmful content on its platform.

title: So many bugs
review: Hard to believe that a corporation with so much at its disposal puts out such a flawed product. Functionality of the app is inferior to that of the desktop version. Why would this be the case when practically everyone uses their phones rather than their laptops or desktops! The app notifications are constantly glitching. You can turn on notifications for certain posts & it is anyone’s guess as to whether it will work or not. I’ve had to notify support about this bug on at least 3 separate occasions now- after the third they finally seem to have fixed the issue- but who knows how long before the same bug occurs yet again. It’s a constant guessing game as to what is going to glitch next. App is in dire need of improvement.

title: I’d like to have a public debate with a Facebook employee
review: Hello Facebook App, I’d like to invite your employees to a public debate. Preferably the employees who handle the restricting of accounts. If you decline the invite that will mean you are admitting I have won the debate and that you have no justification for restricting my account. Facebook claims that I shared “false information” but they refuse to show me what the “false information” was and how it is false. The only post that they could actually fact check me on was a post that their algorithm suggested to me. Facebook is restricting my account with no justification or explanation which effects my business and future in a negative way. If they would like to explain why they have made the decision to bully me then I will give them the opportunity to explain themselves.

title: Marketplace is unusable on iPads
review: The entire app will crash while scrolling through items in Marketplace. Also, the Marketplace local searches no longer work as they once did. If you’re looking to buy anything in Facebook marketplace, your search results will be scattered across the US. Any attempt to localize your search is now completely useless. When the app is not crashing in marketplace, it is returning results that are too far away for any reasonable consideration of purchase. It’s a shame, because marketplace was becoming a great feature. It’s now laden with power sellers who ship items with extra fees not to mention a lack of basic functionality. The App is broken with respect to marketplace. Update.........the app now crashes continuously within several seconds.

title: Terrible App, Terrible Company
review:
I’ve been on Facebook for 15 years. It’s definitely not the fun social network it was when it first started. That WSJ series of articles about Meta was eye opening. Now I only use it for marketplace or I did until yesterday. 

Apparently I’ve been banned for some reason. I dunno, I’m looking for a car so I message five different folks in a few hours. Maybe it thought I was a scammer? I guess Meta is trying to do the right thing and stop scammers.  So I request a review per the instructions.

But guess what? The links for the review don’t work. They just redirect me to articles with broken links or screens that aren’t relevant. It’s completely bogus and shocking this large of a company whose main product is this app would put out something with these obvious problems.

title: Bias
review: I have requested to have my FB account deleted twice in over two years. However, instead I keep getting emails stating my account password was just changed or someone has attempted to access to your account. They claim your account will be deleted in 30 days following your request for deletion, after six months I started receiving emails my account password was changed if it was me please access your account and change your password. I believe they do this to get you to reactivate your account so they can snatch your data while you trying to figure out how to get your account deleted. FB is the worst platform as they are so bias and controlling. If you do not agree with your ideology they remove your posting. They DO NOT engage or believe in Freedom of Speech.

title: Viewing comments on iPad freezes app
review: I don’t know why, but a little over 1 week ago anytime I try to view comments without going into the post first (Example: clicking on “1 comment”) in my Feed or anywhere within the app, the app freezes and I need to exit and restart the app.  If I go into the Post FIRST and then click Example: “1 comment” all works fine🤷🏻‍♀️ I have singed out, deleted the app, loaded it back onto the same iPad, signed back in, with the same issue.  Maybe someone can look into this???  I have reported the issue within the app 3x’s with no response or fix to date

title: Cannot unlock hacked account
review: There is zero customer service. Shame on you Facebook. The guy who hacked my account has more rights than I do and I’ve been a member since 2009. The codes they send me don’t work. The password changes come up in my recovery e mails but I get 2 screens each time: one says my account is locked and another says that I posted picture on 8/20 (over a year ago!) that goes against their standards. That’s where the screen locks and will not allow me to move forward. I’ve sent them forms of ID over 100 times and I get no response. Losing 12 years of photos and memories has been devastating. Instead of screening everything that leans right, how about using that energy to help users who, at no fault of their own, have been removed from this platform!

title: Pretending To Not Be A Publication, but Still Editing What is Said
review:
They proclaim that they are not a publication, but they control the media that we receive. They also delete the content of  legitimate media sources on this platform. 

I’m not trying to be political. I just think that suppressing major news stories that do not fit into the political ideals of those who operate the platform is immoral. This is because Facebook is public forum platform, meaning that the information presented, even if it’s by wackos, does not need to be fact checked. However, this platform essentially silenced an entire political party which is deplorable if they maintain this status. 

I am a third party supporter, so I can more easily state that in this country, there are multiple sides of a story. If a company states that it is a public forum site, it should not be able sensor an entire point of view simply because they do not agree with what is being presented. Now, it it were to assume a publication status, there is no argument from me. 

Selling their company by saying one thing, open forum platform, but doing the opposite, censorship of content, this is a false bill of sales and wildly inappropriate!

title: User Beware
review: FB is not a fun, safe, or unbiased platform anymore. I joined a number of years ago to stay in touch with family and friends throughout the world but it is not worth my time anymore. I reported a comment for telling someone to “go die in a ditch, b**ch.” FB reviewed and replied saying this speech did not go against their standards. I’ve seen repeated issues of labels or bans slapped on posts not because of being untrue, but because it did not meet a certain political agenda. FB does not uniformly allow people to use their own judgement and critical thinking skills; it is demeaning to not be permitted this right on a platform that should be unbiased. The quality of  FB has been steadily decreasing for a couple years, and with it any trust in Zuckerberg and his minions. There are other ways of staying in touch with people.

title: Technical issues
review: Hi, I’m an active Buyer-Seller on the marketplace on the Facebook app but recently there’s been a “glitch” when it comes to viewing a sellers product. When I click on the sellers product or post to view it up close and there’s usually pictures, it shows me the picture but cannot view the rest by swiping so I have to exit and view one by one. I’ve updated the app and even tried uninstalling and installing the app to see if it works. The second time I tried it, it seemed to go back to normal but after a while, it doesn’t let me swipe to see the pictures of marketplace products again. Please help. Thank you for your time.

title: Such a joke
review: This app has been here much longer than most Social media apps and yet still has the worst design and support. And it just keeps getting worse, I’ve been putting up with the nonsense updates to make it less user friendly. My final straw however was for the past few days I have been unable to use market place, my main use of the app, and it’s because it randomly needs a phone number verification. I enter my phone number which is already saved and verified in the past to my account and follow the steps and then I click send... boom no text no nothing every time. And there is nothing I can do to fix it. And the most frustrating part is that me writing this the review is the closest I may come to coming in contact with Facebook.

title: Toxic
review: Facebook is such a toxic, controlling app the only reason why I kept it so long is because it kept me in touch with my friends and family I live far from. Instead of the familiar baby pictures of my cousins I’m now greeted with endless adds about coronavirus (which is good to have the information for it) and fact checkers. The fact checkers are BEYOND annoying and they pop up EVERYWHERE. I could not share any type of political post without it asking me if I was sure that I wanted to. Facebook is literally suppressing our first amendment more and more everyday so I do NOT recommend getting this app. Your time is better put in Instagram (which yes I know Facebook owns) or Snapchat. The political propaganda and toxic news with Facebook is unreal. Hope this is helpful to you all! ☺️

title: Login issues
review: I was logged out of my facebook during the iphone configuration problem and can no longer log back in through the app nor my messenger.  I can log on via computer and on others ios devices.  I find it incredibly frustrating that there is zero support team besides some random articles that may or may not describe your issue.  I have factory reset my phone on top of every other solution internet experts have given and to no avail i cannot log in still.  I wish there was a way to maybe load an older version of the app or restore it for an attempt to log in without me having to delete everything off of my phone in an attempt to log into facebook as an app.  Hopefully an update comes soon for the app and will fix my log in issue but we will see.

title: Facebook Dating Needs To Be Updated
review:
I discovered this little jewel on the application for the phone late last year and I had a great time with it. Found some interesting ladies in my area. 
However, now a days when I check if I have any matches I get nothing so I don’t know if anyone has tried to match with me. The little heart indicator doesn’t carry any notifications or badge number to let you know any type of information. 
After sending a heart like to someone the screen goes gray and I have to close the application to get back to Facebook, so I don’t know if the like sent or not. 
Plus, this app needs to be a bigger part of the PC version of Facebook, not just included in a phone application.

title: Fascist Book
review: This is a place that has and continues to censor any view points they and their leftist agenda deem invalid. This is a propaganda service with full censorship ability masquerading as a platform for all people. Also they will and have pirated your personal information and browsing habits/interests to sell to anyone willing to pay them. They also do this without your consent. Stay away or at best use fake account info and only use the web browser version and never the app. This company should be relabeled as a publisher which controls what narrative they wish by using an editor, in this case so called fact checkers which they could not be farther from in reality. This is a totalitarian and fascist company that should not be allowed to operate the way it currently is. Horrible company, services and products, stay away if you can.

title: Wow! Amazing! 🙄
review:
Hey, you!

Looking to get into a comment war online? Tired of your boring social life with face-to-face interactions weighing you down? How about marketing? Is your business looking to spend obscene amounts of money for little to no return on your investment? Does the idea of being completely unable to navigate to your page from obnoxious and faulty re-directs really get your motor going? If so, this the platform for you!

For the low cost of 2-3 hours of your life daily and swiping through your feelings, you too can embrace the wonders of social media in 2018. With a host of features like bugging you 4 times to turn on notifications when installing messenger, you are almost certain to be fully satisfied.

Rejoice as your news feed fills up with leftovers from yesterday’s manure buffet. You too can dissect the latest accusations of racism, political propaganda, worthless pictures of Taco Bell dinner mediocrity, or even thirsty bathroom selfie comments.

Still not convinced? Try the app for yourself! I think you’ll agree, the sweet release of death never sounded as good as the moment you opened up this app and stared into it’s gaping black abyss of relentless garbage.

Ttyl!

title: Gone downhill
review: I’ve been on here for 11 years. It went from connecting with friends and family far away and sharing pictures, to a valuable place to to share info and get info, then to a marketing nightmare for the user (constant ads, constant “suggestions”) and now it is all ads and political news all the time. And not one person can say certain trigger words without getting censored or worse yet, deleted accounts. The fact checking is a joke. I am an adult. I can take or leave what is said. I dont need “fact checkers” to explain to me what they think is right or wrong. This isn’t law. This isn’t a class. This isn’t a courtroom. This is a bunch of people and their lives and opinions. This app is $$ free but you pay in other ways. This place is no fun anymore. Don’t bother downloading. You’ll be disappointed.

title: Sick and tired of fake “fact checks”
review: In a country where freedom of speech is supposed to be our right, Facebook seems to enjoy censoring our voice. I can post an opinion and I end up getting ghosted or “fact checked” by them. I now can’t open certain links, if FB doesn’t approve of the material or agree with the articles. News outlets and journalists are being censored as well. Facebook loves to spend the narrative that they are “protecting” us. I have an idea, instead of thinking most Americans are too stupid to figure things out or research on our own; how about you allow us to make our own decisions about things. Give the freedoms back to the American people and allow us to censor what we feel is right or wrong? Because things haven’t changed and only seems to be getting worse, I am headed over to Parler.

title: Big disappointment
review: I really want to see if this feedback stays up and it’s not removed .  Not only is this update a disappointment but Facebook in general is a disappointment. The review section seems to be the only section that Facebook would probably read since they give you no choices on Facebook when you want to oppose something or give you a disagreement reasons however I am sick of Facebook treating certain parties with prejudice you know who you are and you know what you’re doing. I read offensive language I see what I believe to be threatening posts but I still see them I post something from the web and because it may ruffle someone’s feathers I get reprimanded or serve time in Facebook jail. All I can say is I wish someone would start a social media outlet that would give Facebook a run for it’s money.

title: Please Make a Button
review:
Hello, first, Facebook and it’s app are great! I record live church services during this pandemic. This is the best option to connect with our members, I will always commend Facebook for it’s accessibility. Our elders are happy to watch from home, who may otherwise risk their health to exercise their faith.

However, I have a suggestion to make live video more user-friendly. I have my iPhone 11 on a tripod, already in the horizontal position. By default Facebook starts live videos in the vertical orientation, can a button be made so users can select vertical or horizontal orientation before recording?

title: Update: ads. Ads everywhere
review:
Update:Ads ads ad ad ad ad ads ads ads ads ad ad ad. So. Many. Ads. 

I liked the new groups section...it makes sense to separate the groups from the friends......until all the group posts started showing in the feed again. So now there are two places to see group feeds? Why?  
Marketplace has been violated - it used to be connecting people and now, just like feeds in our current Facebook world - it’s mostly connecting people with ads. I don’t care what a shop in another state will ship to me. I care what *local* people are selling!
Get back to chronological order in the feed and stop showing me the same posts I have already seen- then suddenly a bunch of posts from 4 days ago show up like they are brand new.

title: Living hell
review: My day has been a day from hell. And it all started from being hacked on Facebook. After being hacked the first time Facebook had me authenticate myself and change all my credentials and after all that the same people were able to hack my account again. And again Facebook had had verify my activity and change my credentials again, and again after changing credentials a second time I was hacked again! By the third time all I wanted to do was deactivate the whole page but I was literally racing against the hackers to stay logged in long enough to be able to even deactivate the page. Since then these hackers have locked me out of my email, and now they are trying to get into my Apple ID account. I’ve been on the phone w/ Apple all day and my bank and yahoo trying keep my self protected

title: Had to make multiple accounts
review:
So in short, my main account got put in Facebook jail for posting things to my meme page that I’ve gotten from other Facebook users/pages that have had the post up much longer and were not punished. But I’ve had to make multiple accounts in order to run my page, but yet even if I don’t post on my “new” one I get a temporary block for absolutely no reason, I only use them to post memes to my page, which I have kept to a minimum to avoid getting blocked for “spam”.

Yet, I still get blocked. There is nothing that tells you why, just a pop up that says “Action Blocked, you are temporarily unable to use this feature” when it comes to “Liking, Commenting, Sharing, and Posting”.

Y’all really need a legit Customer Support so things like this can be resolved, I’ve looked into this and there’s no way of contacting anyone to help, especially if your account is banned or blocked from using any features, you literally have to make a new account to even try to get help. It’s hard to fathom how a social media platform can have this many users and be this large without a Customer Support.

If someone could actually reply back, that would be great.

title: Keep up
review: Your system is compatible with codes from 4 years ago. Catch up. You are supposed to be some kind of genius.  Right now your company looks like a socialist participant. Oh, wait, maybe that’s why your technology is so far behind. My bad, now I realize, for some reason, that’s what you actually wanted. Good luck on your next heart surgery. Because no one will do it within the next 6 months outside of America. Do your research folks. Communism bad, capitalism great. Capitalism inspires folks to work hard. Socialism/communism, everyone is equal. Why would the Dr. work just as hard as the nurse, only to make the same pay? Why would one surgeon work harder than the other, when they all make the same pay? If everyone collects the same paycheck, no matter what, then where does the motivation to get better come from?

title: Block pop up ads
review:
I have no serious problems with the Facebook app itself but I am becoming concerned by the amount of pop up ads I get while in the Facebook browser. The ads are very spammy looking (“you’ve been selected to win 1 million dollars!”), with no way to dismiss them except by tapping “OK” which means I’m forced to close the entire app to avoid taking the risk of downloading a virus to my phone. In Safari settings, you can block pop-ups, but there is no universal way to do that for all browsers across all apps. 

So, Facebook: create a pop-up blocker setting for your browser before I’m too afraid to open any links. 

And users: don’t click on those pop-up ads - just double click the home button and swipe up to close Facebook - don’t risk it.

title: Garbage App
review:
You know what I despise about this app? If I see something in my feed and start to comment on it, but then leave the app to go look something up in my browser, when I return to the app it refreshes my feed and I lose what I started typing. Half the time I don’t even bother trying to find it again. For a company that was so complicit in the distribution of false information, you would think you would want people to be able to confirm facts and do research before posting.
—-
JFC this is still the worst. I had clicked on a link from my feed, was halfway through reading the article when I got a text. Went to answer the text and then back to the Facebook immediately and it took me to a refreshed feed instead of the article I was not done reading. I hope to god the government breaks Facebook up. It is f’ing awful.

title: Worse and worse updates
review:
When watching the video, can’t go back to the feed by sliding right anymore? need to tap the newsfeed icon on the bar on the bottom or the ‘back’ icon to go back on the right top corner only! Stop updating and making it worse to use!! It’s so ridiculous. Why keep changing stuff and how to do thing while some people such as senior users have longer learning curves. Also when I click to see picture posts, it now leads to the black page and if I want to zoom in I have to tap one more time! Why complicating it?! I thought you need to decrease the number of times you need to tap, not increasing it!!! So annoying. And so much inconsistency about how to do things, especially video stuffs.

AND STOP BRINGING ME TO A BLACK SCREEN like facebook watch and ‘other photos you may also like’!!!!!!!!

title: Notifications
review: Ok, while I do love Facebook and will never stop using it this latest update has brought an issue for me. When I comment on a post, share one, or even post my own, sometimes I am not receiving notifications of comments. This doesn’t happen all the time but, since this last update, when it started, it has happened enough to irritate me greatly. The reason I even noticed it was scrolling through my newsfeed and I would see such posts that had additional comments and realizing I never not once received a notification for it. Yes I make sure my notifications or turned on and I’ve also triple checked to make sure I didn’t simply over look it. It would be greatly appreciated if Facebook could fix this issue and I can go back to loving Facebook completely.

title: New version splits news feed page view into 2 columns! Horrible!
review:
I reluctantly updated to the current version and my iPad newsfeed went from a single page view to a two column view, with the news feed on the left half of the page and 3 useless things on the right half of the page (i.e. birthday reminders, recently viewed groups, and a constant, never-goes-away request to turn on chat). This new format is terrible! And there doesn’t appear to be a way to remove or hide the second column. 😡

Reducing the size of the news feed to just one half of the page makes the posts and typeface extremely small and hard to read. The icons to like, comment, copy, etc are so tiny that they are hard to press with your finger tip. You have absolutely RUINED the Facebook experience with this asinine decision! 😡

title: Recent and incredibly irritating issue.
review:
I have the most current update for both my phone and the app. Any time I’m on the notifications screen, if I tap the dots on the left of a notification, the whole app freezes. I really need to use those dots because I make use of the “turn off notifications for this post” feature commonly. I can go to the post by clicking the notification, then scroll to the top of the post and turn off notifications there, but it makes the process so much longer and it is annoying. 

Other than that, it’s Facebook on your phone. I don’t mind the lay out for the most part, not enough to write about anything anyway, besides this issue.

title: Another Corporation Taking Control
review: I hate Facebook. I tried using it for a few years but it felt sort of soulless. Then the marketing/advertising started. I couldn’t communicate on Facebook in any way without being forced to view a bunch of crap. The last straw was the constant censorship. Consistent messages of “don’t do that, don’t say this and don’t say that.” It felt like some drunk girl was in your face yelling “shut up” every time you tried saying anything. Now I’m seeing articles about the new policies of how it is inappropriate to state your sexual orientation or position. You’re no longer able to joke with friends on here without them interrupting. Facebook is just another corporation censoring your freedom of speech. Delete your account and spend time with loved ones in person. If you can’t, then I recommend emails and FaceTime.

title: Very intrusive, illogical support staff
review: I like the app itself, but I am very very very disappointed with the support staff.  They have hounded me and sometimes suspended my account for things that were not my fault.  My account was actually suspended because someone else was stalking me and my wife on Facebook; trying to destroy our family.  If that does not beat all that I was suspended for doing nothing else, but asking for help from the support staff. I guess you can say "If you dislike Facebook so much then do not use it!".  Unfortunately, Facebook is actually engrained in our society and culture.  Therefore Facebook is very unfortunately a necessary evil that is unavoidable.  However, I have limited what I say and do on Facebook to a very minimum.  Until such time as their support and structure improves, my family is doing the same.  Please be careful.

title: Facebook bugs versus the Good Stuff
review:
In my experience, lately, there seems to be a lot more bugs in Facebook, I don’t know if it is because of updates having issues but that is possible.
I have to re-log in almost every day even though my IPhone has done this already.
I can’t “like” posts and videos- I am banned- but for what??? I can comment and share, but that is time consuming. 
On the other hand, Facebook allows me to be myself and make new friends and reconnect with old ones. I talk to my children (adult) on Facebook as three of them live in three different states. I share photos, verses, poetry, and my artwork on Facebook, and love getting feedback. 
I enjoy the videos and share a few.

title: I’ve been locked out for a year
review: I no longer have any access to my account, since Oct/Nov of last year. I switched phones, didn’t know password anymore since my phone auto signed me in. My email was an old high school email, which I haven’t had access to for years. I have tried everything for password resets, adding a phone number, to trusted friend codes (which do nothing except cause a glitch and continue to not let me to the next step in getting my account back). I have no way to get to my account, and have received absolutely no help when reaching out, due to Facebook having no email and no phone number, just crappy “help” forums. If I can’t have my account back, I at least want it deleted so that people stop thinking I have it and inviting me to things/think I’m ignoring them. SOMEBODY HAS TO BE ABLE TO HELP ME.

title: Last Update Flaws
review:
The last update was flawed.  

I don’t if the update helped/created/changed what is was supposed to or not but I know it’s caused other issues. For example:

… when tagging someone it routinely tries to make the tagged name into single characters or words (example:  If I were trying to tag “John Ford” it comes out as something like “J One F Ord”) someone it corrupts the name.  The only way that I’ve fixed this (not a true fix or even a great work around mind you) is swearing and re-tagging the name myriad of times;

… it’s apparent that Apple programmers and FB programmers hate each other or are carrying out drunken joke pledges they made to each on fun-filled Friday nights at their college fraternity or sorority — the spell check algorithm each uses should be seamless but it isn’t.  

There were a couple of other things but I can’t remember them right now.  

I normally just deal with these issues on my own … but for one thing … they’re happening all the time right now and the only thing that could be the issues is the last update since none of this happened prior to that.

title: Stop the BS notifications
review:
It would be great if I stopped receiving arbitrary notifications that are not important (such as, “some random friend to whom you haven’t spoken in 2 years just posted a photo!”), which seem to be aimed at getting me to open the app after long periods of absence. I simply will turn off all notifications and ignore the app even more if you keep this up. 

This practice of arbitrary notifications is taking advantage of the natural cognitive curiosity implicit within our thought processes. It is doing so in a way that is effective, but arguably abusive.

You should have higher standards than the clickbait parasites you continue to let galavant all over the website/app. Stop the arbitrary notifications, NOW!!!!

title: Good but feed/profile issues
review: The app is overall good! However, it seems like it’s a more increasing issue that when I try to go to a profile (even my own), I can scroll down so far until I reach the feed/posts and then it just stalls and loads for nearly eternity, never showing anything.. It’s starting to happen on my news feed too. Please fix this! I’ve let it go for a few times, tried fixing it myself via uninstalling/reinstalling, restarting my phone, etc... I thought it might have been a connectivity issue with my service or something but SC and IG work just fine and FB will load up, just not feed and such..

title: Crashing 24/7
review: For the last week or so, every time I open up a video on the facebook app the video will play for a bit and then randomly at some Point during the video my entire app will just crash and close out. I’ve been dealing with it, learning to just watch the videos without actually opening them. But today, I had to open a video because it was a video showing dogs making funny sounds and in order to have volume the video must be open. Half way through, in the middle of a yodeling pit bull, the app crashed once again, and now the video is lost. This is unforgivable. It is one thing for the issue to effect random videos I don’t care about, but it has now started to prevent me from watching dog videos???? Unacceptable. Fix this issue immediately so I can enjoy my dog videos without fear.

title: Problem with Facebook
review: I’m getting sick of Facebook because so many TERRIBLE, VIOLENT, and ANIMAL ABUSIVE POSTS ARE COMING THRU the NEWSFEED but with no PETITION and no facts (when, where, what) as to what to do to help the situation!!!  But when you want to report it, you can’t explain what it is or why it’s disturbing!! They just ask very fundamental questions that may not at all relate to what the problem is!! So sometimes you’re just reporting the person who last posted it and not the original posting and person who originally posted (possibly the perpetrator who staged the cruel situation).  Why can’t we directly explain what the problem is? My guess is that you don’t want to know!!!

title: Access to account disabled several times a day
review: I have no idea what updates they made to the app, but I am now prompted to log in several times a day and then I get a message that my account is temporarily disabled due to some excessive activity. I have two-step verification enabled, so I doubt there a problem with my account being accessed elsewhere. I would know. All I do is watch the videos in my news feed, add a few likes, post a comment or two. Nothing that would even remotely violate their rules. Most of the content I interact with has to do with pets and animal welfare. I have no idea what triggers this now routine access lock. It is getting to the point where I am thinking of closing my account. I don’t even share or post so much. They need to fix this.

title: I have used sense 2005.  Zuckerberg sold out
review:
Here’s what I can’t stand. 
The fact that Facebook plays politics. But is also forcing politics.
I’ll post something about on candidate..something negative. And I’ll get 6-8 fake accounts using P star pics saying “let’s meet up and discuss” 
Now if I post a “test” comment about that same candidate that is positive ..I’ll get messages from confirmed accounts asking me to donate to that persons campaign.
It is very obvious that FB doesn’t care about one political group while embracing the other. Any anyone reading this knows which group is constantly having to report profiles and end up getting back “nothing was in violation”. The profile is of a p Star wanting $$/bit coin/votes for favors.

title: Atrocious
review:
Post a picture of your pet? You’ll receive a 30 day ban. Post a picture of a Chanel handbag? You’ll receive a 30 day ban. Post a picture of a wild animal frolicking in the brush? You’ll receive a 30 day ban. 
Make a post thanking friends? You’ll receive an account warning. Proud of your new car, and sharing it? You’ll receive an account warning. Log in on a Sunday? You’ll receive a account ban warning. 

This may seem like an exaggeration, but it’s accurate for the Ol’ Mighty Facebook. With “AI” flagging “key words” or “photos”, you’ll feel like your utilizing a social media app developed by the authorities in the book 1984.
