I feel that this goes against our right as grown individuals to speak freely about concerning topics and to educate ourselves on both sides of the story. A mother just mentioned to me that a picture of her own son having a seizure (within an hour of being vaccinated) was removed from Facebook and that her commenting, posting, sharing, reacting and Facebook messenger right have been revoked afterwards. This is happening to thousands of other people expressing their opinions and concerns. This is wrong and Facebook, you should be ashamed.

title: Things Just Keep Getting Worse
review:
For starters, the ads have gotten out of control; too often it seems like their are more ads or suggestions than posts from pages I like and people I follow. Secondly, the layout of things seems to be getting further from simple and closer to annoying. Finally, The cover photo never stays in the position I put it in before saving. If you use a previous cover photo, already on FB, it creates a new photo post when it used to re share the original cover story post. It’s like things are going backwards.

P. S. I could actually go on, but these are the main three bugging me and I do not have all day, which is how long it would take to get into everything.

title: Love FB, but one of the latest updates did something stupid
review: I love FB, but one of the latest updates changed it so that when I am viewing a picture and I click on it, it opens in portrait mode and I have to flip my iPad to see it correctly.  Why in the world would this be a thing?  If I click on a picture it means I want to see the whole picture and be able to zoom, etc.  I do not wish to have to physically flip my iPad so I can see it.  I have a case and keyboard and use my iPad like a laptop as I’m sure many do.  I do not use my iPad vertically.  (Except for Instagram because they still have not made that viewable horizontally.). PLEASE FIX THIS.

title: App not opening
review: I’m not sure if Facebook app is going through some major updates or if this is happening only to me. I have been trying to open the app the other day a few times and it would not open. I tried several times and every time I would click on it it would just get out to my home screen. I never successfully opened the app. I then got tired and figure let me delete and restore the app and maybe that would fix the problem. I have been trying to download for a few days now and even downloading it’s stuck and it won’t do it. The app shows up on my screen but for two days it has not completed. What’s going on? Is this only happening to me?

title: Facebook blows
review:
I like the old Facebook when there aren’t many adds showing in the newsfeed. I managed to blocked them, yet they still show in my feed. I have changed my settings so many times about adds, without knowing it, Facebook managed to change them like I didn’t do anything about it, so I have to start all over. It really blows when all you see is something completely irrelevant including people I don’t know. 
Facebook continues to change, not in a good way. So many freaking fake news. But nobody seems to care about controlling this issue all they care is about making money. It’s very obvious they are all in denial and they should be responsible for all this so called fake news. There should be laws about this stuff, and FB should be accountable for letting this fake news spread all over world.

title: Why??
review:
I enjoy connecting with my family and friends but when they post pictures it shows the link to the album and a few pictures. As you scroll down your feed you will see each individual picture they posted. What’s the point in directing people to an album when you can just keep scrolling to see them anyway? It takes up space in my newsfeed and then there’s that dot at the end pretty much saying sorry nothing else to see now. I’m more than positive that 1 friend isn’t the only one who posted that day. 

Please stop with the constant ads! Especially the repetitive ones! I click the box that says hide ad and the reason why, yet they still show up.

Why is it while I’m reading an article the app will randomly time out and close you out of the app? I then have to go back in and find the article to pick up where I left off. Or hopefully find it on another search engine.

*It has been more than a year since I’ve written this review. Nothing has changed, all of this is still going on. I reduced my star rating from a 3 to a 1. The current update is awful and I’m missing newsfeed from friends. I deleted the app, it’s not worth the space it uses*

title: This app is trash now
review: I wasn’t going to complain but because now it crashes out of nowhere I have to.  My first complaint was going to be about how not funny it was that the app constantly reset my setting for the in app sound even when I didn’t update the app. I was  constantly having to turn my in app sound off EVERY time I opened the app. I found this to be disturbing and odd which made me feel like what the hell else is FB doing to accounts without the users knowledge. The sounds are ANNOYING btw. I recently updated the app and now it crashes out of nowhere. The only use I get out of this app is reading posts and some support communicating with parents from some groups created for children with special needs but other than that I don’t use it because of the frustrating crap I have mentioned above.

title: Freezes and closes
review:
I had an iPhone 6+ and every time I went to my Facebook business page. The app will give me so much time (less than 30 seconds) and close down. No big deal. I have a laptop, I can upload and edit my page through there. Two weeks ago, I got a new phone. iPhone X. Great! Works amazing! I can finally edit my page on this phone. There is one thing. Every time I see a video. It will give me so many seconds and just closes. I can scroll down on sites etc. But once I watch a video. It will close shortly. I don’t mind anything else. 
All the ads, etc... is fine with me. Hey! It’s their site they can do whatever they want but I don’t like how it always closes for no reason!

title: Want more functionality
review:
I am not sure why Facebook still hasn't developed the means for us to mark a post as "read" so it stops showing up on my timeline. I don't care to see a popular post on my timeline every time I log in for two days. Once I've seen it, there should be a way for me to remove the post from my feed. I also don't need it to pop up on my "most recent" every single time someone comments on it.

Also, please for the love, either take away the “back” feature or at least put in a “forward” feature to undo. Nothing is worse than scrolling down and accidentally scrolling to the side a bit, then getting pushed “back” and not being able to go back to where I was in the newsfeed. (Again, wouldn’t really be an issue if the feature in paragraph one was addressed.)

title: Facebook and iPhone
review:
Most of the time I'm usually on my phone when I use FB. I am ok with it for the most part but wish it wouldn't hang up so much. I would also like it better if we had the ability to use it as we do on our desktops. 

At this time I'm happy with the changes that FB has made. My last review above was 2 years ago. Facebook helps me keep up with the people I care about, remember birthdays, anniversaries, special events and gives me a look back at what was happening last year. Thank you for the continued updates. I almost always use FB via my phone.

title: STOP CUTTING OFF MY MUSIC WHEN NOTHING IS PLAYING IN FB !!!???
review: When I switch to Facebook and I have absolutely nothing playing in it, why does it pause my music??? THE MOST ANNOYING THING EVERY DAY . The only option is to quit the app and reopen then it won’t act this way. It seems to persist when I *had* played an ad / some media inside Facebook long ago. Literally hours befoRE Even. App seems to think something is playing in app unless I force quit after watching . This has been an issue thru a year of updates. Who dunnit? — AND WHY IS IT SO HARD TO EXIT A VIDEO or (some) ads??. swipe down? Doesn’t work.. Swipe left???? Oh jk I have to press the little arrow up top on the right. AT LEAST MAKE IT CONSISTENT. We shouldn’t have to guess between very different moves.. can you PLEASE Get To Work YOUR TEAMS NEED TO WORK WITH Each other

title: Meta has just given up?
review:
Facebook is so awful. I’ve been using it since 2005ish, and it’s just so bad now! The ads are annoying, the amount of spam, scammers, and fake news is unbelievable. Their video section is just unwatchable! It’s all offensive, not safe for work or kids, or it’s just spam. 
You can report things but they don’t do anything about it. 
I guess Meta is content making money off it’s users misfortune. 
Do better y’all, you can afford to make it worth using, you can afford to pay people fair wages to hold scammers accountable, and you can afford to care about the effect fake news has on our culture, society, and political system. 
If it wasn’t for my elderly family members that use it to keep in touch I would do myself a favor and delete it all together.

title: Password change/reset was difficult
review:
I had to change my password. Could not find the option on my account. Not on laptop or phone viewing. Even googled for answers or a link. Tried to use “forget password” to reset but was not given the option to. I ended up finding the option in the messenger app. Also discovered I can log out of FB but not messenger. Very funky and weird experience. 

Halfway through, I considered deleting my account. This was just a phone book to me anyways. Even after changing password, I am still considering it. Why is there not a clear and easy option to change passwords on the FB account like it had before? Every other social media has it. Right in settings. 

Advised to fix this issue immediately.

title: Bugs/ App GLITCHES
review: I have been off of Facebook for over a year, and the moment I get on it keeps restricting my account. I have no account restrictions, have not violated any community guidelines it’s just not letting me post anything. I can be off of the app for days and the moment I open it up I am restricted. I have made SEVERAL reports and it’s like no one is getting back with me. I send in multiple reports at a time , the restriction times don’t even add up, one says I’m restricted for 24 hours one says 5, and my account still says I have no restrictions. Their needs to be something fixed. This app just does not care about its users. I re downloaded to stay connected with family and It’s looking like I’m going to have to find something else. Just wish they’d fix that

title: Crossposting is not an option for all
review: Facebook several months ago added a crossposting option so you could post in one group and if you manage more than that one group you could post simultaneously only having to do one post. It was a great option. I used it almost daily then one day disappeared, and nothing I have done has been able to get it back. I’ve also found out that many others on Facebook have lost that option, however hundreds of thousands of other people have the option. & don’t try to get a hold of Facebook because they won’t respond. Now, I’m left with doing three times the work that everybody else has the option to do once and absolutely zero replies for me asking for help for several months. 🤬

I have restarted my phone And I have sent four different messages to get help. Facebook has shown its integrity by standing behind how exactly Zuckerberg stole the app from the original creators, now in the face of his empire falling, he hired a team to go after his competition, “TikTok“. review: From the fact that they sold their users data which left their customers unsafe since the beginning, to the illegal behavioral analysis they performed on their users which caused mental health issues, to allowing Russia to collude in our 2016 election, to allowing a space for the January 6th insurrection to occur, to becoming an illegal monopoly and violating antitrust laws. title: Absolutely ridiculous
review: This is absolutely ridiculous. My account was hacked but somehow I'm still logged in. I am unable to change the password because it keeps requesting me to put in my "current" password before I can change it. How am I supposed to know the current password!! I was hacked, they changed it! So I can't reclaim my account that way. My email and phone number I no longer have access to so I'm unable to receive the codes being sent for verification. title: Zero help from Facebook when there’s an issue
review:
My account was hacked weeks ago. I’ve reported this to Facebook several times over now. I’ve received ZERO CORRESPONDENCE from Facebook to regain access to my account and intellectual property. title: My account was disabled for no reason at all
review: I have had my Facebook account for 15 years and now this happened someone hacked my account and yesterday it’s disabled I went to the help desk and It wouldn’t let me fill out a review form I keep getting an email from Facebook in Vietnamese. I barely make post on Facebook but this was a major way I stayed in contact with my family and friends all my pictures and memories are gone just like that I’ve looked up other people in situations just like mines and they never gotten their accounts back or they would have to lie and fake like they want to but an oculus for someone from Facebook to even look at their review but I can’t even fill out for a review because Facebook help desk keeps loading and nothing comes up

title: App works on iPhone, not on iPad
review: Both Apple products are new and both use my same Apple ID. I can auto log in to the phone app but the iPad version (most recent version newly downloaded) will not accept the exact same password which is auto-input from my Apple password settings so I know it’s the same. The iPad app gives me the error that my password is incorrect. I also tried the FB website in both Chrome and Safari on the iPad, but get a message on both those platforms that the same password is an old password and I should use the newer one. What is the problem?

title: Privacy Problems
review: I’ve been using Facebook for years but however, this past year I’ve been having nonstop privacy problems where my Facebook account keeps getting hacked through Facebook Messenger, at first you’ll get sent a message with something like "Look who died" and a link with it that allows hackers to hack your account even if you don’t open the link, there’s no way to protect your account, it happens constantly, I’ve changed my password for my Facebook and email constantly for this security reason and my account with thousands of other people still get hacked, the creators of Facebook has done an outstanding job with their security for Instagram but not for Facebook.

title: Absolutely demonic hellsite
review: Every few months I download the app to see if I missed anything. Then I remember that there’s nothing to miss. Then I immediately delete the app again. I suggest you do the same. Better yet, don’t bother starting an account in the first place. You can more fruitfully spend your time hanging out with family and friends, reading books, woodworking, or participating in any other of the countless hobbies that will be time better spent than hanging out on a website that is, at the end of the day, a landing page for every person you know from high school who is now trying to sell you essential oils, explaining that Trump’s last name is actually “Drumpf,” or demanding to know why you are bottle feeding rather than breastfeeding your newborn. Log off, everyone!

title: Read!
review: Facebook used to be great and simple of course there would be a few bugs and things but it wasn’t bad the algorithm has gone awful you can’t make things private anymore you used to be able to keep your personal things personal and not just entirely public even though it is a public app there should be better limitations especially for peoples family you should have better options for what you can and cannot do you used to have a choice now it’s either put everything out there or nothing at all i myself have used it for years it’s sad to see it go so far downhill and many other people have said so and it’s still going unnoticed facebook do better if your going to download it you should know the risks upfront

title: Disabled account
review: Should Facebook decide to disable your account, you get no warning. Should they not have the man power to “look into your disagreement with their decision” you completely lose your account. There’s no one to talk to, no actual help center. Everything you’ve ever used Facebook to sign into becomes a nightmare to use/create a new profile for. This product is the absolute worst product I’ve ever had the misfortune of using. If you’re a real person trying to reclaim your account, you have no say in the process, no way of arguing your case, but don’t worry, if you’re a spammer you can just create many, many new accounts. I hope meta shares plummet and Facebook disappears into the far, darn, cold, lonely reaches of the Internet. Too bad instagram is connected to it.

title: Help
review: So long story short, My account and another lady have the same phone # programmed into our own accounts, I notice when I try to sign into something through facebook it always gives and shows me her profile instead of mine.  When I try and go to reset my password (which I forgot) to update or try and fix this issue, It continuously asked me to "Try Signing In." I tried using the facial recognition to input my password but it says that it is incorrect. Now I did not add my email to my account since I had not thought of needing one, But now when I try to add one so that I can find an easier way to changing my password, facebook asks me for my current password that I do not remember. Is there anyway I can get some help on recovering my account password?

title: Facebook Algorithm
review: Facebook has become a complete joke. The algorithm is so messed up that normal people can’t even use Facebook anymore. We are being flagged as bots and treated as cattle. We can’t have an opinion or talk about politics. We can’t sell on platforms too quickly because we look like bots. The algorithm is shutting people down and turning off our facebooks when that is our connection to the outside world. I was apart of many auction groups, I ran groups as an admin and I had a business page. Everything got shut down. My first page was shut down when I offered a homeless pregnant mom some food!!! The second time I was shut down was for posting items for sale too quickly. At this rate facebook won’t last. It will fade away just like MySpace did.

title: This app is HORRIBLE!!!
review:
I don’t know what FB is doing but the group section of my feed only lets me scroll down about 5 posts, then I can’t go any further or it says it’s broken and to try to reload the group feed. In addition to that shenanigans, FB is so busy suggesting groups (that other people on pages that I have liked previously, that I have zero interest in) that I no longer am able to see the measly bit I’m allowed to see. WTH FB!! On my regular feed, I hardly see any of things I do like because I’m constantly bombarded with “sponsored” post. It’s a nightmare. FB used to be cool, now it’s basically useless because you only get to see paid post or specially curated suggested posts. Complete garbage. 
I do have the most updated version of the app and it makes no difference.

title: Censoring conservatives
review: I don’t even consider myself a conservative, I’m an old-school liberal but Facebook is still censoring me if I question the narrative of any of the main stream content. They also disable my ability to react if I like or love posts that they don’t agree with politically. Facebook is a propaganda arm for the far left. As a private company, they claim protection under section 230 as a public forum. When an organization claims protection under section 230, they are not allowed to act as a publisher and censor as a publisher might censor. So they are breaking the law, are disingenuous and unethical. Everyone should be mightily aware that they are not receiving all the information if they get their information from Facebook. You’re only receiving the far left narrative that they want you to receive.

title: First Amendment
review: The people who operate Facebook are no longer interested in preserving our first amendment rights.  The platform itself has deteriorated into an echo chamber of political ideology and if you have opposing views as the people at Facebook, you will be censored.   The new marketplace is horrible and I am inundated with ads that target me but are of zero interest to me.  In fact, businesses that advertise their products on Facebook are wasting their money on me seeing their ads.  Even if I have an interest in the product, there’s no way on God’s green earth that I will spend a penny of my money on a company that advertises on Facebook.  Such a disappointment from the early years when I could connect with old classmates or former coworkers and keep in touch.  It USED to be fun.  Now it feels like a propaganda machine for CCP.

title: Facebook security is not helpful
review: My profile was hacked about a month ago. My email and password were changed so I wasn’t able to get back into it. I was notified by email that this happened and followed a link to prove my identity. I submitted my personal information to this link and waited for them to confirm. After 48 hours they confirmed my ID and sent me a new password and a link to follow. It did not work. I emailed Facebook security to tell them it wasn’t working and have not received a response in a very long time. I have contacted them now 3 times by email. I still have not received a response. I wish there was a phone number I could call to expedite this process. I am extremely dissatisfied with their service. If I could give a rating of zero I would.

title: Desiring To Hear The Voices
review: This app was an awesome way to keep up with friends and share information. I have been shocked this past year as Facebook has self appointed themselves as communication police. They have determined a narrative and regardless of actually facts and events they sensor information. The company bullies people by saying their voice doesn’t have a place in this world rather than allowing readers to think for themselves. Facebook is the oppressive government in the books and movies we have been fearful of living within. On a positive note, I have learned not to simply take the opinions of others for fact but have learned the importance of verifying with the initial source or official documents. I have also learned fact checkers aren’t necessarily concerned with truth but swaying opinion.

title: I used to like Facebook
review: There was once a time where Facebook was a great app to use, but now we live in a world where freedom of press is being attacked. Your speech is monitored. You’re constantly being watched be “independent fact checkers.” How can we guarantee these fact checkers aren’t pushing an agenda? We can’t. I was taught one way everything is either one way or the other. But as I’ve lived i realized there’s is and will always be grey área. I question everything. That’s the way life should be we need to question media, celebrities, and the news, our leaders, and social media platforms. In a world where no one questions anything. I refuse to be a part of that group. The only reason I use this platform anymore is because people who I love refuse to use other means to communicate

title: Hacked
review: I have always loved being able to keep up with family and friends. But, waking up to an email saying my password was changed from Corona, California was not what I had on my agenda today. Someone was able to get into my account, change all of the login and personal info so that by the time I got in to try and change it back, I wasn’t able to get in because it said I was the hacker that they were protecting my account from. I can’t comprehend how this company talks about how great their security has gotten, but someone can get into my account and change everything like it was me doing it. I can’t even go in and delete my account, it’s just accessible for whoever got it. Makes me sick. No longer using this social network at all.

title: Selective Censoring
review: Facebook seems to censor what they like and feature what they like. I understand that this is their platform, but I am sure this is against what they claim their policy is. In particular, they approve of racist posts against Palestine, and censor any posts or news that shouts about the ethnic cleansing that takes place against the Palestinian population. Also, Facebook cracks down on curses and what is known as “bad language”; facebook, you’re not my mom, stop censoring us! Stop this patriarchy! Throughout history, “censorors” were always on the wrong side of history. Stop censoring, stop silencing the voices fighting for justice, and stop censoring tyrants. It is not your job!

title: Awful App
review:
Would
Not allow Teens or younger to access this App. Or any loved one for that matter. FB tracks everything you do. Down to how long you watch an app. Even when your off the app it tracks. Everything. And running. FB is Trash. If you have this app turn off your tracking and delete the app off your phone.

title: Marketplace Search function non operational
review:
The most disappointing thing about this problem isn’t necessarily the problem itself (even though it is very frustrating and makes the process near useless). I use a 2018 IPad Pro and have updated the Facebook app and the latest IOS is always updated within 48 hours. 

When doing a search for any item on Marketplace the results show up on a tiled page as they should. But once you choose any item to get info on it a generic page saying “Markeplace is not available” is what shows up next.

OK I have to add another comment now that I’ve had to waste another 5 minutes trying to come up with a “nickname” that isn’t taken and that without it this message won’t go forward! Is this even possible??

title: So disappointed lately.
review:
I love Facebook, don’t get me wrong. I use it every single day, all day long. But something is just not right with MY Facebook. It’s like it just will not UPDATE properly. It says it’s updated but... ITS’S NOT. I still can’t make an avatar. The option just does not exist for me. No way, no how! Not that the avatar in particular is a huge deal but everyone has it but me it seems like. SOMEBODY HELP ME!! 
I’d give 5 stars if it wasn’t for this!

title: Just the bugs are bad enough.
review:
The app stalls, reloads, and crashes fairly frequently. As many mentioned, they are so desperate to keep you viewing that it’s impossible to find something you just looked at. The page reloads in random order despite what format you select. It will show you a few posts in no particular order of people or groups you follow but never a full feed. 

Aside from the skewed political issues, the app requires permissions no reasonable person should have to agree to and are incredibly intrusive. Your doctor cannot reveal your medical issues, but say you join a support group for a condition, guess what, now everyone FB sells your data to knows all about it!

 Facebook has turned its back on the user (sorry, revenue stream) and become just another example of unbridled corporate greed.

title: If you’re into censorship, I guess this is for you
review:
They once stated they wouldn’t influence politics but here we are four years later and they decided to totally remove anyone who doesn’t bow down to leftist mobs. 

They thought by deactivating and banning Trump for so called violence they were doing the “right” thing. But he never incited violent behavior but called for peace. Maybe someday I can find a platform that allows me to communicate with my elderly former schoolteachers and relatives and talk about politics and culture with my friends that doesn’t perpetuate a noxious neo-McCarthyist tendency in the guise of building a better community.

review:
Facebook has always been difficult to use for a business.  They just keep making it worse.  Now it’s horrible where before it was just bad.

.. My business page gets 10 times more suggestions in the news feed than actual news feed WITH NO WAY TO TURN IT OFF.

.. I can’t copy anything from my personal page to my business page anymore.  Whose bonehead idea was it to program that?

.. There’s no way I can find to get a person to help with anything.  Just articles that don’t help at all.

.. Update.. now I can’t even create an event.  Facebook is just horrible.

.. worse and worse .. wish I didn’t already rate it a 1 so I can rate it a 1 now.  Tried copying an event to my page.  It just pasted a web address no actual event.  Paste the address in a browser to get the event.  More than a click and no ones going through the effort and it makes me look like an idiot.

Someone please come up with a good social networking app so we can get rid of Facebook once and for all.  Every step of the way with Facebook is just frustrating and angering and I’m sick of it.  They offer no help whatsoever.

title: Zero stars review. What a piece of crap!
review:
Zero stars review. What a piece of crap.

No more Facebook.

title: Gone too far!
review: Facebook and their censorship has gone too far! In January, they stopped allowing me to comment or post on any groups, including one for my business for two weeks! I had not said or done anything crazy for them to do that. There was one picture I shared on someone’s post, in a comment, explaining something, and evidently they didn’t like that I shared that picture. I did nothing crazy or inappropriate whatsoever! They even indefinitely banned me from creating events or groups, which is completely uncalled for. I have never, in the history of my presence on there, even created an event! I have only created two groups, both of which, were for selling makeup! I have never done anything to merit this treatment. Facebook has gone to the crap holes.

title: Facebook is bad for the world
review: Facebook is a disgusting coward that promotes violence and hate. Facebook is controlling people and their viewpoints through bias media and they control what you see and dont see. As I have many times and I usually get the same results, I reported a very violent video where a man was beaten by another man until he was having seizures on the floor choking on his own vomit. Facebook says this does not violate their rules and guidelines. This is typical of Facebook and they are the problem. They should be shut down for the sake of this planet and the people who live on it. I’ve reported many disgusting violent videos and none of them get removed. However if you talk about a natural health product, your comment is removed instantly for violating their guidelines. How does this make sense? You are evil and disgusting, Facebook!

title: App Doesn’t Work, Developer Won’t Help
review:
Back in January 2021 I was logged out of the Facebook app on my iPhone and as of March 29, 2021 I still have not been able to log back in despite extensive research to troubleshoot and numerous attempts to contact Facebook/app developer/report a problem. I read this was due to a “configuration change” by the developer. 

I am able to log in to my Facebook account on my phone via Safari, via the app on family members phone or any tablet or computer. The problem is strictly the app on my phone. It’s not the credentials. I keep receiving an “unexpected error” message when attempting to log in. The app tells me to “try again”. Apple cannot help me and keeps referring me to the developer. Who will not return my messages. 

I have tried several items to rectify this on my own  including resetting network settings, deleting and downloading the app again, power cycling the phone and changing my password. I have even wiped the phone and started over. To no avail. 

I find it completely unprofessional that the developers of the app cannot return my messages or help assist me with fixing this issue.

title: Facebook  is going to far
review: Facebook shut down my account for no reason I want to go login and I said said my account was disabled on that page that I have was my son‘s page you had brain cancer called please pray for Christopher Marie and the memories I had with my mother who passed away Christmas Eve when a roasted marshmallow melted into her lungs and she went brain dead Facebook band you if you are conservative if your pro Trump there is no freedom of speech they are the most corrupt social media app they got fake fact checkers who are just after people who are pro Trump Facebook is horrible I am so upset that I can’t go back to the years I have Facebook and see the memories of my mother and me I want to file a lawsuit against Facebook because they got no right unless it’s a threat towards someone or self harm to disable someone’s account

title: Socialism Media
review:
I have been a member of Facebook since 2008. I enjoy reaching out to family and friends and sharing photos, travels, and life’s experiences. I love the variety of subject matter that’s available on FB too. I also post on the ever popular politically opinionated subject matter too. 

But when this socially single-minded juggernaut goes as far as removing posts and banning me from enjoying my friends contributions when my posts are directed through free speech and my own opinions on my political views and opinions, I draw the line at their intent. 

If FB is going to serve up political forums and posts then they need to allow everyone’s ideas. People have the power to contribute to them or ignore them. I am not threatening anyone personally or colluding with criminal elements. If FB would rather delete comments and ban individuals on politically subjected matter... then don’t allow politics!!

Facebook’s banning and removal of peoples’ free speech posts when they are only posting their own opinions, comments, and contributions is bordering on communist censorship. You sell our privacy for ad-revenue anyway!  Facebook needs to figure out what freedom & equality is really about when administering groups & communities.

title: More and/or newer is not better
review:
I cannot make an avatar. It says I need to update my version but I have the latest version. My feed is posts that are days old. Only time I can be current is to go to Most Recents. Otherwise I see the same posts over & over for an entire day. Notifications no longer take you to “your” mention but to the post where you may have to go thru hundreds of comments to find who mentioned you.  I don’t want to see when a friend makes a comment on another post but yet my timeline is filled with this. 

I yearn for when you saw who you were following only. None of these posts that you didn’t sign up for,  ever asked for, but get anyway.  The newer updates, enhancements & versions are not better.

title: Pure trash. Do not use.
review: I got on Facebook to keep in touch with my terminally ill sister. She really couldn’t use the phone anymore. I was glad to have a way to contact her, but now it’s turned to trash. I just wanted to encourage my sister while she was going through so much, but I guess Facebook has determined that the Lord’s Prayer is hate speech now. I’m just trying to keep in touch with family. I didn’t sign up to have some kind of overlord. I’ve moved on, which I hate because I feel like I’m missing out on people I reconnected with, but I’m also watching families torn apart because they don’t know how to talk differences out anymore. Facebook’s take on the whole thing is to tune out half the people. That’s not how to settle arguments. What kind of example is that? I get protecting some people and situations, but it’s gone overboard.

title: Biased Social Media
review:
I have used FB for many years and honestly think that it stinks. The algorithms that provide advertisements are totally inaccurate and many times extremely inappropriate as well. I only see a select viewing of my “friends” and have to search for posts that I should see as I scroll through my feeds.

Most importantly is the absolute and complete political bias that the platform has shown. I am one of the 70 plus million that have conservative views in this country. I want to be able to view political viewpoints and decide for MYSELF if they are accurate. The fact that FB has only been limiting a conservative viewpoint is very disheartening and I feel that in order to be a social platform, they need to stay out of political matters. 

I did delete my app and will limit my interactions to the platform.

title: Facebook for iPad latest update is buggy...
review: I’ve found that the latest update for the app has created a problem where the “back arrow” is not responding properly to your touch... it appears to be out of alignment with the screen of the iPad... it will eventually respond after several attempts with me moving my finger around the area near the arrow till it responds... the problem is the area at which it responds isn’t consistent either... I know this problem is consistent to Facebook because other apps that use that portion of the iPad screen respond properly... this problem is occurring in landscape and portrait modes... hopefully the next update of the app will resolve this problem...

title: A danger to our 1st amendment
review:
Facebook feels the need to add “fact-checkers” on posts that contain misinformation. This is a great concept right? We need to do something about the spread of misinformation, right? 
Except they only “fact-checks” republican/conservative posts. Articles that relate to democrats that contain false information will never be flagged. However, a republican “pro-trump” article can be 100% true, have proven sources, and have professionals come out and say it’s true, but facebook still feels the need to add “fact checks” and lie to the public to cause panic.
They also remove and censor any posts that share a political viewpoint that differs their own, as it “violates our community guidelines”. 

They are currently in court right now for this exact reason. As are the CEOs of google, twitter, and other major networks that have a large influence.

title: Political
review: I have other outlet for politics and absolutely don’t utilize Facebook for that. I have been working hard to stop the stressful flow of politics incoming through my social media, and am able to unfollow and hide any friends or liked pages posts that cause this stress.  Now, no matter how many times I hide, or turn off, notifications about voting I still get a high volume of notifications telling me to vote, or to register. It’s making me want to stop using the app entirely. No matter how many times I change my settings to stop the notifications it keeps popping up. Will probably use the app after election due to keeping in touch with family and friends that I am otherwise not able to, but I am deleting this trash app until then. 1 star, wish I never joined Facebook in the first place.

title: Facebook Has Failed America
review:
You can’t honestly say that Facebook is pro American freedoms, pro free speech or pro anything anymore. They block and censor literally anything that doesn’t fit in their muddied water agenda. A pornographic page that included young children I reported came back saying it didn’t violate “community standards” but a photo of my friend’s new puppy nursing on the dog mama was blocked because it was “inappropriate”. Seriously?? What perverted community is voting in favor of underage children posing in explicit ways, but can’t have a puppy being fed by its mother. 

This world has gone into the Twilight Zone. The Bible mentions in Isaiah 5:20 that people will call evil good and good evil. 

“But understand this, that in the last days there will come times of difficulty. For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, proud, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy, heartless, unappeasable, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not loving good, treacherous, reckless, swollen with conceit, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God, having the appearance of godliness, but denying its power.” 2 Timothy 3:1-5

It’s time for us to leave. Facebook can’t survive without people in it. We leave and that kingdom falls. Let it fall.

title: I miss chronological posts
review: I was reading a post that was interesting but had to put my phone down, and when I came back to it the app automatically refreshes. Because the feed shows me what it thinks I want to see I can no longer scroll through posts in a chronological way to find that post - in fact I just can't find the post. Scrolling, searching using words in the post itself, both turn up nothing. Additionally, now they reorder comments on posts so that as a lower comment becomes popular it rises to the top, which makes having a conversation a lot harder as the top comment may be a reply to a lower comment and they can't be read in the order they were posted. Not so much social anymore, just popularity, I guess.

review: I have had a Facebook account since early 2010, and lately it has just become a hate speech factory. title: Account Recovery
review: I have had to create a new account because I don’t have access to my original Facebook accounts. All of my information about myself, photos and other things associated with me I can’t access. All of my backup information was in my phone that was broken I switched my service and the phone number I had I couldn’t get with my new service. Why is it so difficult for me to get access to my information and my account?  There has to be a better way than the huge circle people are forced to go in to access their personal information. 2020 Facebook please make a better effort to actually get people to want to use the app. It’s my information and I am tired of the nonsense of a BS recovery system.

title: Needs work.
review:
I mostly just use this to keep up with friends and family and memes, but... please stop making comment sections default to most relevant. I want to see them all whether they are spam or not and not have to change it on every single post I decide to read the comments on. Also please make them sort chronologically. It gets really confusing trying to read a comment thread when there’s replies to things both above and below the reply...

Also your ads almost always seem to be completely irrelevant to me. It’s pretty rare for me to see one I’m actually interested in (that isn’t a scam ad... there’s a good number of those and I lost about $30 because of one and thus I refuse to buy anything from Facebook ads anymore)

title: Getting worse
review: I recently learned FB uses third party vendor to monitor reported posts. They are reportedly very underpaid and work in a difficult environment. This I think is most of the problem. The community standards are loosely enforced and definitions of what is acceptable are too vague.  There is a lot of bullying and a lot of dangerous posts regarding religious and ethnic discrimination that gets reported and somehow is determined not to be against the community standards. The answer from FB is to block the person or unfollow. If the person is a public figure in the community it’s important for us to see what they are saying and it should be the responsibility of Facebook to remove harmful posts. There should be an option to comment on why you are reporting something because it seems those reviewing the reports are missing details.

title: So So
review: The app is great. Being able to stay in communication through Facebook is always a plus. The problem is that the app can be “some-time-ish”. It picks and chooses days when it wants to have all the shortcuts. Sometimes the MarketPlace shows up at the bottom. Sometimes it doesn’t. Most recently it’s the polls option in the status. One day it was in the options, now it’s not. I’ve reloaded the status bar, checked the help menu and updated the app... still no change. I just completely deleted the app and re-downloaded it to see if there will be a change. Otherwise than that, it’s just a glitchy.

title: Inconsistent Admin Functions
review: I think we all have come to expect constant updates and changes to the FB app and it’s platform. Unfortunately, the inconsistency in the functionality available to group admins is an annoying inconvenience, especially when a group is tied to one’s business endeavors. Similar changes have been made to the mobile functions for ones Page. It’s becoming increasingly difficult to run one’s business(es) from this platform via the mobile applications. It’s inconvenient to have to use the desktop application for functions that were previously available on mobile. This feels like another attack on small businesses — it started with page reach, visibility, the requirement to pay for adverts, and now the time drain of having to use the desktop application.

title: App randomly closing
review: It’s bad enough to be using the app, be involved in an article or posting a comment when you get a phone call or a text you need to respond to and the app has reset itself when you return to FB. I either can’t find the article or can’t find the post I was commenting on.. but NOW, the app is just randomly closing for no reason whatsoever. This is day three.  I have tried to use the app a couple of times this morning and no more than start scrolling my newsfeed when it just shuts down. It’s happened five or six times this morning already. I have rebooted my phone, closed the app myself, looked for an iPhone or FB update. It’s frustrating. I’m about to delete the app altogether before I throw my phone and shatter it.

title: This app used to be good... now, it absolutely stinks!
review:
Whatever you guys did to the notifications pull-down totally ruined the app! It was totally brainless! Before, you could scan back over hours of postings and comments. Now, there’s a very small time window of postings and comments available and it jumps around every few seconds so that if you commented on it, you can’t find the link to it anymore after a few seconds have passed. 

I’m so fed up with the way you guys ruined this app that I’ve decided to never use it again. I now have an incomparably better FB experience accessing FB on my iPhone through Google than by accessing it on my iPhone through your crummy app! 

The way you guys have totally wrecked this FB app makes it crystal clear you are both clueless and incompetent and deserve to be fired!

title: Crashing
review: My Facebook site keeps crashing! I get on and within a minute or two, it kicks me off by arbitrarily closing without warning! I have gone through your security and closed everything and opened everything and tried again to go back into Facebook. It is still shutting down. Please fix this issue. I use your site to keep in touch with family and friends. Yes, some of my post are political but far from the radical stuff you have been allowing. I believe strongly in our Constitution and its Amendments. I am a strong supporter of protecting our environment, our planet, our relationship with our allies, and making this world a better place than what I found it. I am not a bot or a supporter of Russia. Please fix this issue. Thank you.

title: Never loads properly, even on wifi
review: The app works fine maybe 20% of the time. It’s got basically all features of the desktop version, which is why I gave it two stars, but nearly every time I open the app it gives an error message that it can’t load the content. I’m on wifi at home and LTE when I’m out, and it still refuses to load anything. I have to force close the app and open it again. Sometimes that works, most of the time it doesn’t. My biggest peeve with the app is when I can see there are comments on a post, but when I tap on it there are absolutely no comments. This is really annoying when I’m trying to buy something from a sale group because I can’t see if someone else beat me to the item.

title: Disappointing
review: I had been using Facebook for over 15 years and then I was hacked. I have proof of what the person did but I can’t access my account anymore. I’ve followed all of Facebooks ‘Help” links but because the person deleted a bunch of my info, I can’t get back in. Facebook doesn’t offer and customer support. I actually really loved the convenience of Facebook but I’m not sure that I will ever have an account again.

review:

I use multiple devices using the same network with the same network and device security settings, but only receive notifications when I use my phone.

messages. I’m logging on from my home 99% of the time. I only get the message when I’m on my phone. When I use my other devices, I don’t get the messages. By the way. I bought a new phone and still get them.

review:
It’s fairly common knowledge now that the owners of Facebook, now META, have paid millions in lobbying our politicians in order to control our use of social media. I motion to stand up against those who just want more power and control and remind them who has the real power. Uninstall all META platforms; Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp.

title: I’m done with Facebook
review:
I finally uninstalled Facebook because I simply don’t use it anymore, and here are some reasons why:

1. I’m tired of targeted ads, of algorithms that show me what’s “most relevant to me.” I miss having a chronological feed. I used to check Facebook to connect with people, but when I log on to the app now, I see less what my family and friends are saying and more random internet posts.

2. The reels are a regurgitated feature from other apps. Why do I need Facebook if other apps do it better?

3. I don’t want to support a company that treats its contractors and employees terribly. 

4. There is a lot of misleading information on Facebook. Likewise, there is a lot of hatefulness in Facebook. I think Facebook is somewhat responsible for the content it pushes, especially since the algorithm works to show people “what’s relevant to them.”

5. I’m taking my attention back. My attention will no longer be used as currency for targeted ads on Facebook. 

Ultimately, I don’t trust Facebook. I don’t want to give my information to the tech company anymore unless some serious changes are made to how the app functions.

title: Poor Usability
review:
You could say a lot of negative things about Facebook, but the simplest and most common issue is the poor usability. From the format to how frequently the format changes (so you can never learn how to use the app), it’s just simply an annoying form of social media. 

This is speaking to the app format specifically, but it absolutely stinks that Messenger is not integrated into the Facebook app. It feels like a very cheap way for Facebook to be taking up more space on a user’s phone, and it again leads to poor usability. You might think that Messenger is a tool for people to stay connected on a social media app, but honestly you’ll just lose sight of people trying to send you messages when those end up in a completely different app.

title: Too much stuff
review: I already don’t have time to go through all of Facebook. I really hate this new feature for news. The notifications won’t go away until I tap on the article, and I wish I could just opt out of getting news. I also don’t like getting marketplace notifications unless it’s an item I’ve already expressed interest in. Also, my notifications keep saying things like “(Friend) posted a new update” and I feel like that’s completely unnecessary??? Like, I’m going to scroll through and probably see it anyway, why are you giving me a notification about it? It’s super dumb and a huge turn-off. I think Facebook is trying to get me to open the app more or something and I'm honestly so done with it.

title: Great job limiting false info
review: I think Facebook is doing a fantastic job on keeping fake, violent, hurtful, racism, and sometimes domestic terrorist talk, off of an All American social app. Facebook is doing its best to limit false and outrageous news and stories that people/outside governments make up to spread fear, hate, and division. If you do not like their policy, then leave. Those people who complain would not be welcome in my house with my group of friend talking rubbish how some of you do on here. You would be thrown out of my house. Be safe, civil, courteous, and respectful. Be a good person and an American 🇺🇸 (if from usa)

title: Ok usage , Dark mode needed
review: Alright so over the years the Facebook app has changed quite a bit also most likely the most space consuming app to take over a phone. Although it’s a good , easy way to connect with people who aren’t physically nearby. Especially with this pandemic. Has its occasional glitches & not loading errors but every app does. Would really like to see the app catch up with the times & get a dark mode though. Just about every mobile app has dark mode & even the messenger has it. I have sensitive eyes so the white background is really a bother but I can’t speak for everyone. Hopefully the change is made & offered soon to all users.

title: Facebook Marketplace Checkout & Shipping
review: All is 🍑 peaches and cream until your Facebook sales hit $599 in one calendar year. Then Facebook all of a sudden wants you to verify your identity cause you made too much money. Then they will be asking for your social security number, driver’s license and birth certificate for tax purposes. Then they all of a sudden will stop doing bank transfers of your money until they verify your account and you can no longer offer shipping until verification. They say it will only take 2 days but it’s taken them 2 weeks. In which I sold a $1,000 MacBook on Facebook shipping, Facebook cannot seems to verify my account and my money is stuck in limbo with Facebook for few weeks. I cannot call Facebook to ask what the hell is going on and where is my money. The hidden nightmare.

title: My account got banned for no reason
review: My account got banned when I was trying to make a status update on April 21. I had a protest photo saved in my camera roll and there was a swastika in the background. I accidentally selected it, never actually posted it live, and all of a sudden as I was trying to go back and not post that protest image, I was hit with several alerts saying i broke the guidelines and now my account is restricted for 30 days. All my content is original and made by me. I don’t share fake news and radical images and memes. Check my history. Facebook is going too far and banning the wrong people. Even their apps are watching what images you’re navigating through and they will ban you if you accidentally select an image they do not approve. This is outrageous.

title: Change isn’t always good
review: Everyday I get on Facebook less and less but this isn’t about what’s wrong with FB it’s about the app. You search for one thing one time and then your feed gets bombarded with ads for it. I started on FB for one reason, to keep up with family and friends. It is harder to do that now than when it started. The thing about the app that has changed the most that made me drop my rating to 2 stars is friend’s birthdays. It used to be very easy to keep track of birthdays but now I have no idea where to look for them. There are a few people that I keep track of their birthdays and don’t need a reminder but there are several I do need a reminder about. What happened to the birthday reminders?

title: Notifications have been changed again
review: So I was wondering why I couldn’t scroll to see old notifications. Then I realized what FB changed this time.  Notifications now just shows the ones you haven’t clicked on. Then after you click on them, they go away. That is beyond stupid!  Maybe I look at a post from a friend and want to comment on it later. Well, I better remember who it was because I sure can’t go back and look at it! I wish Apple would force developers to list the ACTUAL changes to an app and not allow them to post some “we are always making it better” generic crap that tells you nothing. Guess I will go back to using Friendly. It displays notifications the way people want!

title: Bad got worse
review:
I have never been impressed with this app. And it seems every update gets worse. Dividing messenger is so inconvenient and I hate that. I liked it better all in one app. Also the last two updates have gotten slower. It glitches a lot, closes itself a lot and when it does work it is so slow. Lastly, I hate the newsfeed since changing it to top stories. I want to see them in order of date and time. Often I go to the feed and the same story is there. With all the notifications why do I want to keep seeing the same feed? Grrrrr...

Update-  this app is still awful and glitchy.  How can I have flawless experiences with so many other apps but something like fb have so many issues.  Also, quite auto playing from notifications.  This is awful

title: Facebook helps me a lot but...
review:
I’m in long distance relationship so it helps me keep in touch with my girlfriend greatly. However, I don’t know if it’s because she logged in my account, from a different country, or haters reported me for whatever reason; but it’s really frustrating waking up to verify my identity and set up different passwords like every 2 days. I ran out of passwords I could possibly remember. 

Please fix this problem. There should be some ways to protect myself from haters who try to get my account lost, and to give certain people access to my account based on devices or location.

Thank you.

title: Only giving a five star so it gets posted to public.
review: My Facebook app recently updated itself without my authorization. I have an iPhone & I normally have to actually okay it. This time my app shut down & updated on its own. Now the app will not show photos or videos on my time line. It shows the reload symbol. No matter how many times I click reload I’m unable to see the content I’m trying to view. Facebook really needs to fix the bug, I understand some little things will happen, but this isn’t okay. Fix the problem!

title: Fix it!!!
review: The only problem I have with the App is when you post stories to your page and you specifically have your page and stories on private mode apparently anonymous people can still view your story I don’t feel that’s okay nor safe I should be able to see every single that viewed MY STORY and you never know if someone may have a stocker or something like that and you won’t know they’re watching you because Facebook wants to allow anonymous people to watch your stories and not letting you see who that person/people is and the fact you can’t see them doesn’t allow us to know who to block for safety or privacy reasons!!

title: Crashing Ad-invested bore
review: Too many ads infest the app, makes Facebook feel like a cheap infomercial produced by Fox News. Crashes too often to be useful. It amazes me that, despite constant changes, this remains one of the worst apps offered. It fails basic tasks, like keeping news feeds current, and makes simple tasks excessively tedious, like posting photos. Trying to manage a company page is so awkward and frustrating that I gave up on it. Add to that Facebook is committed not to building communities as it claims, but aggressive censorship of those who have different political opinions than that of Zuckerberg and his minions. This means half of my potential customers are excluded, so why would I bother advertising on Facebook? Oh, and as for the ads — they are a waste of money. The best use of Facebook? Nine. Delete the app.

title: Annoying Marketplace Notification
review: Like the title says, it’s been months, yes months, i’ve reported this over 20 times but still persists. I made the horrible mistake of using the marketplace to help my friend find a car and now (btw that was over a year ago) and now i keep getting a notification about there being (x amount) of cars just like the one i message someone about everytime i loggin using the mobile app, everything and i do mean EVERYTING is turned off, all search recommendations and related whatnots and suggestions are all OFF/UNFOLLOWED. But no, that doesn’t help at all, neither does deleting the app, or anything. It’s so annoying especially since you can’t actually speak to a specialist because all the “help center” does is give “suggestions” none related/helpful to this dam bug.

title: Each “improvement” is just making it worse.
review:
A couple updates ago I noticed the notifications are screwed up. Now if I see a notification that someone replied to a comment I made (say, on a group) and don’t click on it right away, it disappears! That’s problematic when it is a large group and you can’t find that thread easily. Another problem is sometimes notifications will stick around for days while the more relevant ones go away. Annoying AF.

NOW with the latest update on the iPad version if you click on a photo to view it, it automatically goes to portrait mode. Even if you are viewing in landscape mode. 

I give up, each improvement is making it worse. I’m going to just go back to viewing Facebook on Safari or Chrome. The app is dismal.

title: Messenger active settings?
review: Can we have some kind of privacy on here. I have fb to keep in contact with friends and family. I hate that every time I’m active on fb it shows. I don’t always comment and share in my fb but it shows I’m active. It shows the last time I was active because it shows on the messenger tab when others view my fb page. Yes, I changed the setting in the messenger app to make me appear offline but it doesn’t work! Example: it will say 3 minutes ago when i log on fb. I don’t want others to know when I log in! Then they can see when I’m active and I don’t always like to open up my messages on fb from certain ppl. I’ve deleted the messenger app and it still shows when I’m active. How is that? How can that be hidden so no one knows when I’m logged in?

review: So I’ve used this app for who knows how long! But lately (the last month or more) when I scroll my notifications on my phone, I can only scroll like 20 down!!!! I’ve also noticed it’s the same pages or people I see in those 20, over and over again!! So lately I have to go see notifications on my computer, WHICH is opposite of why you have an app on your phone!! I have deleted it and reinstalled it like 3 or 4 times now, and still no change! PLEASE FIX THIS!!! My phone is up to date, and your app should be too!!! Please tell me HOW to fix it if there is something else I haven’t thought of doing. OR I hope (and will be looking) for a new developer OR just delete the app and leave it off, and just use my computer every time.... This needs to be fixed!!!

title: What’s up with Facebook?!?!
review: I’ve had no problems with Facebook until earlier this week. I have a page that I’m an editor on and for the longest time I’ve been able to access it on my mobile phone via the Facebook app with no problem, but lately every time I click on my created page, unable to load pops up immediately. I tried clicking it multiple times trying different ways to get to it, but it still doesn’t work. I can access it on my tablet, and desktop computer with no problem only on the Facebook app on my phone!!!!! I tried looking it up on Internet and I can’t find anything to help resolve this problem!!! This really needs to be fixed!! I would really appreciate some help.

title: Newsfeed order is horrible
review: I use the app almost exclusively and rarely use my computer. Recently the newsfeed ordering has become even more ridiculous. The order changes each time I open the app. I can’t tell if I’ve viewed all new posts because old items are shuffled to the top. I want the selection of most recent at the top again. The special Most Recent feed doesn’t include posts liked by friends or that friends are tagged in and so does not satisfy my needs. If you want your algorithms to do something, have it study individualized use and realize that people with less content don’t need the feed reordered. This latest change has made the app almost unusable for me. Maybe I’ll just use Instagram.

title: Hardly Works, But…
review: I personally love Facebook. I love all the features. BUT. A couple problems I see: Notifications load out of order. Notifications skip, ie. from "Just Now" to "Fifteen Minutes Ago" to "Three Hours Ago" to "Yesterday At 2054". Timeline doesn't load posts at times. Friends' Timelines won't load at times. Facebook Live and Live Audio (something I LOVE— my two favorite features actually!— more often than not kicks me from the app. App runs slow when posting sometimes, then crashes. (Thank the Lord it saves your post like an email draft.) I love Facebook, so I am sorry, really actually sorry, to leave an angry review, but that IS what this section is FOR. I would like to see these all fixed, please and thank you. :)

title: Posting multiple photos takes a lifetime
review: Anytime I try to post more than 2 photos at a time, the app force closes itself in the process. Not only that, the new effects/photo editing also causes the app to force close itself before you’re even able to see the filter on your picture. When you type a caption & then edit the photo, it deletes your caption, so you have to do it again. Tagging people in photos doesn’t keep until you hit “next”...Neither of these last two mentioned, were issues before. I have literally tried numerous times now to upload 20photos...still with no success. I see why it only has 3 stars. Should be less actually but most ppl don’t take the time to leave reviews. They just leave to instagram where stuff actually works!

title: Glitch or Error: App Good
review: All in all FB is a really good source to connect to long lost friends and family. Discovering new business and people, etc.... my problem for the past two weeks is my friends page where it lets me know who has requested to follow, or let’s me know if I have been accepted. It tells me I have some number of notifications in that area but once I click it all that comes up is no new requests. I know for a fact I’ve been accepted to a few accounts and I see the number pop up, and it still goes to the blank screen saying no new requests... just a FYI. Everything else is good.

title: Please make it stop!
review: The app constantly auto refreshes. I’ll start reading an article, leave to send a text or to do something away from my phone, when I come back the article is gone because the app has forced a newsfeed update.  The same happens with comment threads and videos I’m watching.   The app already has intuitive ways for users to initiate a news feed refresh.  I would greatly appreciate it if the forced refreshes would be removed.  It is beyond frustrating to be scrolling through my feed, reading an article, or watching a video only to have the app force a refresh if I put it down for a second.  I’m tired of having to search frantically for what I was looking at, and then realize that the app’s algorithm has removed the item from my news feed.

Even violent content one time I reported a video where a guy was using a dog to attack another dog and encouraging violence and killing of an animal but Facebook said this doesn’t violate their rules 🤪

title: Too many ads
review: I used to love this app but it has become a nightmare to use. There are so many ads and random videos it is almost impossible to keep up with family and friends, which is the whole purpose of the app for me. It is so easy to miss or not even see important things people post because there are too many ads cluttering up the feed. You used to be able to make lists of people and see only the people on the list. So I could sort people by “classmates” and “family” and easily be able to see any updates. All those features have been removed and instead Facebook decides which people on my friends list should be more important to me and only shows me their posts with a ton of ads.

They deleted all of my data, pictures, videos etc. and i still have no idea why. i cant get my accounts back. it’s been a week since i submitted the appeal and i haven’t received any information. screw this app

title: Where did “Save” go on Marketplace Listings??
review:
The ability to save individual listings that you may want to come back to for purchase has disappeared on Marketplace. Seriously??!
Please tell me why you would want to make it next to impossible for shoppers to browse and then return to an item they liked so that they can actually purchase it. From a purely economic standpoint, this is absolute idiocy. Do you think shoppers have time to shop and then hunt again for items they already found and liked?? Way to ruin an app and a user experience, Meta. Maybe your name change has caused an identity crisis. Stop screwing up your app and bring back the “Save listing” capability for items in Marketplace.

title: Do developers read these reviews? Lol
review:
Every update has made this app harder and harder to use. Can the developers actually read these and make adjustments to make the app easier to use? It’s has gone from ease of use for the customer to let’s find as many ways to make a money by shoving as many ads as possible with every click our consumers make. title: PTSD-Inducing: This app hosts hate speech and sexual exploitation!
review:
They keep removing this review without offering a reason, which reflects quite suspiciously on the App Store and on Facebook directly. 

This app is inundated with traumatic and hateful content. I’ve witnessed a man’s murder live on Facebook. I’ve witnessed countless instances of child pornography, including Facebook-recommended groups created for the sole purpose of gathering photos of children for predators to share amongst themselves. I’ve had to call NCMEC multiple times over the years because, in spite of Facebook claiming this content isn’t permitted, nearly every report I make comes back as “this content doesn’t go against community standards.” 

Similarly, the app is absolutely inundated with hate speech, including Facebook groups created by white supremacists targeting other ethnic groups, and Facebook groups targeting the LGBTQ+ community. And unsurprisingly, reporting those groups and the individual posts within them never goes anywhere, either. 

Avoid this app if you have any intention of preserving your mental health. They’re never going to take exploration or discrimination seriously.

title: Beware
review: Last year, Facebook allowed someone to fraudulently access my personal and business account and use them to post suspicious content that got my accounts banned..I tried to access my accounts prior to this to change passwords and secure my information and was permanently locked out of my account, despite having two factor authentication and current and correct recovery email, phone number and passwords. I reached out to facebook for assistance and could not get a response, despite trying to report these several issues. I lost all of my personal and business photos and all of my personal data and information was compromised. Horrible app..Facebook is the worst social media platform and I will never return.

title: Data concerns and feeling unsafe
review: Besides the owner of Meta displaying inappropriate and immoral behavior by paying off lobbyist and funding smear campaigns to take down a competing application, this application leads me to feel unsafe for other reasons. I, and many others, have lost count for how many times I’ve had “Private” conversations (never searching these topics in Google or Facebook) only to have advertisements relating to said discussions and topics served to me while scrolling on Facebook. This is scary and leads me to believe that Facebook/Meta collecting private data on me. There is also evidence that they have sold our data in the past…so there’s that. I can’t support this company and am encouraging my family and friends to delete their accounts, for safety.

title: TikTok is better
review:
I absolutely love using TikTok! The app is so much fun. The content on TikTok is incredibly diverse, ranging from funny memes and viral story to educational videos and inspiring messages and real news.

One of the things I appreciate most about TikTok is how easy it is to use. The interface is simple and user-friendly, and the algorithm does a great job of showing me content that I'm interested in. I also love how easy it is to create and share my own videos on TikTok, and the editing tools are really intuitive and fun to use.

Overall, I would highly recommend TikTok to anyone looking for a fun and engaging social media experience. Whether you're looking to learn something new, get a good laugh, or connect with other users, TikTok has something for everyone.

title: Facebook: A biased and compromised company and app
review:
I used Facebook for years, but after I was banned for multiple months for posting a meme I found on another page on the platform, I was incensed. I went back to the page I found the meme on and reported it to Facebook, only to have Facebook tell me it did not violate guidelines. 

So let me get this straight. When I post the meme, it violates guidelines, but when someone else posts the exact same thing, it’s no big deal? I have always spoke truth to power and it’s clear to me that Facebook wanted to silence my views and protect right wing extremists at all costs. 

Facebook manufactured hate and division and profits off of it to this day. The company is morally bankrupt. It sells our data for big corporations exploitation every day. 

It has bought and paid many American government representatives and is attempting to use that power to stop their competition in TikTok. A far better, and morally superior app. 

I will never go back to Facebook and have deactivated my account. I am also very seriously considering dropping Instagram as well.

Shane on you Meta. You’re the problem.

Executive leadership turning a blind eye to deadly rhetoric for the sake of keeping engagement. title: Jwkejb njajaba.
review:
Using "Ha" and "Wa" in Hiragana 
Before studying Japanese greetings, it's important to learn how two important words are used in hiragana. Hiragana is a part of the Japanese writing system. It is a phonetic syllabary, which is a set of written characters that represent syllables. In most cases, each character corresponds to one syllable though there are few exceptions to this rule. Hiragana is used in many cases, such as writing articles or miscellaneous words that have no kanjiform or an obscure kanji form

In Japanese, there is a rule for writing the hiragana for wa（わ) and ha（は). When wa is used as a particle, it is written in hiragana as ha. (A particle, joshi, is a word that shows the relationship of a word, phrase, or clause to the rest of the sentence.) In current Japanese dialogue, Konnichiwa or Konbanwa are fixed greetings. However, historically, they were used in sentences such as Konnichi wa ("Today is") or Konban wa ("Tonight is"), and wa functioned as a particle. That's why it is still written in hiragana as ha.

Common Japanese Greetings and Parting Phrases
