Was using this app but needed to take a vacation for a year, however after a year, the problems persisted and worsened  bugs seem to be by design.
-Extremely invasive sign up requiring an updated Photo, personal phone number, and voice profile whats next, a DNA sample? Yet still after all things described, was still “hacked”
-Privacy virtually nonexistent. Despite “caring about privacy” they collected information and assigned me a political affiliation as well as a targeted marketing profile.
-Was a victim of sever harassment who was still able to contact me after finding my private profile. All Privacy boxes were maximized for just such an event. A
-And probably the most grievous offense, while browsing several accounts put links to their prayer page showing violence both severe and gory nature, pages that have sexually suggestive comments, racist/xenophobic, or genocidal.
All pages reported however, Facebook says it “Isn't violating the policies” even though according to the policies Ive read it has so one can only assume it condones this behavior.

title: No AVATAR ON IPAD RPO....Cause need new version!!!
review: Ok so I’m using iPad Pro which is not an old version of iPads (iPadOS 13.6) and is telling me that current app version doesn’t support Facebook Avatars..... of course it doesn’t need an update because the app is updated but really what is happening? I have an iPhone as well but I’m not switching over to my phone just to use my avatar it makes no since really......while my phone charges and I’m relaxing on bed checking Facebook and congratulating people on birthdays or anniversaries on a bigger screen after a long day of work is ridiculous that I have to put my iPad down or shut it just because the iPad Version is not available.

title: I'm tired of the crap!
review: I can't post anything. Not on my own news feed, or a group post, or comment on a friend's post, or pictures!! And I'm soooo very tired of not getting new notifications until 24-48 hours later! I'm involved in a few groups that allow us to posts sales, and I never know about the sale until a day or two later, by then, everything that I could have wanted to purchase has already sold. Even though I'm a stay-at-home mom, I don't have the time or patients to sit and continuously refresh the page to make sure that I don't miss a sale! After soooo many updates, and reviews from other people who are having the same problem, why hasn't this been fixed?

title: Hurt
review: I have been a Facebook user for over 10 years and I have never had any problems, never been blocked, reported or anything. 2 weeks ago I was logged out of my account while browsing my newsfeed and asked to send in my ID for an Identity check. I have not been able to access my friends, family and photos in two weeks with no explanation on why my account was disabled. I am completely hurt. During this pandemic of Covid-19 I just want to check on my loved ones.

title: Hacked and then ignored
review:
I was recently banned from marketplace due to apparent listings on my account that I DID NOT POST. I went back in and changed my password, and there hasn’t been any unauthorized activity on there since then. I attempted to appeal the marketplace ban TWICE, and explained that I had not posted those listings. My appeal was denied twice. I cannot find anyone to contact about this issue and everything has been really frustrating.

 I typically use Facebook to keep up with animal groups and to buy things on marketplace. I have NEVER listed anything on there and I am extremely disappointed that there has been zero help with this issue, which has been going on for upwards of two weeks. 

The idea of Facebook is nice, but if you have an issue prepare to be totally ignored.

title: Still buggy on iPhone XS Max
review: This application is great because everyone has Facebook. The one thing that makes the app unenjoyable is how much it crashes when you try to use it. I tried to get on the app numerous times and I keep getting a white screen and then it takes me to the main screen. I hope they fix this bug and patch an update very soon. This really killed my experience and I was using the app just fine before the new 13.3 update. Overall, it’s a good app because 90% of everyone already have Facebook and the app is easier to use and share. Once they fix the bugs and glitches, the app will be solid once again.

title: I just joined and automatically got disabled
review: I joined Facebook so I could join the group chat for the college I will be entering next year. Once I joined I chose an appropriate profile picture and followed a few of my school friends. Then, when I check the app again, it said it was under review and I will be given a notice when I can enter again. I thought this was standard for every account, but when I checked today (a day after being told my account was being reviewed) Facebook told me my account was disabled. This is ridiculous. I just wanted to make new friends with kids going to the same college as me and it’s frustrating how I can’t even do just that! What was the point of me wasting my time making an account if it was just going to be disabled? Uncool.

title: Horrible
review:
Ok lets start with the basics. Facebook infringes your amended rights by selling your personal data to government agencies such as the NSA for "surveillance" when in reality is profiting from invading your privacy and selling it to a organization that created this program of collaborations specifically for having the power of blackmailing people they deem enemy of the federal gov. 

Now the platform. Is very buggy and on top of that is full of trolls and people who always want to annoy others. Marketplace crashes the app every time and the live option is pointless since it never worked after uninstalling and installing the app. Mind that I have a top of the line brand new phone. With that being said Instagram is a way better platform. Facebook just breaks way to many national laws and rights for profit.

title: Odd refreshing.
review: Everything works accordingly, but I have one slight problem. Not really sure how to explain it, so I’ll do my best. Say for instance I’m on Facebook, maybe commenting on somebody’s post, or looking at a photo, video, etc. If I switch apps in the midst of doing this, once I return to Facebook it just refreshes back to the home screen. Before it would just resume as to where I was before when changing about, but now not at all. This is a minor complaint, but is quite irritating to say the least. I will say the app doesn’t crash, it just seems to refresh to the home screen.

title: Frustrating
review:
I have never in my life dealt with such incompetency... for over a month I have been attempting to start my own company and integrate it with my IG page (DarkForgeGymCo).  The software flat out does not work.  When I hit “add page” no area appears for me to apply a page.  When I go to connect the email it says “invalid email” to every single email I have created trying to do this.  My last attempt even got my account deleted and my email banned which put me back to square one.  The “Help” center is useless and offers no solution and there is strictly no way to get in touch with support.  

I am so disappointed and so frustrated, it’s unbearable.  I honestly don’t understand how this app has made it so far.  This is absolutely rediculous and I could not be more displeased.

title: No privacy, feels like kindergarten
review: Horrible lack of privacy. No rhyme or reason to what is displaying on the wall, mostly ads and old posts I’ve already seen instead of what’s new and relevant with my friends. And lastly, and most annoying is that Facebook shares comments my friends are making in other specific groups or subjects, that are often controversial and in no way relevant to ....feels like a horrible invasion of privacy, they can’t do anything on Facebook without being “toddle tailed on” to me and all their other friends. Why would anyone want to hang out in a social environment where irrelevant conversations and private stuff is being shared with everyone you are NOT wanting to share it with..., if you did you would just post it in your wall or story.

title: Can’t even watch one video anymore
review: I have had Facebook for almost 10 years now, and I’ve loved it up until recently. Now, with all these pointless updates, and I don’t have internet to do so, I can’t use the app correctly. On top of that, I can’t watch a SINGLE video all the way through without it stopping—I can’t even re watch it after closing out the app. I know this is to push updates on me, but that is ridiculous. Also, the ads that we have NO WAY of avoiding are pathetic. I used to adore Facebook. Now I can’t stand it and I only use it to connect with family and friends. I can’t even enjoy 5 minutes on Facebook without being rudely interrupted by a video I can’t even watch or an ad.

title: Fairly Decent
review: I only have a few complaints. One is that every time I click on a link to read an article that’s on a website outside of Facebook, it takes forever to load. Sometimes I get part way through an article and can’t finish it because the rest of the page refuses to load. The other is that every time I get one notification, the badge app icon says that I have 5 notifications even though it’s just one. If I get 2 notifications, the app icon says there are 6, and if I get 3, the icon says there are 7, etc. Its not a huge problem, just kind of annoying. Other than that, I have no problem with this app.

title: FB app crashes and can’t move down on my timeline
review: I wanted to report this problem on my FB Page, but the app crashes before I type anything in the reporting section.  The Facebook App crashes when I try to do anything on the app.     I am unable to scroll down on my timeline too, even though I can scroll down on other peoples timelines just fine.  I’ve tried everything...I deleted and reinstalled the app, I reset the settings on my iPad, I checked to make sure I had the latest iOS update, I went out of the app and back in several times.  I have no crashing issues with any other app, so I doubt that this is a battery issue and I have 79.4 gb of free memory.  Please tell me what else is there to do?

title: Going backward!
review:
The Facebook iOS app has long been a work in progress, but it had gotten to the point where despite mysterious divergence between what it showed you and what you'd see in a browser, it could mostly be relied upon.

However, since the most recent updates, it’s gotten seriously wonky. For the last couple of days, if you try to post a link with a brief introduction, that introductory text randomly disappears and reappears, or is visible on the web but not in the app. As of today, I’ve started noticing the same happening even with regular update posts with no link involved. So one sees a “post” with likes and shares and comments, but no actual content! 

Refreshing the view temporarily restores normalcy, but leave the app and return and your content has again vanished. 

This is all extremely annoying, and since FB provides no easy internal channel for feedback — a sign of corporate disdain for users, in my opinion — I'm forced to raise the issue here. 

I hope this issue can be resolved quickly.

title: Marketplace location issues
review:
Updated to the newest version this morning and marketplace is completely screwed up now.

As a collector I search for things all over the UK, Australia, Canada, Netherlands, France etc. I used to be able to set saved searches for those areas and get notifications. In the last couple of weeks I have received notifications but then can’t view them without physically dropping a pin in those locations to try and find whatever was new that came up. 

After the update this morning I have not been able to drop a pin and change my location to anywhere overseas. I scrolled back over to the US and cannot change my location there now either. Every place I try to change my location to gives me an error.

title: Facebook - The Mobile Version
review:
The mobile version of Facebook is not nearly as good as the regular version.  There’s two reasons.  The first being that the notifications.  You can only see some of it.  Literally about the first 20 of the notifications.  Of course, it is a lot different on the regular version where you can everything.  The other is in regards to the most updated news, etc.  If you want to see the most updated feeds, then you must do a couple of extra steps.  I had to literally ask one of my Facebook friends where I could see the updated feeds.

I would like to see it improved in the future.

title: Not Worth It. Use Safari.
review:
This app used to be good like, forever ago. Now it’s just a crazy, laggy mess. It crashes every time I use it, and before that the lag makes it barely usable. I can barely load or write comments, can barely refresh my TL (WHEN I WANT TO because of course when I DONT it does it anyways) and renders trying to watch any videos useless. None of my other apps do this and my phone is brand new so there’s definitely nothing else to blame here. As for the “updates” they never tell you what exactly they’re doing because it’s probably NOTHING and regardless, it gets worse and worse every time.

UPDATE: it crashes even more often than before and sometimes I can’t even open the app without it force closing immediately. Thanks, useless updates.

title: What happened to Facebook
review:
I don’t know what Facebook is thinking but I very rarely use the app anymore because all I see is ads. I rarely see any post from friends which i thought was the main purpose of Facebook. If they want to continue losing members then keep it up. Otherwise stop being the greedy, money hungry tech people y’all have become and go back to what it’s main purpose was. I will gladly keep using TikTok and just delete this app if it doesn’t change soon.
Update: I just went to look for something on marketplace cause I was desperate and decided to scroll just to see if its gotten any better and I counted 26 ads before I saw an actual post from a friend on my feed. Come on Facebook do better!

title: Notifications
review:
Before the last couple updates I was able to leave a comment on someone’s post and then click to not receive notifications about it…now it doesn’t come up until someone adds another comment to the same post; I have to click not to receive notifications for that specific post in the menu. 

The app used to be so easy, but with the last several updates, it has gotten worse. 

And there is no one to help when certain features don’t work. For instance, Facebook dating comes up on all my friends’ profiles, but it doesn’t give me that option. And all my stuff is up to date.

title: Customer service
review: It’s like Facebook doesn’t care one bit about people using their platform. When there is an issue, there is no way to let Facebook know there’s a problem with their application. There’s no way to talk to anybody about anything. So I give this one star because I’ve been using it for a long time. The platform has a lot of benefits, but when it comes to caring about the people using their platform. I would give them a zero. They absolutely do not care at all. But they are happy to make using their platform. Not so fun sometimes. I mean try going through your friends list and liking a bunch of their posts. You’ll find yourself unable to do that anymore.  Anyway, that’s enough of my rant.

title: Phone not ringing (no ring sounds) when Facebook app is open
review: For the last month I have not been getting call sounds when Facebook is open. You might see an incoming call if you are looking at the screen but there is no sound. I have missed many important calls because of this. There are many many forums regarding this. It is not the iOS or the phone software; it is absolutely something that is because of Facebook. They are somehow able to override system settings when the app is open. Of course this has been happening for over a year with some people and they never ever get a response or resolution with Facebook. Mine happened directly after one of the updates

I am extremely disappointed in the support offered from Facebook which is virtually nothing. All of my contact information was changed within 5 mins even though I had 2 step verification in place. This is an extremely frustrating situation and as a user of this app I have to say I feel like the customer is not cared about at all. As someone who has bought marketing space on your platform I am disappointed that you make a profit off of every user yet can’t have safe guards in place to help them or even a support phone number or email address.

title: STOP ACCEPTING REFUNDS AUTOMATICALLY!
review: I sell as a business on Facebook and have had a great deal of success using marketplace HOWEVER they accept returns with no proof of anything and I am tired of it! I have received 2 of my refunded items damaged! And had another refunded before delivery! You need to work out a better way to get seller involved in return process and not take it upon yourself to refund for no good reason! I am very upset this is happening without being told to me! I find out when I check my order screen and see negative! I am very upset and honestly want to stop using Facebook because they are acting like they are the ones who sent the product when I they didn’t!

title: Worst Social Media App to Grace the Internet
review: This review is emotionally fueled so I’m not gonna have many comments on the overall functionality and technological part of the app (thought I will say, both of these aspects are not admirable). The only thing keeping me on this wretched app is the vast amount of elderly relatives on here that insist I keep it so we can keep in touch. I have no idea what they see in the app, but I sure do know what I see: a horrible example of social connection. The overall layout of the app makes zero sense and the lack of moderation is insanity. I regret ever turning on my phone with each annoying notification from this app I get. Not much else to say besides avoid Facebook and maybe even Instagram at all costs.

title: Facebook no more
review: I regret ever switching from MySpace to Facebook. Times were good for a while. But over the years, it became a cesspool filled with people updating you on things that don’t matter and extreme views. Then, our parents joined (looking at you, Boomers). That was the beginning of the end. If I wanted to watch people jump down each others’ throats all the time, I would just go to a family gathering. The algorithm is the worst part. Every other post these days is either sponsored or an ad. They’re not even targeted. Facebook is the anti-social media. Because there’s nothing social about it anymore. And they suppress actual voices in favor of monetization. Now this anti-TikTok lobbying? Nah. I’m out. You’re not worthy of my time and ad revenue.

title: I’ve since deleted the app
review: Facebook has just become a cesspool of hateful people accounts, horrible influx of miss information to many times has it spammed my whole phone with notifications of every single person posting it has spammed my email of every single message in person who likes and responds and it’s like I can’t get away from the app, too many times have I been on the app and I don’t have my camera on but my camera light turns on as if it’s taking a picture of me or it’s recording me while I’m on Facebook. It’s the only time my computer or my phone ever does that and it’s very scary. I have since deleted Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp because I have a feeling all of Meta is starting to do this.

title: STOP. SLIDING. MY. SCREEN.
review:
Every since the new update the app in unusable. Swipe left for this, swipe right for that, it’s unbearably clunky and poorly executed. Glad I recovered my password so I can delete my 17 year account I’ve had since this app was nothing more than a website competing with MySpace. I thought in the last year that Meta would provide better features, more accurate feed algorithms, and better use of software and read space junking up the site. Nope. It’s almost unbearable to be on for more than 10 minutes. 
I’ll be glad to ditch my account, and the app. I can’t possibly see it becoming anything other than another outdated app we all delete for better, newer apps. Shot yourselves in the foot in what you did.

title: You lost me
review: I have enjoyed (or semi enjoyed) my time at Facebook since 2009.  Due to the glitchy messenger and ever changing interface and the post suppression, nothing about this app interests me anymore.  The only connection I have is all my older family members still use this app.  And now with the lobbying to take away our freedom of speech in America I cannot just sit here and standby and still use a product created and run by a man who’s gone mad with power.  I appreciate the work you put into building such a massive company and connecting us all but you’ve gone too far with control, censorship and now getting involved with our laws.  You’ve let seemingly unlimited power get to you head and we’re all pretty over it now.

title: Unfairly banned
review:

title: How is it this bad after so many years
review:
Tldr- I'm bored so I'm writing about how Facebook kinda screwed me out of a lotta dough

There's a lot to dislike about Facebook. I'm gonna just write one grievance though. 

Messenger quit working for me suddenly sometime last fall. I was selling my car, getting some messages here and there, then the messages just stopped. I just assumed that people weren't interested in my marketplace listing. My old convos were still in my inbox, so I didn't question if it was messenger screwing up. After a long time with nobody apparently interested in my car, I sold it to a guy down the street who low balled me just so I could get it off my hands.

Fast forward, this summer I was on marketplace a lot and realized that messenger wasn't actually working. I'd send messages but my convos wouldn't appear in the app. I complained to Facebook, then suddenly my messenger began working again. And my inbox flooded with a dozen messages about my car. With multiple offers to give me my asking price... Twice as much as what I gave it away for. 

So from me to you, Zuccercorn - thanks for that.

title: Waste of Storage.

title: Marketplace

title: FB Marketplace crashes
review: FB Marketplace is so buggy.  It crashes all the time after a few minutes of usage even if you clear your cache and reinstall the app it still crashes.  Also, nobody that I know can share a Marketplace listing to a Messenger recipient.  This used to work and does not matter what phone/device you use or who you are - it does not work no matter what hocus pocus they tell you to try. Guess what folks - FB is sharing all your info with whomever they choose. Your best bet is to just use good ole email and SMS.

title: No customer service
review: My account was hacked, my email changed, my password changed….all in the middle of the night from a different browser in a different country. I have tried to reopen my account by proving my identity to no avail. There is no human customer service, so no one cares. I have posts on there that go back to 2009. Lesson learned. They aren’t tagged, they just comment, and then some random person’s post is on my news feed. The only solution offered-hide all posts from each person! So annoying.

title: Overstepping your boundaries
review:
Here lately Facebook has been on a rampage of stomping all over people’s rights to freedom of speech and expression. Certain things are ok for certain people but for others, not so much. Facebook you’re getting beyond a point of ridiculous with some of this stuff and the majority of people are getting tired of it. Every profile has a Block feature for a reason. 
Back off with your communism rules!!

title: Censorship & Fear Mongoring

Everything has gone down hill with its ideals of being too much of a censorship based social media platform. “A place where you can connect with friends and people around the world.” Well, when there’s increased censorship of political ideals, silencing of Palestinian rights, tracking across various sites and apps, it’s getting ridiculous. They have also made no real change to their advertising, privacy, or AI practices in the wake of numerous scandals.  

2) Misleading notification control.  I turned off nearly all push notifications, yet Facebook still sends me notifications that I can’t find a way to turn off, or worse-notifications I have already turned off.  Then, 9 times out of 10, tapping the notification doesn’t even bring me to the referenced content, but instead to the news feed - an obvious attempt to pull me into the app with misleading information.

title: Broken for months
review:

I decided to make a new page and had to start all over just to get blocked from liking and commenting on people’s posts?!! I did nothing absolutely wrong if I keep getting blocked I will surely have this app be rated 1 stars. This is sad 🤦🏽‍♀️

title: Love, hate relationship with FB
review:
I rate FB a 1 overall because of their invasion of privacy. Also, the constantly changing privacy polices that we are not informed about. I rate my FB friends, family, and co-workers a 10, for all the posts, comments, photos, and things I would never know or learn otherwise. And, I actually chose all of you! I can even hide, or delete you.
I would love to see more businesses, companies, corporations, politicians, shareholders, board of directors, etc become more transparent, accountable, and operate with integrity! Just waiting for a better app if FB doesn’t get their act together. If FB doesn’t do it someone else will. I actually love FB’s format, but hate their deceptive practices. I’ll rate 5 stars when they become transparent and operate with integrity.

title: BAD APP!!!
review: Facebook keeps updating the app and every time they do it messes up my Facebook. First of all I have notifications turned on in my account and they aren’t showing up now. Secondly in the past couple of days my boyfriend posted a few things to Facebook and he tagged me in it and showed me the post from his Facebook but yet it will show on my Facebook timeline or when I go to his profile. But he did indeed tag me in it, and post it because my friends and family have showed me. It’s one thing for the app to constantly be changing but it’s another when it starts messing with my Facebook and me being able to see what I want to be able to see. Thanks a lot Facebook👌👌 really appreciate it! Stupidest app I’ve ever used and very frustrated!!!

title: First Amendment
review:
Social media is a cancer that has taken over the minds of modern Americans. To makes matters worse, Zuckerberg is allowing false ads to be pushed through his platform. This is what is known as propaganda. I keep my profile to update people a few times a year as to my life status, but the app itself rarely resides on my phone for longer than a day (if I’m conducting business a little longer). 
The moderators of Facebook are also guilty of crushing free speech. If enough people disagree with your comment and report it, even if it is not against the community guidelines, the moderators will delete the comment to appease the masses. Often times, moderators truly do not understand the actions that they take on the platform, and Facebook as a company is failing to train them.

title: The Social Network site that CENSORS YOU!
review:
Facebook USED to be one of the BEST social networking sites out there, until they’ve decided to censor their members and CONSTANTLY take away our right to, FREE SPEECH! I can understand if people post and comment offensive stuff on a PUBLIC FORUM!!

HOWEVER, If I’m in a SECRET group where the only people who can see the comments and posts are other members of this, SECRET GROUP! What’s the point of a SECRET GROUP when there is NOTHING secret about it whatsoever?!?! 

Nowadays everyone takes EVERYTHING so literal, even the slightest of jokes. Even memes/pics of a couple, “Making love/having sex” where there is ABSOLUTELY NO NUDITY WHATSOEVER, and what happens?? Here comes the Facebook police running and rushing to tell you that, “You can’t post this, therefore now you will be banned for X amount of days”. 

Tell me, what’s the problem with sharing something in a SECRET GROUP, amongst other members that CHOOSE to be in the same group which means they share the same sense of humor, thoughts, and opinions. That is why we all join these groups! To be surrounded by our peers without judgment!!

title: I’m unable to use it
review: Yesterday, I was on the app just trying to search different profiles for new associates then the whole app stops working. What I mean by that is it turned into a white screen with a bottom bar but no icons on it, even when you close the app, clean it, then go back. After about 30 minutes I decided, I should delete the app and re-download it. With my various attempts, I can’t even get the thing to down load. Since I’m on a iPhone I press the iCloud download button, it turns into a circular icon which keeps circling and doesn’t start the downloading process. After various attempts through out the day the app won’t even pop up on my home page to download. This is so annoying and I’m about to give up on it

title: Hate the way the newsfeed is organized
review:
My newsfeed is no longer organized in chronological order, instead it’s a jumble of posts from anywhere from 2 minutes ago to 2 weeks ago. It’s frustrating because now when I open my app, I mostly just see the same, old, repeated content and I feel like I’m missing new posts from my friends. I’ve searched around to try and figure out how to change my newsfeed preferences, but I’ve only seen the option to select which friends I want to see at all in my newsfeed. 
On top of that, my app has been randomly closing while scrolling through the newsfeed. I can only make it a few posts down before it shuts down.

title: Angry
review: I’m so tired of trying over and over again. I’m tired of trying to logged back in but all I been receiving for the past 2 weeks are “an unexpected occurrence happened” and I’m tired of deleting the app over and over again. I can only log in through google and if I want to message people on messenger I have to get the app but it say “ an unexpected occurrence happened “ so how am I supposed keep in contact with my family. And not only that anything associated with Facebook is not letting me log in. It took a day for me to log back into Instagram because my Facebook is connected to that account. For matter being I didn’t do anything wrong for me not to be able to log in through the app. But Facebook you need to get your act together.

title: Marketplace Disaster
review: I used to be an avid user of Facebook and Facebook Marketplace. Recently, however, my Marketplace access was suspended. I have tried everything from filing claims to sending messages to the Support Center but all I receive is auto-generated responses. According to the messages I broke their Commerce Policy, but it doesn’t tell me what listing caused it or which policy was broken. I have not been able to reach an actual person, yet still remain suspended months later without actual justification. Prior to suspension, I had used Marketplace for years and have ensured to abide by the policies. I’m still not sure what algorithm determined my suspension, but I will no longer be recommending Marketplace to my friends.

title: Won’t load all comments
review: After a week of dealing with the issue of comments not loading on a post not matter how many times I click for them, I’ve decided to add a review in hopes that it will be corrected. I have reinstalled the app, restarted my device, and even tried to use the web page instead of the app, but nothing works. For example, if I am in a group and click on a post with 78 comments, about 20 comments are listed but it starts with the option to “view more comments.”  The first click looks like it may load more comments, but it loads the exact same list. The second click only removes the option to load more but nothing seems to show me the remaining comments. Please fix this.

title: Throw it away
review:
An app made for socializing makes it near impossible to enjoy.
One needs a manual and years of training to use Facebook now.
App is unstable and shuts down without warning. Typing is deplorable. The words stick together or have erratic placement, affecting paragraph structure. I issue dates back beyond 2012 on multiple devices. 

The new FBI is cumbersome and  intrusive. It wants access to information it doesn’t need in order to operate. 
The messaging system is ridiculous; you have an inbox (which you can only access via web or an intrusive Messenger app), then you have “message requests”, “other” messages, and a direct message someplace — Which are all illogically placed and difficult to access no matter the device or OS. 
FB also claims to not be recording information but too many instances have occurred with FB showing results ONLY relevant to prior verbal conversations intentionally held outside of ANY apps utilization. Out of our way to mention things which are not usually relevant to see it in an ad? Ok Zuck.
The FBi: Federal Bureau of Intelligence.

title: Temporarily blocked for no reason
review: Everything has been going great with facebook for 10 YEARS until recently. Out of nowhere, I got a notification saying I am “temporarily blocked from performing this action” action as in “liking” other people’s posts. Since when was there ever a limit as to how many likes we can give? And why would they care? What if you just enjoy everyone’s posts that day? I checked their policy and the only time you can get a “block” is when you posted some type of hate speech. You will never see a single trace of hate on my profile. That’s just not me. Though recently I posted a status on how weak the game of thrones finale is. That must be it. They must be paid by GOT to block anyone saying blasphemous thinga about the show.

title: Buggy...always buggy!
review:
This has got to be one of the most buggy apps I’ve ever experienced in all my years using a smart phone. Grammar bugs out and has to be added manually to words, despite auto-punctuation being on and working just FINE in other apps. 

Also, notifications. I’ll receive notifications that someone has replied to me but when I click to see it, there’s nothing there but if I open up Facebook in a browser, it’s there. 

Also, with every “update” they make they claim they “improve” something but funnily enough when they improve one thing another thing will go wrong. Currently I have no usage of the gif search bar and it’s completely blank when I try to find a gif to use, no matter what I search for. 

The very worst thing of all, which isn’t about the app but more about Facebook overall, the reporting system. Facebook has a serious issue with cyber-bullying and 9/10 times if you’re being harassed or see someone being harassed, you’ll get told that whatever it was did not violate the community guidelines. Way to look out for your users though! 👏👍

title: Notifications in Groups
review: FIX THIS MESS!!! Why are group notifications not being fixed??? When I turn it to ALL notifications in the Group Settings that means I WANT ALL NOTIFICATIONS! It’s not working, I have a background in computers so I’m not stupid. Fyi! Come on Facebook, you’re starting to lose people in droves! I hope someone builds a platform that out does yours someday because I guess your company is to busy running ads in every video, which we don’t won’t by the way or secretly giving every company that comes along access to our private information that you can’t fix something as easy as ALL Group Notifications!!!! Trust me when I say I’m not the only person that is having problems in this area! It can’t be that complicated! Good Grief! You all stink!

title: Nearly impossible to use for what I need it for.
review:
I primarily use FB with my small business to post pictures and weekly updates for the families of our preschool and it is SUCH. A. PAIN. I’ll write an update post and attempt to add pictures, only for it to crash every time. Not only that, it’s impossible to ensure everyone sees our weekly updates because of the weird way FB sorts new posts in groups. It’s to the point where it would almost be more efficient to print out a weekly update and hand it out as far as my time is concerned.

Extremely irritating and we are now looking for different ways to connect with our customers. What’s the point of having a social media that doesn’t let you be social and share info/pictures?

title: Too pushy and it drops all the time
review: It drops me off the site a lot. Takes forever to connect. Wants access to my pics in order for me to add add a pic from app. Nearly always annoyed when using. I can't look into an interest and go back where I was. It always hunt and look for every thing. Things from a few hours past aren't available with out a major search and its too much trouble. FB wants to collect too much information on me and wants access to too much on my phone. Get out of my life!

title: Annoying Changes
review:
Please fix the mobile issues for group pages. You can not view recent posts at all. Top posts are the only option. You can even go to the “About” section of the page and see the 3 most recent, and it has a part that says “View All” but does not allow you to click on it or make any sort of adjustment. This is very frustrating seeing as you can not view over 3/4 of the listings on most groups solely because of this problem. 

Also, does a 3 minute video REALLY need 4 different ad interruptions? I get it, you guys want more money. But while Facebook may be free, you guys sure are making it more and more inconvenient for the users...

title: Facebook should get zero
review: After using Facebook for several hours last night I got blocked from liking and reacting to posts on Facebook. So I guess I will have to use another platform to enjoy videos and converse with friends. This is so stupid. This application should be at the top of its game in terms of network glitches. I'm sure Facebook have thousands of people dealing with thousands of other types of glitches. However if someone has doubled the security on their Facebook there shouldn't be a block when that person has used your app for hours making you money all the while. It's very unfortunate that Facebook is still not on top of its game. They need more people to help create a better application for the masses who use it everyday.

title: Where did my feed go?
review: At the last update, something happened where once I look at something on my feed, it disappears. It’s really frustrating because it doesn’t allow me to go back to locate something that I want to see again. 👎🏽 I also tired of all the fake news that all over the place. Facebook says they are trying to get rid of that but I think they are just saying that to shut people up. The constant broken promises to their users are ridiculous. I also can’t stand the continuous flow of “copy and paste” posts that just designed to track peoples activities. If I have FB Friends, I should be seeing all of their posts. I shouldn’t have to copy and paste a million posts in order to see what everyone is doing. 🤨

title: Groups are taking over... and not in a good way
review: I love the option of joining a group, the problem has become that the posts in the groups are taking over my feed. I no longer see family or friends posts. There should be an option to join and follow groups but not blow up my feed so I can go to the specific page when I want to see the latest info. There are some small business pages that formed a market. When they hold the market, that day, they all post pics before opening. Conveniently, I never see these until days later, even when choosing the “most recent” option. It’s like Facebook doesn’t want me to support local business. Instead, I am slammed with tons of ads for places I would never support.

title: Misunderstood
review: Facebook is probably one of the best social platforms you can use. It’s up to you if you have problems  with Facebook it is your own fault. You are the maker of your page and everything you do on Facebook can be controlled by the person who made the page. I have had only a couple rare issues with Facebook but all the other comments show all the issues that they themselves seem to create. Be careful, be safe, and most of all be real and leave your drama off of Facebook.

title: Normally a great App
review:
Something has been happening lately with a couple of iPhone users, including myself, when watching videos. When you swipe down to exit watching the video the screen stays dark but slightly transparent and the app completely stops working. You have to open the multitasking and exit the app completely and you lose your place in scrolling through your news feed. 

This only started happening recently and it doesn’t happen every time you watch a video either. I was hoping this most recent update would fix it but it happened right after updating the app.

title: THIS APP CONSTANTLY FAILS TO DELIVER!
review:
I am consistently disappointed in this app. Something is always NOT WORKING PROPERLY, no consistency of service or quality of product. It has limitations as to what can be accessed, it doesn’t allow me to utilize the NOTES feature, I routinely have issues with uploading profile pics and cover images, and their own features for additions to profile pics/cover photos and adjusting them properly, NEVER WORKS. 
I uninstall this app on a routine basis. It seems like that’s the only way to correct an issue for just a short time frame, then the app will mess up again. 
The App also does not allow you to access your photos stored on Facebook. It allows limited access to photos for cover and profile pics only. 
NEEDS MUCH IMPROVEMENT!

title: Dangerous Scams
review: I had downloaded Facebook two weeks ago, and I barely use it. But today, I decided to check my notifications and see how many follow requests I had, or what’s new, and I had 2,396 new followers! And I have a private account! So, right there and then, I realized that 2,396 scam artists and hackers were following me. I checked a few of my followers Facebook accounts, and quite a few of them were the same, there was no photo on the account, they had rare, moronic names, AND STOLE MY INSTAGRAM AND FACEBOOK ACCOUNT PHOTOS AND POSTED THEM ON THEIR STUPID FAKE ACCOUNTS!!! It was a bit scary and I had no idea what to do! So, I deleted all my followers, and changed my personal information to lies, and then I logged off and deleted freaking Facebook! And now I know why FACEBOOK IS ALWAYS GETTING CALLED OUT ON THE NEWS!

title: Random problems with disappearing abilities
review: A few weeks ago the “dark mode quote option totally disappeared. It took a week of informing them before it came back… Now there’s no longer choices on the share you can share only to your timeline or send them a message or put on a friends timeline there is no group share, etc. there used to be several options. I’ve been contacting them for a week every week a new bug I delete then start the app anew, I clear my cache, I double check my settings, I have no violations of community standards or limitations in posting. It’s pretty frustrating to use anymore🥲

title: Agree with everyone, use it only to monitor family, although
review:
We complain so much about FB but we are still on FB, FB can CARE less about our feelings, this is a 18 BILLION dollar a year BUSINESS! they are about making money and not to be concern about how we all feel. This is a review about the app, my 5 stars are only because the app works great for me, if FB is causing me to be angry or distress for whatever reason I will just remove it and forget about it. I remember people saying: “ahhh I hate Howard Stern, did you hear what he said this morning...”
LOL!!!

title: This most recent update
review: This most recent update has been a terrible mistake. I’m very unhappy and wish I could return to the old version prior to the update. Currently when I open my app, I’m seeing the same handful of posts from Friday. It’s Tuesday. No I didn’t comment on that post, no I didn’t like it, no they aren’t one of the people I have selected as “see first”. I can’t seem to see posts from today, I just keep seeing the same posts from the last four days since the update. It’s Tuesday morning and the first thing that pops up, is a post from Friday morning at 5am. The really old version of Facebook allowed us to choose what we wanted to view first; “most recent” or “top stories”. I miss those days because this is ridiculous. Please fix.

title: Facebooks problem with pointless notifications.
review:
A rant review here. But, seriously?! I only use this app to contact a select few people and my god, anything someone posts, I get a notification. Some specific group I follow, “This group has a even you might be interested in.” Someone tags me to a story, “Make sure to reshare it before its gone!” 

Like PLEASE, I want to use the app to my own accord, please stop aggressively shoving these notifications in our inbox to click on your app, it’s ridiculous.

Not to mention this app suddenly recommending me 6 trillion group suggestions on my timeline with stuff I don’t care about and showing me stories of people I DONT HAVE ADDED.  

Rarely I ever leave a review but seeing the ratings of Facebook on the app store, I wonder why it’s so low. Facebook is just pointless spam at this point. Make sure to have thousands of friends added and use this app 24/7 to stop the constant spam. Because theres absolutely no way to turn them off. You can report them or disable a specific person or group, but it won’t really do good!

title: No Dark Mode On iPad?
review: I am trying to figure out why Facebook does not have an option for Dark Mode on iPadOS. I know where that option should be in the setting and it is not there. Should be in the same location as it is in the iOS Facebook App. I literally look all through the menus in Facebook and found nothing. I need Dark Mode because of my sensitive eyes. I guess I’m stuck with using my iPhone to look at Facebook until they get this fixed and put Dark Mode on iPadOS. Oh and yes, I have the latest Facebook update installed.

title: Facebook Marketplace Is A Joke
review: Don’t get me wrong as a buyer. Facebook marketplace is a great place but as a seller, you’re better off not wasting your time. The process to sell your items on Facebook is an utter joke, and there is no way to talk to a person regarding issues. You must go through a computerized program or attempt to fix it yourself. Then the process of trying to sell things in groups. For example, if you delete a listing, you would assume it deletes all of the listings. That is not the case. It only deletes the listing on marketplace, not anywhere else, and the only way I have found to delete your listings from groups is to find them in the group and delete them manually.

title: Now I remember why i left fb
review:
Facebook is trying so hard to be tik tok and Snapchat. But won’t complete the new “features”. 
I don’t know how many times I have been watching a video, and then accidentally click another button in the video completely disappears. I go to my watch history, and I can’t even click on the video to continue watching. It shows me what video it was, but it doesn’t say what page it’s at or provide me with the link that will take me to the video. This is just one of the many many flaws Facebook has. 
Also, the videos have been coming across are in very poor taste. Overall I just don’t get a good vibe from this platform anymore and will be leaving again.

title: Complete Garbage
review: Facebook is such a terrible platform. Their lack of customer service is repugnant. I’ve sent countless emails after my personal and business pages were hacked and have not gotten a reply to any of them. Their excuse is they don’t have enough staff to handle the amount of questions and concerns they receive daily, yet when it comes to fact checking there’s plenty of people to handle that. Their help center is just a circle of continuous “try this” but with no avail. Meanwhile some idiot is posting under my account and there’s nothing I can do about it besides continue to report them which is redundant because Facebook won’t do anything to put a stop to it. Do better.

title: Spam spam spam
review:
Public groups are filled with reposted “reels” from spam groups based in foreign countries. I delete so many out of my group and ban the members and report every one of the posts and nothing is being done. Before the spam videos were spam events I had to delete daily from foreign profiles trying to hack peoples accounts. When Facebook made it so non-members could interact in public groups and it’s been downhill ever since with the never ending foreign hacker and spam accounts.

Then on my regular feed is constant “suggested for you” posts, multiple in a row mind you, that you do not have the option to turn off. It’s infuriating.

title: Security concerns
review:
Facebook is a very outdated app in features, but most likely because they funnel most of their money/effort into surveillance and data mining. I was exposed to the proven claims of Cambridge Analytica back in 2016, and since then this app has done nothing to take changes in addressing my concerns. The app is always trying to track my location, ask for permission to my pictures on my phone, access my Wi-Fi and local networks, and other personal, sensitive information. Whenever I attempt to post factual information I’ve spent hours researching, my post is taken down. Presumably because it doesn’t have accurate information, despite me citing my resources.
-10/5 wouldn’t recommend

title: Slow and restrictive
review:
I'm giving Facebook a 1-star rating because of a very bad experience I had with their app. The app was slow, unresponsive, and kept crashing on my device, which was frustrating and made it impossible for me to use it properly. Additionally, I constantly feel like I'm getting one-sided opinions on Facebook, and the platform feels restrictive.

As a user, I expect a certain level of reliability and performance from such a popular platform, but I also expect to be able to express my opinions freely and hear different perspectives. Unfortunately, I often feel like Facebook is limiting my exposure to diverse viewpoints and promoting a certain narrative that may not necessarily align with my own beliefs

title: Metaverse? More like Betaverse
review:
When I was 12 years old and I lied about my age to create a Facebook and connect with my middle school friends, gosh did I love this site. But another 12 years later, Facebook is nothing more than a graveyard full of ghosts I don’t want haunting me anymore. It’s been trying so hard to become an app that competes with the others, all the while losing every trait that made me want it when I was a preteen. I miss the days of FarmVille, and stealing my parents credit cards to buy the upgrades. Facebook has fallen to MySpace status, but at least MySpace didn’t try to create a “meta verse” that steals your information and leaks it to the highest bidder. 
Facebook has fallen, and Instagram is close in its wreckage.

title: Doomed App
review: Facebook has been outdated for sometime and tries to implement features implemented by other applications too late to keep them relevant. Their app is hard to use or find anything in including privacy and security settings. With how many data leaks Facebook has had in the past I don’t understand why we as a population continue to use it. Not to mention Facebook obviously uses facial recognition software (because they suggest which friends to tag in photos) which means they collect body data. Isn’t that the exact thing Tiktok is being accused of doing and it being a national security risk? Not to mention the thousands of bot accounts and scams that happen on Facebook marketplace and in messenger.

title: American people are tired
review:
We are tired of the lies and false dreams that we have been fed.   This country is not the greatest country with endless possibilities.   We are straddled with debt from doctors and hospitals.  We are straddled with corporate debt from CEO’s that make millions of dollars while paying their workers nonviable wages.  We have mandatory healthcare insurance with high premiums and deductibles that do not cover our treatments, surgeries, and medications.   We have corporations that pay our elected officials for votes.   We also have elected officials with pensions, excellent healthcare, ana paid time off while they vote
to keep Americans without these rights.  The “ American dream” is our day to day nightmare.    We can’t trust our own government to make decisions for their own people.

title: Worst app award
review: Has to be the worst application on the Apple Store. Where’s the quality control, Apple? You don’t allow other apps for not being complete or having bugs but Meta is allowed? This app doesn’t show any comments, when you click on likes it leads to a blank page even when you have likes, turns dark mode on/off auto with no ability to shut off, has messenger area in the application but then requires that you download a completely separate app to access the actual messages, if you have a separate page you run you can’t even access it through here (that’s yet ANOTHER app). It’s had under 2.5 stars forever now and yet nothing is done to make it better.

title: Zuck Loves a Buck
review:
I’m tired of Zuckerberg hiring fake fact checkers (by his own admission) to cause severe unrest between Americans. I’m tired of Zuckerberg tracking us and selling our data outside of the country. If Tiktok has to go, so must Meta. Zuckerberg spent an insurmountable amount of money on the MetaVerse and couldn’t even bother to fund legs for the characters. What did he really use the money for? It didn’t go towards the game, that’s for sure. Zuckerberg is a Commie ROBOT, so that must mean Facebook and Tiktok are one in the same for our government. 
I would prefer to live as a free American where I AM PROTECTED by my government, not made a joke out of. 
BAN FACEBOOK, BAN INSTAGRAM, BAN META. Zuck is doing all the same things as Shou. Our congressmen are incompetent and don’t understand basic technology. We are EMBARRASSED.

title: Facebook video call
review:
A lot of people will stop using Facebook cause of the video call background that’s removed from messenger and mark is gonna lost a lot of people and money…my advice Is better you program the background video call back for the sake of people using it and Facebook get more people everyday 
Facebook is one of the best dating app and beg app ever to have fun but you decided to disconnect a lot of people from using Facebook due to the removal of background video call

title: What are the updates even accomplishing
review:
If we’re gonna work hard to change up the mobile layout every other week, could we at least make the video/reels side actually functional? Why is there a history tab for videos and a whole section for saved reels if the videos you save for later don’t actually save, and the videos you watch don’t end up in recently viewed tab? Or anywhere else for that matter. And that’s if I can even FIND the tabs I’m looking for.
Everything gets so convoluted every update, if Facebook could focus on just being the website/app that it was meant to be, instead of trying to be every other app in one, maybe it’d do better.

title: You’re the product, not the customer
review: Facebook has turned into a cesspool, not just of misinformation, but also of corporate greed and power. The Facebook app has been a terrible place for a long time, and not just because it’s where we’ve all been going to argue with our crazy uncles. But in 2022 Meta/Facebook doesn’t even try to hide how focused they are on the idea that you are a product. At least Google mostly hides it by delivering a product focused (mostly) on the end user’s needs. Facebook has nothing to offer. You can’t scroll through more than 2 posts without seeing an ad or a “suggested for you” designed to further true corporate interest. It’s completely unmasked corporatism.

title: A true Americans review
review: The political bias and the bias of censorship is at a mind blowing level. It’s funny how the things censored are from the right , pro-god, pro-2nd amendment, pro-American. People are banned for basically loving this country and telling the truth about things meanwhile The anti American mindset is awarded . It’s very clear how radically to the left this social media app has become . Misinformation and fact checks are done to censor the truth/Conservative information . The covid vaccine was shoved down our throats and the truth was censored … the truth is that the vaccine isn’t effective at all and people are starting to have terrible issues from the vaccine . I’m very glad I didn’t get it . Maybe one day free speech will matter on this app & the political bias will fade away

title: Marketplace Search Filters
review: I have to use my browser on my phone because in the app, when you select a category and search within the category, there is NO OPTION for filters. For example, I tap categories in the app, tap on vehicles, tap on motorcycles, and then I type into the search bar “abs motorcycle.” There is no option to select filters after this in the app. When I go to Facebook on my mobile browser, the option is there. Further, the option to filter bikes for abs DOES NOT WORK, which is the reason why I have to use the search bar in the first place. This is extremely annoying. What gives??

title: Barely any freedoms now
review: An over updated app, constantly changing its layout once you get used to it. They change features you don’t want changed and constantly putting your account on a restriction for ridiculous instances. The community guidelines are so strict now you can barely post. Also any time you try to report something that’s offensive racist or overall just something you don’t want to see they do nothing. The case always goes closed with no reprimand to the poster or anything but no someone posting an April fools joke gets their account suspended for three months. Screw this app. I have used this for years and in the last three this app has just gone down the toilet.

title: Worst
review: Facebook has been widely criticized for its lack of data privacy and security. The social media giant has been involved in several scandals related to the mishandling of user data, including the Cambridge Analytica scandal, which saw the personal data of millions of users being harvested without their consent. Facebook has also been criticized for its role in spreading fake news and misinformation, which has had serious real-world consequences. Additionally, the platform has been criticized for its negative impact on mental health and social well-being, with studies linking excessive social media use to increased anxiety, depression, and loneliness. title: Facebook live audio problems
review: “Since the last update Facebook live does not recognize the external microphone connected to the phone. Previously the phone connected to the external microphone if it was connected at the beginning of the live stream but lately this does not work anymore. Reached out to Apple tech support but as video recording with external microphone works fine in other apple apps, they suggested to reach out to fb instead. In this time of pandemic it is essential for people to be able to connect to others and if Facebook does not make improvements in this then it doesn’t serve the community which has been of outstanding importance these months...”

title: Facebook customer support
review: I was kicked out of my own fb account around three months ago because someone change my email on Facebook . I the mean time I try all means to recover my account(sending my ID to verify my information, sending emails to the customer support, try to contacting them via Twitter and nothing) I just lost all of my old photos and  everything. My problem is not with the app itself, is the lack of customer support from then. If the most revenues of Facebook are from ads, and you don’t care for those people that view your ads for at least implementing a better customer support or anti-hack measures then I understand the backlash that you guys are receiving. Totally disappointed!! F grade for them.

title: Not working.
review: The app is still not working on my iPhone. After we all got logged out, I have not been able to log into the app. I keep getting a login error “unexpected problem occurred please try logging in again” message. I have tried re downloading the app, resetting my settings, and a password change. I can log into my account via a laptop but not the app. This same problem occurs on the messenger app. I have sent two requests for help through the Facebook help center and no help has come. My phone is updated and the apps as well. Is my account just locked out of my phone? I know I’m not banned since I’m able to log in via a laptop. How do I fix this?

review:

‘This post goes against our community Standard’

title: Disappointed
review: Facebook has always had glitches and issues that they’ve tried fixing, however the over sharing of personal information is a big issue that needs addressed. As well as their so called ‘fact checkers’, that don’t provide any actual facts when they tag people’s shared content. They dont allow for anyone to post ACTUAL content that is true and factual, and instead flag it as false and misleading. They only allow viewpoints of those who think as they do, which is very much like Communism. They ban people indefinitely for encouraging peace and unity and then mask it as hate or riot inciting. They too are a part of the problem instead of a unified solution. We should have never left MySpace. At least Tom was our friend.

title: Do Not Trust Facebook
review: What makes this app so horrid, is the absurd company behind it. There are bugs in amongst every square inch of the software, constant pop ups, and a poorly designed layout from top to bottom. Every account I’ve created has actually been banned by Facebook themselves. You can opt for a review on your account, but I’ve never once gotten a reply. All I wanted to do was use the marketplace section to find a vehicle I can buy. But as I’ve been IP banned from any and all access to there app or site, there’s isn’t even a possibility for myself to do that. Now I have to resort to other companies, which is unfortunate because I live in the mountains. So Facebook was as close I’d get to anything local. Do not trust these moronic developers AT ALL.

title: Too much censorship!
review: Back when I believed they would respect my right to freedom of discourse, and my right to question prevailing narratives, I put all of my photos here. Otherwise I would just delete this app. I have been given temporary bans for the most unfair reasons and given no opportunity to appeal. Another reason I don’t leave is because this is where my friends are. Of course they all signed up back when they thought they would be free to engage in open discourse as well. If you are looking for a place to discuss politics that don’t fit in with the same kind of politics you can see on the main stream liberal media this is not the app for you. If you like tame memes, cat videos and unlimited photo storage then you might like this.

title: Issues
review:
I was put on notice of suspension when I asked a hateful left wing person to not make ugly comments, and they were horrendous comments— Facebook said I was being a bully and they took my post down! — I reported the  hate filled comments of this person— full of racial slurs to Facebook  to see if they would take his post down and they came back and told me they saw nothing wrong with what this person said!
