All I said was “ Dont say ugly things” that’s all!! Facebook targeted me because I am a conservative and they let the hateful left wing person slide! FaceBook used to be a place to meet family and friends but it is no longer that… It is a political left wing extension of the democratic party!
I will be leaving soon

title: Overreaching power
review: To much to write and not enough space. Facebook was meant to be a social media outlet for those to meet, share ideas, connect with family, network, and a place to voice opinions. During this time in our countries history, FB has decided that it is Their “Responsibly” to filter and monitor all aspects of our Social lives within FB Society.  I for one do not need “Big FB Brother” watching out for me.  I am a grown adult that can make my own decisions and come to my own conclusions in regards to post and whether I want to share them or not.  They have become way to powerful and have aligned themselves to the liberal, socialist side of society! They do not represent all of society and should make an effort to have an inclusive social media platform.

title: Socialism At Its Finest
review: This app sensors anything that’s not within their agenda. I’m constantly subjected to antifa and blm related posts and there is  literally no way to say i don’t want to see this on any of those posts!!!! Can’t block the pages or anything you just gotta have it shoved down your throat. It constantly freezes and i have to restart it. I had to make a new one because they said they wanted a picture of my drivers license and to do a full scan of my face as well which i’m completely not cool with at all. Anything I post related to being a republican is completely censored and reported anonymously and then my account gets restricted. If i could give this app zero stars i would. Just can’t have social media at all at this point.

title: Stopped reviewing notifications
review: A few days ago I noticed I wasn’t receiving my notifications like usual. So I did research and did everything under the moon to try and get them back working. Come to find out it’s not just me that has experienced this problem but others as well and some have not had notifications for over a year. This is something that should be able to be fixed from their end. If I have to go without notifications I might just have to end my account with Facebook because it annoying not seeing what people tag me in or comments I’m mentioned in.

title: Can’t sort posts
review: All of Facebook’s ethical violations aside, the app UX design itself is often frustratingly suboptimal (and inconsistent). Someone with the same phone and app version as me is able to sort group posts manually, while my app does not give this option. I am consistently missing important updates in my groups and feel left out of conversations because posts are days old by the time I see them. The most recent posts are way down the page. I don’t have a lot of time and want to be able to quickly find the most recent post — not most recent activity — and control how these posts are sorted. Frustrating and confusing.

title: Completely biased
review:
Facebook has overstepped its bounds. I would love to see it taken as a public utility.  Severely inconsistent with its so called decision on standards violations. The so called review process is non existent as no one is given any opportunity to defend themselves.  If in fact actual people are making such decisions, they are biased. It’s completely oblivious. If you are not a left wing radical, anything you say can and will be blocked and given a ban... 
a study has been performed to prove that fact.  A liberal friend and myself posted the exact same comment. Mine was served with a 30 day suspension. His was found to not be in violation of community standards.. 
the appeals both rendered the same results. 
Facebook is in fact a liberal platform that is in fact in violation of free speech.

title: Okay but could be better
review: It’s okay, but could be better. It would be nice to have dark mode and an updated home screen. It also doesn’t share most recent posts in the feed, which is very annoying. I don’t like seeing certain post 2-7 days or more after it was posted. Facebook is supposed to b a place where you share life events and experiences and feelings with your friends and family but you’re not able to if you find out your friend graduate a week after or had a baby 4 days after sharing it with loved ones. It also crashes and has several bugs.

title: Avatars not available for me
review: I don’t understand why the avatars are unavailable to me. Currently most of my friends lists are posting their avatars but my phone does not have it as an option under the “see more section” where every online article about Facebook avatars have written it should be. I have updated my Facebook with every update. Uninstalled and reinstalled. My phone/devices used to access Facebook are not out of date. I just want explanation or a time frame to when I maybe could expect avatars to be made available for me.

title: I wish I could give no stars!!
review: This app is completely buggy!! If it was possible to give no stars I would!! I am unable to see anything in my news feed.. this has happened before but maybe for an hour or two.. it has been over a week and all I get is a “loading” wheel whenever I try and scroll down my news feed. I can’t see any posts from friends.. just old posts from pages that I follow and select the see first option.. I don’t understand why this is happening.. as much as Facebook updates their app this should be a bug free app!! I should not have to go to Safari just to keep in touch with all of my friends if there is an app that I SHOULD be able to use!! Please fix Facebook!!

title: Stop refreshing
review: I like scrolling through fb throughout the day, but every time my screen times out, or if I leave the app and reopen it, or if I open a link and stay in it too long, it automatically refreshes and goes back to the top of the page! I hate this! I should be able to disable this feature, and I have seen online instructions to do so, but the location I am supposed to find to disable this doesn’t exist. I have tried from the app and on the mobile site. I don’t use a computer so that’s not an option for me to change there if that’s the only place. Let me scroll!

title: People i don’t wanna be associate with
review:
So I deleted my account and waited 14 days to be completely deleted with all my information but apparently that’s a lie .
Facebook keep all your information even after you delete your account.
So I deleted my account because I had so many people that I no longer want to be associate with. So the 14 days has gone by then I made a brand new Facebook page thinking that I wasn’t going to see the old friends that I had on my old account since “ Facebook deleted my information “but surprisingly every single one them popped on my page and they started sending friend requests which I DO NOT WANT!!!! If all my information were deleted WHY the same exact friends popped on my page !!!

title: Please fix it
review: I have been using Facebook for like more than 8 years lol and when the music feature came out I was impress although when I moved from America to Samoa I would try to add music (background) for like a simple video and suddenly the music sticker was gone. I had updated my apps just in case it was some glitch but it still hasn’t popped up again which is very frustrating and disappointing. And before they come out saying “the music feature isn’t available in this area in the world” they’re wrong! Because even my friends who live here have that feature, so please fix it.

title: What Happened to Feeds??
review:
I like to keep track of certain groups of friends. Until recently, I was able to do so by selecting the Feeds menu and then selecting one of my custom lists (close friends, friends & family, family only, no coworkers, etc.). Now, if I want to see what’s going on with my close group of friends, I have to either weed through a bunch of crap Facebook thinks I should see, or search for each person individually. Why??

Update: I've switched to using the mobile site only. In IOS you can save your password with a thumbprint & save the site to your screen as if it were an app. The mobile site still has the user-defined feeds. Once I discovered I could view my custom Family members feed, I found out my stepmother is in the hospital & gravely ill. I would not have known this if I had to rely on the app. 

FACEBOOK PLEASE ADD THIS FEATURE BACK TO THE APP!!!!!!

ALSO.... The app says 7 people posted on my timeline for my birthday, but I can only see four. I had to switch to the mobile site to see them all. I HATE this app! 

Facebook developers, are you listening? No? Crickets????

title: Sharing videos
review:
There is a video from my family that I need to share but I don’t know how to. I think there should be directions on how to share videos. It was a video from my family to other family of mine and it would make them laugh. They live far away , so I cannot show them unless I send the video. If there is a way how to share, make a way to show us who don’t know how to. It shouldn’t be that conflicted to share your personal videos with your family. 

Thank you.

title: Gets stuck 99% of the time
review:
First time I’ve ever written an app review, this version has put me over the edge. First of all the new “look” is not user or eye friendly at all, the blurred gray background and clear lines between posts were much easier on the eyes. If you were going to go all white like this, you need to make it compatible for dark mode. 

My phone gets stuck showing both the “Snapchat” screen and the news feed every time I browse.

My notifications do not load comments for videos, if that’s where it takes me. I see a totally blank screen, if trying to pull up a comment. 

Nothing is the same when you go back to find stuff on news feeds.

And. I absolutely hate when I go to an event and am scrolling, and hit the bottom because I passed the button that says “see posts”. That’s what Facebook is all about, the feed! I shouldn’t have to do somewhere to fix.

 This absolutely used to be the most user friendly app I had and now with every update its sucked more and more. Please fix it.

title: Where do I begin....
review:
>>The most recent...As I'm trying to comment on a post, I am kicked out to my home screen. When I go back in and TRY to find the post again, my comment is still in the "Reply" box, but only half of  what I had typed. When I begin to finish my comment I'm booted out AGAIN! 

>>When using the iPhone, as I type a comment there is no longer a curser🤬This causes sooooo much confusion if I'm posting a long comment, or if I need to make a correction/addition to part of what I have been typing, and with this newest iOS update and its predictive text, there are LOTS of corrections😫

The new update to the iOS has enough glitches... I've started cutting my time on FB, I am only on to check my notifications 1-2x/day because it's so frustrating to spend any extra amount of time on it when you I'm automatically 'refreshed' after I've been on a post-reading/watching/commenting-for longer than a min or two...and then I have to hunt & search trying to find where I was. 

~~An extremely agitated and aggravated user~~

title: Marketplace Photos
review: Before I updated the app, I used to be able to see the full picture of the item I’m selling on Marketplace and swipe to see more photos if I uploaded multiple. Now when I go to look at the items I have for sale, it only shows one picture and I can’t even click on it to get a look at the whole item. I’m selling some clothing so I had front/back pictures and pictures of the tags and now all I can see is half of the front of the shirt. I can’t see the other pictures and I can’t see the whole picture of the one that’s displayed. I also can’t see my description or pretty much any other information about my items other than price and how many views it got on Marketplace basically.

title: Better experience without hassles
review: It would be helpful if Facebook could make an option/way to check messages besides just have to have message app to check in/see who might’ve messaged you without needing the message app or in cases where whomever may not want to use the message app/having to reinstall it if they took down the app to be able to access messages without the app. Also, it would be cool if customize/choose to not have people’s stories as an option for stories showing up on Feeds on Facebook including notifications showing on your friends so much somehow with an option including page interests liked/checked

title: Anti-Free speech Anti-American Anti-human
review: I have the ability to make my own opinions, I don’t need to be constantly harassed with politics.  I have no political affiliation, but Facebook is obviously pushing an agenda outside of most people’s knowledge.  Account took 90 days for full termination, and I haven’t been happier to end any app ever.  Will never be back.  I hope more people get off of this brain washing behind the curtain string pulling puppet show.  Oh and Facebook wastes so much time.  People exchanging brownie points when they don’t give a flying frick about you or you them.  Seriously, turn it off and see who you hear from. I bet not even 5% of your “friends” will contact you.  That’s if you ever could have the power to delete it, which most sheeple won’t/don’t.

title: Facebook Evaluation
review: Facebook is nice website. We can use it for business for socialization with other people in all parts of the universe. We also can get immediate news from everywhere. However, I believe there are shortcomings such as it reveals some informations people don’t want others to know such as if two people become friends Facebook spread this information though both friends don’t want others know about their friendship. Also, when a use make comment on photo or subject or make like the Facebook tells everyone about this though the user doesn’t want everyone know about it.

title: Locked out and nothing is working.
review: I’ve been trying to post on one of my business pages for a about five days now and for some reason I can’t post anything from the Facebook at to the business page. I can post using internet explorer but it’s much more time consuming. I’ve tried asking community help and submit through app multiple times and nothing. I kept trying to post and ask for help but now Facebook has temporarily locked my account. I can’t recover my account because nothing is working (I’ve tried everything like send text to phone, identify recent comments and identify the Facebook friend) there’s no phone number or email I can contact and now I’m stuck with a locked account and no help.

title: App just gets worse and worse as time goes on
review:
The longer I use this app the worse it gets. With the current build posts in threads just don’t appear. I thought the constant one sided conversations I was seeing where due to deleted posts. Get on my computer and those missing posts are there. So the app isn’t loading lots of comments. 
Also I don’t get half of my notifications that some one liked a comment of mine. Those are important to see because if you are having discussions you need the notifications to quickly go back to where you where having the discussion.
Update: All of that still happens and when I click ‘Most Recent’ I still get posts from days ago first. Worst algorithm ever.

title: Deleting inactive profiles/friends
review:
Is there anyway that Facebook could come out with some type of setting, or feature that would make it easier to find and delete the friends who aren’t active, or who don’t get on their Facebook anymore? I have over 4,000 friends and I feel like only 1/4 of those people are actually active. But it would take entirely too long to go through and find and delete those people who aren’t active. 
I’ve searched and searched and from what I can find there isn’t a solution to this. I don’t want to have to deactivate my Facebook page and make another one.

title: Every device has it’s own problem.
review: Please. Please. Please. Fix the rotation issue. It’s so infuriating having to spin my whole iPad around, especially when it’s charging, to look at anything on Facebook. Also doesn’t switch back to landscape mode until I click the home button and re-enter the app. Almost all pictures and videos are cut off when I’m in the app on my Laptop, but look completely different on my phone and iPad. Also doesn’t update or refresh my feed consistently or correctly. Things disappear from my feed that I know are still there cuz I can see it on another device. And I still travel backwards in time when my feed shows me what it looked like yesterday, but nothing current.

title: Facebook is deteriorating
review: The site is far too cluttered with advertising and it is more complicated to navigate. I keep being presented with potential friends and despite my rejection they keep coming back. Some people have let me know that Facebook keeps asking them to link with me and it sounds like they think I must be desperate. I am also presented with potential friends who I have already accepted. I have become more careful about what i put in Facebook because I don’t trust the website. I want to have a smaller web footprint but it might be too late. Next thing I expect is facial recognition so that when I use my credit card at 7-11 an automated voice will say ‘hi francine’

title: Stay away if you can!
review: I have been a Facebook user for many years and ever since they came out with Facebook marketplace I’ve been intrigued even more. However, I keep getting an error message that says that I’ve exceeded my message limit for the day when I haven’t done anything yet for the day. I periodically buy stuff or inquire about stuff and for some reason every time I ask a question it says the same message but it’s not happening to my wife’s Facebook account. I must have been banned or suspended without notice and I think that it’s unfair to do that to someone who hasn’t done anything wrong. I have contacted their support group many times and not one person responded. If you can stay away from the marketplace!

title: NOTIFICATION NIGHTMARE
review:
Whatever you have done to Notifications on IOS (If not on other systems as well) is a nightmare. I can only scroll down so far before it stops. If I want to see what's below those notifications, I have to click on the notifications above, MANY OF WHICH I DON'T NEED TO READ!  I don't need to click on notifications when someone likes a post or comment. I've seen by way of the notification that they've done that! Not every notification is of interest!

Please RESTORE THIS TO THE WAY IT WAS so if people want to scroll down and look for earlier notifications or they just want to skip stuff, they can. This is maddening!

title: Notifications
review:
Every since I updated recently, my notifications are all messed up. I will get the last 10 or so just fine, but the ones before that start with a day ago instead of going in order and it won’t let me see more than about 20. Being some that has at LEAST 30 notifications every few hours, this is a HUGE problem!!
UPDATE Oct. 7th, 2018
I downloaded the newest update and guess what? My notifications are STILL messed up and mine aren’t the only ones. 
FIX THIS PLEASE! I want to see my notifications in order, not 9 in order, then some from hours or a day ago, then when I check one and go back, all the recent ones that were JUST THERE are gone. I’d give you a zero rating if it was an option.

title: Who checked our post
review: I am very disappointed about the most recent Facebook update which appeared to take away the function of seeing who viewed your posts. We have a closed group of 100 friends all over the world and when I would make a post you could see who viewed it.  That now does not work the same which started this weekend.  You will see that 35 people viewed and then the next day all you see are the people who liked it.  As we are having an event with a guest coming over from England and we are Facebook live on August 25 we need to know who is joining....this was the whole point of joining FB and I am exceptionally disappointed as this is s feature we expected and taking it away is s great dis service

title: Pages and Articles have incredibly low reach since update
review: Facebook I don’t know what you did on your last update but it’s the absolute worst now! I have 10 pages with over 1.5 million followers and every Instant Article post barely gets 10 likes and reach is incredibly low now. There is clearly a bug going on, or you are really sticking it to your publishers and people who create content that attracts your users in the first place. It is horrible business practice that you allow people to pay for advertising to grow page followers, then you lower the page’s reach and then force page owners to “boost posts” if they want to reach the same people they already paid for in the first place using advertising.

title: Facebook
review: Facebook is a great platform to get your name out there and to network by Facebook and also be deadly and dangerous to those who are unaware of the trolls that are behind the page to ruin your life. Facebook is known for a platform to broadcast everything that’s going on in your life but some users of Facebook will use their platform to bully others just because they feel Facebook is just a Internet game. Be aware of your surroundings when using Facebook because Facebook can ruin your life.

title: Marketplace
review: I’ve sent over 10 reports and comments on this issue and no one has gotten back to me, not fb or the mp. I CAN”T see my items to renew or to mark as sold. It’s been over a month and I haven’t found a solution even after constant fb updates. I’m tired of se sending reports bc it’s hopeless. Reading other comments it’s seems like fb and the mp have ongoing issues these they are overwhelmed. Is Facebook on it’s it way to being discontinued? Doesn’t seem like anybody cares to help with its members issues

title: See the Same Statuses All Day
review: I know the chronological timeline has been gone for a long time without going to most recent but now it seems to be gone all together! I go to Most Recent and see maybe three or four updates from today then it jumps to two or three updates from yesterday, then three or four updates from two days ago and so on. What is recent about that? And the ones I do see aren’t from people or pages I interact with most often.  Because of this I log onto FB maybe once a day now and instead use Instagram and Snapchat much more often.  I wish FB would stop trying to figure out what i like and just listen to these reviews where we tell you what we like, we want to see everything!

title: Only bright spot is Marketplace
review:
The social side of this app will ruin your perception of the world. I never use this app, but recently I’ve been moving and have been on the app for marketplace reasons. When I checked out the videos tab one day, it was an endless stream of fight videos, shootings, body cam videos, ultra violence, videos that feel like they’re targeted to children even though the content is for adults, random soft porn, karens, male karens, true horror stories, etc. It was the worst of the worst of humanity on repeat. 

It’s almost as bad as seeing the random, unhinged thoughts and beliefs of all the people in your life. 

Using this app is the opposite of social and it makes me want to engage with the world less.

title: Idea
review: I thought about something. I think it would help a lot of people's mental health if we had the option to turn off "likes" on specific posts. That way users can focus more about sharing than about a popularity contest. I know Facebook is all about giving people control over their content and I'm sure there will be people that enjoy that option. Facebook sometimes gives me anxiety over stupid likes and I've found myself posting and logging on less. I'm certain that I'm not alone in this. Thanks so much for considering my idea!

title: Latest update
review:
This app is absolute garbage on the ipad. The videos in “watch” are always in “dark mode” and you cant see what you type to comment. Also the videos automatically go into full screen mode if you move the ipad. I cannot find any way to adjust these if they are settings within the ipad app. I can see how to turn off “dark mode” on the web page…but not the ipad app. And it doesnt seem to carry over from one to the other. The videos going into full screen just by moving the ipad is incredibly annoying.

How about making an update that fixes real issues rather trying to find ways to get more data out of us to sell!!!

title: Horrible experience
review: The UI is the worst thing ever. The app never shows you anything you want to see it shows you only what they want to show you even the ads are bad it shows you ads for products that you cant use. They very clearly don’t know how to run a social media platform with the lack of sociability on the app the groups are so heavily moderated by Facebook that a lot of groups won’t let you post out of fear of getting banned. They also ban people for no reason all the time. I dont recommend using this app legit either use tiktok or just go outside take a walk kick a can down the street and you will have a better time having social interactions with people

title: My account was disabled for no reason
review:
Longtime user of Facebook. A little while back, my account was disabled under the guise of a community guidelines violation - but was never told what I did wrong. I also rarely posted on my account so I’m not sure what was wrong.

I sent in an appeal, they asked for my personal identification, sent that (not very smart, I know, but I was hoping for the best) and waited for OVER A MONTH just to be told my account was going to be permanently deleted anyways by automated messages. The fact no representatives were available at all and I only had automated to “help” (which only sends you to various links that don’t even answer your questions) made me feel completely and totally hopeless.

Multiple Instagram accounts of mine were linked to that Facebook account, and now I no longer have access to those alongside thousands of photos I’ve kept over the years, all because of a blatantly faulty system.

Suddenly I’m redirected to a place that is not my news feed plagued by videos that I don’t want to watch by pages I don’t follow. review:

This has since been removed, making it very easy to accidentally share a post multiple times before realizing it actually worked. If the phone is muted (like most people do), there is no way to know if it worked, besides visiting your profile, sometimes to discover it shared 5 or 6 times. This is such a small, unnecessary, and fixable problem, especially since it was once a nonissue.

I deactivated my account and I’m so much happier and less stressed by not using social media. Will probably permanently delete my account if I’m able to in the relatively near future. This online space is a toxic cess pool of humanity, and disinformation runs rampant. Not to mention them data farming for money, everything about this type of service and app is absolutely disgusting. App was also super buggy while I used it...and multiple apps just to chat with people? Come on, that’s ridiculous

review:
I wish you could turn off automatic refresh when you open the app. 

You should be able to search just within your groups. You can only search within each individual group or all groups throughout Facebook. I wish we could sort/group sets of groups together to make it more organized instead of having all groups listed randomly

The search function should follow basic rules like if you search a phrase or set of words in quotes, it should search for that specific set of worlds, not each individual word.

review: Facebook pushes for you to “grow your business” with them.  Since I hadn’t had issues with Facebook in all the years I’ve used it, I thought it would be a great platform so I set up a business page and started growing my business.  After selling for sometime and averaging 40-60 orders a day, October 26th everything stopped working . I’ve contacted everyday, multiple times a day and nothing .  No support.  No fix.  No retribution.  Everything I worked hard for just gone.  Literally get told by the “same person” to try and update my app as if that is going to get the entire US to be able to order from me again.

title: Terrible Interface for Actual Discussion
review:
Perhaps Facebook isn’t meant for discussion? When discussions become long and involved, Facebook tends to break down. Comments appear out of order — so people have no idea what comments are responding to. The phone app sticks in “Most Relevant” mode, which evidently we can’t change. Even on a desktop “All Comments” doesn’t show all comments in the proper order, and sometimes it doesn’t even show all comments.

LOL — today I went to one discussion and all I could see were my comments. I guess I’m “most relevant”?

If Facebook desires to have a serious chance of surviving the next couple of years, this needs to be fixed.

title: Awful Update
review:
The update that requires me to watch videos in Watch instead of on my normal feed is absolute trash. I want to watch a full video, then continue scrolling, and I don’t always want audio. In addition to that, Watch now only works with audio for maybe 1-3 videos, so when I actually do want to scroll through videos, I can’t without re-opening the app every 6 minutes. 

It’s unimpressive. Please change it back.

Update: every time the app auto-updates, it turns on my “Active Status” which I do not want, and it keeps turning off my dark mode. Both of these things are no bueno, quit updating if the updates aren’t good.

review:

You can’t even post your own opinion anymore without seeing FB fact checkers posts, “president elect” posts or FB telling me how safe our elections are.  FB is too political now and they are suppressing truths.

title: The app functionality is becoming less and less useful
review:
Despite the numerous updates being done to this app, I’m finding its functionality becoming less and less useful.  Aside from the numerous repeated postings from news sources—to the point that I don’t see posts from people to whom I’m connected—I’m constantly made to see posts that I knew I deliberately hide from view on my timeline!!  

There are just some posts I don’t want to see!!!  I should not have to resort to either snoozing, or otherwise “unliking” pages, to clean up the timeline of items that do not interest me!  What would be helpful is an update to enter key words that would actually FILTER OUT much of what I’m finding to be useless information.

title: Old News!
review: There needs to be an individual preference setting to allow the user to set their newsfeed to be the most current posts instead of the most active. I’ve viewed the same 15 posts off and on all day, everyday. Facebook is losing its appeal to logon when I know it’s going to be the same old news I’ve seen 500 times in a week. I’m sure this is not only a frustration of mine, which could be one of the reasons the application only has an average of 3 stars. Facebook users need to have the access to set up their application that works best for the individual.

title: Care react and glitches/bugs
review:
I use Facebook everyday, so I make sure to keep my phone AND the app up-to-date.

I’ve been waiting weeks to get the care react, but haven’t got it. I’ve used other people’s suggestions (logging in and then logging back in, getting on the desktop and then you should have it on the mobile, keep updating, let it roll out, etc) and it hasn’t worked. I’m kinda disappointed because I really wanted to care react to people’s posts. (SIDE NOTE: I haven’t got the pulsing heart on messenger either, but that doesn’t really matter because I don’t use messenger all the time).

Aside from the care reaction on mobile, I’ve had a lot of glitches/bugs. Some have fixed themselves, other didn’t.

One of them is that “it” (the app and desktop) blocks random people which is a HUGE struggle in the Facebook groups I’m in.

Another is, duplicates. “It” duplicates my comments and posts. That’s a real problem in groups that have a “do not delete your own posts/comments” rule. 

There’s like 5-10 more but I cannot remember them all. 

Thanks.

title: Please Fix Video Watching
review:

When you tap a video, any video in your feed, it takes you to the video tab. This is very annoying because now I have to double tap the video to watch it full screen. Also it takes two swipes to get back to my feed. This just makes me not wanna watch videos anymore! 
How about some solutions? Let us disable tabs or customize them. I don’t always need the marketplace, group or video tab on my app. That way the video tab wouldn’t be annoying and it wouldn’t take up space at the bottom of the app!

title: Ads, ads, everywhere!
review:
The last week or so, I have seen more ads popping up than I care to see for the rest of my life. I don’t like them, and I don’t like telling you why I don’t like them. All I want is to see posts from my friends. About every third or fourth post is an ad of some kind, totally irrelevant to me. I really don’t like that you are watching what I shop for and what kind of stories I like to read. Sometimes I just like to look at things. That doesn’t mean that I want to see that many ads on the same type of thing. 😱 
🤦🏼‍♀️ 🤦🏼‍♀️  Can something be done about this, please?

1. Hate the auto refresh. 
2. Wayyy too many adds. 
3. For some reason I’m not getting all my notifications. If I’m tagged in something or someone replies or comments to something I’ve posted, there’s no longer any notifications. I get nothing. I’ll scroll down my timeline and see my own post with extra comments and sit there wondering what the hell is going on. Since none of my notification setting have changed. I checked them a few time to make sure i didn’t accidentally change something. So many things wrong with this app it’d take forever to write but this is by far the most annoying thing I’ve encountered.

review: Why must you mess with the search feature?!?! ONE flipping search bar!? Are you freaking serious!? That’s the dumbest crap I’ve ever seen. I literally loathe it!!!! I need my search bar back on my notifications screen, and back on my menu screen! I HATE having to go back<back<back< out of a page to search something up. What if I’m looking at something on one page and need to compare it to something on another. Guess what!?! I can’t do that because I have no other search bar! That was seriously the dumbest decision ever. Who thought that up!? Oh and while I’m at it. These random glitches that sends me back to the top of the page?? Come on. We’ve got to do better. PLEASEEEE bring back my search bars!!!

title: Bug after bug
review: Seriously, did y’all stop caring about your app the past year? So many bugs keep coming up. First it wasn’t showing me comments. Then it wasn’t showing me polls. Then nothing would load. Now it refreshes without warning, even if I leave the app for just 2 seconds to reply to a text. Sometimes it refreshes when I’m using the app. NOW it won’t let me comment or like comments. I can like posts but I can’t comment or like comments and I can’t vote on polls. I never get any response from Facebook support when I “report a problem”. Nor do I ever get a response about what they did if I reported spam or abuse. It’s getting old. Seriously get it together Facebook. This is ridiculous at this point.

title: No Push Notifications for 10 months now...
review:
Haven’t received Push notifications in over 6 months. Facebook app settings are all set to receive/Push, my iphone & app settings are set to receive, and my iphone is not on ‘do not disturb’, etc. My phone is updated to the latest IOS. 

I’ve uninstalled and reinstalled the app, deleted my backup and completely wiped my phone, resetting to manufacturers settings... and still no Facebook Push notifications. I have to open the app to see if I have any notifications. 

I’ve reported the problem about 100 times... no fix.

Facebook actually gives me ads that I want and they usually come with discounts and offers that have saved me a lot of money!!! If I choose not to, I will unfollow them, it should be my choice, not chosen for me by some stupid algorithm. Also sick of selecting most recent and having posts from hours and even days before showing, while top stories shows me there are plenty of recent things that should be on top. I’m using Facebook less and less because it’s just frustrating, and it’s also extremely boring just seeing the same few people repeatedly. I shouldn’t have to go check every friend’s page individually to see if they’ve been posting.

title: Constantly crashing and failing to load
review:
Since the most recent two updates, the app keeps crashing, often right while I’m in the middle of typing a comment. I have an iPhone X so I know it’s not the hardware. It’s very frustrating on its own but what makes it worse is the frequency at which it happens. I am honestly disappointed that this wasn’t caught in the last update. If I can get it to not crash long enough I still have the problem of my news feed not loading. Sometimes it will even load 4-7 posts and then it’s as if there are no more posts to be seen. It just won’t load. At that point I have to close my app and go to Snapchat.

review:

title: Change Password to prompt Security Audit?
review:
I am an iOS App Developer who recently had a friend come to me asking how to lock down their account. They recently changed their password and didn’t know how to track down the root cause.

Although walking through the various security settings your application has come to offer. It wasn’t immediately clear what menu options nor what settings to adjust for their reported behavior.

Thus I saw at the bottom of your Security and Login page you have an option to walkthrough a security audit for if your account has been hacked. The idea arose that you might be able to prompt such a walkthrough with a deep link upon each password change? This could be a natural actions an user might want to take with each time they change their password?

Otherwise I love the app! It’s slick and a daily essential that I use often!

review:

little, then allows me to open the app again. However, when I reopen, I must start from the beginning as it does not return to where I was when it switched off.  This occurs every few seconds or sometimes every few minutes making it very frustrating to be and accomplish anything on Marketplace.

review: I’ve encountered quite a few bugs and general annoyances with the Facebook app. First, notification are now useless; when I click on the I don’t actually get sent to the correct place (though this only seems to be an issue on the iPhone, not on the iPad 🤷🏼‍♂️). As for the news feed, Id like to see stuff from today, not three days ago or have to click on “most recent”.

title: Recent update is stupid
review:
I'll be looking at or reading a post, the out of nowhere the newsfeed updates and I lose the post I was reading and can't find it. If I know which of my friends posted it, I have to look up their timeline to finish reading it & respond. Most of the time, I'll be into an article and it refreshes out of the blue and I can't remember what company posted it. I'll go to the search bar to type in the subject to see if I can find it again, but usually without success. It shouldn't be this much work for what is supposed to be a leisure app. 

The ads are getting ridiculous, don't need a freaking ad between every 5 posts.

title: Garbage

title: Most Recent
review: I use this app constantly and I do enjoy it a great deal. My rating cannot improve, though, because the comment button seems to have disappeared and there is no gif icon on any posts in my feed. We now just have a text entry line, and there are buttons for stickers and photos. Gifs are left out. However, if I follow a shared post to its source, the comment and gif options return. Unfortunately, that prohibits me from posting gifs on things my friends have shared since I can only use them with the original poster. Tap on the share button of a post and select any of the options; poll or reaction or whatever, then tap on remove poll. After it removes the poll the “What do you think” text still remains. Unless this was intentional then disregard this but if I remove the poll I expect everything it came with to go away. 🤷🏾‍♂️

title: Predictive contact selection screws up accessibility for blind users.
review: I’m a blind iPhone user who uses a Braille device when doing serious reading or writing on my phone. While posting or writing comments to others’ posts, an annoying contact list of sorts pops up, completely stealing focus from what I’m trying to write, which in my opinion is stupid and completely unnecessary. This nasty bug was introduced fairly recently and I can safely say that I’m not the only blind user who’s complaining about it. If sighted users find predictive contact selection helpful, fine, but put something in the app’s settings that will let us turn it off if we so choose. As it stands now, this bug screws up accessibility. Shame, SHAME!

title: Too many fake accounts. Poor enforcement of community standards.
review:
I’ve had a Facebook account since you needed an email address from an Ivy League university to attend. (Yes, I’m an OG) 

In that time, Facebook went from a sophisticated platform to connect to friends and colleagues to a cesspool. The app, desperate to be everything to everyone, is bloated and poorly designed. It has a terrible UI that’s bizarre to navigate. 

But my biggest problem is that it doesn’t enforce their own community standards in a consistent way. There are so many obviously fake accounts that never get removed, and people can use slurs or other hate speech and not get punished. It’s like the only way they can attract people to the platform is by generating animosity and division. It’s a place to argue, not share ideas or inspiring content.

As I approach 20 years with Facebook, I ask myself, is this really something I need to connect? Each day, I spend less time interacting on this platform and connect more via text or phone calls.

I never post negative reviews. And it’s only because I really like Facebook and want to continue using it that I am doing so now. Between its algorithms, ever changing community standards, and technical changes, pretty soon it’s going to be a miracle than anybody keeps using it. 

The latest frustration is now you can’t edit posts anymore from your iPhone, which is the main device I use Facebook from. 

Can’t edit a post — shades of Twitter!

Seriously, in order to edit a post, I now have to go to my laptop or desktop to write a post. Even when I tried to edit a post from my Safari browser, it was horrible. 

What are you people thinking? 

If I have to go to my laptops every time I want to post, I will probably stop using FB. At some point, your advertisers are going to find out you are losing users. Please fix this problem. Fix it now. Because, trust me, if I can’t post on my phone, I’m probably not going to post or even read others’ posts either.

I have sent numerous “reports” and have had zero responses. review:
After the last update something changed in the Facebook settings 
I can’t see when people comment about my post. No more sad or surprised face, no more heart or care, no more likes and no more COMMENTS. I try everything that I could think of with settings, but nothing works. No matter where I login it is the same, that means it is not my equipment but Facebook itself. 
If I can connect to my friends and followers because Facebook took away that privilege (can’t see when they respond) then I don’t see the purpose to stay.  I am waiting for an update and if no change then I will leave.  Very sad, specially now locked at home because the corona virus.

title: It would be so nice to actually use it...
review: I tried downloading to sell a lot of things that I have collected and cluttered my house with over the years. It wanted me to verify I was a human. No big deal, however my account got disabled for absolutely nothing and I’m not getting any help from them on how to fix it. I violated absolutely no terms or conditions, and I was banned for no reason. Facebook even saw that I was a human during the verification video I sent them, yet banned me for nothing! If you want to sell something this is NOT the way to go. You will probably get banned for nothing and have your adds stripped down. review: When someone shares a post from Instagram into Facebook I can’t see it, I noticed because my sister is always sharing her Instagram posts to Facebook and now I can’t see anything she posts. We checked the privacy settings and no luck. We even changed the privacy to public and I still cannot see the public posts that come from Instagram. We tried tagging me on the post but nothing happened, I still cannot see it. And all the old posts I shared that show un on my Facebook memories of the day now they say that “the content is not available.” It is very frustrating.

review: Why this App Has Much “Social Meaning” is beyond my understanding?  It doesn’t make staying in Witten Contact with friends and relatives a very useful and effective social platform,  in my opinion!  Phone calling is Not financially feasible, and letter writing is more difficult for this senior to physically do and be sensibly legible. title: Ok when it works
review: The app is alright when it works but I’ve been unable to use it for three months since I updated it. Facebook and Messenger apps just suddenly wouldn’t open on my phone and never have again. I have used all their BS avenues to contact and get it fixed. But none of the options actually lead to someone reading the issue and so it never gets fixed. You can only message public forums , unmanned bug fix mailboxes and review sites. Which I am hitting one by one. The customer service of this billion dollar company is 0. Absolute and 100% no way to get any kind of help if you ever have an issue. May as well never download this piece of junk at all. Save yourself the headache.

title: Groups admin tools has issue
review:
Hi, I’m an admin of a group here on Facebook. There is one critical change that I feel needs to happen ASAP. Facebook needs to make that you can not click “Join” until you answer the group questions and agree to the group rules.

Lots of people don’t answer the questions and the rules. 

If this was a requirement to join instead of a suggestion, the administration process would be a lot easier. No need to have filters for those that have answered questions or rules.

title: Excellent for personal use
review:
The app works well for me as an individual. It allows me to keep in touch with my eclectic group of friends from many times and places.

The app works for our Lions Club except for the annoying suggestions that it keeps making as if we were a business. We are not a business, we are not hiring and our posts are not ads. The algorithms need to be tweaked to recognize a non profit and differentiate one from a business.

title: Out of Control With the Changes
review:
So many things are changing so fast with the app that you can’t even tell what’s going on anymore. 
We have a business page and it’s gotten to the point that whenever we get a like, comment, share, recommendation, message, or anything, we have no idea where to find it. When you tap on the red dot that indicates something happened it no longer takes you directly to the comment, etc. - you have to spend 2 hours trying to hunt it down. By the time we find it our customer thinks we’re ignoring them. 
App is a complete mess. Need to retract the last 6 months of updates.

title: Facebook jail
review: Facebook jail is getting a little ridiculous, particularly in instances when the community standards have not been broke. I know the point to to try to prevent/alert people to possible hacking, But if I am the one making posts(and have not been hacked) there should be a way for me to notify Facebook and not have to stay on restrictions.  As far as the concern of to many posts being spammy, that should be for the people receiving them to decide, if they don’t like it they can report it at that point. (Or when it is in my group, leave the group)

title: Recent update is a step backwards
review:
I’m not sure what supposed bug fixes were in this latest update, but I get a few posts in to my feed and then it just stops. It’s as if the info just doesn’t load. This is happening on my app and when I log in on my laptop.

FB is not loading more content (a.k.a. the famous ‘please wait’ spinning circle), but it’s as if there is simply nothing else to see...no more posts...no more pages...just nothing. 

Come to think of it, this has been going on since the update before this most recent one (today??)! So frustrating!!!!!!

title: Don’t appreciate changes
review: It seems just when I get used to Facebook it changes AGAIN. I got to the point where I just don’t really go in it any more but post from instagram as it seems more user-friendly. I avoid updates like the plague. I hate all the “secrecy” it advocates. There’s enough negativity & infidelity in the world.:(  I don’t really like social media platforms that advocate it. I understand you don’t have to utilize what’s there- but the fact that it’s in your face and my friends, children & family who uses it seeing that on messenger (which is now an entire different app?!?) makes me hesitant to continue use or recommend it to anyone. review: Somehow even when FB doesn’t have permission to access the microphone on my phone, I’m getting ADs that have something to do with keywords from recent conversations. There’s an option to edit AD interests. I delete them and within an hour there’s a bunch more. Either for things I talked about with my phone in my shirt pocket or leftist causes and politicians. It’s not ok for me to voice my beliefs politely and respectfully, yet it’s ok for someone to make vulgar comments against Christians. I’ve read multiple comments/posts that are derogatory towards white people and FB deems it not racist because of the color of who it’s said to/about. Racism is racism. It doesn’t matter what color/ethnicity.

title: Review
review: One of the big issues I have is that people can send you friend requests just by having a mutual friend. And then their friends will send one and so on and so on. My page is private and didn’t know that people can send you friend requests even though it says on my profile they can’t. The other issue is,is the hacking and people using using my data for themselves. There are a lot of other issues and the only reason why I still have it is to keep up with my family even the ones I really don’t have contact with outside of Facebook

review: Okay, overall it’s a pretty good app. However, i don’t know about you guys, but there’s some things that i posted that i regret. I have some pictures on facebook that I’d prefer not be public. I want to take them down, but i don’t want to delete them entirely. I think if you guys could add an option to archive posts, many people would benefit from it. Maybe even whole albums incase you don’t want people to see them, but don’t want to lose the memories.  Please take this into consideration.

title: Total Trash Nowadays
review:
Since Facebook created the “Share” feature a decade ago, the site has been on a long downward spiral. There is so much low-effort reposted, recycled garbage being shared, that it completely blocks out any original content on the site. This has caused me to spend less and less time on the site - especially in the past couple of years where the decline has been especially evident. I don’t know what facebook’s financial strategy is, because this self-perpetuating dumpster fire is chasing away all the people who actually produce content and leaving behind people who can’t afford the products and services being advertised on the site.

FACEBOOK, PLEASE KILL THE SHARE BUTTON OR LET ME OPT OUT OF SEEING SHARED CONTENT

Why is the profile photo in the center? This blocks cover photos that I might want to show all of or they end up looking funny behind my picture. Unless we have hidden people, why would want to not see posts from more friends?

Like others, I'm seeing the same posts over and over.  I don't like having to search for the most recent only to still see old posts.  Ugh!

review: It has recently become unusable. I have to use Facebook in my phone’s browser now. title: I fixed the problem
review: Well I seem to have solved the Facebook app problems I have been having where it keeps crashing on me. I deleted it then logged on using my safari browser, changed my password and logged out of other logins. Then reinstalled the app. When I went to reinstall it said get on the app instead of showing a icloud download icon. So now I have been using it for two hours and it is not crashing anymore.

title: Awful
review: Facebook really needs to do better. I hate how it makes you crop the photo whenever you go to upload it. Then it automatically crops it even more for the thumbnail. You can't edit your thumbnail, so if your face gets cut out, you're just SOL. And the posts that appear first on my timeline seem to have no consistency to them. Sometimes they are posts from two days ago, instead of them being the most recent. Also, reporting posts to Facebook is just pointless. I had a stranger actually use a picture of me from my own Facebook page, and I reported it to Facebook, and they refused to remove my photo.

review:
When will we be able to manage multiple Facebook accounts without having to log out then log back in each time? Instagram allows you to be logged into multiple accounts at one time and all you have to do is choose the account you want to view from a drop-down menu. Facebook owns Instagram. What’s the problem? title: The worst app of all time
review:

Additionally, the app is plagued by constant crashes and freezes. I lost count of how many times I had to restart my device just to get Facebook to function somewhat properly. The frustration that comes with using this app is beyond belief.

To make matters worse, the content on Facebook is severely lacking in quality. It's filled with spam, clickbait, and low-quality posts that add zero value. Instead of enhancing my experience, it felt like the app was actively working against me.

title: Facebook marketplace
review:
Regarding Facebook marketplace

It has become increasingly difficult to buy a car on Facebook marketplace via private sales. Many dealers post ads as private sale, only to later be revealed as a dealer. This can be misleading and sometimes even predatory. 

Suggested resolution: Require that all dealers and/or salespeople plainly list the dealership in their ads. Also require that dealers state the FULL price of the car upfront (in the detail section). 

This will help people know when they’re buying from a dealer or not. I’m more comfortable buying from private civilians, not businesspeople. Dealers have hidden motives, bad tactics, and extra taxes/fees.

Feature request: Please add video upload support for the new iPhones 4K recorder.

PS - When you add Apple Pay support to the payment system, then I'll use that service.

Yawn! Stop trying to make FB a thing it's like a retirement home now. So boring and they think by adding Snapchat like videos now it's going to be cool. No thanks, I legit use it now to keep in touch with my mom & elderly relatives. Oh and the event page to see what's happening around town. Otherwise I couldn't care less about any of its useless to me features. They lost my interest the day I had to download another app to message people. Another app equals more waste on my phone. Not cool. 

My position still stands on the above comments and now the most recent update you can’t see the comments when you hold your phone horizontally when watching a live. I just can’t understand the stupidity.

title: If you don’t already know
review: I hate Facebook, I hate their app, I hate Mark himself, I hate the idea, I hate the guy. Facebook amongst their plethora of problems, have decided that it is in everyone’s best interest that they don’t have a phone number. You can’t call anyone, at “headquarters” or customer service, nope it’s your problem. They charge hidden ad fees when you run ads off of Instagram. Who they for whatever reason bought out. title: Customer service
review: I was scrolling the fb marketplace, fell asleep while scrolling, woke up and was locked out. When logging in on the app it would just say login error please try again, and on messenger it requested verify identity then just said they optained my info and it was waiting review.  Today I tried again to log in and after a month it now says my account is disabled.  I have no clue what I did, why my account got disabled, or why I needed to send in my id for them to not get a hold of me and tell me at least why my account is locked.  They can’t even scroll the internet and remove imposters with a number to call for Facebook (fb has no phone number) trying to scam you.

title: Very Unhappy
review: You keep updating FB every few days to improve our experience. Well, nothing is improving my experience. Just getting me more aggravated when I try to go on and see what is happening with my family and the groups that I am a member of. Most of the time I get posts that are days old that I have already seen and read. Now starting today, when I sign in, I’m only getting a few posts, and that’s it. Where are the posts from my groups? Where are all the annoying ads that run all the time? Where are the posts from my friends and family?  Please fix whatever is going on, so I can continue to keep up with all that I look forward too.

title: Groups feed not working
review:
Just wanted to give y’all a heads up that the group feed is not working. It shows one update and then a link to “discover more groups.” I know my groups are updating and I would like to see them. Please fix the bug. 

Also, I still hate that there is not an option to choose most recent updates on all feeds instead of “most like” or “most commented.” I don’t care and I don’t want to see the same one every time I check the groups feed, or a specific groups feed, or even my general feed. I don’t want to be commenting on something from more than a week ago. It’s not relevant anymore.

title: Comment thread out of order
review: Whenever I try to have a discussion in the thread of a comment on a post, the replies are all out of order. For example, from top to bottom in a discussion of a comment, one reply could be from 20 minutes ago, then another from 8 hours ago right under it and then one from 6 hours ago under that one. It’s hard to have a discussion when all the comments are out of order. I don’t know what I’m supposed to respond to half the time. Either this is because of a bug or a feature. Regardless fix this issue ASAP

title: You can’t handle the truth!!
review: I’ll tell it like it is: it’s the best app ever, period. Nobody wants to admit it and would rather complain about it but they know it’s the app they use the most by far and it has shaped the direction of human history... IG does not do that and owes its existence to FB. Could I drum up stuff about FB that me personally doesn’t like? Sure... But that’s not providing an accurate review. If you read this review then you have an example of how it’s done. FB: absolute. No replacement.

title: Fake/Real
review: I enjoy Facebook, but have found it hard to know what is fake news and what is real. It seems like we don’t have any real reporters anymore. Wikipedia  comes to mind when I think of Facebook to day, but the fact checkers aren’t involved in Facebook to remove falsehoods and downright lies. Political information is very hard to determine fact from fiction. Where can you find factual information . I want news and factual information. I want to contact my friends and post things that happen in our lives, pass on clean humor and feel safe when we do this.

title: Most disrespectful platform ever!!
review: On no other social media site is there so much pure TRASH!! Than on Facebook! If I could give this a -100 star I would! 1 is way too much. The people are trash. The posts that are meant for one specific person become a portal to people’s ideas opinions and comments that are beyond unwelcome. No one has a filter or any common sense. And the idea that you can just trail on for eons of time over and over is absurd! I literally can’t even have a private page with 2 friends and no be inundated with junk and ads and all kinds of crap! Biggest waste of time space and technology I’ve ever seen. Delete this app and your account and your life will be better for it!!

title: I never do reviews but I had to now
review: I understand your trying to protect privacy, but I honestly don’t feel It’s necessary to ask for a picture of a passport or a drivers license to confirm it’s actually the person. I literally haven’t used Facebook for 3 yrs and I finally decided to log into to Facebook and it’s asking me for a picture of my most private information just to confirm I’m the owner of the page if I put in the right password with out an issue and it’s asking me for more proof? I feel that’s a bit to much a picture of my drivers license or passport. If not even close friends and some family know where I live why would I want Facebook to know? Just so they can “verify it’s me”

review:
Hello!

title: Great app to communicate
review: The Facebook app is really a great way to keep in touch with family & friends. Your able to speak what’s on your mind and let your family and friends see how there lives and yours is going. I don’t use Facebook to meet anyone to start a relationship with because most people are already in relationships. But overall it’s a great place to keep in contact with your loved ones

title: Disregards users reports and do not try to fix apps within Facebook
review: Only going to give one start until they fix this issue I’ve been reporting for 3 months. There dating app freezes after you get over 30 people “liked you.” When you click the “liked you” section the screen is completely blank and will not load. I have deleted my account 2 times now and restarted to see if it will resolve the issue and it does for a few days and once you get over 30 people who swiped on you it’s back to being a blank screen. Please fix this. I was enjoying the Facebook dating over and other dating site until this started happening.

title: Got Banned Without Reason
review:
If you’re looking for a reliable platform to share your life or opinion with your friends and public then Facebook is not for you. Please look elsewhere. 

Apart from censoring speech and taking a dump on I Amendment, they can even ban you without a reason. This has been happening a lot since they rely on computer algorithms to automatically ban users and no algorithm is perfect. When you are logging in, you never know whether Facebook will let in our you’ll be presented with a message that your account is disabled. 

And what is even more ridiculous is that they ask for a photocopy of your ID. Not only this is ridiculous but there is a little chance that your account is going to be reinstated after sending them one. 

If you care about yourself and your community, please consider deleting Facebook, moving to other platform (there are a lot of worthy alternatives) and encouraging other to do the same. Facebook has way too much power that they think it’s okay to do unconscionable stuff.

title: Browser in Facebook app hijacked
review:
Hi, 
A number of times I’ve clicked on links within the Facebook App, and wound up being brought to a scam site which I can’t get out of. There should be a way for the app to have an spyware, or malware checked that detects when something is trying to redirect the browser to an infected site. Maybe something on the Facebook end, since the browser is inside the app, or at least give the user an option to have another app on the phone to check to make sure the browser, or website aren’t trying to redirect to some sort of scam site that says the phone is infected with a virus.

title: Everything Changes even without updating
review: Even without updating things like where my notifications show up change and I can’t change it back. But it’ll swap back and forth between lower left and lower right. It’s pretty frustrating. Also, the main reason I’m writing this review is that when I’m looking at posts in a group, I can no longer organize it by most recent. Instead it is always “top posts” when I have to see recent posts I have to open up my laptop or web browser. What’s the point of an app that gets a million updates all the time when it can’t do even the most simple of tasks that it used to be able to do before?

title: Timeline refresh
review: I wish the Timeline would not refresh when I leave the app to use another app.  Sometimes I see something posted by someone and I want to use Safari to get more details.  Then when I return to Facebook, the app refreshes and I have search for the post that I might want to make a reply.  Sometimes I forget who made the post, and so scroll down forever to find it, if ever.  Other times, I just need to do something else and return to the point where I left off.  This should be an option for all users of FB, an on/off option.

title: Now you can’t even catch up on friends posts!
review: I haven’t been on Facebook much lately so I went on to catch up on family and friends’ posts and commented on several then all of a sudden I got a notification that my comments were not being seen because they were against spam standards!!! None of them were spam or even had to do with each other they were on completely different posts and most were even different people! Facebook has gotten COMPLETELY RIDICULOUS!!! Exactly why I’ve been spending most of my social media time on MeWe instead! 🤷🏻‍♀️🤦🏻‍♀️🤯😡 If it weren’t for keeping in touch with family and friends far away I’d leave Facebook altogether!

title: Stories heard in the background
review: I just noticed this problem as of the last FB update. So I open FB and go to my notifications and open a new video from a page I like, as the video I press play on I then hear (only audible) audio from the stories I have on the top of my page. So it’s like the row row your boat continuous singing version. You are watching and listening to the video you want and are listening to audio from stories at the same time. So annoying and you can’t stop it till you X out of the video your watching, if you try and press play on any other video, same thing happens. So stories are always heard in the background while watching any video.

title: Really?
review: I honestly hate the new security updates. Like i dont have the same picture on two different devices so how the heck am I going to be able to sign in on my phone when the pic I used was on the computer????????? In my opinion this little security update is kinda dumb because it stops some people from being able to quickly sign in on a different device. Like what happened to the two factor authentication???? I was totally fine with having to verify with a phone number but now a pic verification? Because of it I may never be able to sign back in. Honestly what is up with the people who work on these updates? They all need to be fired if you ask me....

title: Got 30 day ban (my first) over nothing
review: So before I say anything Facebook is designed very well as far as consumer needs goes but their AI and algorithm it uses targeted me for making a joke with a friend and having Facebook review only for them to say it violates policy even though I didn’t incite violence, sexist comments, anti-LGBTQ comments, or any racial or class comments. The big kicker is that people can go to CNN or C-Span news coverage of that Covington kid and literally say they want to MURDER this 14 y/o and you try to report it because..ya’know murdering kids is bad—you would assume—but, according to Facebook it’s cool idk man their standards need to change because I can’t even talk to my friend on one of his posts without stepping on egg shells..

title: Yesterday's news today...
review:
It's fantastic that I get to read everything that happened yesterday first on my news feed. Well, except that I ALREADY READ IT YESTERDAY. 
Most recent should be the default. Not your idea of what the top stories are! Please make an option that allows me to select most recent as my default & it never, ever, ever goes back to the top stories option. Ever. 
I just want to see all posts in the order they are posted & it seems most people feel the same about this...
Also, in the latest update, when I do get to select most recent, I only get to see the last couple of hours and then a spinning wheel. It never loads anything older. Terrible update!

title: Great app just has minor issues that can be a little annoying
review: I think this app works great and all of the features available are very helpful especially for those who run groups and pages on Facebook. My only complaint is that the app has issues on refreshing the page and updating to the most recent on the feed. I wish this could be resolved so i can make sure my posts are actually going through or so I can see the most recent posts on the pages.

title: Help!
review: All week I haven’t been able to share posts, like anything, or share my own memories on Facebook. It pops up saying that I have been blocked from sharing or liking anything even if it is my own memories. It will only let me take pictures and post statuses, but I can’t share anything from any page or from any of my friends. review: It is Friday and I go to look at Facebook, I find that I have been seeing the same post for 5 days.  I hit the “most recent” button again and this time I actually get 1 new post that happened 1 hour ago and then all the rest are from Sunday and Monday. Have a setting that allows all the posts in “most recent” order and have it work!!!!  I don’t want to look around on the feed for new posts, I just want to look back to the last time I checked it, and see everything since then.   Chronological Order!!!!!!!

title: Profile viewing on iPhone?
review: No matter what I do it will not let me open and view my own profile. It may be only an issue with iPhones. My app is updated. It has an issue with me viewing my own content in general also. I posted a picture with a caption and I went to go back and edit it and it looked like the captain was gone. Then it wouldn’t let me go to my profile and find it. Tried on and off WiFi. But my boyfriends Samsung phone could see everything fine. Please fix this issue.

title: Feedback
review: Facebook is something I don’t go on often. To be honest, I only maintain an account to stay in contact with friends from all over the world and for Facebook events. Because I rarely go on I find that I miss event that I’m invited to. My feedback is for there to be an app specific for Facebook events like Messenger App is for messages received from Facebook account. Having an app specific for events will open a community platform to engage even more people. I would attend more events because I’ll be able to be notified and quickly access the event information.

title: Can’t even get notifications off but they expect us to believe we are secure?
review:
Their laughable campaign to convince us they c are about our privacy is absurd.  On top of that even if you turn off all notifications except things that pertain to YOU - still tons of notifications of person a posted a picture, come see person b’s post. Etc. 

Everything about this company is a farce.  They’re selling the world to micro targeting, ruining all sense of privacy, and taking over our devices with contact linking, notifications, ludicrous promises of doing better.  

If you can’t figure it basic notification settings I sure as heck can’t trust you to get encryption and other data protections right.

title: A few problems
review: Okay I see one person is having problems with their notifications and it’s happening to me too. They won’t pop up unless I’m in the app and after I check a notification it’ll pop up again claiming I haven’t checked it yet and I have. Also, can you PLEASE make it so we can change the publicity of our cover photos? It’s always on public and I’ve been trying to figure out how to change it to just friends and it won’t let me. You have a lot of angry customers so I suggest you do something about it, please and thank you.

title: Continues to get worse...
review: Removing the marketplace icon from the front page was the dumbest thing to me. The marketplace was literally the ONLY reason I still kept this app installed. Now it's tucked away in the "explore" menu. I would maybe understand if there was a more important icon placed there but instead it's a second button on the main/home page to view your profile... I was excited today to see that I still had the old app on my iPhone, only to find out a couple hours later Facebook auto-updates to this terrible, new, entirely confused version. Even though I have auto-updates turned off across every app. Please stop making this app worse.

title: Daily lock out crashes
review: Going on 1 week of daily crashes. And when it does crash the app then will not open. When I open it, it immediately shuts down. I check back several hours later...seems to be working fine and then it starts all over again. Horrible update? The FB app is horrendous. The ONLY reason I use is because FB makes it nearly impossible to use desktop version on Apples Safari iPhone. Such crap we can’t even make that decision anymore. You took away my choice of how to use messenger and made me download that crappy app. Now you take away my choice to simply view desktop. Which is the only place you can actually access ALL settings.

title: Really annoying issue
review:
Does most recent mean "random" now? Recently when I go to most recent the order will be like "2 hrs ago, 10hrs ago, yesterday at 11:36pm, 47 mins ago, 1 hr ago, 2 hrs ago, 7 hrs ago, 1 hr ago" with seemingly no order instead of being chronological. 

This is still an issue: So when scrolling on most recent, since I'm right handed my thumb sometimes accidentally slips a tiny bit diagonally while scrolling and it decides to go back to that more page and I have no way to get back to where I was on most recent without scrolling all the way down again. This is so frustrating and it needs to stop please.

title: Needs work, but does the job
review:
this is still not designed form the 10.5” iPad pro. everything looks a little fuzzy and just makes the viewing experience chunky and annoying. it’s been 3 months... the Messenger app is updated, but not this. 

also, across iPhone and iPad, I’d like control over what goes in the bottom toolbar, and/or having the ability to let it disappear as i scroll so i don’t accidentally touch something in the bar (as i usually do by accident).

this is one of the reasons why i rarely use facebook... the app is not up to par as it should’ve . years ago it was perfect, but now it’s taken a nosedive.

title: It is overloaded.
review:
First more of an inquiry but my notification bar is the top left of my app....everyone I know with the same phone and update has theirs still at the bottom of the app....

And second...get rid off all this extra crap. I can't see there being people who actually requested for certain features like town hall (most towns have pages), qr barcode (there are app for that), jobs (we've got linkedin and indeed)....i get wanting to be that all in one app but some apps (like yours) just need to be what they are meant for....destroying our emotional system....that is all!

title: Messenger
review: I’ve been using Facebook for a while simply for gaming, but recently I’ve started using it for its actual use as a social media app. I would give it four or five stars if not for the fact that it will. Not. Stop. Nagging. You. About. Facebook. Messenger. As someone with a 12 GB phone and someone who literally has absolutely no use for Messenger, I really do not want to get the app. There should definitely be a Messenger feature in the app for those people who don’t have enough storage or won’t use the app, because Facebook won’t stop bothering you until you download it.

title: Sad app
review: The latest updates make it so buggy I can’t even use it. A”Retry” to go back to notifications? Really? Can’t add PayPal as a payment option to boost my business page, plus myriad other constant frustrations. And now marketplace won’t show me individual items for sale, again asking me to retry and insinuating I don’t have an internet connection. C’mon Zuck, you can do better than this! If I have to go back to my old desktop to access FB, I’ll be on a lot less and I won’t be the only one. Now, can’t even access my business page as an admin! It’s a total disconnect. I’m disgusted.

title: Spread the Word
review: At the beginning of the Pandemic FB helped keep me focused. I started a group and crafted.  Then I started reading the Bible every night to my followers.  I didn’t know how long it would be before I was taken down. But I promised I would keep reading as long as I could get on. It’s been awhile now. I don’t know how many times we’ve read the Bible.  But I’ll keep reading and telling people how FB has helped me help others.

title: Horrible
review: I wish I can give this app NO STARS ! I’ve had my Facebook account for over 10 years and it was hacked and my email address was changed with no notification letting me know that any changes was being made and there is nothing else I could do to recover the account with all my memories from over the years. It was so easy for them to hack my account I’m starting to think it’s Facebook employees because Facebook wants me to send in a picture of my ID for what ? title: Facebook is ok I’m 16 and I use  Facebook more than Snapchat
review: Facebook, I can talk to other people socialize, Open my shell be more out there talk about what other people think if I agree with them we can become friends, I can be closer to my grandparents I can be closer to my parents understand what kind of jokes they like… Facebook is a good way to socialize, my whole family loves Facebook… I rather be on Facebook then TikTok any day.
