I don't get way they had to change everything, it was working just fine. I use to be able to go through my news feed and see things that I hadn't seen, now I'm going through posts from last week. I don't care about those posts anymore, I just want to see what's going on now not last week. It's almost pointless to have on my phone now and take up space!!

Still having this issue. For a couple days there was the option to see most recent and then it went away. So now I’m seeing last weeks posts from friends that I have already seen. Kind of pointless now to even have the app since it’s like living in the past

title: Am I the only one??? Plz plz help
review:
Not sure why the heck my friend notifications are about working... it’s just pretty irritating, not knowing who sends me a request & whatnot..... I just deactivated and made an entirely new account bc my old one had been hacked. Butttttt.... when I decided to make a new account I could see there were some friend requests... but I couldn’t seen who it was from nor did I have the ability to accept or deny them bc ALL it would say was that it was unable to connect. I have been connected to WiFi. I have turned my WiFi off AND...... I have used hotspot (from someone else). Like what on earth?!?!?
Am I the only one?

title: Facebook Avatar?
review: It’s been about 3-4 weeks since Facebook avatars came out, and I STILL CAN’T MAKE ONE. I’ve never had an option too, I never got a “Try It” button on any of my friends’ avatars. I’ve just been wanting to make one since it came out, and it’s frustrating that everyone else can make one, but I can’t. I’ve kept my app up to date, and I’ve looked in every spot the avatar button is supposed to be in, and still no luck. Facebook, fix your issues before you come out with something new. It’s not fair that some people can do this, but others can’t.

title: Just keeps getting worse.
review: One of the poorest functioning apps. Nothing works in a way that makes sense. For example, I’ll get a notification that someone mentioned me, or replied to a comment. When I open notifications, it will show me the comment. But when I click on it, it doesn’t take me to the comment. So I can’t even reply unless I want to spend a few hours sifting through thousands of comments to find the one. It also constantly re sends notifications I already checked. Just to force me to open the app. Sometimes the “new” notification is weeks old. And when you try to scroll through, it nothing but propaganda, misinformation, and fake news.

title: Marketplace
review: Pathetic. I disabled auto updates in the past due to foolish actions by companies such as Facebook, yet they've fooled me once again. I read through the update and nothing monumental seemed to be happening (plus the app continued to bother me about updating) so I finally did. It immediately removed all Marketplace messages from Messenger, instead putting them in a subcategory of Marketplace. It also did away with read receipts for these said messages entirely. HOW can a bunch of app designers get together and think that is a good idea? Literally a 12 year old could use more common sense. No wonder this app has such a low rating. Absolutely disgusted

title: Backing Out (Supporting above negative review):
review:
This same thing, as above, has been happening to my phone, but also lost volume on serious and/or casual responses, timely news, chuckles regarding news, suggestions, responses and humor.  Due to necessity of having to reset my name and password just to read an item, and to access the next item, I have to sign up again with my name and password every single *+^~# time!

I now read everything else first before signing and ‘passwording’ each time.   So much time is wasted just to open PASSWORD, and then to find out it isn’t important, I have begun to not even try again and just pass.  Please stop your updating.
FedUpinSyracuse

title: Horrible
review:
Facebook is horrible. They control what you say, and what you do on there. If they don’t like what you say they block you for no reason. We have something called freedom of speech in America. And if you don’t like that we have a freedom of speech. Well they still take that away from you and block you. No matter if it’s agreeing with someone. They still block you. They swear it goes against their Community policy’s. But no it’s just they want to Control everything you say and do. Facebook careful you can and will be sued. For our first amendment right. You have no right to block someone’s first amendment. Shame on you. I hope it will come back on you 10 times fold. 
Of wait it will.

title: Resuming threads
review: It used to go straight to the comment that a person left after you on posts. Now if someone posted a comment after you in a group, on the same post, it doesn’t navigate there automatically anymore, it just lands you on the main page of the group itself. The only time it takes you straight to a comment on a post is if the person tags your name. Please fix this problem. I like being able to see what someone said after me on a post instead of trying to find the post again... like I said, it used to work fine, now it doesn’t work at all anymore

title: Awful app
review: If I could give negative stars, I would. Everything this app does is terrible. It freezes, locks me out, and when I ask it to send me a verification text message in order to get in because supposedly my password is always wrong, it claims the number it sent me is wrong. There are so many things wrong with this company to begin with, so I ultimately decided to cut ties. Now Facebook won’t let me. It makes deactivation so hard, along with everything else it claims it can do. Anyhow, if I could forewarn anyone to stay far far away from this crappy social platform that allows some of the most illegal and atrocious acts to file through...then I’ve done my job. Good riddance facebook!

title: App Won’t Stay Open
review: For a while now I have been having issues with the Facebook App. One issue is that videos do not play. When I would attempt to play a video on Facebook the video either stops or has no sound. It is horrible because I miss out on important videos from family. The other issue that I have with Facebook is that the app will abruptly close. It is very frustrating when you are looking at a page or my timeline and the app just closes. I have contacted Facebook for assistance and no response or fix. As a matter of fact when I contact them the app performs much worse than when I didn’t contact them. I have since deleted the app.

title: It’s listening
review:
The Facebook app listens the users conversations without notifying the user of the practice, to serve you targeted ads. The ads that are served can be a bit insensitive to the user. Example: We were having a PRIVATE (or so we thought) conversation about their family member suddenly passing away. That friend received a target ad for funeral homes in the very same week. This is never okay. The least you could do is:

1. By default users are opted-out 2. Warn users when you’re listening into their conversations, at the exact time you’re spying. Users have a right to know that you’re invading their conversations just to make more money for your investors. 

This company is sleezy af

title: Annoying Changes
review:
There are two changes that were recently made that I am finding very frustrating. 

1. When you click on a post with an image, its quickly cuts away and opens the image. This is similar to how it use to be but when youre finished viewing the image instead of scrolling off of it on to something else, you are forced to click off of it at the top left side of the screen with an arrow. Its so annoying. Dont give me a feature I enjoy that is convenient and the take it away. 

2. When I send something to someone in FB Messenger, instead of them just viewing it when clicked, it now goes into a separate window to pull up the page of the ones that posted it! Often times the page posted it several hours or days ago so its buried and not worth digging through the page for the content. 

Im not sure why they made these changes but it is only making me want to use FB less and less. Please fix them.

title: Unable to Approve Login Error
review: Last Thursday I got a Session Expired popup they automatically logged me out. Changed password to ensure I won’t get hacked. Get the same error again but this time I checked my email to see what location was that this “person” was trying to log in from and it was the same location as me. I went through trying to approve login through pictures from friends, that didn’t work. Tried approving login on the one and only device I use to log in with Facebook and still nothing. Are these updates somehow making this site/app unstable? If so that’s a big threat to everyone especially if they made their accounts years back.

title: Business
review: Since starting a business, I started a business Facebook page that is linked to my account. Over half of the time, I can’t like/share/comment as my business. Only myself. Also, when going back to review comments on the business page, to try to keep in touch with my customers, I can only see 3 of 17 comments... I’m losing customers because they think I am either ignoring them, or don’t care enough about my business to respond. When looking at other post, I can’t see over half of the comments because “most relevant” is selected, but I’m unable to change it. Facebook has become an absolute joke recently. Things need to be changed.

title: Clicking notification takes me to top of page instead of Post
review: I don’t like that when you tap on a notification from a page that you follow, it takes you to the top of the page instead of to the post that it notified you about. I don’t want to scroll through page info and pinned posts every time I click on a post notification. These are pages that I follow and have selected to be notified about, I am AWARE of their basic info and pinned posts already

title: Fake allyship
review: These fake allies are dismissive of my identity. Killed my account I've had for a decade because I won't use my dead name. Legal name changes are expensive and arduous. They won't respect my identity and meanwhile trolls with obviously fake names and pictures of cars and dead presidents have free reign. All my photos from the past ten years are just gone. I can't promote my art. I can't stay connected to friends in far away places. Can't keep up with friends art. All because they won't respect my chosen name that I've used for years. All June long there are rainbow flags, rainbow frames, all this stuff in support of Pride, but it's false allyship. Facebook is just another dishonest garbage place full of garbage people.

title: ALL THE ADS
review: Facebook updated and now literally every 2 posts is an advertisement. I repeatedly hide the ads to the point that I’ve now hid 80 different company’s from showing ads on my timeline and I still continue to see them constantly! I’m super annoyed by this. I have to see ads in every video I watch as it is. It’s already bad enough I have to have a separate app to see when someone messages me. I’ve hated that feature since it came out and I’ve deleted the app but it’s more annoying to see that I have a message the entire time I’m on Facebook than to just have the stupid, pointless app so I can see some useless message. The ads are out of control. I’m over it.

title: Do updates ever work?
review: Went o open my app and I immediately get a black screen and sent back to my home screen. Check for an update and there is one so I run thinking maybe that will fix it. I’m not always the best with staying up to date when updates are released. But I tried to open my app again after updating it and it’s the same thing. So what’s the point of this update? Is the logo going to change to another slightly different shade of blue or are things actually going to be fixed. It would be nice to be able to get on my app to check the growing number of notifications it’s telling me I have, but like I mentioned my app won’t open. Good job Facebook!

title: New update is slow on iPhone 7plus
review: I don’t know if others are having the same problem but when I click “see more comments” or whatever it says, it’s delayed like 7 seconds before it shows the comments. My posts/comments are taking a long time to load, could be my service but I doubt it as I have at least 3 of 4 bars at most times as I live in a city and 3 bar WiFi in my house. Bring the reacts back as well but I do like the new them overall. Fix the bugs, and I’ll give 4 stars, fix the bugs and change reacts back, 5 stars

title: Same problem, no permanent solution.
review: Facebook has so much potential, except for the fact that every 2 weeks there’s a new problem. This same problem has become a constant. I can not post any statuses. Comment on any friends or public posts. Send images on messenger. It always tells me to “try again” except it never works and it will be like this for days. Completely unacceptable. I love far from my closest friends and family because of university. Facebook is my favorite way to keep in touch with every one, so when I can’t do that for 3-5 days it’s extremely upsetting. Get it together Facebook. Fix it.

title: Not Interested in most these features!
review: It’s BEYOND irritating getting notifications that people are having watch parties. I could careless. Please stop notifying us, some of us have thousands of friends and it’s bothersome. Also, take away the poke feature!!! I get “poked” by so many fake accounts. It’s creepy. It’s like being in a mall and a complete stranger comes up and touches you. Group notifications, if I’ve turned off notifications why am I still getting notifications that there’s been a post. I don’t care. I can go look at them at my own free will. I don’t need red numbers sitting at the bottom of my screen. Stop the madness!!

title: Buggy
review: For weeks now I have not been able to view posts normally, either I get an error message that said posts can’t be displayed currently when my phone is connected to WiFi and every other app is working, or it’ll load about 5 posts, mostly ads, and then I reach the bottom and cannot load more, or just nothing shows up at all. I’ve updated my app twice to see if it needed to be reset, still the issue arises. I even deleted the Facebook app and reinstalled the entire thing, still doesn’t fix the issue. I’ll be deleting the app and using Facebook via a web browser for the next couple months, hopefully this gets fixed.

title: Security settings, profile/cover photo and more...
review: Alright, FB, a few things... I have to log in through safari more than occasionally because the app pops a connection error to settings and more. Also editing and choosing pics through viewing albums bugs out, freezes, or just doesn’t through the app. These weren’t an issue not that long ago. Holler at me when the fixes are through, and I will change my rating. This is a constructively critical review. Everything else functions as always, and it’s why we keep using it. We trust you with our circles, tribes, families, and friends. For that, props.

title: live photo doesn’t work anymore
review: When uploading a live photo, even thought I already selected the circle to enable the live photo feature, and after waited for the photo fully loaded, and tried to 3D touch the screen, it won’t work anymore. the previous live photo I uploaded a few months ago still works by 3D touch the screen and it will work. so I upload that very same live photo uploaded a few month ago, is not working now when trying to upload it as live photo now. the current uploaded live photo will show the circle on the lower right corner of the photo that it’s supposed to be an live photo but when 3D touch the photo it won’t work anymore.

title: Marketplace and Newsfeed Issues
review:
Way to continue to perform “regular” maintenance to better the experience...err if that means that the app becomes more and more useless. My news feed barely functions and almost always get stuck on 1-2 stories. I’m lucky if I can see more than 8 people’s post without the newsfeed glitching out.

Then there’s the marketplace. I’ve only sold 1 item EVER through the marketplace while getting absolutely bombarded with so many spam messages. How is it possible that so many people are supposedly interested but never respond?! 

How about creating a feature for sellers to report these spammers so that FB can either investigate them and potentially kick them off!!!

title: Same version but different
review: A friend of mine and I compared our Facebook apps and we were perplexed. We have the same phone, the same provider, and supposedly the same version of this app from you, however, their app has 6 buttons at the bottom, and mine only has 5.  The difference is, they have a button to their home page and the notification bell is in color. I want the 6th button please, I also wouldn’t mind having a color notification bell. MY main question was why is the same vet different on another person’s phone?

title: Home sales needs to have a more specific price range to choose from
review: Facebook, if your get to see this review, please make it so that if I’m searching in the marketplace for homes, I could choose specific price ranges for the homes. Nothing too crazy but if I wanted to see the homes for sale that are in between 100,000 and 300,000usd, so that I could. Now the choice is only between 0 dollars and 20,000. The only way to get specific is if it’s in between 0 usd and 20,000. What about the homes that are above 20,000. Please fix this issue. Otherwise so far it’s been a great app. Thank you!

title: Can’t See ALL Friends on Feed!!!
review: Why bother using Facebook when it’s supposed to be used as a platform for all friends and not just the “most-talked-to” people?! Just started my account to connect with family and friends and already sick of it! Ugh...Think I’ll give Twitter a try instead or Instagram since REAL CBS News shows FB has a lousy outdated firewall to stop ELECTION HACKING YET AGAIN. At least the “founder”, with a loan from a friend in college, made him rich and allowed the breach of thousands of fake accounts interfere in an important election or he wouldn’t have been brought in to testify that he screwed up by allowing it to happen. Bye Facebook with 2-faces! Outta here. Site seems it’s imploding all by itself.

title: Won’t load notifications
review: For the past month new notifications would take forever to load and usually older notifications that I had already seen will load as new. Now after the update, in the app I can’t see any new notifications. My app updated two days ago and I can’t see the individual notifications on the app. Only way for me to actually see what is going on is to look through my notification wall on my iphone home screen and click each individual Facebook notification to view it in the app.

title: Barely a working app anymore.
review: Facebook is absolutely trash now. It won’t load your posts. It doesn’t load other people’s posts. You’ll see the same posts, from the same people all day long with no updates no matter what you do to refresh the app. It’ll show you how many notifications that you’ve received throughout the day, but it won’t load the notifications once you open the app. It’s garbage and it’s really annoying seeing as how Facebook WAS how I kept my family, who doesn’t live around me, updated about my daughter. I’m really hoping it gets fixed soon or I’m just going to remove the app all together. Fix your crap Facebook. Get it together.

title: Marketplace glitch
review: I have updated my Facebook app and keep it updated regularly but for 4 days now my app keeps loading as I am trying to scroll. I’ve started using Craigslist and Letgo to sell my items for moving. So frustrating because it was easy to use before. I also do not like when I am in messenger and when I click a message for a marketplace sale to respond, it makes me click through Facebook (out of messenger) to reply or view the post. Overall though, the glitching and returning my scroll to the same section of “sponsored ads” without even allowing me to view a group (furniture, kids and baby etc) has led me to find other avenues to buy and sell.

title: Not As Good Anymore
review: I used to think it was so convenient to use this app from my phone but now I’m about to delete it. First of all tired of seeing ads for things I looked up on Google. Secondly because I looked (or tried to) look at articles under certain FB pages (Morris Chestnut, Nancy Grace, Little Things, etc.,) these annoying “you won! Or “congratulations!” come up and I can’t get them off or prevent them. I have reported these to FB but they keep happening and Apple can’t seem to help me with this problem (they keep saying contact FB). So I’ll probably delete it. Tired of all of the negative stuff on there anyways.

title: Logging in.
review: At this point in time I am not happy with Facebook.  I had a 3rd party put results of a test I did not take on my page and I went to delete it and report it.    I was asked/told FB was going to update my information so this wouldn’t happen again.   That’s all fine and good.  My problem is the place they took me wants to redo my password and for that to happen I have to remember my old one.    I don’t remember it and there is no place I can go on FB to redo it because it keeps kicking back to the page requesting the old one.   There is no option to redo the password thru email.    Also, because of this, my messenger is not working correctly either.    NOT A VERY HAPPY CUSTOMER

title: Improvement suggestions
review: This app allows users to select the FB account for login when multiple accounts are used on one tablet; however only three accounts are saved at a time for this quick login feature. App needs to be able to keep unlimited multiple logins. Facebook itself was created to engage users to share personal moments and increase the ability to connect with friends and family online; however information is dull and repetitive. Instagram & other social media outlets win the market here.

title: Hmmm
review: For those who said facebook doesn’t care about your privacy, it because you don’t know how to use it. It’s allow you to change the privacy on every post, unlike instagram, you either have to go public or privacy. It’s also great that you can also exclude specific people to not look at your photo, or include that one person you want to share with. So quit complaining and try to understand how to use it

title: Quirky app
review: My complaint started as a joke because I really don’t care about creating an avatar. But I have not been able to create a Facebook avatar since they first put out the app in 2020. I keep getting a message that says that my version of Facebook doesn’t support making the app and that I need to update the app. Of course my app is constantly updated and what makes this even more ridiculous is that if I log into one of my other accounts, using the same Facebook app I’m able to create an avatar.  And the lack of customer service is just outrageous to me.

title: NEW SOCIAL MEDIA Project
review:
As you read this review continue afterwards, to read more reviews. The majority of people who are writing reviews about the Facebook app are continuously talking about how bad the ads the glitches and the over whelming new improvements that are absolutely useless make it very unusable.

It’s at a time like this that you can tell that the developers have no means of fixing any of these problems and just continue to make Facebook worse and worse, until it is completely filled with ads/ and no one wants to use it, like how other social media sites of the past. Then they sell this one off make $$$ and have a new one ready to roll out that will replace it.

title: Needs some friendly user updates
review: I have several groups that I have set to receive all notifications. I can get a notification yet when I go to that group many times I see that that post was posted hours ago yet I just received the notification. Also please give us the option of viewing posts by most recent posts or most recent comments on a post. I want to view the most recent posts, not posts from yesterday which is what I see almost every time I go to my groups. Same goes for what's on my wall. Facebook, do you read these reviews??? If so please take into consideration several of these suggestions from these reviewers.

title: The fall of democracy
review: Social platforms, while providing an outlet for expressing our views and opinions, often have a narrative bias. Facebook, in particular, has been influencing others by presenting only "half of the story." I used to appreciate Facebook for its ability to connect me with cherished friends and share my thoughts. I have always respected others' viewpoints, even when I disagreed with them. However, recently, Facebook seems to be misleading the public by showing only a portion of the truth. This practice does not align with my understanding of what America stands for. Until Facebook revises its policy to be more inclusive and unbiased, I can only rate it one star.

title: Your October 2023 update
review: I m not sure what bugs you were trying to fix, that your app no longer works, I couldn’t open anything on Fb app yesterday, deleted app, rebooted iPhone and downloaded again. Was working last night, today, I tried to save a photo, it forced me to hide access to all photos through privacy settings, and I did, since then app doesn’t open. It just tries to get to links but not freezing up, just gets me phone icons screen. And no, I didn’t download last 2 iPhone versions and have no plans doing it yet. Do we need app which doesn’t work? So what kind of bugs did you fix?

title: Abysmal App Performance
review: The FB app for iOS is atrocious. The notifications come through a very small amount of the time, even though they’re turned on. I open the app, go to the dating tab as an example, and the page doesn’t load. Close the open and reopen with the same results. Many times it’s the same result back to back to back. Absurd. It’s a simple software fix and they have people they pay to do. Clearly those people don’t monitor the app because the notifications and the not loading have been on multiple devices with multiple iOS updates. The only constant variable, is the app.

title: Data Breach Support doesn’t care to fix.
review: I am so sick of this app and their supports inability to answer any questions. I deactivated my account and NEVER received an email about it. I logged back into my account with the INCORRECT EMAIL ADDRESS and it still let me through. It has claimed to send me 2FA text messages that I have never received. Their entire database AND PLATFORM is compromised, yet you don’t see anyone bothering to fix it.

title: Please fix!
review: When watching reels you no longer can pause or scrub through the video. Please fix this. I often pause these videos to show something to someone or to retain that information more. I don’t want to have to re watch a 2 minute video when I was looking to replay a 4 second section of it. Please put pause and scrub feature back please thank you

title: Wild
review:
Shortly before the namesake was purchased I had a notification that all of my things from FB were being removed and my account was against community standards. 

My wife made me the page and gave an Alias of pop culture that she knew I enjoyed. 
I never once pretended to be anyone. I did however have images of myself and family treating the app as a keepsake almost with the occasional meme. 
The company swore it was woke but apparently that only applies to pop culture in the same demographic. With an 80 hour work week I missed the mark and lost all of the photos of my family, my account and my desire to respect such a blatantly terrible company.

title: Market place and fake accounts.
review: Market place is a joke any person trying to sell still will eventually be banned because a fake account will try to scam you when they don’t get what they want they report you and you get banned. Facebook is supporting the fake accounts because other wise theyed say oh this review was made by a fake account but they don’t then instead ban the sellers account. I’ve never seen an app with so many “don’t accept a friend request from me my account was hacked” posts in my life. They need to get it under control for the people that use Facebook and for the market place, they are losing customers.

title: My final view on Facebook
review: I never write reviews on any apps. But now I need to do it. Facebook is really misunderstanding to be honest. I do understand the limits and regulations for the users but it was really hard to just for instance change my own name and when I even sent my official original passport, surprisingly my app was completely blocked for 60 days or smth. And now I am unable to use the app. There are some other situation that had happened as well. But that’s now my rating for this app honestly. I have no idea what should I do if I need a Facebook app for my needs to use it.

title: Facebook Social Lousy
review: I honestly am telling you that old Facebook is the best more than Meta…I hate Meta is very strictly, don’t care and lousy service…You won’t help me nothing because I’m deaf person, so I can’t type your comment and my english comment is not good without the phone, not fair to me… I prefer to call you in person on VP and communication with you smooth easily without write review… Your Meta Company is sooo stupid because it already changed from old FB to Meta… Why do you that to us? title: Data Privacy Concerns
review: While I understand that much of the content I post publicly enters the public domain, I have concerns that Facebook and other meta brands are not doing enough to protect my privacy. In fact, i believe meta provides our information to other companies, advertisers, google, etc. If you just google your name you’ll find all kinds of factoids about you that may have originated from Facebook. In fact, Facebook says on their privacy policy that they do provide user data to partners. And while they have guidelines for how user data can be used, I don’t believe they have the reach or authority to actually enforce said guidelines.

title: Data privacy issues
review:
I deleted Facebook because it is too sneaky about how it collects, uses and sells my data. Also, way too many ads, even after adjusting the settings. Facebook is spending too much time and resources against companies that are doing better than them, when they should be improving their outdated unappealing clunky social media platform. 

I had a phone conversation with someone about a topic I had never talked about before … I had never searched for it on the internet, never thought of it before that phone conversation… guess what type of ads popped up in my Facebook newsfeed that day?

title: Worst social media platform available
review: This is probably the worst social media app available. The only people who would consider using it are just too old to figure out other platforms. All of its desperate attempts to stay relevant have failed miserably leaving it worse and worse with every update. At this point it is unusable and honestly embarrassing to be caught using. I will be deactivating my account and deleting the app because I am so disgusted with the political manipulation the ceo has personally taken part in to force out its major competition. If he wasn’t such a pathetic excuse for a man I might consider keeping it. Too bad.

title: Facebook tricks you into using it.
review: Facebook fellas like a trap. I had my about since 2009, and I loved it. It's the original social network, but like most first editions, it's outdated, and it can't get away from that. The only way Facebook had been able to keep my attention is with cheap attention grabs and exploitation is my emotions. For some reason all I hear about on Facebook is death, and things to buy. Oh, my friend died? Can't delete Facebook now, gotta send those care reacts. Gotta keep my account activated because otherwise how will I connect with my community? The answer? Delete Facebook and start being nice to your neighbors. Just do it.

title: Community Standards Notification
review: I reported a profile that was using my fathers photos and there was not violation found but when I clicked on the notification it’s now making me do all these steps to reset MY password and check accounts that I have followed or people I have friended and when it’s all done it says something went wrong and makes me repeat everything and now I can’t log in to my own account! Poor management of fake accounts and then giving actual human accounts the round about to log in to their account. I can’t log in! Help please

title: Zuckerberg is a fascist!
review: This app has been declining for years now.. and with new information coming out about the failed TikTok purchase and political agenda of its CEO I now see why Facebook never deleted outright lies and misinformation from certain political posts and people. Yet another billionaire throwing a tantrum. It’s disgusting and embarrassing. And it’s ever growing “New improved” features only make things slower or more difficult to actually use. Social Media is nothing more than a way to spread agendas of its corporate investors. And the entire FREE SPEECH rhetoric is tired and played out. Speech on Social Media hasn’t been free in years. Unless your ideologies match its owner.

title: Add turn Comments off button

I don’t like facebook’s in-your-face approach and how they decide what you get to see, even if you’re following or supposedly getting notifications from a particular group, friend or business. I got so fed up with it that I had my account removed and have thoroughly enjoyed not being on it. However, there is a group I joined for some help with animals and, the only way to get access to most of their stuff, is through their facebook group. So, here I am again but don’t plan to do anything else with it except for this group.

review: Marketplace used to be great but now it is full of scammers, especially the vehicle section. I’m seeing more scam ads than I am legitimate ones, and it’s so easy to tell which ads are fake they’ll only have 1 or 2 pictures of the car and it will look really nice, with a very low price, when you go to the sellers profile you see the same ad posted 50 different times so that there ad will get shown to more fb users/potential buyers, and it seems they don’t care about trying to fix this problem because it’s been like this for awhile now…

I go to make a post in a selling group I’ve joined and I am suddenly told my account is disabled?? I’ve had this account for a long time. I can’t think of any reason why that would happen. Furthermore is it not enough to verify my email and phone number? They want a VIDEO of my FACE? I don’t even have my face connected to this account in any way. I didn’t do a video but I did upload a photo and now I have to wait. This app is so sketchy and if you don’t absolutely need it, get rid of it right now.

title: Junk app

I have restart my phone because the app had made my battery gone not respond at all. I deleted it 3 time and reinstalled it, just to have it do the same thing . You would think Facebook would have a trust worthy app.  But guess they are more focused on changing it every few months then having something that work. I not like most , I don’t live on Facebook, only got it for family. But sending text works just fine with me, and it doesn’t mess my phone up.

review: For the most part Facebook is alright. Except for the algorithm. It’s all screwed up. I keep seeing the same posts from 5days, 3days, or even weeks ago. They used to have a “recents” tab where I would just click on and be able to see some of my friend’s latest posts, but not all of them. But now with the latest update they’ve taken that tab away. So now every time I go onto Facebook all I am seeing is posts I’ve already seen more than a few days ago. So annoying and makes me not want to use the app anymore. Please fix.

title: Facebook videos won't keep playing/ loading after watching the first clip.
review: (Example) you are scrolling through FB and you see a video in your feed you want to watch. Everything loads up and the video I clicked on will start playing. (Usually I scroll down from the video I was watching and it will keep loading up videos for me to watch). So the problem here is that the videos are no longer loading and showing up. I'll try to scroll down and it will take me back to the top without loading another video.

review: I randomly decided to make a new account the other day with just basic information about myself, because I don’t trust “big tech” with anymore than that. A couple hours later, after just looking some people up, I received an email from Facebook notifying me that my account had been disabled due to “violating ‘Community Standards’”. So I requested a review of this decision. In that process Facebook asked me to enter my phone number for “identity verification”. And sure enough, right after providing my number, the next message I got was “After further review, you’re good to continue using the site.”

title: I can’t post pics!! Please fix this!! Urgent!!
review: I am in several pet group pages on Facebook where it’s vital for me to post photos in certain cases. When I try to comment on a photo and upload a photo through the camera button, it does not allow me the option to access my camera roll to choose the photos I want to upload. It only allows me to post old photos I previously uploaded, not new ones from my camera roll.  I never had this issue before the update. Please fix this!!

title: App freezes when I click to read comments
review:
I have many issues with Facebook and their intrusive data collection methods.  I continue to use it because it allows me to keep in contact with friends who live far away.  

However, with the latest update (to fix crashing and loading issues) the app now crashes and comments do not load at all.  When I click to read comments the app freezes.  If I wait long enough (several minutes), the comments might load or the page will refresh and the comments I was looking to read are no longer on my feed.  

I miss the days when the feed was simply all the posts from my friends in the order they were posted!  I despise that Facebook decides what I should see and what I shouldn’t see. 

I can no longer use the app.  I now have to use a browser on my phone and iPad to use Facebook.  

Fix the darn problems Facebook. Otherwise, people will find another platform to use!!!

title: Lost years of baby photos, photos of my late grandma, wedding photos and more
review: Facebook recently flagged a video as going against community standards. I can’t even load the video to see if I was hacked or if they randomly decided a video I posted was “not okay”. There is no way to contact anyone, my account is disabled until they decide or it expires…my heart is broken as I had photos of my children, my wedding, and my recently deceased grandmother that I will not be able to get anywhere else. I have had a Facebook for nearly 15 years and have never had this problem. I imagine it has to do with the recent company changes…

Facebook has become very toxic! Their algorithm pins people against each other! No wonder there’s more hate and division, and sometimes because of how the algorithm pins you against some people you get blocked for 7 or 30 days for just freely expressing your spicy opinion!
It’s time we the people did something about ending this tyrannical monopoly… in democracies there supposed to be no kings, so why are we letting Facebook be our king while we are the driving machine to its success and prosperity, the money Facebook makes is from all of us, so it’s time to start creating alternatives to end this monopoly once and for all!!

Looked and noticed its happening to hundreds.. and scammers are taking advantage (or causing it in the first place) to pose as customer support to naive consumers. Where they then ask for money or personal information for “help”. What a joke.

I’ll confirm my ID and it will provide me with a link to sign in and finish recovering my account just to ask for my ID again. I just wish I could call or chat with a Facebook representative but customer service is nonexistent for the company. I don’t even want to get back into my Facebook anymore.

Censorship abounds on this app. There is no freedom of speech. As of today, Facebook has announced that they will limit the reach of all posts from users who repeatedly share "misinformation" flagged by "fact-checking" partners, hand-picked by the social media platform.

title: Events

So I made a new account and now it won’t let me log in. As a service member these apps are sometimes the only way I can contact my family. Highly upset that this is happening. review: I’ve used Facebook at least ten years, Extremely loyal! I shared pictures of my life, and my childrens. title: Same issue as others...notifications
review:
Just as others have stated, my notifications for groups do not bring me to the post. UPDATE 8/15

title: Draconian, Unfair, and Arbitrary
review: I have been blocked from posting 3 times in the last 3 months, all for responses that allegedly violate “community standards” despite the fact that the posts I was responding to were actual offensive content.  Meanwhile I’d try reporting pages or even groups that feature racist, gay-hating, or graphically violent content, and I’d get a response claiming that very blatant violations of “community standards” are somehow not violations.  Facebook’s rules are a joke and it’s standards are an insult.  So far as I can tell there is literally zero human presence or involvement whatsoever in any policy enforcement, meaning it is completely impossible to fight back against an unfair block, or arbitrary refusal to get rid of actual problem elements.

title: Endless bugs
review: The current version of the app won’t load posts on any group pages unless I disconnect from WiFi then close and restart the app while using cellular data. It also sometimes won’t load comments. At least this version shows comments on posts where comments were sorted as “most relevant” as opposed to having to switch to “all comments” to see them like in a previous version. Every update they release seems to include some annoying new bug. They sometimes also include annoying new features but it’s the endless bugs that caused me to take the time to write this review. The bugs are starting to make the app unusable.

title: Downhill spiral
review: Every new update seems to operate worse than it’s predecessor.  Last few updates when I refresh the newsfeed it comes up with “Posts could not be loaded” and a refresh button, but the only way to get my newsfeed back is to force close the app.  Also I’ve been blocked from the Facebook Marketplace for over a year.  I posted free kittens that I found in my back yard, got blocked for “selling live animals” and cannot get a human response when trying to appeal and get unblocked. I can’t write a post along with a video I want to share ON THE APP because only the text comes up. The video doesn’t come along with it when I want to share a written post, to sum things up.

review:

It is mentioned that people who misuses the memorialized status reporting feature will be punished with the penalty of perjury. However, how can anyone be located if sign in is not even required on this form?

review:
It used to be that you could scroll back for days on your notifications.  Now you can only go back a very, very short time I really miss not being able to go back as far as I want to. Life is busy!

review:
App crashes every time I go to open it after the most recent update. Also, I'm sick of all the pointless updates every few weeks just to reset the crummy reviews. review:

title: In-app sounds play as system alerts
review:
In-app sounds (for example, after refreshing newsfeed by swiping down), ignore the general volume setting, and instead play as system alerts. If that’s not a noob mistake, please fix it anyway. 

When a user turns general volume to zero, while leaving system alerts at an audible level, this should silence in-app sounds, yet allow important alert sounds like calls, notifications, etc. 

The issue has persisted through multiple updates. I ran the available update while writing this review and just confirmed the issue persists. Silent mode is OFF, general volume is zero, “ringtones and alert volume” is at MAX, and “change with buttons” is OFF. In-app sounds should be silenced, per the general volume being at zero. 

Also can we talk about why a global tech giant can’t hire decent coders?

title: Dark mode
review:
Almost any app today takes advantage of the iOS dark mode feature, yet Facebook has not. When is this going to be a thing? Second, stop moving functions around in the app. It seems like every new update, the buttons at the bottom keep changing. I finally get used to what each button does and next update its something different. 

The UI overall has been the same for years. Surely there is some ground breaking ideas to come through and maybe change up the design a little bit. Also I’d like to see my friends posts today, not when they wrote them 4 days ago.

title: No new backgrounds for status posts
review: I’ve been waiting for over a month for the update and still NOTHING! I’ve been on Facebook for 12 years and you’d think I’d get the same options everyone else has. I can’t even get help for this issue because there’s no help option for it. So disappointing. I stay on because I have family overseas as well as throughout the US, and this is how we keep in touch, but that’s all that’s keeping me from deleting my account. There are other issues, but this one irritates me the most. I hope someone reads these comments because things need to change.

title: So disappointed....
review:
When I first got the app and created my page for my music, everything was great. I could actually view my page and know exactly what was where and what was going on....However that is not the case now.
Instead of actually letting you see your own page, it takes you to this field down disaster of a mess that helps nothing. I hate it and it sickens me to no end to have to use it instead of the old way.
I’m all for bettering apps and such, but Facebook, this was not a good change and I want the old style back!

title: Continuous Issues w/FB
review: This stuff gets old fast when issues keep popping up on my wall or via the newsfeed. Unable to view my photos, get an error when editing my comment, and uploading “my story” that never completely uploads just tells me there’s no story. It becomes a nuisance when there’s always issues, bugs, people hacking accounts etc. Facebook needs to up their game security and do whatever it takes to minimize most issues that are becoming too common and happening too often. It’s our private stuff that we choose to share we should feel protected and at ease

title: Awful. Every update makes it worse
review: Facebook continues their quest to make Facebook as difficult to use as possible.  They keep burying regularly used features further and further into menus and replacing them with more and more garbage that they want to stick in your face instead.  It used to take two taps to get into my favorite groups.  Now it takes no fewer than five taps to get into them and that’s if I can even find them around all the garbage they keep putting in their app.  I am just about done with Facebook altogether and will go back to a normal life where I actually talk to people in person instead of this ever more narcissistic garbage that they keep pushing.

title: Facebook makes me inefficient
review: I don’t like it that the watching of a video causes me to see another video following it....a video not of my choosing.  Facebook has tried to figure out my ethnic origin....none of your business.  My friends are not posting as much.  Political, lying crap comes my way, especially after some bad news for this president.  Too many ads!  I would like to be able to say, “This is from a friend of mine.  I enjoyed reading it the first time but it wastes my time to keep strolling past it.”   That’s what Facebook is doing....wasting my time.

title: App crashes 8 times in 12 minutes
review: Since the knee update my iOS app keeps crashing. This morning was the most ridiculous literally as soon as I would click it, it would pop open a white screen and then crash and take me back to my home screen. For a solid 3 minutes it was a like a game we played where it would “look like” it was opening and just shoot back to the home screen. Very annoying since most of my business is ran through fb. I’d just like to see this bug fixed! Otherwise it’s a great tool

title: Not loving the new update
review: I use facebook for my small business utilizing the schedule posts feature however now it has become difficult to see all the posts scheduled. Prior to this update some aspects of the scheduling feature could have been better (such as being unable to edit the scheduled posts until they are actually posted). Although I can use the business Facebook app however I am having the same complications with that.

title: I cant share/post a status??
review:
For TWO MONTHS. I have been trying to figure out what is going on.  Every single time I post a status, or share a status, it keeps saying “ we will let you know when posted” and it never ever posts.  I’m getting really sick of it.  Every time I submit a ticket for it, I get the same thank you response and NOTHING GETS FIXED. I can only share/post a status from my PC NOT THE APP.  So that is how you know it’s an APP situation.  I’ve had Facebook for years and years.  Now with all of your stupid updates, it doesn’t seem to work anymore.  
I’ve seen many others complaining about the same thing but I just don’t quite see you guys fixing it.

title: Marketplace problems
review: Facebook has been getting worse with every update. I used to have the Facebook marketplace icon and then one update it disappeared completely, not even in the side menu. When I search the marketplace and click on it, my Facebook app crashes. I do not understand and it’s quite irritating. Both my mom and my girlfriend have the same phone and they both have it. I was a frequent user of the marketplace and was absolutely in love with it. If it could be fixed I would be so grateful. Please reach back out, Thank you.

title: Notifications
review: For some reason the last week I have had to delete and reinstall the app multiple times because it’s not giving me all of my notifications when I go to check but then the badges on my phone still show I have them and the only way to get them to show in my notifications list is reinstalling the app. I’m getting very frustrated that not only can I no longer ignore a notification that I’ve seen, I actually have to press every single one, but that they aren’t showing. If this wasn’t such a huge way for me to keep in touch with people I’d be getting rid of it.

title: News Feed won’t refresh
review: For over a week now, my News Feed won’t refresh. All I see are the same 10 posts, that were posted last week. I don’t see any of the pages I follow, or 99% of my friends’ posts. Even the people and pages I’ve marked See First aren’t showing up. Same thing when I try to refresh using Most Recent. I’ve done everything to try to get it working again. Checked my settings, forced closed the app, uninstalled and reinstalled, restarted my phone, nothing helps. I’ve reported the problem every day for a week, and still nothing. No reply from support, or even any kind of acknowledgement of the problem. This is garbage.

title: Only seeing top posts. Really annoying.
review: Here recently it has only been letting me see top posts instead of recent posts. I am missing out on things friends and family post because it’s only showing top posts. In my feed I only see stuff that was posted days even weeks ago even when I have it on most recent. On Facebook groups I can only see top posts when I really need to see recent things to see what is going on in my community. I’m tired of it and something needs to be fixed where we can choose our settings on if we want to see recent or top posts not be made only see top posts. I’m close to being done with Facebook.

title: Not convenient or worth it
review:
I occasionally like to look at Facebook to see what people are saying. The problem is that it is just that an occasion. I don’t need an app which will target ads, take up storage space and overall just make my life harder for an occasional check in.
You may ask why I don’t just use safari or google and go to the website. I can’t. I attempted to login six times and it didn’t work on any of them. Continuously saying I needed to login first after all my login info was properly typed. This is practically a marketing tool for their app because I can find dozens of other reviews reporting similar issues and it is not getting solved.

title: The quality of Version 204.0 has gone south
review:
I have never written a review for the Facebook app, but recently its quality has drawn my attention enough to point out issues that I noticed in Version 204.0.

When one tries to click on an image, many times a mosaic would show up. At times, when tapping on an image, one will see a very low-quality version of the image. If you tap on it later, a high-res will then appear. Sometimes when one is viewing a post the app will become unresponsive to touch events. The other way to get out of the issue is to kill the app and restart.

They should do more software quality testing before pushing an app to the App Store.

title: Notifications are ridiculous
review: I don't need a notification whenever a friend updates their status, adds a photo, or any of the other crap this app blows up over. I really really wish there were more options for which notifications I get because I am so tired of poking through 10-15 notifications an hour about things I couldn’t care less about. Groups in marketplace posting things I’m not interested in for sale, continuously getting notifications I changed my settings to NOT give me notifications about, and now it’s telling me I have a new message that I definitely don’t have. (No notifications from messenger, just Facebook.) 🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬

title: Notification icon but no new notifications
review:
For a while my all will show I have for example 18 new notifications. I click to open and nothing new. 
I tried removing the app, logging off, restart my phone, still the same. Showing I have new and nothing. It’s really annoying, and the notifications will stay lit and not remove even if after i turn off notifications from a post. I have to “hide notifications” to no longer see it light up. 
All this money you guys have and the app has been more difficult by each update. 

Groups notifications not working that I admin in, pending post will sit there for hours since I can’t see them.

title: Crashes when uploading photos
review: Since the last update, whenever I try to upload a photo to either my page or to a friend's, after I select the image and click to post, the app shuts down and brings me to the home page on my iPhone 6S. I am on the most recent versions of both IOS and Facebook. I am way below the storage threshold on the phone and I have very few apps running in the background. Also, I'm seeing less than a quarter of my friends' posts since the update the days ago and I cannot change the newsfeed order to most recent. Please address these issues.

title: Love the app but....
review: As a social media app that revolves around posting pictures and videos along with status updates the media side is very bad. When scrolling through albums some pictures never even appear. When youre watching an interesting video the video suddenly freezes and presents a loading circle. Moving the icon that allows you to go forward or backwards in the video doesn't fix the issue, as a matter of fact if you try to move the icon before the buffering starts the video freezes at the exact same spot. I'm sure this could be a simple fix, which makes it all more the worse that it keeps happening.

title: Bug alert!
review: I know you have to do updates to keep things running smoothly but sometimes it does the opposite... it’s getting really frustrating since the last update where it doesn’t always show the caption on a post or a picture when you click on it. I mean the caption is still there if you go looking for the post directly on the profile page... but just clicking on a post you’re tagged in from notifications you can’t see what someone wrote in the post that they tagged you in! Just annoying.

title: Disappearing notifications!
review: I am so beyond having my notifications disappear after I open them. They just go away and I cannot get to them again after that. Fix this! This app used to be so good until that started happening, and no update has fixed it. I get A LOT of notifications from groups I’m in, and it’s frustrating not being able to find them after I open them, to reply later. The only way they stay is if I turn off all other notifications and don’t have any coming in. That’s the only time any of my notifications don’t disappear, which is frustrating because I WANT to see all notifications, opened or unopened. Fix it!

title: EDITING MULTIPLE PHOTOS
review:
I love Facebook but before the update I could edit pics without it closing out of the photos. Now Everytime I want to edit a picture (if I'm posting multiple at a time) I have to keep clicking back in the post everytime I want to add someone or crop it. It's very annoying and is taking me double the time. 

Also could Facebook please stop tagging my own face in my own pictures? I'm pretty sure my friends and family know what I look like so I don't need to be tagged in the pictures that I AM POSTING. 

Please fix these problems asap. If I could I would but since I can't I hope you read this. Thanks.

title: Great way to feel connected!
review: I really like the fact that I can still simply pick up my phone and connect with my grandson in basic training. We always texted each other before he went to BMT. Through Sandboxx, I can  write a lot or a little, and send a picture without gathering writing materials or finding a stamp. I can fire off a note from the grocery store parking lot or while I am watching some show we enjoyed together.

title: Recent updates causing issues
review:
The two most recent updates have caused some significant issues to my everyday Facebook activity.
I am unable to view albums on multiple pages that I check almost daily. 
Also, when playing videos I am no longer able to reach the menu that allows me to pause or scrub through the video. When I tap on the picture, it now brings the post on which the video originated. Just full screen of the typed portion of the post and nothing else. The pause/play/scrub through/TRT menu is completely missing from videos now. 
Please fix!

title: Comment Collapse Glitch
review:
A former update had a glitch that caused long comments to collapse unexpectedly after hitting "see more." Updates seemed to fix the problem, but with the newest version, the problem is back. I cannot read comments that are long enough to require you to expand the comment box unless I keep clicking "see more" and read a few words at a time between collapses. It has made the app unusable for me. 

Additionally, you can no longer copy parts of a friend's post (say an address or phone number) without copying the whole post, which could be quite long. I have to paste it into a notepad and then select the info I want. What a pain!!

title: No more "most recent"
review:
UPDATE: once again my “most recent” button is gone. I’m seeing stuff from last week mixed in with stuff from 5 mins ago. I use this all for current events and news so old crap is not helpful. Please give me back my “most recent” button!

I don't like to see updates jumbled and I used to use the most recent feature to only see new posts. Now that's gone and all I see are posts from over 6hrs ago and yesterday all out of order. Please give back the most recent button or make the time line chronological!

title: Constantly refreshes toward the top when reading a post
review:
It’s annoying that the my app refreshes and moves the post I was reading. It seems to scroll to the top and I’m constantly having to scroll down to find the post I was on only to have it move again. If I get distracted and then try to come back to my reading, the post gone and I’m back at the beginning. Even if I had selected the post.  

I use to be able to set my pad aside and come right back to what I was doing, leaving the app open but asleep. 

I’m using an iPad with current IOS.

title: Stop forcing users
review: There’s been a new development that i absolutely loath; my husband and myself have gone into our notifications to realize we were notified of a page we have never heard of before. Turns out, people are allowed to pay for advertising to clog our notifications and not just our newsfeed and messenger. Seriously? I understand that money is awesome, by why does everyone else have to sit through adds we don’t care about just to connect to familiars? Pro tip; most folks don’t like adds that even pertain to them. We just scroll right passed it. Not once have i seen an add and went “whoa i should really buy that” literally has an adverse effect.

title: Spam
review: First of all there are so many ads now. Every time I turn around it is one thing or another . Don’t get me started on the sex and porn. It’s everywhere. I got Facebook as a way to stay in touch with family and friends. It worked out fine for a while but it’s not safe anymore. Even though I changed my password regularly, don’t play games, don’t share posts I just lost my page that I had for years. They changed my name, my email and my password and photo. You don’t even warn me or go through the security. How can you let this happen?

title: Newsfeed
review: I use FB daily but miss a lot of not almost everything my friends post because I don’t have time to scroll through what FB thinks should be priority on my news feed I should have to dig in and switch temporarily over to most recent every time I get onto FB and even then it’s most recent by comments left. I don’t need to see things I’ve already seen in the past because it has more comments or a recent comment on it. I literally scroll a few inches down and give up.  Despite going on everyday I mostly use it to view videos now instead of keeping up with friends. For that I can use you tube which I’ve been heading to more and more.

title: Too Much
review: I don’t normally use Facebook, nor do I have any problems with it except for one. There are too many notifications! I want to know certain things, but I don’t need notifications for every time someone comments on some random picture or updated their status or something. It bothers me that those are all the things that use up my data or pop up on my phone in the middle of the day. Please limit the type of things that you are notifying us about

title: Biased propaganda machine!
review: Elon better buy this platform out too and fix it like he did with Twitter. The level of posts getting deleted for no other reason than they go against the main stream media narrative is disgusting. We’re trying to document a genocide over here so these innocent people aren’t dying in vain, and FB “community guidelines” apparently prohibit posting anything that regards one person inferior to the other SO WHY THEN DO POSTS ABOUT ISRAELIS TREATING PALESTINIANS AS INFERIOR GET TAKEN DOWN INSTEAD OF PROMOTED TO OPEN PEOPLES EYES SO THIS CAN COME TO AND END! This is happening in 2023 and it’s never going to stop if we can’t unanimously agree to resolve conflicts without any violence. We are human and capable of this!!!!!!!!!!!

title: Need an easier way to block posts we didn’t ask for
review:
I’m having trouble with a site called “Garden Answer” by Brittany Rose.
She is hacking the original “Garden Answer” with Laura and her husband, based in Oregon.
I was trying to block her, and stop seeing posts from her, and this morning, I’m greeted with, “Welcome to Garden Answer with Brittany Rose” I went so far as to try and shut down my phone (Power off) and it wouldn’t allow it! I went into the perpetual spinning clock, so I removed the app! 
There has to be an easier way, to block sites that we aren’t interested in? 🤷🏻‍♀️
PLEASE! 
Otherwise, I DO ENJOY Facebook! 
It allows me to interact with family and friends, and keep in touch! It’s a valuable resource, to all, and especially Seniors, that aren’t getting out as much as we are used to.
Thank you!

title: Manage
review: The app is supposed to make making changes easy for users on the go. The Featured section is hard to get into/not really working through this app on the iPad. Can’t Manage to get into the section to MANAGE the pinned posts. The iPhone app version works - yet the iPad app seems to be several updates/versions behind - doesn’t work. Being able to change and edit things on the iPad would be an energy boost.

title: Crashes all the time!
review: I was using the dating side of it to make friends and it apparently deleted it and now won’t let me restart it or open it! Also when I’m looking at the market place and I’m scrolling the squares become white and no info pictures nothing is shown except for blank posts. The adds have become out of hand as well constant harassment to click links and they make the buttons to make them disappear so tiny that you end up clicking on the add and it shows up even more! Facebook seems to be going down. I’m just waiting and hopping something better comes along.

title: Terrible experience
review: This platform and other social media platforms are a true cancer to society, more people would be better off without using social media. Tell the real people in your life to take your number like the old days, and if they don’t, leave them in the past. ALSO, FACEBOOK IS TRYING TO MAKE IT MORE DIFFICULT TO DELETE YOUR ACCOUNT, THIS CAN NO LONGER BE DONE IN THE MOBILE BROWSER. SCREW YOU, FACEBOOK. I hope this company fails and dies off, along with all the other social media platforms that use your time and attention against you, then sell it to advertisers. There’s a reason these companies make so much money while being free, YOU , THE CONSUMER, ARE THE PRODUCT.

title: Phone number verification
review: I can’t even verify my phone number and I tried too many times and it says that my account can be blocked for too many attempts I click on the button continue but it doesn’t load at all, I was banned from marketplace for no reason just for asking about car prices I don’t really get it honestly and I had to do another Facebook  Account and it doesn’t let me verify my phone number still, I can’t believe Facebook is no longer a useful platform this company is falling apart, it’s horrible it needs an update and they need to take care of this issues is annoying

title: Terrible
review: I don’t know why but my age was set to 2009 and it won’t let me in the marketplace so I tried to change it to my actual age and it kept not working so I looked out of my account and made a new one with a completely different email and everything ,and it would force me back to my old account? This happened about 10 times with different emails. Don’t ask why I have so many emails. I don’t know why Facebook would force u to stay in your old account , it’s just annoying and this is why nobody uses this dumb app anymore 🤦‍♂️

title: No means no
review: I can’t tell you how many times I have told Facebook I don’t want to see the enlargement adds or reported them for having straight up porn on them. I’ve also noticed that if I report or say I don’t want to see the add the more I see. The only thing I use Facebook for anymore is marketplace because if I want to see how my friends are doing I have to scroll through a million adds and politically charged posts that are recommended to me. This app is no longer for relationships and it’s disgusting. With the technology they have it shouldn’t be hard to fix but I don’t think they are looking to fix it.

title: Community Standards
review: Facebook/ Meta I think you should first give a warning before issuing a block in some ones account. To completely disable ones Facebook account is personally ridiculous. I guess there’s too many that can’t act their age and be responsible. Then while trying to resolve the matter is impossible do the fact that y’all don’t allow proper response from the user, you keeping just putting in the same page with out allowing access to the account at all. No way of contacting you you don’t reply to email. You should probably look into have better customer service

title: Everything about this app is wrong
review: I feel no freedom as a person to express the things that are necessary to express on this app because it is so heavily policed. People get kicked off Facebook and shadow banned for the most ludicrous reasons. For instance, Facebook tried to restrict me for referring to ONE famous cereal unaliver (you see how we have to word things now?) meanwhile ANOTHER famous cereal unaliver’s name was trending because a movie came out about them. Facebook/meta only cares about profits, not the people. Censoring words doesn’t stop those kinds of things from happening. Those things should be openly talked about so we can solve problems as a society.

title: Just not a good App
review: The Facebook app acts as an interface to the website Facebook, so therefore, it is quite difficult to review the Facebook app without reviewing Facebook the platform itself. Gone are the days of seeing interesting videos, articles, new stories, etc. on your Facebook feed. The videos are all fake pranks, or thinly veiled fetish videos, the articles are usually fake or untrustworthy, and it’s design is hideous. In my opinion there’s only two reasons to keep the Facebook app: to see when peoples birthdays are, and oh yeah, that’s the only reason to have it. Get yourself a calendar and save yourself some storage on your phone.

title: Why does this app connect to my home wifi
review: After watching a congressional hearing on why the social media app “TikTok” needs to be banned, it made me start to think. One of the old people asked “does the app connect to my home wifi and why? I don’t want it stealing my address to make a clone of me” and I saw how this app needed to connect to my home wifi too. Thank you for making me realize that Facebook and it’s associates are out to steal our data and turn us into lizard people. NO THANK YOU. I won’t be using this platform ever again cause I don’t want them connecting to my home wifi and stealing cloning/spying on me through my devices.

title: Sketchy social media
review: In 2018 it was confirmed that Facebook shared data with chinese electronic companies that have close relationship with China’s government. In an attempt to bring down Tiktok Mark has lobbied against them by trying instill fear into American citizens saying they sell data to China, all while THEY have been doing it. At the same time he and most of congress is going to profit if Tiktok is banned. Within the last few weeks congress members have bought or traded meta stocks in hopes of gaining money from said ban. Not only that, it has caused a domino effect in congress that could lead to a potential North Korean style Internet censorship. All before the next election.

title: Why would I use this app ever again?
review: My page has been hacked 4 times. 4. I don’t use Facebook very often. It’s only so family members that I don’t really know can tell me like happy birthday or share an old photo cause they still use this app. Honestly it’s outdated and boring. Im not a fan. Not to mention all of the sketchy stuff that the app promotes and does with peoples information. I’ve been tired of this app and the recent state of the would has made me see that it’s not worth feeling creeped out by one app on my phone any longer. Facebook shall lay down into the shallow grave that it deserves. And Mark Zuckerberg stop it. Get some help!

title: Mostly ads now
review: So I’m deleting this app AGAIN because about 90% of my home feed is ads and going to the friends feed shows me 1 ad for every 2 actual posts. Literally. I counted. I used this app to catch up with people I don’t communicate with often. I have no interest in being bombarded with garbage I don’t care about and didn’t ask for. And before Facebook responds with “you can tailor your ads!”, imagine this—I just don’t want an app that is a poorly concealed money grab. Like, I don’t mind a ad every once in a while. You gotta make money somehow, but the over-saturation is obnoxious and detracts user experience.

title: Random reordering of comments
review: Why do y’all randomly reorder comments? That makes no sense whatsoever. Normal threads can’t even be read comprehensively because you don’t know which order the comments were made. Just leave them in their original order! & why do I only get half of my notifications. I’ll scroll down my TL and see a post I’ve been tagged in but I never received the notification. Lastly, if I get a notification about someone replying to my comment, the notification should take me directly to the reply, I shouldn’t have to sift through the entire comment section to find my comment.

title: Update
review: It always says that I have an old version of Facebook it is it is for me to update when I go to update there’s no update but there’s features I can’t use and it will not let me update Facebook please get better. It’s so many things I can do. This is weird because I made another page using the same phone. I made another Facebook account and all those features are there but when I sign into my account account I had for 10+ years. I can’t use those features because it won’t allow me to update. Do I have to update on the laptop I don’t know I’ve been doing this for the past year.

title: Comments and other issues
review: So since the updates on this I can’t do anything I can’t view tools on professional settings I can’t view comments under certain videos I post on my timeline nor can I change my profile picture AT ALL and my personal page shows I’m on professional mode Facebook has yet to fix it. I can’t even go see my Reports submitted to Facebook on the app it say “retry again”!! I have deactivated the account and reactivated the account then I deleted the app and download the app again. And nothing has been fixed at all. At this point I am over Facebook. You need to fix this!!

title: New Update
review: The new update that recently came out is horrible. Please take Facebook back to how it use to be. My Facebook worked perfect, now after the update, I can’t edit posts. I don’t get any notifications when people tagged me in a post or commented on a post, but I get a message in Facebook Messenger about someone tagging me in a post. I don’t like this because then I no longer have the choice of reviewing the tag before I put it on my page, plus I can’t see what I’m being tagged in! This is very annoying and ridiculous. Please stop changing the simple things on Facebook. Go by the motto, “if it ain’t broke don’t fix it”!!

title: The buggiest version in a long time
review:
This latest version is one of the buggiest in a very long time. 
Likes don’t show up unless you refresh the post, comments don’t always post, comments don’t all load, even picking ALL COMMENTS, it will show the option to see older comments, but tapping does nothing. 
This version is the worst in years. 
And it seems that Facebook is trying to make their app update on the fly, with hidden background updates to certain aspects, mostly related to advertising. 
This version of the app needs to either be rolled back, or corrected without all the hidden updates.

title: Hacked kicked off no way to dispute
review: I’m on Facebook 15+ years. I wake up 20 days ago and apparently I’ve logged in from another location and the friend request I accepted I didn’t know them. I attempted to log in and boom - YOUVE POSTED SOMETHING AGAINST OUR STANDARD. I was sleeping. How hard is it to determine the IP address message wasn’t me? I get messages from time to time - “we don’t want to lose you”. Ok then I’ve clicked on Dipute decision and get nothing. I hate that they not only don’t care about my security but that they brag about kicking me off in the name of some security standards. I hope that they figure it out. If they don’t - I’m not sure it’s the worst thing.

title: Hacked
review:
My account just got hacked this morning and when I tried to delete the account the hacker had locked me out of my account so I tried to make a new one and call the support number to have the old account deleted. The official customer service number then had me download a “remote access app” and then proceed to give me the run around of 30 minutes. They sound like scammers quite honestly. With this and the over complicated process of just DELETING MY ACCOUNT has made me realize this app has gone way down hill, I’m done with Facebook. Deleted me new
Account and uninstalled the app. Recommend others do the same

title: Disabled account
review: A month ago my account was disabled for something I did not post. I have been writing in to many different help links as well as trying to dispute or try to get a exact reason why my account was disabled. I have photos of my children I have no longer access to, deceased grandparents photos and not to mention my business account that is all lost. There has been no further communication as to why or how to get my account back. It was something I did not post. This is so frustrating. After years of using Facebook I am unsure if I’ll go back. I can’t express how disappointed I am.

title: Deleted account for no reason
