title: Crashing & Saved items
review: Give the option to view the “posts” saved through the mobile app. Also, give us the option to view saved items by month in which they were saved. Don’t change the current “saved items” layout, but give us the filter option to search by month or specific date. I personally have numerous saved items and this would be quiet helpful when searching for a specific item. This app is also crashing sometimes.

title: Keeps crashing when browsing market
review:
wow, it’s been a really longtime since I last wrote a review... back then it was because my iphone 4 had issues, this time is with my iphone 8.

Basically, it’s alright for checking videos and friend posts for a few minutes. But if there are too many posts with videos, it’ll crash.

But the major issue I’ve encountered is while looking up stuff on facebook market or checking my saved items. The app simply crashes unexpectedly and sometimes it even gives me a black screen and spinning wheel. I am running the latest ios version 12.4.1 and the same for your app. 

UPDATE: I deleted it, rebooted, cleared cache, and reinstalled the app, but the error remains.

Removing and reinstalling it does not solve the issue, rebooting the phone only works temporarily and I have over 100gb free, so it’s not storage capacity related.

It’s pretty much just very annoying. Checking online, it seems a lot of people are having the same issue. please fix it.

title: Can’t view events or birthdays from side bar
review: For some reason when I try to click on the day’s birthdays or events nothing comes up. Completely blank. What the hell? This is annoying. I can’t easily view the events or wish my friends happy Birthday unless I go to the even page (which can sometimes be hard to find) or go to the friend’s page which I don’t have any other reason to do so... or I have to wait for the stupid notifications for those things.

And messanger is being all weird when I try to send a picture message to him, it says attachment unavailable. This attachment may have been removed or the person who shared it may not have permission to share it with you. It's only doing it to one person not anyone else he's not blocked I went through all of my settings nothing out of the ordinary. What is going on how do I fix it?

title: Notifications issues
review: For the last 2-3 months. When tapping on a notification, it no longer brings me to the comment or post I am being notified about. I can no longer see who comments, what they comment, or know where they comment. If this is an update I would like to delete it, is that possible? My husbands facebook updates by itself when he is in the middle of reading something on his news feed, it just goes to the top of his page on its own...Facebook has become very frustrating...

title: Scrolling through Pictures
review: I love Facebook and have always adapted to the updates easily, but with the newest update you can no longer scroll through one persons pictures (which stinks for boutique pages and others that are selling items). You have to click on each individual picture that you want to see and get out of it and click on another to see the next one or it takes you to a complete different picture from a complete different page that you weren’t looking at and didn’t want to see. NOT a good update and NOT user friendly.

title: I’m only rating this because of memes
review: So the app is pretty good in my opinion, but a really GREAT feature would be to write/share a post, but set it to a future date, so that it automatically posts on the date and/or time you set it to, without having to remember to do it (ex. February 15th is Annoy Squidward Day, and sometimes you find that meme, but it’s not on that day, so you could assign the post a specific date and/or time to post so you don’t have to worry about it later). Top notch idea that’s easy to make happen considering Tumblr had it. Just sayin’.

title: The app is great WHEN it works
review: For years this app has been fine.   For about a month or two now the performance has dwindled.   The app’s feed doesn’t update properly and it often doesn’t load completely.   So as you scroll along, eventually it just stops almost as though you’ve reached the end of Facebook.   However, it does it many times after only a minute of scrolling.   When using the newest posts feed, what is the newest at 5 pm is still the newest two hours later.   It needs some work.

title: Video playback issues
review: The app constantly makes you switch pages to continue a video or once switching pages to watch the video. It will also freeze and you will have to fast forward to a future point on the timeline and resume the video to bypass the glitch. Also, sometimes it will just say no connection when connection is fine and every other app or video player works correctly and won’t allow playback entirely. This is super frustrating please fix these bugs

title: Don’t do it
review:
We are all well aware of why the concept is a waste of time to begin with, but as far as this app goes...
Crashes constantly, when my phone is brand new, with tons of memory and no other apps on my ph have problems. It will crash in the middle of shares, comments or me checking my notifications. review: Every update makes Facebook as less satisfying app. This latest update causes it show I continually have 9+ notifications. No matter whether I've looked at all of them before. When I reopen the app, all notifications are back to being new. And they no longer show in order of newest at the top. This is the last for me, I think. I've been patient with the algorithm crap and all of the ways Facebook forces its agenda on us, but having to sort through all of my notifications to see comments, etc, every time - over and over - I hate Facebook now.

review: Not sure if it’s just me, since the recent update, but the app seems to crash every other video that I view. Leaving me wanting to finish but can’t because now I have to search for it thru my Refreshed news feed.  I also noticed that it does on occasion crash when I click on some links.  I usually don’t mind but it has happened enough times to where it gets really annoying, and I just don’t even open the app back up.  Please fix, I’m only on here for family and all the comments.

title: Updates = UGH!!!!!
review: Seems like every time there is an app update, something gets screwed up. Currently you’re not able to see the full set of photo folders on your own profile or anyone else’s (been that way for months now and still not fixed - you have to log in from a browser to see the folders), I’m lucky to see maybe 5-7 of my friends’ posts in my timeline now (even those marked see first).  My timeline is predominantly posts from pages I follow, advertisements, suggested pages, and friend suggestions. And they wonder why more and more people are leaving Facebook 🤔🤔

title: Finally downloaded- love it
review: Finally downloaded the app instead of going through safari on my phone. i really don’t know why i waited so long, because the app is very easy to use. and there are more advantages to using the app rather than using safari, it works faster, and there is more i can do through the app, and everything is easier to see and navigate through. thank you! 5 stars 👍🏽

title: Suggestions on Featured Photos and more
review:
I have enjoyed the Facebook app quite thoroughly as it provides an ease of access to a frequented website. The app has crashed on me before, which only results in a minor annoyance; but it is an otherwise reliable application.

A few suggestions:

1) Sometimes there is a major event and it’s all I see on my news feed. If there were a way to, say, prevent all posts about topic X for a certain time (similar to “snoozing” a person for 30 days, but with topics instead of people), that would be wonderful!

2) Could there be more ability to edit the presentation of featured photos? I’ve tried using several photos and because of the space the photos occupy, key parts of the photo will get cut off. At the very least, allowing people to adjust the photo view (as you can do with the cover photo) would be wonderful!

title: FACEBOOK KEEPS CRASHING!
review: Have used Facebook for years.  Some of the changes are irritating, but can live with them.  However, lately my app keeps crashing right after opening....sometimes only seconds, sometimes a minute or two...but it always crashes.  Have tried every suggestion to fix it that I’ve found (several times) and nothing helps.  The app won’t stay open long enough now to report the problem on Facebook.  Frustrating!...Many other people are having this problem, it’s on Twitter and other sites.  Facebook help is so anemic and I haven’t had any real help solving this problem.  It’s become more trouble than it’s worth.

title: Good but could bee better
review:
Should allow for deletion & editing of comments left on status updates & photos but otherwise it's pretty good.
UPDATE: comments can bee edited & removed. That’s great. The issue now is that an entirely different app is required for messaging as well as all of the unwanted, unsolicited notifications about random videos & activities completely unrelated to me, events my friends are planning to attend or interested in attending & page events. Yes, you can opt out of these notifications...one by one. It’s all just so unnecessary & annoying.

title: Unnecessary ads
review: Every time I check out a story it gets interrupted by ads, it’s a lot annoying and seems to happen more frequently. Why is it happening? And is there any way I can stop it.  Also I keep getting these stupid ads that say I’ve won a phone or some crap and the only way to get rid of it is to exit Facebook and start the story again but then the stupid ads come back again....WHY???????

title: I’ve only had Facebook for a day
review: I downloaded Facebook yesterday because of the marketplace feature and I would love to use it. I download it and it won’t show up, I search it and I find the page but when I click to open it , it tells me it ran out or I don’t have permission for it . Like what. I looked it up on google to see if there was a way to get in it, but apparently I’m not the only one with this problem and plenty of people have sent in complaints about it and I guess there’s no such thing as customer support with Facebook so no ones problems have been solved and mine won’t be either . Thank you for wasting my time and effort

title: Want my old FB version back!
review: I used FB Groups several times a day when it was easy to find.  Now, since FB took the separate Group section away and blended into regular FB pages, I have to search everywhere for it.  This app has me so confused with all the page switching, etc..  I get lost and don’t know if I’m on a live feed, my timeline, your timeline, or whatever!  I hate this app now!  It makes my anxiety fly sky high, so I’ve just about stopped getting in FB at all!  Sometimes you can take things too far and ruin a good thing!  Please make it easier to use for some of us not so FB savvy people!

title: Needs improvements
review: Provide Bug Fixes for a lot of bugs. Allow some of the Facebook ++ tweaks in the Facebook app but don’t get to carried away. I think we should be able to modify Facebook app the way we want it but in a safe and fair way that is limited. The more features you add the better but then there will be more bugs so make sure you are ready. I am giving this app a 1 star until this dream happens.

title: Too much
review: I use Facebook regularly for personal and business. As someone else who manages a business, I can tell you that you're supposed to make using your service easy for your customer. When I download Facebook, I want the full feature. I don't want to download 2+ additional app just to message people. I have texting for that. Plus, I usually ignore messages now because I don't see them while I'm in Facebook. It's irritating that all these additional features keep getting added, other features get pushed out, and we have to download multiple apps just to use the basics.

title: Can’t View Old Notifications
review:
After the update to iOS 11, I had to update the Facebook app to get it to work on the new iOS. 

Now, I cannot view any old notifications. The page will not scroll down or load. You get only one page of notifications even if you have older notifications you haven’t checked yet. 

Please fix this issue. I want to view all of my notifications even ones I’ve seen already. I go back to post constantly for references, so being able to see old notifications is a must!

title: Too much content you didn’t ask for
review: On average, every 3 posts I actually want to see, from likes or follows, I get an ad or suggested post or suggested group or some garbage I don’t want. I spend most of my time on this app snoozing these suggestions; and I can’t turn off the feature. The ads I understand more, but they are unreasonably frequent. The combination of unwanted content and overabundance of ads has caused me to use the app less and less, as I am simply bombarded by garbage; in time I will end up deleting an unused app I used to find some value for.

title: Reporting Issues
review: With how much blatant spam, content theft, and otherwise toxic/fake profiles there are on this platform you would think Facebook would be proactive about reviewing suspected profiles and taking them down. This is rarely the case, in fact every profile I have ever reported has been allowed to stay up. These are accounts with CLEAR patterns of misuse. It would only take someone a matter of minutes to figure it out if Facebook actually had someone reviewing these cases. It's pretty discouraging knowing this platform does next to nothing to actually help keep us consumers safe and happy.

title: Terrible Fraud Support; NON-EXISTENT!!
review:
I initially got on FB to keep in touch w/ out-of-state family, which I loved. However, after 14yrs, my page got hijacked and my info was used to falsely try to get money from people, which law enforcement told me is a crime. However, getting in touch w/ FB to advise them of this, even though I had the person’s email and URL, was impossible; I just kept getting an auto-generated message saying, for security reasons, they couldn’t unlock the page. I tried other ways, but kept going in circles and could never get to an actual person for help.

Basically, FB was more concerned w/ protecting the hacker than offering any way to help the victim! It wouldn’t be so bad if I didn’t know of this happening to numerous other people.

I loved FB, but am unbelievably disturbed by the lack of concern on their end to engage w/ customers, which is ironic given their whole philosophy revolves around bringing people together.

Use at your own risk!

title: Facebook groups
review:
Not being able to change our private group back to public is bad for groups that are trying to bring in more members. Now we're stuck with around the same number with no fast way of expanding. I have a lot of complaints about this app which is my rating always remains a 1 star.

Another thing: It's bad enough that we're forced to have our videos upload into short video form in our Facebook groups, but now we can't even edit the caption on it. This a terribly run app. The only reason I'm still on this is because of my groups I have with friends.

title: Software abomination
review: This app is a privacy nightmare. They take so much information, more than any other social media platform. Advertising is horrible. My feed is clogged with ads all the time. The user interface is ridiculously overly complex (and I’m a web designer), and it changes almost every time I open the app, which makes navigating it very confusing. There is very little good I can say about this app. I reinstall it occasionally because it is the only place I am still connected to some people - if they were on other social media I would gladly uninstall and never think about it again.

title: What's with not being able to rewind videos?
review: I'm not sure when this started happening and I'm not sure if it was due to an update but, I can no longer click on video to rewind them. If I click on a video on my phone it pauses the video and I am completely unable to rewind videos in anyway. It bothers me that I can't rewind a video when it starts playing as soon as I scroll to it and I couldn't hear the first part cause the volume was down when it started

title: 80% satisfied
review: In my life, Facebook has for the most part done more good than harm in the 17 years since I have joined. Maybe because I've been on it for so long, I've come to understand how to set limits for myself. I struggle to do this with TikTok, for instance because it's so new. Facebook is familiar for me now and allows me to keep in touch with friends and family in different parts of the country. Like any social media though, it requires discretion.

title: Account got hacked
review: My account got hacked, they changed the email and phone number connected to the account. I can’t use any of FB’s account recovery methods because they ALL relay on know the email or phone number. Now this person has access to all my information and family group updates. I have no other recourse then to just report the account and hope that FB deletes the hacked account. Also there is no live reps to speak too so the irritation is just compounded going round and round in circles. DO NOT USE FB IF YOU VALUE YOUR PRIVACY. This has been going on for months now and I think the account is still active.

Just awful and not at all needed.

This app tries to pretend like it’s a free and open place for people to speak, but it censors us and then has the NERVE to try and make us pay to have our posts seen. title: Delete this App
review: This app tries so hard to be relevant, but instead it provides bias media coverage with a political fan base. It has numerous issues keeping people’s data safe. It’s full of ads. It’s not entertaining. It’s makes you download a completely different app if you want to communicate with other via messaging; which I honestly hate. I only kept this app as long as I did for the easy login feature on other websites, but google offers the same feature. I actually use my email daily, so I have no need for FB. I just deleted my account because I don’t feel FB has anything left to offer.

I had to go through my companies corporate office to put pressure on Meta to even look at it and fix. We sell ice cream and there’s literally nothing that’s ever been posted or commented by any of my customers or myself that even comes close to violating any rules. Garbage app and garbage company, if so many of my customers didn’t rely on our Facebook page for announcements from us I would have stopped using it a long time ago, but what are the alternatives? Help? Yeah, no thanks.

review: I recently posted a golf cart for sale on the Facebook marketplace. Posted 4 photos, a detailed description filled in all the blanks and shortly after I received a notice that I didn’t follow the community standards, so I can’t buy or sell on the marketplace. Still don’t know what I did that crossed their line or how to fix it.  A lack of specifics and no one to discuss this with from Facebook. CENSORSHIP CENSORSHIP CENSORSHIP.

Basically, the FB is saying there’s a new reply, but we’re not going to let you see it.

More than once since the most recent upgrade on my iPhone running iOS 13, I will be typing a comment when all of a sudden the box goes blank mid-typing and I’ll lose my text altogether.  It’s very annoying to the point where I will either stop trying to leave helpful comments, or need to type them in a better app so I can copy and paste them into the comment field.

title: Locking up iPhone
review: In the past month or so, while using FB app (with no other app running in background), my iPhone locks up so badly that my only recourse is to do a hard reset. Hitting the Home button does nothing. The screen goes black except for small spinning circle, and it will stay like that until I reset the phone. I let it go for 35 minutes one time just to see if it would correct itself. It doesn’t. I’m a bit worried about what is happening in the background while it’s locked up like that.

title: News feed needs work
review: The app now only gives one or two posts on your news feed. Then stops. If you go to most recent post it gives you posts from 3 or 4 days ago. So clogged up with ads that it’s almost impossible to see your friends posts. Rarely shows today’s posts but repeatedly shows the same 2 or three posts from past days. If you want to see your friends posts you actually have to go to their page. It used to tell you if they had new posts it no longer even does that. Used to enjoy Facebook but quickly losing interest because of these issues.

title: Too Much Advertising
review:
Every update seems to bring more ADs, sponsors, and “suggestions”. How about more friends & page feed, and less commercialism? 

Also, most notification within FB seem to take you to the group page rather than the direct notification or item that was posted. This is a real drag, trying to scan a page to see the post, because they are never chronological anymore, just random photos or links or posts from groups & pages followed. Seems every update or improvement brings more issues. Geesh!

title: Marketplace Crashes
review: I spend most of my Facebook time in Marketplace so I do not know if the problem that I’m having is systematic of the app or just Marketplace. Anyway, it crashes every few minutes and from what I’ve noticed it only seems to happen when scrolling. I’ve reset my iPad multiple times, I’ve force closed all other open apps, verified that I have plenty of free memory and I’ve even uninstalled the app completely and reinstalled. There have been several updates since this began. Surely I’m not the only one that has experienced this! It’s been going on for months now and has become very annoying!

So I made a new account, liked some things right away, and Facebook in its infinite wisdom decided that it was suspicious and locked my account. Then they don’t give any directions on what to do, just “give a photo so we can review it.” They’ve been reviewing it for ages and aren’t saying anything. Online sources say the picture has to include some data like birthday and stuff to confirm it. I didn’t know that so I sent in another picture of my face with nothing. Now I have no idea how to resolve that and I don’t want to make another email account to make another Facebook account. 😕

title: Facebook lacks in customer service help
review: I’ve been trying to get help to get back into my account since April and I’ve done everything possible to try and get the issue resolved. Facebook only replied with a generic reply sent to everyone who messages but there was never a follow through. This has happened multiple times. I need help, tried calling customer service apparently Facebook doesn’t have one only for marketing? Seriously? Would appreciate a response or a reach out from Facebook to resolve my problem as it’s also killing by business not being able to reply to my customers.

title: Not worth it anymore....
review: Facebook has become pointless. While I used to enjoy using it to keep in touch with friends,  now it has became an app for ads, constant product suggestions, a completely screwed up Newsfeed that never loads the most recent posts no matter how many time I choose it, posts that never load or posts of others that I can’t read, and it shows about three of my friends a week while filling the rest of my feed with 50 posts from the same page I liked in the past. Most of my friends have switched to Instagram. Guess it is time to finally make that switch.

title: Privacy defaults, post feed error
review: Post feed won’t load correctly occasionally, only a few at a time. Ruled out connectivity and my phone, so it must be the app. Had this problem a few times the last 6 months but it has gotten out of hand the past week. How about also notifying us when you update your privacy defaults? When I want people to see that I am available to talk, I would like a simply, manual, way to be online. But most of the time on Facebook, I am either reading or watching something and would like to not be bothered by people.

title: New profile
review: So the Facebook profile I had for 9 years got hacked and I tried to change the password to protect myself and my friends and I got completely locked out. I mean to the point that I cannot even find the profile at all. I lost every thing. All my pictures and all my memories just everything! I am completely heart broken. Now I have set up a new profile and I’m having to start completely over.... I have no marketplace no Facebook tv or videos on my search icons ...nothing... WTH is happening... it makes me not want to be on here at all. is anyone else experiencing these issues or is it just me.

review: I don’t know what’s wrong with Facebook the last couple of days. I got a pop up that said “Action Blocked” you have been temporarily blocked from doing this action, with the options to choose “This is a Mistake or “Ok”. I don’t even know why this happened? I didn’t do anything different than I usually do. I don’t post or saying anything offensive. So I had to wait 24 hours to use my account again. It worked fine for about 5 hours after the 24 hours was up, but now it just blocked me again? This is ridiculous and frustrating please fix this problem ASAP. I’m using an iPad if that helps at all.

My most loved app has become my most concerned app. I want an ad-free Facebook (if needed a paid version) with highest priority for our data privacy. I want to use Facebook 24/7 without any tension of illegal intrusion by any third party organisation.

It happens regardless of where I am. I’ve tried uninstalling it and reinstalling it. I’ve tried resetting my settings and everything. Works fine in the browser. As it is I’m ready to delete the Facebook app so my phone’s performance can be normal instead of dragged down by this app.

title: Malfunction in new update.
review: My app was working fine until the update yesterday. After the update the stories at the top on the news feed do not show up, reactions to posts do not show up unless I react to the post, when I click on my notification button nothing shows up. When I click on the 3-line link in the bottom right, the only things that come up are the link to my personal page and the settings links. I can’t see my saved pages, friends list, groups or anything of the sort. When I go to my page more than half of the information on my page is not visible.

title: Confusing priorities
review: Known racists are everywhere on this app and they spread all kinds of misinformation and the app allows them to create safe havens for other racists to interact with each other. However, when you make a negative comment towards a SPECIFIC individual the app’s algorithm will ban you immediately. It is quite confusing to me and that has made this app unworthy of my time and I hope you don’t waste your phone storage space on this hotbed of misinformation, hate speech and hypocrisy. Side note: This app tracks everything you look at and will shove ads down your throat non-stop. It is not worth it.

title: Let’s be honest here...
review: This app is aggravating. Not only must we deal with ad after ad after ad, buy we have to deal with advertising that Facebook thinks we want really bad, just because it heard someone speak of it. If I search my web browser for pizza, that’s where I want that search to end. I don’t need pizza advertising coming across my screen while I’m eating pizza. Facebook, you have forced me to delete your app yet again! Stay out of our business.

title: Display
review: I’ve been on Facebook for years and have observed the many changes and upgrades that’s came and gone. I applaud the creator(a) of this app regardless of the negative correlations that go along with the app. I would love for the app designers to import a dark mode feature on the app to go along with the dark mode feature in messenger and on the desktop version of Facebook. It would be greatly appreciated.

title: Selective Loading
review: The app only loads content about 2/3 of the time. Want to watch your friends stories? Forget about it. You get one or two but most never load. There is just a black screen that never loads anything. Try disconnecting your WiFi to only use cellular—same thing. Try turning off cellular and only using WiFi—same thing. Also, why can’t I just use this app to see my messages? FFS... two apps? Really? Maybe just limit functionality in the Facebook app, but it is ludicrous to not be able to view and respond with basic text on an app that already supports the same thing and so much more.

title: Checking group posts is a hassle
review: For some inexplicable reason any time there is a comment made to a post in a group the notification only goes to that group, not the actual post.  In smaller groups it’s easy enough to find the post, but in larger posts with hundreds of posts a day it’s extremely frustrating to sift through and find the post you were following/commenting on. I’m not sure when it changed to doing this, but it has made my experience worse.

title: Contour
review:
I have used Cox Cable for years without ANY problems ...but recently my power went out and somehow messed up my 
TV .  When the serviceman came, he said they were phasing out what I had and he had to change the cable boxes so I was forced to take Contour.  I despise it - I have had nothing but trouble with it and no one seems to know how to fix it.  I’m tired of paying “through the nose” for TV that I can’t watch. title: Inefficient for running business page
review: Everything on the app runs smoothly for me my only complaint is that the options for running the business page are really limited and it can be very inconvenient. There is no option to schedule posts ahead of time and you can’t make a post and then save it as a draft to share later. On my computer I always use the publishing tools but they’re not available on my phone and is annoying. Once these options become available on the app I will give it 5 stars :)

review: I enjoyed connecting to family and friends, groups with similar interests. But replying to ads which get your information and then resell it I know is responsible for finding my Email compromised on the Dark web. As well as the endless robocall scams. review: I just bought an iPad 7th generation. review: I understand that ads are necessary. In the videos that are being sponsored, but now, even when you tap a gif, to the right of it is a hidden ad, and when the gif itself opens beneath it the hidden ad opens a browserr and ad where it’s saying  “youre the winner”! and is basically spam. I didn’t want to be ungrateful for a platform that allowed us to share so much. But it’s way over the top now. These gif parasitic ads are ridiculous.

review: I’ve been using this app to run 4 different business accounts for some time now and as of yesterday I was unable to rotate my camera into landscape mode for live videos. Every other app on my phone allows me to rotate (and no I do not have orientation lock on) and Facebook even allows me to watch other videos horizontally and take pictures/videos horizontally to post on my story but I am only having issues with the live feature. title: App is broken
review:
Notifications aren’t clearing when you go into the app and press on the notification button. When you pull down to refresh it just spins. And typing this won’t wrap so it’s impossible to see the full post. Freezes, closes and news feed is out of date 

The app just isn't user friendly and crashes frequently. The news feed shows things 24 hrs old like it happened 2 minutes ago. Since you can't control this like you do from the computer it's frustrating to only get 5 recent statuses. What's the point?

title: Continue watching on Facebook watch
review: I don’t really enjoy this feature on Instagram for IGTV. I sure as heck don’t want to jump away from my Facebook feed to finish watching a video. I’m hard of hearing and I’ve gotta keep my phone on silent at work so there’s no point in me clicking on a video where the sound is gonna run and it takes away from smooth consistent scrolling. Also, a friend posted a video today and the “continue watching on watch” popped up and there was 2 seconds left in the video. It’s annoying and not helpful. Maybe consider giving people the option to turn the FBTV option off and on.

title: Private groups
review: I am so angry! I made a PRIVATE group for a surprise party. I didn’t know it was set up to be VISIBLE to anyone automatically! It should be automatically INVISIBLE to everyone not invited. review: It seems marketplace tends to get left out when updating everything else. review:
I used to be able to edit my timeline posts to most recent.   Now when I use the most recent choice on menu, I get a bit of everything but most of it is stuff I’ve never seen from 2-3 days ago, or even a week!

The settings for who do you see is useless as you have to pick from your list of friends/pages and prioritize that way.   I want to see what’s going on now and most recent from all of them.

title: Recent Update Removed Diabling In-App Sounds
review: In general, I’m quite happy with this app. However, I updated it this morning and have lost the ability to disable in-app sounds. I do not wish to hear them. Every time I toggle the setting to disable in-app sounds I am greeted with a message that states my settings have been updated. However, in-app sounds return each and every time. Please fix!

title: Bias
review: As much as I love Facebook I am increasingly getting tired of the bias against Republicans. The liberals can say and post the most racist, hateful, filthy language things and don’t get put in Facebook jail. Yet we can state the truth and get put in jail for the littlest things. I just got put in for agreeing with someone else’s post! Nothing racist, nor offensive, not hate, none of the things they have listed. Our Freedom of speech is being taken away.

title: Issues
review: I’m running a small business through a Facebook Group. For the last 3 days none of my customers can see my product posts or any photos within the group! I can post products and I can see the posts but no other group member can. I’ve reported the problem through Facebook twice and some of my members have reported it also! I’ve gotten no helpful response! This needs addressed! I would love to keep my business running through Facebook! Please fix it!

title: Bug needs fix
review: I just updated hoping it would fix the bug I have been experiencing, but no such luck. It involves viewing messages that are sent to your pages. You can’t click on the notification to view Because it goes nowhere. If you go to the page and then click on messages, the app crashes. Having to switch to another app to view them is not ideal. Please fix this bug. I manage several pages and this makes it more difficult.

review:

     Also I have no button to get to photos or albums anymore!

review:

Facebook needs to stop changing everything all the time. It’s so easy app but they trying to complicate it all the time.

title: Newsfeed doesn’t update.
review: My newsfeed will have the same posts for up to a week.  I not only get sick of seeing the same thing over and over but when people ask if I saw their post I never have even though I’m following them.  It’s a lot easier to have the app than to have to manually search for and log in to Facebook.  But most of the time there doesn’t seem to be much of a point to having the app since it doesn’t function properly.  At least we’re not charged to download it.  If that was the case I certainly wouldn’t.

title: It's okay
review: How about fixing some of the many bugs before introducing more features?  For example, why does the “In App Sounds” always mysteriously turn on in the mobile version when it is set to off?  Also- why, when I go into the edit a previously posted comment does the cursor jump around and parts of words get deleted when I am typing?  Why can’t I edit a previously written post that gets responded to from the “Alerts” on my phone?  I have to scroll up and click “post” to get to the original posting in order to do anything.

review: Seriously, how in heavens name do I trust my fitbit when it was charging across the room overnight but tracked my sleep? Plus people need to know that when you are unloading your groceries to check out that it is counting your arm moving as steps! The ten thousand steps people think they are taking is a farce! You do “so called” steps while you stand still ironing! I’m really disappointed. I only wear mine to remind me to move. My friends are killing themselves thinking they are actually walking 10,000 steps! How do you get away with overstating what this thing does!! Love how it tracks my sleep when it’s not even on, that one takes the cake!!!

title: If I didn’t need it, wouldn’t have it
review: I’ve never liked Facebook because it is too complicated and it takes way too long to create an account. Other social media sites it takes maybe five-ten minutes to start a new account, here it takes days. They even disabled my account for some reason even though I had just created it so now I can’t login and they’re keeping a photo of my personal ID (I can’t change my preferences since I can’t log in). The only reason I have a Facebook and have to go through all this trouble in starting it up is for my work, otherwise I never would’ve wanted one.

title: Multiple updates... same problem
review: Well once again I updated the Facebook app (which I knew I probably shouldn’t do since I had finally gotten it to show me what I wanted again for the most part). Once again Facebook screwed up my news feed and stopped showing me my “see first” selections. That was yesterday. Checked today and there was another update. Well I updated again since I was hoping they had put a patch in and of course... IT STILL DOESN’T WORK. Could you get rid of some of the people you are paying that flag things like Babylon bee as hate speech and start paying more ACTUAL TECH PEOPLE to work on this app!!  😡

title: Yo fix the issue with typing
review:
Hey, this is something I’ve noticed ONLY on Facebook when it comes to typing - autocorrect doesn’t work properly. Like it’ll correct your spelling, however if you press the space bar afterwards it doesn’t work. So once you start the new word it’s attached to the old one. This is not only when you misspell a word and it gets corrected for you, it happens other times concerning the space bar.  
And it also only happens on Facebook, no other social media app. It’s very annoying and makes me not want to use it. Please look into it.

title: Nearly nonexistent human support
review: While appealing a page name change (the appeal being denied isn’t the issue) I found the default message very rude for assuming someone who runs a page and several groups wouldn’t understand the community guidelines. I asked to speak to the person above the original message and was met with the exact same appeal denied response!! Absolutely disappointing. I had a similar experience when my account I’d had for NINE years was hacked, they wouldn’t do anything even though I could verify beyond any doubt it was my account. If I didn’t have to have a Facebook to talk to family I wouldn’t.

title: Downhill
review: Facebook has went downhill lately. I constantly get booted off (mobile and laptop). I cannot share posts, like posts, comment on most of them (sometimes not even my own). It will say things like, “cannot like this post” or “post failed because you have been temporarily blocked.” It’s several times a week. It all started couple months back because I uploaded to Facebook tornado pictures and I was reported over my tornado pictures as “inappropriate and against Facebook policy and standards.” But I see really inappropriate things on Facebook, and the ones who post it have no problems and not reported.

title: Video
review: Hey Facebook you guys have had a problem for a while with videos on the IPhone. It’s a little hard to describe. I will be looking at a video on my feed and as I scroll through this same video preview will show up on the next video previews in my feed, even though these videos are completely different. I still love the app, just wanted to let you guys know what’s going on.

title: Do you know what most recent means?
review: I am easy going and always open to change. The change to the most recent feature is a huge miss. It seems like someone had a partial idea and just patched it through without another review. Most recent does not show most recent. It is a worse version of “favorited” page, which is already pretty bad. Please allow me to see all of my friends posts in my news feed. There is no reason to count them out and decide who I should see based on interactions. I can’t interact with some friends because you’re not showing them to me. Get it together, or lose users.

title: Notification issues and no landscape mode.
review:
Fortunately, I haven’t had any issues in quite some time. The app has been working fine for me for a change. Hopefully it stays that way. But why is there no landscape mode? Please add that in. Four stars because there’s no landscape. Add that and I’ll give five.

UPDATE: There was an update about three days ago. Most things are working ok. But the poke feature isn’t. It’ll say I have pokes from people, when I click them to see them and poke back, it doesn’t work. It says there’s nothing found. I’d like to have my “poke wars” back.

Updates are so large that I have to connect my Iphone directly to my computer to accomplish them. Very, Very disgusted with the Facebook app!

title: Cannot view Notifications
review: I’ve had Facebook since 2009, but now it has come to the point of frustration trying to view my notifications. I’ve reported the problem 3 different times, but have not received a response or resolution. Does the “report a problem” option really work? I restarted the app, and it still does not allow me to scroll. I hope this problem is addressed soon.

title: Unbelievably bad in every way
review:
1) There is no way to show posts in chronological order, ever. Good luck ever knowing what any of your friends have posted besides the 3 people facebook has randomly decided to show you ever post from in completely random order.

review:

If you value your privacy, avoid Facebook like the plague. This app is the embodiment of data exploitation and privacy violations.

Remember the Cambridge Analytica scandal? That was just a glimpse into Facebook's insidious data harvesting practices. Their ad-targeting system relentlessly sells your information to advertisers, crafting eerily accurate profiles of your interests and vulnerabilities.

Despite claims of improved privacy controls, Facebook's core business thrives on your personal data. Seek alternative platforms that respect your privacy, and don't let Facebook's data dystopia become your reality.

review: Used to be such a wonderful platform. Connect with old friends for general communication. A great way to keep in touch, and in some ways still is. However, the more it has grown, the more it has degraded. Now it is riddled with spyware.  Ads constantly pop up if you happen to look at something one time. And all of the political crap pushed down your throat is unacceptable.  Not to mention censorship!  We can make up our own minds as educated people. Need to see all sides of issues and opinions. Don’t need a platform or algorithm attempting to influence my thoughts and decisions. Shameful what this platform has become.

title: CENCORSHIP CENTRAL
review: Facebook whether it always has been or was only recently hijacked is now nothing more than a full on propaganda machine. Expressions & ideas that do not conform with their unnerving globalist narrative are immediately suppressed or blocked from view. “Fact” checkers are nothing more than the modern day Orwellian “thought police”. Do yourself & your brain cells a favor & look for your news from a truly unbiased platform where you may speak out freely without being “punished” with time outs on certain features for daring to use your own mind. Give them a one star review to let them know Americans don’t comply with censorship.

title: Freedom is lost
review: Fb constantly fact checks things that a person believes to be true. Very biased. I should be able to decide what I put on my timeline and others should be able to decide if they believe it or not. I have already proven the site snopes to be wrong on their “fact checks”! So over someone deciding what is true and what I can post and putting people in fb jail? If I don’t want to see what someone posts I can hide those posts. Why put them in jail. Ridiculous! Censored for your protection! 🙄🙄 because we are all children who need protecting! I hope everyone switches to MeWe where you are not censored

title: Terrible social media
review: The censorship that Facebook has done and progressively continuous to do is a detriment to our freedom of speech. As a main source of communication and news for many people Facebook is now no longer just a regular company. They need to be held to a different standard and what they have done in 2020 is manipulate people’s thoughts and feelings through personal gain censorship and helping push certain agendas by deciding what information is true or not (when most of the time they are inaccurate and censoring true information). I am jumping ship to a different social media platform and so are millions of people daily!

title: Can’t scroll in groups. Have to go thru Notifications just to get to the Group timeline
review: The problem with not being able to scroll through my group’s posts is beyond annoying. I always have to go through Notifications from the group to get to the Timeline and even then I can only access a few posts. If I click on the group directly I can’t even make it past the announcements. There’s always something or other wrong with this app. SMH

title: I HATE BEING CENSORED
review:
Facebook has made it to the #1 WORST SOCIAL MEDIA PLATFORM!!!!!! I am so sick of being censored on what I can see and post. If I want to post something about Trump and this freaking ridiculous presidential election’s voting fraud then I should be able to post about it. 

Facebooks so called “fact checkers” can shove their opinions up their butts. Most of the time the posts they mark as false information has information that is true connected to it in the post itself or in the comments. 

Will no longer be using Facebook as one of my main social media platforms until something is done about their ridiculous standards!

title: Getting worse every day
review: I have watched Facebook deteriorate over the years. My newsfeed no longer displays my friends’ posts. When I noticed this change happening earlier, I could go to my groups to see just their posts, then those groups were removed. Now I may see a close friend’s post appear 1 or 2 days after they posted it! Meanwhile everything has some type of Facebook ribbon telling me how to interpret the information or worse it is removed before I can read it. I can think for myself & don’t need information or opinion censored. Deleting my account and using MeWe.

title: What the heck is going on?
review: Facebook’s app has just steadily gone downhill for a while now. First it’s the random refresh of the timeline which sends you straight to the top again when your in the middle of reading, or watching, something. Note it’s the Notification Center. It will say i have 5 notifications but when i click on the bell to see them it says i don’t have a single notification, it won’t even show OLD ones. It’s like ive never gotten a notification in my life on the so even though i know i have tons. This app needs to get its ducks in a row...

review: I am trying to sell my car and truck on Facebook marketplace, and every time I finish up the post, it disappears no matter how many I make. I try and go to see if it’s on “my listings” and nothing is there about them. I made a post about my truck the other day, and now I can’t even edit on the post and I’m also not getting anymore messages on it. Please try to fix this issue for marketplace. I’ve tried updating the app, updating my phone (iPhone 11 brand new) and deleting the app and re downloading it, and still does it.

title: I don’t understand
review: I like FB on my iPad but I don’t understand why the FB iPad app doesn’t have all the features that the iPhone app does. I can’t even get the personal avatar on my iPad app it’s irritating. Also, when you watch a video and you go to enlarge it the video starts completely over INSTEAD of continuing where you left of that’s also irritating.  I’m completely confused as to why this app is different in every way the looks and the features. PLEASE fix this I don’t want to have to grab my phone just to use my avatar to respond to a comment.

title: Usually fine, where’s the rest?
review: This app is usually working fine, but on occasion and even after updating the app, the home page may only load a few stories then nothing more. No spinning loading wheel, just a grey abyss with nothing else to show. I try to reload the page by hitting the home, or scrolling to the top, or closing and reopening the app and still the same thing. I know there must be more than 10 posts on my home feed, where are they?

title: Facebook stories problem
review: Please fix this problem even though not many people have it. I noticed Facebook stories option wasn’t available on Facebook or messanger. When I reinstalled the app Facebook stories feature would show up again but when I close the app or restart my phone and open the app again the story feature disappears. I have tried every single recommendation online to fix this problem but nothing helped. Please fix this

title: Adding useless BS...
review:
I don’t normally ever write reviews, but I absolutely can’t stand when developers add useless BS to the app that makes the experience worse. 

Remove the “Continue on watch” button that freezes my timeline videos 30 seconds in, just to redirect me to a new tab....FOR NO REASON. I watch a lot of videos with sound off in public areas, but when you hit the button sound goes full blast. Just absolute nonsensical BS, probably just to get people to use the “watch” tab. 

Remove this and I’ll change my review, why can’t people just keep things simple and fix what they already have....

title: Just use mobile browser
review: How can an app be updated this frequently and still be so useless? I have had consistent problems with pages, comments, posts, pictures, and anything else I might actually want to engage with on Facebook refusing to load in the app. The developers seem more concerned with constantly and pointlessness switching up the UI than actually addressing the issues in the app. Using Facebook on my phone’s web browser is faster and more effective by far- never a good sign for a mobile application.

title: Becomes more problems than its worth
review: The feed on my iPhone just stops after a few posts. All the time every day. I have tried EVERYTHING in every post on your site and it's still crap. I can't get it to work. I do a lot of work on Facebook, but I'm about ready to ditch it forever it is so frustrating. And having read the sites, there are so many people with the same issues. Why won't Facebook fix it? Is it that difficult? I'm running the newest version of Facebook on an iPhone XR. It used to work just fine then stopped after an update. Facebook, please fix this stupid bug!

title: Photos are stupid!!!! And make no sense!
review: You guys made getting to photos super hard and just doesn’t make sense. I don’t do reviews almost ever. But this is ridiculous!! You’ve basically ruined Instagram and Facebook!! Absolutely horrible! Make things easier. Especially photos!! Was trying to save some photos and do like a valentines things with my wife but it’s extremely confusing. Why?! You guys keep changing things on Instagram and Facebook and it’s making it worse for creatives and artists. But this won’t even make a difference cause it’s all about money and not about the community.

title: Old posts
review:
Why do I keep seeing the same posts at the top of my feed? Why can’t I be given the option to see the posts in chronological order? Often I cannot find a post that was at the top the day before. Instead, there are several old posts at the top AGAIN.  The post I want to see is buried or lost completely. It’s frustrating. 
Also, the ads. Why do they have to be imbedded in the videos? Don’t be so desperate to get our sales. It is way too annoying.

title: Post editing
review: Very disappointed that FB took away the option to add additional photos to a post already made. Often times I’ll make a post and over the course of the event, I’ll want to delete and add photos to the post. When I click edit post, that option is no longer available to delete a photo or scroll to the bottom to add more???? And I’m talking about posts with very few photos included, like 1-10. Very disappointed if this was a result of a recent update. Please fix this and give that option back.

title: Ads everywhere
review: Really hard to watch videos and scroll through feeds these days. They also do a very tricky thing and don't allow you to fast forwards through certain videos so you have to watch ads. Not sure if its just a bug but if that was on purpose then thats makes the company look horrible. I get having a few ads here and there. But when my feed is mostly ads and every video has 2-3 ads mixed in. It just becomes unpleasant. I know this review doesn't matter I'm just adding to the overwhelming amount of 1 stars so maybe they will actually make a change.

So first I get locked out from Facebook for a SAVED GIF and when I open my other account I can’t react or comment posts and neither send messages. Wow.

review:
I’ve been on Facebook for 10 years now and over those years it’s been slowly going downhill. In the beginning it was fun and enjoyable, now I can’t find my photos. Moving profile picture to the center of the page takes away from the cover photo so why even have one? 

Articles are hard to read because of all the pop up ads. I dislike if I google search something, my search shows up on Facebook. I could go on and on but why waste my time. I’m thinking about deleting my account because Facebook is no longer enjoyable.

review:

title: Unnecessary timeline refresh
review: I typically enjoy using the app but lately the app will automatically refresh my timeline without me even pressing anything to take back to the top of my news feed. I will literally be reading a story on my timeline and the app refreshes my feed by itself... IN THE MIDDLE OF ME LOOKING AT SOMETHING. It’s frustrating because of course when I go to find the article or story again it is freaking impossible. This was never an issue before but this has been going on for about a month and a half and I’m sick of it. Fix this issue please!

title: Call me crazy but...
review: I use Facebook quite often.  I have friends and family that I keep in contact with, and in doing so I prefer to see posts that happened more recently than 2 or three days ago.  I have always sorted by “most recent”, but since the latest update (and multiple phone reboots), the application only shows 3 posts when I sort by “most recent”.  It is very frustrating seeing posts that I have already seen days ago and no way for me to change it.  Allow me to sort by new, without restriction.

title: Business problems
review: How am I suppose to promote my fun businesses and make some $$ when I encounter problems ALL THE TIME!! Can’t change the name, can’t merge pages, can’t change the cover photo, can’t find the sell button when it should be on my page, both pages have different settings/options/look? even tho they’re the same style!! I’ve seen countless messages to Facebook with no answers or obvious attention to fix it. I’ve deleted the app, brought it back. It’s still messed up. Instagram is sounding more and more beneficial EVERYDAY!!

title: If it’s not one thing it’s another!
review: First off all these ads are ridiculous!!! Can’t watch anything without an ad interrupting it! Same when scrolling the market place. title: CONSTANTLY REFRESHES NEWSFEED
review: IF I COULD GIVE HALF A STAR I WOULD. Sometimes I’m in the middle of reading comments in a thread of a post I was interested in or maybe I was watching a video. Either way I am sick of this. I’ve even done this as a test and timed it. title: Latest update is just crazy
review:
I don’t know what is up with notifications but it is driving me crazy. I don’t need to click on each notification. If I have been on Facebook since I was notified, quit telling me I have notifications from an hour ago!  I see things in my newsfeed half the time and the notifications keep coming back. 

It’s buggy, I can’t seem to go from notification to post without churn or I never make it there. Really needs a smoother update.

title: Issues Since Last Update
review:
FIX THE MOST RECENT NEWSFEED! It is even worse after the last app update! 😡

•The app crashes constantly on my iPhone 7. 👎
•WHY can’t I view my newsfeed in “Most Recent” mode anymore? I select most recent and within a matter of seconds it switches back to showing me posts from 4 days ago. 👎
•When searching for a specific post within a group on mobile it pulls up posts containing those keywords, yet you cannot click the post to open them. So basically the group search function is pointless now. 👎
•I used to be able to select “Feeds” on my phone and then select a friend grouping a had set up called “All Friends.” That would allow me to see just posts from my friends not business page posts. When I click on Feeds now the only option is Most Recent. What happened to this feature? It was awesome! 😭

title: Terrible!
review:
Every time I update the app there are issues. The platform has erratic performance and regularly cannot refresh. Messenger has problems as well. (Notifications for non-existent messages). 
I have sent no less than 6 request/messages to the support group. Never a response on how to correct these issues. Generic preprogrammed “thanks for submitting “ messages are all that are returned. 

All these changes being pushed on users should be elections that could be made in settings. You have chosen to make Facebook irrelevant to users since restricting our control of our pages and info. 

Good luck staying viable as users will remove as much personal content before leaving. Thus; allowing FB to take its place in the digital world right next to MySpace. 

It makes one wonder if all along the point was to generate user data. Now that this has taken place, Your platforms and apps are no longer user friendly.

title: This is the first review I’ve written in my life.
review: I never write reviews, no matter what. If I don’t like the app I normally delete it, or I don’t spend much time on it. This is he first time I’ve gone out of my way to complain about a service. Whenever I’m on Facebook it says I have three notifications in messenger, so I go to check it and there’s nothing new. I was hoping just restarting the app would help but the notifications I see on Facebook remain. They have been there now for a good little while. If I have to re-install Facebook I’m just not going to do it. Not worth it. If I could rate this zero stars, I would.

title: Please fix this update ASAP 😫😭

review: The newest update makes my notifications disappear, even if I haven’t yet clicked on it. It’s frustrating because I cannot go back and look at previous notifications as they are no longer there... it makes searching for a comment to respond to more than trying... I have to go to someone’s news feed in hopes of finding the original post and scroll through. Much more time consuming. Hope the next update clears this up

title: Bug in marketplace, PLEASE fix
review:
When adding a new item to marketplace...
If you add photos, then edit any other text and then click on a photo while you are still editing the item, program will open the photo and allow you to scroll through any/all photos you have uploaded. HOWEVER, there is NO way to return to the listing. There should be an “x” or back button to get back out of photo viewing. But instead you have to close app AND you lose all the info from that new item.  This occurs on iPhone 6s with iOS 11.

title: Latest update has screwed up views
review: I cannot at all get the newsfeed sort to display correctly. No matter how many times I go in and set it or even reset it, it will not show things MOST RECENT. I see the same peoples posts over and over, no matter what view I choose. I continue to see a message notification on my phone when I know for a fact there are no new messages. title: Facebook update
review: Facebook has been crashing upon opening since early July.  Sometimes it’s working better than others. Today I can’t even make a post or read my feed at all. Yesterday it was fine. I am on an iPhone 7 with plenty of memory and good signal. Even crashes on Wi-Fi.   Don’t know why but it was like this a few days ago too and I thought it was over. Hope they fix this buggy update soon.  Meanwhile, it’s a good way to keep me from going on Facebook.

I took my phone to Verizon and they can’t find anything with my phone or the settings.  I hope Facebook fixes this soon.  Very unhappy. (This was 178). You can't get ahold of anyone. This is a bit ridiculous. Facebook needs to fix this!

title: Expanding Comments
review: On the last version, as well as this update, you are unable to expand comments to see more without it shortening itself almost immediately. My friends tend to write long thoughtful comments, and I’m constantly clicking “see more”, scrolling to read, scrolling back up to click “see more” again, scrolling to read another word or two before FB shortens the comment again. I shouldn’t have to do this 10+ times just to read something I feel is extremely thoughtful and engaging. It’s so frustrating. Please, fix this and push another update.

title: Create Preview before actually posting to wall
review:
It would be very useful and helpful to be able preview a post before you actually post to your wall. The preview would allow you to see how the post would actually appear with the pictures laid out in the actual way it would appear.  It would also be useful to have this preview for your profile picture, too.

The new “make a comment” on the pictures are a distraction and very ugly. Needs to be removed

title: Face the reality
review: I didn’t use face book until last year and I don’t know why people are saying, “They do it for the money.” Like what do you expect it’s a free app of course there’s going to be ads. Also if you say there’s no privacy why get the app it is for socializing and interacting with people around the world. title: Concerned
review:
It seems like, very recently, the ability to turn off location services for Facebook under Privacy >> location services in the iPhone settings has been removed. The Facebook app no longer shows up in the list of applications that can have location services managed.

To turn these off you have to go into the app to turn off location monitoring.

This is unacceptable. I don’t trust that, at the application level, Facebook will honor my request to not track me despite having turned off location services inside of the app.

I would rather have the ability to deny location services at the OS level inside of Settings >> privacy >> location services which it common for other apps that can potentially access location data.

I would encourage Apple, FWIW, to require Facebook to add the app setting back into the appropriate place under privacy and locations services.

We can expose these people, thats fine, most of the time it’s even easy. 

The issue is: when we report them YOU DO NOTHING!! We can spam report them, we can send dozens of people after them but unless they use the magic word of “I’m selling this dog/cat” we get the nice old “We reviewed this and it does not violate our community guildlines.”

Was it a dog? Yes. Was it saying it was available for rehoming? Yes. Isn’t the exchange of animals against your guildlines? YES! So why aren’t you removing them?!

If you don’t want to put any effort into actually making your platform safe, maybe don’t throw a curveball to the people trying too!

review: I uploaded some videos to Facebook to free up space on my phone and noticed it didn’t really give me anymore extra space. So I googled it. The app is more user friendly than the mobile version of the website but the space is totally worth the hassle.

title: Over rated

I have some selected some very important points from this..enough said..
    The Psychology of Fact-Checking
Fact-checkers aim to get closer to the truth, but their biases can shroud the very truth they seek
By Stephen J. Ceci, Wendy M. Williams on October 25, 2020 

“Researchers have studied the cascading cognitive effects of misinformation, and their findings are relevant to current concerns about fake news and to the limitations of fact-checking. Misinformation can be insidious; it can seep into the unconscious mind and influence beliefs and behaviors long after we have forgotten its source or the evidence invoked to support it.”

”Journalists and fact-checkers are human beings subject to the same psychological biases as everyone else—and their analyses of what constitute “facts” is affected by their own political and ideological values, resulting in what psychologists term selective perceptions.”

“Having each side’s fact-checkers checked by the other side’s fact-checkers could lead to an infinite regress toward an uncertain truth.”

It began with a little censorship in the name of stopping misinformation, then turned into a monster that is nothing more than an overbearing mother in law figure watching your every word and banning your account for spreading truth that it began redefining as hate speech. Let it burn and let it crash, it has no purpose but to collapse and pull its ugly head back to its third world communist countries where it needs to stay. Parler is where we are going, we will develop it into what Facebook should have stayed. A free speech social networking site.

title: #facebookdisabledme
review: You would think a $2 billion company would have some kind of support system. After 15 years of being on Facebook, never been in Facebook jail, or had any warnings about anything, my account was suddenly disabled yesterday with no email, no explanation, and no support in getting it back. 15 years of content and memories, gone. Just like that. I’m not the only one. There are hundreds of thousands of people out there in the same situation. Something needs to be done about this, this needs to be heard. Until then, Facebook is the worst company out there in my eyes.

title: Hypocritical keyboard warriors
review: The entire Facebook staff is racist, fascist, and hive minded children that think they can dictate their own facts with no proof discredit people who disagree with them and silence anything that contradicts them. They believe they are the court of law/public opinion and what they say must be taken as fact or your account risks being deactivated, deleted or shadow banned. Worst of all they will tag articles in post they don’t agree with even if they are found to be inaccurate just cause it’s from The NY Times, CNN, Vox, etc. all of which are know for not printing retractions or admitting their wrong even in the face of overwhelming evidence.

title: Horrible support when account is hacked.
review: My friend’s account was hacked three days ago, at least 20 people have reported her profile and messenger conversation as being hacked and Facebook has done nothing about it. The hacker has stolen money from my friend and people on her friends list. They are STILL accessing her account 3 days later and still trying to steal money from people. There is no support on how to shut down an account that is conning people out of money. The hacker changed all her information so she has no way to gain control back. It’s ridiculous that’s there’s no way to remedy this.

title: Since the last update, I can't scroll past yesterday evening
review: I loaded videos around 10pm last night, and it kept freezing and glitching. It finally loaded, but now I can't get past a certain thing in my feeds. It's like I just started fb. It just shows up as a grey block area. I tried refreshing the feed, using WiFi, using my data, uninstalling fb, and even checked it on a different type of device. My personal account I can scroll and see what I've posted. Just not on the main feed page. Please help.

title: Difficult to use
review: The app is hard to use and too complicated. Whenever I try to manage my posts, either one button is missing or I’m not sure what another one does. It also releases info about you that isn’t relevant and personal?? It’s too difficult to view posts, manage your profile, etc. App isn’t trustworthy and there’s just no use in using it anymore.. just switch to Instagram.

title: Some problems
review:
I always enjoyed using Facebook but lately the app refreshes too much just because I switched to another app or turned the screen off then I lose sight of what I was intending to share.

Also since I updated it today when I’m in the ‘my reactions’ the feature of touching the item and be redirected to the post which I reacted no longer works which is kinda frustating.

Please return the ability to reach the post you reacted to by simply touching it in the ‘my activities’ section the lack of this pisses me off.

review: I gotta be honest for a moment. Facebook is the only app that crashes when I use my phone. This is a billion dollar company that benefits off of selling personal info to scammers and yet we can’t even get a half decent app. The page never loads posts on the timeline and and constantly wipes off other post if there isn’t enough post to display on the timeline. Some days I wonder what would’ve happened if Tom never sold MySpace to Timberlake. I also wonder why Facebook tries to be Twitter, Snapchat and tumblr all at once. Especially since they bought Instagram and ruined that too.

title: Glitching
review: I love Facebook and all but I was trying to post like ten pictures and for some reason Facebook decided to post my whole camera roll so thank you for that 👍🏻 from my point of view it only said 10 but from my followers they saw everything! Luckily I don’t have any crazy things on my camera but I do have pictures of private documents like my banking info. Please fix this cause that seriously felt a little embarrassing. I tried reposting twice

review:
Do not like the automatic pictures appearing before everything else.  Do not like personal messages being “against community standards “ when they are 
PERSONAL messages.  Do not like 99% liberal ads.  Do not like being told items that I like are not to your liking. And if i am watching videos after videos, the sound would be good but then suddenly the sound would stop suppose at the 5th video. Then same, cancelling the video and start it again.

title: Hackers
review: I’m very upset that it took me not one but multiple days in order for me to get back into my Facebook because I was hacked, and the help center was no help. I even gave up and tried to create a new Facebook due to mine being temporarily locked, and I still wasn’t even able to do that. I wish there was more information to help other people when they get hacked and not only that, Facebook should have a number we can call when having these types of issues. If I could I would give this zero stars due to y’all’s lack of hacking information. Very disappointing!!

title: Downhill...
review: Same as with Messenger, this app has nosedived since the last update. First messenger won’t send my messages and the recipient doesn’t know I’ve replied, now Facebook itself isn’t working for me. Marketplace freezes consistently and in-app games (silly things like OMG and Nametests) crash and refuse to load. I’m bummed out because although there are alternate social media platforms and messaging apps, Facebook/Messenger is where my family and friends are and it’s impractical to change that. I hope the next update fixes all the problems this update has caused...

title: Disappointed
review: It’s been nothing but glitches. My phone won’t run the app more than 20 minutes before crashing. It won’t allow me to post a job for my business which I’m in desperate need to hire someone ASAP and my platform is usually facebook for hiring. The app is honestly horrible. Won’t let me post photos, won’t show me certain groups, won’t allow me to scroll through my profile without crashing. It’s just one big glitch and it’s honestly encouraging me to stop using facebook. Please fix this issue facebook.

title: Spyware
review: Developed to spy on you so they can sell your information  but we continue to use it until we get more accustomed to some new way of communicating via chat. There are plenty . Today I was mysteriously  boocjed from logging into my account which is the reasoning behind this review. title: Fix this.
review: First of all, still waiting on dark mode for Facebook on iOS. Messenger has dark mode. Also, I’m tired of the app itself constantly changing what’s on the bar on the bottom of the screen. I’d rather it stayed the way I originally had it which was home, friends, profile, notifications and settings. I don’t want to see what’s currently available to watch. I don’t care what my groups status is. How hard is it to keep the bar the way I had it? Fix it.

title: Marketplace Update
review: The most recent update has made marketplace basically useless. When I go to marketplace, I only see 8 listings and then it all posts from online stores. If I wanted to shop online stores I would. I’m looking for good deals on marketplace but I can’t even see listings anymore. The new update also makes it almost impossible to sell things too because of how hard it is to see listings. Unless someone is specifically looking for the wording you post your item as, no one will see it. Marketplace is the primary reason I have Facebook and now it’s useless! Two thumbs down!

title: Fb... you are the best.

Marketplace is such a useful feature and I love it. However, I hate how often it has been just closing out of the app entirely or freezing up and how long it takes to load a page or item. It’s like it has a mind of it’s own. Facebook really needs to get it together. The experience of utilizing the wonderful features could be so much more enjoyable. This app is turning out horrible!

I joined no groups,  made no postings other than saying I’m back on Facebook, and posted three completely appropriate pictures of myself.  Within three hours my account was disabled and a month later nothing has changed.  Tried to appeal in help center and got no response.  Even used my real name that matches my ID when I opened the account.  Facebook is horrible to deal with.

review: I use to love the Facebook app until it started to do these random updates and now it’s starting to bombard me with these random notifications of others that I didn’t ask to be notified about. I’ve tried to fix it within the settings but it won’t do anything because I still get them. We use to have the option of who we wanted to see more notifications from and who we didn’t wanna see. Please fix this Facebook!

It’s actually happened three times in the past few weeks. Does anyone else have this problem with a new phone, or the app in general??

Now you have to try to find it first. And in groups I cannot get the sort feature to stay with recent activity at the top. So posts are all out of order. I’m about to stop using the app because it’s just one thing after another of problems! Come on Facebook step up and fix this!!!!!

title: “Most Recent” isn’t recent at all...
review: For some reason I am not seeing anything recent  until about 3 posts down. So many that are from the previous day, 8 hours ago, and then finally an actual recent post. Instead of seeing most recent I see posts from the same 7 people who post the worst stuff who I never want to interact with. I used to not mind changing from popular posts to most recent to see what’s actually happening. PLEASE give us actual chronological order recent posts again.

title: Portrait view photos??? Still??
review: Was hoping today’s update would fix photos always opening in portrait mode, but no, that’s still happening and is a big PIA!! And I agree with others about notifications being wonky and not especially helpful anymore. I’d only like notifications about comments on my posts or in threads I’ve commented on or have asked to to follow. Don’t care about new posts in groups, notification I’ve already seen, items for sale in selling groups, etc. Keep it simple like it used to be.

title: Notifications
review: I am very tired of getting notifications that I have something new to view, yet it is the same thing over and over again that I view 8-12 hours ago. My notifications also keeps popping up and then disappearing as if to say, look!! You have something new to see...awww, wait, we lied. Just like other people, it gets old when I see things friends and family posted almost a week ago and then I fall behind on what they have posted most recently. Can we please go back to the days where the new stories are first?? That would be super.

title: Marketplace Bug
review: Recently there’s been a bug with the Marketplace. When I click on a category, a screen pops up that says “where are you located” with the options to either “turn on location services” or “not now”. I select “not now” and a map pops up anyway and forces me to designate my location. I do so and click “apply” and the whole thing starts all over. It’s an endless loop that I can’t get out of.

title: Frustrating
review: I just wish I didn’t have to use a desktop computer in order to keyword block posts. I shouldn’t be forced to see hateful religion and political posts. There should be a way to block all of that stuff and keep Facebook pleasant. I find myself more and more using Instagram and avoiding Facebook.  Not to mention right at the moment my marketplace does not work. I can use it to the browser but not through the app. It comes up with a blank screen.

title: Horrible
review: I have an iPhone X, for over a year now and this Facebook App has progressively gotten worse and worse. Initially the bugs were confined to freezing and double notifications on the same notice, but recently it has been crashing within seconds of me opening the App. I have tried removing the App and reinstalling it at least ten times, doing a Hard reset on my phone, and all of the phone and updates; but nothing has fixed the problem! This is such a drag, especially considering this a 428 Billion Dollar Company and they can’t come up with a Fix!?!?
