review: Just stop with all the freaking updates! The statement that is notated by the updates is laughable. It says you’re working hard to improve the app. With every update you do, things continually get worse. First, it was not being able to see most recent posts, then only showing about fifteen of them. The next problem I had was not getting notifications and now the stupid app continually crashes. I’ve tried all the common fixes and nothing works.  How about focusing on making an app that actually WORKS like it’s supposed to and quit trying to be “hip” and “edgy”.

But it’s still not working, this is crap I can’t even show support on the videos that I’ve been watching ㅠㅠ 😢

title: Security
review: Hackers are being able to hack accounts way too easily, even if passwords are being changed periodically. I just had my account hacked, and I tried to remove the account, however the hacker changed my email and password so now I am locked out of my own account, which is very frustrating. It’s not worth starting over with a new account. Better security measures should be happening; since people are using FB to purchase things, that means that their credit card info will be compromised as well.

review:
For about two weeks now, after countless updates, whenever I tap to view a picture, regardless of the orientation of my device, it ends up turned one way or the other. Even Fraking upside-down! Really? Is it that hard to tell your app to read device orientation and NOT CHANGE IT?

And it’s really nice to see Facebook making up for losing their profit from selling our data by giving me a “Sponsored” (read: ADVERTISEMENT) video. Not to mention getting ads in the middle of my videos just for funzies!

Getting less and less from an app that started out so nice...

title: Poor Newsfeed and Glitches
review: Since the last update, my newsfeed now only shows about 5 posts. Once I’ve scrolled through all 5, nothing else generates as if out of all of my friends, groups, and pages I follow don’t post anything at all. I have to continuously refresh my newsfeed to see 5 more posts. It also has been very glitchy; a post will show it has comments, but when I click to read, nothing shows up. A couple of hours later, I’ll see the post again and the comments will appear.

title: Issue with the new update
review: I’ve never really had any major problems with the app. But since this last update, every time I post a status, & then click on a notification for it (so & so liked your post) the post doesn’t show my actual post it just shows my name & the likes and comments. It wasn’t bothersome at first until today when I had posted two different posts/questions & I couldn’t tell who was commenting on which post.

title: Security
review: I'm giving a one star for the security. I changed my password & my email address to stop someone from getting into my account. I even removed their device. Somehow they were still able to get in. Which I for the life of me can't understand.... So I removed my device to see if I would still be able to get in. All I had to do was "forget password". I typed in my name. They remembered my device(even after I removed it) & I was able to change my password to get in. That's good for the actual account owner. Not so much for outsiders!! Something needs to be done about that.

title: This release seems way buggy
review:
I don’t know who screwed up what, but clicking on links for pages either results in a linked page or website reloading every 30 seconds or just downright crashes the app.  It’s practically unusable for following links unless you immediately hit “open on Safari.”

Also, get rid of the mid-roll video ads.  There is no reason we should be forced to watch what amounts to a commercial per minute for a short video, and your mid-roll ads often cut off content mid-sentence.  Very hostile user experience in my view, and completely kills the flow.

title: Cropping pictures
review: You guys need to bring that option back, to be able to crop the picture before it’s posted. And the option to be able to move or change the order of the pictures posted by holding the picture down. Loved those two features.

title: Great Experience For Entertainment
review: Let’s start off with that I joined Facebook in 2014 it was simple than it helps me connect with loads of different people that became my friends outside also and if you’re feeling bored many memes page are in Facebook it never fails to entertain u and u can connect with people easily recommended to every person who don’t use it....🔥🙏🏽

title: Issues with notifications.
review:
First, yes, I know I’m complaining about a free service and a free app. However, FB has made billions from us so I’m not feeling all that guilty right about now. 

Two issues I have with notifications lately: 
(1) FB is getting pretty loose with what it considers a valid reason for a notification. A friend I haven’t communicated with in 3 years and whose page I’ve literally never visited just posted a photo? Great, I don’t care. A band just announced a show literally 3 states away from me? Wow, great! 
(2) The badge app icon displays a number of notifications that isn’t valid. Let’s say it says there are 5. Then I open the app and there are really only 2. And those two are garbage anyway (see my first point). 

Both of these issues are caused by FB artificially inflating notification numbers in an attempt to trick users into opening the app more.

title: App Crashing on Launch
review:
Ever since the last my update, about 80% of the time when I launch the app it loads one post and when I scroll to see more posts I get a spinning load symbol for about 15 seconds and the app goes to a black screen and crashes. This is especially annoying because it is irregular, and occasionally does not crash. I have restarted the app, and restarted my phone to only minimal success. I love Facebook, but this crash is extremely irritating and I would love to see it get fixed. 
Thank you!

No exact explanation of exactly what is wrong so it could be fixed and no one to communicate with.

title: I’m over it

Done with the endless efforts to get me into their needless separate messenger app. Done with the constant barrage of unfiltered social vomit of people I used to respect. I’m just over it. title: FIX THIS PLEASE...

title: Why the recent changes?
review:

Tell us how to think and what we can and can’t say or think.  They consider our ideas and thinking hateful when they don’t agree and they ban and/or attempt to control us thru retributive actions and punishment.  They take privilege to attach their opinions to our personal and private posts and then they tell us facts are not facts.  They are an absolutely inhuman greedy Anti-American group hell bent on destroying American society and culture for their own gain.

title: Needs to update
review: Facebook is a great social media app to keep in touch with friends and family also a great place to let time pass by....Now I know am not the only one that is waiting on the dark mode I notice that it automatically sets the dark mode on it own but as soon as you exit the app it goes back to the light mode I think Facebook should fix that dark mode would be way better please Facebook update.

title: Facebook Rating
review: The app has been going downhill for a while. Now if you post certain words in any order the algorithm will automatically ban you. You then get no recourse. You’re banned. I wish there was a way to appeal the ban. Also, the app is always changing and it’s hard to find posts. It’s sad. China and big brother are happy. It’s also sad that they turned it into a political. Place for the left. I posted some right leaning stuff and it was removed and I was banned for thirty days. I like to use it for my friends, it just seems that my hands are always tied on what I post and say. Sad just sad

title: New update
review: I guess there was a new update of the layout on FB since Friday .. well every since this update I haven’t been able to share any post with a caption. I have to share it then go back and edit the post to make a caption. I’ve done a report on this like 4-5times already on the app itself and still nothing. Either fix it or change it back to the old layout. Almost everything update y’all try to do is trash af, leave well enough alone

title: Reality
review: I will Suggest someone has control or consult on the video because not everyone has the same feeling or maturity to post. I really enjoy this service which give me a lot of views on the world and understand how mighty wonders our Lord is  every time I have a chance to view my service it improved my understanding there is a lot of lessons we can learn and exchange every moment is so challenging sometimes I enjoy or disappoint

title: News feed
review:
This app is SO frustrating. Checked it 30” ago. Showed a post from 1&1/2 hours ago. Just reopened the app. Same post but (shocking) it’s now 2 hours ago. Most recent is a joke too. It’s obvious Facebook chooses what I see. I don’t mind the ads but good grief it’s too much other garbage. People have been reviewing this app for years and making the same complaints but it only gets worse. Not sure if it’s even worth it anymore...smh

Update: Not sure when I submitted this review. Could have been yesterday, last month, last year, or two years ago. NOTHING has changed!!!

title: Nothing but False Media and Lies
review: It is such a shame, that with the continued spread of false media on social media in today’s society, Facebook takes little to no action to combat it on their application. Posts by political leaders and others with intentionally misleading information and blatant lies about our country remain on display for all to be deceived by and conspiracy theory pages such as those dedicated to the controversial “QAnon” still remain intact on the application. This company needs to do better to combat false information on their pages, or I will not be using this app for much longer.

title: The app is a joke
review: I got logged out of my account and I didn’t remember my password. I clicked “forgot password” and it took me to a page to reset my password. Only problem is that I have to actually KNOW my password in order for it to let me reset it. It’s ridiculous. Also when I tried to click the option “try another way” it just goes back to the same page to log in. The Help Center on their website is a joke too and give zero help at all, not to mention the fact that there’s no way to get in contact with someone from tech support.

title: Censorship
review: Facebook used to be a fun place to go and interact with friends that I’d lost track of. I joined in 2006. I was annoyed when they screwed up my account in 09 for a name change but that was nothing compared to the censorship that is going on now. I was put on 24 hour restriction for trying to post 2 factual stories simply bc they didn’t align with their political views. What happened to free speech and public domain? If you sell a product as a public format, you cannot censor views, opinions, and facts you don’t like simply bc they aren’t yours. I’m tired of their overreach into people’s posts and not playing by their own rules.

title: No Help From Facebook
review: I’ve been locked out of my account for “security” reasons, (Facebook knows better than I do!) and they refuse to unlock my account or even try to help. There’s no way to email support, no way to get any help regarding my account. It’s a shame that a platform that brags about people “staying connected” isn’t even able to help people get back on their accounts. I didn’t even request them to lock my account, they had no reason to. I haven’t even been on Facebook for three years, does a person have to live on it so this doesn’t happen? What gives?

title: Awful and getting worse
review: I just updated a the latest FB app update yesterday. Now I cannot open my FB app at all on my iPad Pro. My iPad software is up to date. The app is fine in my iPhone (it updates automatically so I don’t know if it updated the app for sure). I uninstalled the app, restarted, all the usual steps and still cannot use it. I am not spending anymore time on this, so if FB wants to lose customers really fast, keep this up. In addition to all the censoring going on I keep hearing about from a few friends, and the examples they are telling me about, I am about ready to leave.

title: There is a bug
review: I cannot access the “see more” on posts. For example, if multiple people share the same post... you could click “see 3 more” and it would pop up everyone who shared the post. Another example... if I have a person set on “see first” and they post 10 posts. Facebook ops to show you 3-5 and then archives the rest into “see all”.... After the latest update, my iPhone 11 Pro Max just gives a blank screen once I press to see more. You need better beta testers. In the meantime, fix this issue or simply stop grouping/archiving the posts. Thanks.

title: The new app update crashed my app
review: I love FB so I have it the stars I feel it deserves but the app installed today has made it impossible to open the app. It crashes immediately on opening. Fix this please. Otherwise, I love having my photos in one place, being able to find and connect with friends and everything else about the app.

title: Too many needless restrictions
review: I had too many things in my newsfeed from pages I didn’t like anymore, so I unliked everything and decided to update the pages I liked. After liking a few pages, I was restricted from liking anymore. Restricting someone from liking things too quickly is absolutely stupid. I can’t think of a single reason there would be a security feature in place that would actually prevent a person from being able to like things at their own pace. What kind of person thought that up.... come on Facebook. Get real.

title: Notifications stopped working
review: For over a week now, I am not getting any notifications on most current app version, most current iOS version. I’ve gone through everything possible - uninstall/reinstall, soft reset, log out/log in, everything. All push notifications are turned on and nothing is muted. It seems impossible to get a response out of Facebook. I’ve sent screenshots through “Report a Problem.” I can go into individual posts and see comments, likes, etc. however zero notifications for anything. This is an unacceptable glitch.

title: Trash
review: This app is total trash. Betwixt the overbearing data tracking and the buried “options”, and the incredible amount of “new” features. This app eats almost all my bandwidth just to play a video. God help me if I’m trying to find a thing I just saw a few seconds ago after a refresh. No one really needs this garbage app. Just call your friends and actually talk. This app is great for spreading false information. Especially if you love Trumps pomp. Fakebook will feed you Trump’s special brand of absolute bull crap, free of charge! I deleted it and have never needed to re-download it. Boy, BYE

title: Why do you update app every third day?
review:
Facebook app is continually updated, but the truth is you hardly see what’s really updated. 
The app is exactly what it was two years ago.  Changes look like are for FB folks to manage. Why can’t they do it once or twice a year? These incremental changes, that really don’t change anything,  are ridiculous .

title: Awful
review: Your newest upgrade started adding “JOIN THIS PUBLIC GROUP” and then a sample post from the group. I keep seeing the same groups. Rate my plate is one that keeps showing up. It is basically every third post on my newsfeed. There is food which is triggering for someone with an eating disorder. There is tons of cussing and verbal abuse which I CHOOSE NOT TO SEE on my feed. Yet, I had to join the group to block them. I blocked them. I am STILL SEEING THEM IN MY NEWSFEED. I have reported every single post to Facebook.  They agreed and removed some posts!!! Take this newsfeed violation away now or I’m canceling Facebook forever.

title: Facebook Support is not helpful
review: I have already submitted an appeal to recovering my Facebook/ Instagram account and have only been receiving automated messages instead of a person contacting me back about my issue. They removed the feature where you could actually speak to a person so I have been stuck using the broken appeal system. Once you send a review case, you will be emailed back with an appeal email. I have not received ANY form of return from what I sent as if it was just ignored. I was falsely accused of impersonating someone even though I sent my face with a confirmation number AND ID.

title: App freezes and have to continually uninstall to get updates
review: Started last week where I open up the app and it only shows a gray screen. Nothing loads. “Force closing” the app and restarting the phone doesn’t help, Facebook just loads up again straight to the gray screen. I have to uninstall the app, install it again and then the app will load past the gray screen but second time I try to start up the app again it gets stuck on the gray screen. So I have to continually uninstall and install the app; I’ve done it 5 times already the past 2 days and it’s so annoying.

title: Is not working, it’s just awful
review: Every time I tried to trim a video in my stories, the app crashes, all the freaking time, and also I tried to view my profile as a visitor by clicking view as, and now it’s logging me out all the time. It’s so annoying. Also the reason I used view as, it’s because a guy sent me a text message and I didn’t know who that is, but when I asked him how he got my number he told me that I have it in my profile, and I have my number blocked so I’m the only one that can see it. It’s so weird, I don’t want random people texting me. I got to stop using this app.

title: I don’t even know
review:
It’s a good app. I’m just tired of seeing the same posts, from the same people, over and over again. Even at different points of the day. 
I’ll just be scrolling and see this post from whoever from Tuesday 
And then I’ll scroll one down and see something shared a minute ago. 
And if I refresh the app, the only thing that refreshes is the “people you may know” which also, how am do you think I know people who have 0 mutual friends? 
Fix this.

title: Bugs need fixed.
review: Alright so i like to sell stuff in various groups. And before you had the option of either keeping on the sales format or turning it off via a phone. Well in the past year that option has disappeared and I can’t turn off the sales format on one of my sales post in different groups. I use to have that option before. I can still do it on a laptop or computer but not my phone. Can you fix this please.

title: Discrimination
review:
This app is full of hypocrisy. I’ve been flagged for hate speech 2 times and am actually being targeted ever since I started liking conservative pages. 
A man says a cop needs shot and there are no consequences. A man comments on a post that he’d shoot a cop and nothing. I call out clearly white trash for harassing a middle aged woman and a man threatening her and I was accused of hate speech and locked down for 7 days.
If you don’t have a Facebook, don’t bother. Community standards aren’t enforced on nudity, racism, or hate speech in general as long as you’re not a conservative person. If you are they target you and put you in Facebook jail.

title: Ineligible to use Facebook??
review: My account was banned or deleted and I received a message saying that I was ineligible to use Facebook. I only had friends and family, less than 200 total, I hardly ever shared anything and when I did it was never anything controversial. I had this account for over a decade. It’s possible my account was hacked, but whatever happened I haven’t received any help or explanation from Facebook other than an automated message. My Instagram and WhatsApp was banned or deleted at the same time and I cant make new accounts with my phone number or email address.

title: Just tired
review: Every time I turn around something is going wrong with this app . These updates clearly aren’t helping . I can’t share any post  what so ever . This has been going strong for 3 days now and I have written I know 15 reports with screen shots to hear nothing . I can share pics and like post etc but I can’t share other post or use the share button with out a error notification and saying it’s a mistake try again this is only like this for my account but works fine on relatives from me using my same phone . This is ridiculous to say the least . 🙄🙄

title: Discrimination,bullying it’s allowed nothing it’s been done!
review: I’ve been complaining,reporting abuse harassment,bullying and public humiliation none authorized using of my personal pictures  , from one sick minded person with 10 different accounts and nothing has been done! This shouldn’t been happening in this beautiful app, but it’s seems like Facebook doesn’t care anymore about the safety of the users this things are unacceptable and shouldn’t been allowed , hopefully someone from Facebook read this and take action against bullying ,discrimination , harassment and care more about the users, .

title: Garbage app, garbage site, garbage CEO
review: Facebook used to be cool, simple, user friendly, and sleek. Now it’s a bloated mess with intrusive and annoying ads, recommended content that is irrelevant and arduous to circumvent, and OH YEAH: illegal data mining, phishing, and privacy violations! Not to mention a bizarre algorithm that bans people for violating “community standards” when posts are innocuous. How ironic is that? Lizard skinned Zuckerberg and his platoon of geeks are committing crimes and they have “community standards” which are ambiguous at best. Facebook is really trash. And the app is a clunky, bugged, poorly functional mess as well. There are a variety of alternatives that are much better. I recommend using MeWe.

title: The Worst
review: I tried returning to Facebook after a few years of being away. I started a very small business and wanted to use Facebook as way to promote it. Within 3 hours of making a new account they locked it, twice. They’re asking for ridiculous information just so they can unlock it. I don’t trust this app or this company anymore (not that I did all that much before...). They’ve taken something great and completely ruined it. Waiting for the next big social media platform to happen. This is bullsh**. If they ever unlock my account, I’ll be deleting immediately.

title: Need to add another hobby!
review:
I really like the addition of the hobbies, but you do not have 3D Printing/Additive Manufacturing. 
Can you guys please make the addition? My fellow printers and I would greatly appreciate it.
I would also like to know where you can find all the request you have sent. It was A LOT easier to find in the update before this one. Now I can’t find it.

title: Facebook marketplace
review: I love Facebook overall , use it daily but right now for some reason I can’t access Facebook marketplace at all. This is only an issue bc my family is moving and we are working together on finding a house, sending links of houses we like from Craigslist , Facebook , and many house websites and apps and on my device not only do I not have the option to access marketplace, but when I’m sent a link from the marketplace I can’t view it.

title: Creepy App Beware
review: If you enjoy having your personal information exploited, sold, and turned against you then sign right up!  Facebook is always listening, and always learning new ways to manipulate people through advertising.  Get tracked by an algorithm that can predict mental disability with a higher success rate than licensed professionals... and why?  So you can see ANOTHER minion ad of course! We live in a strange time, and Facebook is determined to monetize every scrap of data it can get its hands on, regardless of the ethical implications involved.  I would recommend deleting the app after use, browse cautiously.

title: Pitiful
review: Your latest update is ridiculous!  I just received an update that someone made a new post; it was posted seven hours ago.   I also received a notification that someone posted thirty minutes ago on a post from last night.  Your new “features” with groups and pages are beyond frustrating!  Only showing most recent comments with no way to change that setting, SOME posts are now ONLY shareable from pages who ALWAYS allow comments.  Change it back.  I have no idea why I’m typing this because you never change things back.  🙄🙄

title: Ugly and not functional
review:
The new update came out and Facebook is literally impossible for disabled people to read.

Also, Facebook Marketplace used to be great, you could see a bunch of stuff for sale by local people, and you’d be able to easily sell your used stuff. Now, it’s all ads from businesses and stores, you can’t find people’s stuff to buy, and more importantly, no one can see your stuff to buy because it’s all clogged up with ads. Now I can’t sell anything. Screw you Facebook, you turned one of the best features of your site into a crap hole because you’re money greedy.

title: Horrible Support
review: I run several business pages and have submitted several tickets in an issue for months, where I’m unable to share videos or images between my own pages, either on the app or the browser and every ticket goes unresponded to, before eventually getting closed with zero resolution or conmmunication. I’ve paid thousands for their ad services, and this issue directly impacts my business. Again, this is a months long issue with no response and nothing but closed tickets to show for it. I can’t recommend their service or app to anybody.

title: Pathetic. Down right Pathetic.
review: It’s honestly so sad that Facebook, being one of the biggest media platforms, is so unreliable. I’ve tried so many times to log into my account but every time I send an SMS to myself it net comes and it ends up saying “you just wait 24 hours” I’ve been trying to grow my business and this has really set me back and has me very frustrated. I have no clue how to get into my account and if I can’t get into it I won’t be able to link it with Instagram and do promotional ads for my clothing brand. So thanks Facebook!, you guys have really out done yourselves this time.

title: I’m deleting this app and anything to do with Facebook
review: Facebook is annoying. It notifies me of random stupid people getting live. To now being the slowest thing on my phone on the app to every browser being unable to use it. The market place is cool and was very useful but I feel like they can just intergrate that into messenger or make it into a standalone feature . It’s got a lot of good features but it’s slow and besides family an some stand alone features it’s completely useless. Just download the messenger app and disable Facebook unless you are using the market place it’s unusable.

title: Stop updating for the sake of updating
review: I don't see why Facebook feels the need to update their app frequently for the sake of keeping the app current as they seem to add rush updates to the interface. Why are we no longer allowed to see photos people are tagged in from their profile without scrolling through their timeline? Why are timelines reduced “highlights” of posts? Facebook employees don’t seem to understand what their users actually want. Perhaps if they would take the time to talk to people outside of their “bubble” in California, they would see what is truly desirable.

title: Bulky UI
review:
The past few updates to both Messenger & Facebook apps have included a bolder enlarged font that does not adhere to your iphones font size settings, and you cannot change them within the app settings.

Still waiting for the option to chose personal app wide UI color in both apps. It doesn’t make sense that you can do so within group messenger and pages, but not app wide when that is a simple option that can be unlocked and would add to the user experience.

It would also be great if you could chose to hide stories from newsfeed. I have an 8 plus and the story cards take up nearly half the screen. That’s overkill.

 It would probably lead more people to use Messenger over iMessage seeing as it’s still only an option to change accent color on MacOS.

title: Facebook
review: Facebook has morphed into a Political Tool used to divide! If you are somewhere right of center you can expect your account to be under constant attack, you can expect your posts and comments to be attacked from all sides. You can’t say anything about anything without getting banned. All the while death threats, Racism and Hatred is not filtered if you are a liberal. As a liberal you can threaten death on conservatives and their children without consequences. However if you are not a liberal any thing you say will get you banned! The death of Facebook is at hand and our Country will be better for it

title: Give me a break!
review: With all of these updates, you would think that the app would improve. Now I only see one post at the top, and nothing else will load. STILL seeing posts from days ago, simply because someone commented on it. I don't want to see all of that! Do you even read these reviews?? This app is terrible. Stop acting like it’s new and improved, because it’s not. Also, after the latest update, I can’t edit any post I make without it erasing stuff I’m not trying to erase. I start typing and it erases the letters from a word I’m not even trying to correct! Ugh. This app is a MESS.

title: Unhappy with update
review: Since the latest update, the Marketplace posts no longer show how old the listing is. This is especially frustrating on garage sale posts. The sale may have been last weekend - or a month ago - and it is listed as current. So now I will have to contact everyone to find out if their sale is current, and hope they get back to me. Many people do not remove their listing after the item sells, so it is important to know how old the listing is. PLEASE put that feature back!

title: Feed won’t load
review: For 3 or 4 days now, the feed will randomly stop loading. I can’t proceed past the last entry. I try to reload, and it says there is an error with the network connection. All other apps on my device work fine. Reinstalled the app and it just did it again. Fix it or I dump the service. The reason I keep the account is for the news feed. Very irritating! Also, I never see some individuals updates anymore, but I get all the ads under the sun. Give me back my updates and dump the ads. This service has just become bloated over the past decade.

title: NEEDS ANOTHER UPDATE FOR IPHONE Xs MAX
review: When looking at photos on Facebook, the first time I click to view a photo, the photo opens up clear then goes blurry. This happens EVERY TIME. I have to then close the photo and reopen it and then it’s not blurry. I had an iPhone 7 Plus before my x max and never had this problem. My iPhone and Facebook app are both up to date on updates and this happens when I have full service or good WiFi reception, so I don’t think it’s a network problem. PLEASE FIX!!!

title: Do you even test the app before you release it, FB?
review: In their latest update, if you have your iPad locked in landscape mode & touch a picture to see it without the post it's connected to, the app will automatically rotate the image to portrait mode. Very annoying! I lock my iPad in landscape for a reason. Images should remain in landscape mode & not automatically rotate to portrait, forcing you to turn your iPad around to see it. Does the FB app team even test the update before releasing it? And there's no settings within the app to lock the orientation to match that of the iPad. Fix this mess!

title: Getting worse
review:
Crashes
When it does open, I can only see two posts. Sometimes they are recent posts, sometimes they are old posts I saw a week ago. 
On a rare occasion, FB loads more than two stories but they aren’t in chronological order going back in time as I scroll. 
Birthday notifications should pop up every morning together. I had a day recently with three friends’ birthdays were on the same day. Got notification for one of them at bedtime, one came two days later, and third never came. 
I would delete FB if it weren’t for work using FB to trade shifts.

title: Level of political censorship = PATHETIC!
review:
Facebook: what you are doing at this point is worse than the election tampering by the Russians.  You are just flat out removing pages that you find “offensive” regardless of whether they are run by real people or bots.  Liberty Memes in particular was well known for charitable work and the admins were very open about their real life identities.

It is extremely obvious that you are purging American political pages leading up to the US election. I realize you have a right to set the rules of your platform, but if you no longer want free speech as a cornerstone of your rules then you should be ashamed of yourselves.

title: Password
review: After losing 3 phones to moisture had to reset things and fb wouldn’t accept my phone number so after some frustration adding it, it wanted a new phone number over and over, so added my husbands phone in its place, to where they texted a password then someone reported me as a fraud, which I’m not so having to prove myself again is bs and makes me wanna delete it all, but it’s important to me to see what my friends are up to so I deal with it’ and they know that!!  I have one phone number and can’t change it!!

title: What is going on at fb hq
review: Facebook use to be a great and simple  app   You all remember the days of goin thru your news feed seeing pictures and then watching a long thread of videos but now they have some weird sections when you click on videos called episode pages what is the this and who ever asked for it.  Your fixing something that isn’t broke.  This is why MySpace failed and it’s why you will fail over time just stop changing things we didn’t ask you to change fb it’s obnoxious and doing your community a disservice   Also remove ads from your videos

title: Shop section when creating a page
review: So I created a page threw my mobile and found after doing a lot of research that Facebook doesn’t have a way for anyone to add things that they want to sell to there shop section when creating a page on any mobile device. I’ve tried both my iPad and iPhone. I’m upset about that because I was holding to kick start my new business. So I was hoping you guys could somehow make that possible.

title: VIDEOS ARE ALL MESSED UP
review: After this most recent update, watching videos on fb becomes CUMBERSOME. It used to be like that I click on one video, and I keep scrolling to keep watching other videos that usually I enjoy. Now it is all messed up in this “discover” format where I have to manually unmute each video that comes up and when I click on a video to watch, I can’t keep scrolling to keep watching auto-videos. Ugh it pretty much keeps me away from using FB as I love to wind down for the day by watching a bunch of silly videos CONVENIENTLY!

title: Potential privacy violation, unless I’m missing something
review: Settings for photos are set to Never for Facebook and Messenger- yet I was able to open up from the app , browse and post pictures from my cellphone album- I went to privacy settings to turn it off and was alarmed to see they were off already! I went back to The FB page after writing this review and checked to see that my post was not on the forum(anymore) and I tried taking screenshots of posting a pic again but this time received a message indicating my privacy settings prevent access- something’s fishy!

title: Too many ads. Non-trustworthy. Not worth it.
review: I liked Facebook because it was nice to keep in touch with my family, and see what they had been up to. However the ads became so overwhelming that I saw more ads, than my own family’s posts. So I had to delete it. I am also not a fan of the copious amount of terms and conditions. It’s not worth reading through it all just to scroll through the internet, nor is it worth it to just agree to the terms. Especially with all the sneaky stuff they do with our personal information. Definitely not a trustworthy company.

title: News feed jacked up
review:
Ever since I updated to this version, only about 6 posted show up. When scrolling the bottom of the page says more posts but when you scroll it tries to load but then finishes with nothing. This affects both, news feed and recent feed. 

I also have been hating the swipe back feature. It never fails that I am scrolling through the feed and accidentally swipe and it goes back to the last screen I was on then I have to start over scrolling to get where I was, which is sometimes hours and hours of posts.

title: Phone crashing and Photo browse and view before posting gone
review: In the latest update my phone keeps crashing right as the app is first being used. When the update first occurred it was glitching now it’s unusable. I also noticed that when I was posting a pic and wanted to chose it from the photo roll I could not zoom in on it or edit it before I posted as in the past. Now I must edit any pics and try to view a small version of them before I can post. Not happy with this update. Also I can’t seem to go back very far in the newsfeed. One post is all I see.

title: new update is trash
review: i HATE the new update. it’s totally stupid. my friends tag me in a comment on a video, i press on the notification, and it brings me to the “facebook watch” page where i can’t react to the comment in the info tab. then when i go to the comment tab to try to reply or even react to the comment i was tagged in, i can’t even find it— just a bunch of random people’s comments !!!! this new feature is incredibly frustrating, and will ultimately lead to a decline in my facebook app use if it does not get fixed soon.

title: Need collision insurance
review:
Crashy, Crashy, Crash-Crash-Crash. Please, please please please fix the stability issues with this app. It is getting really old having to open everything in Safari just to assure getting through an article.

The notifications at 1:00am... really?? 1:37, and 1:39???? Enough is enough. I need my sleep more than I need to know a random person commented on a post. Especially when it’s not a thread I’ve had anything to do with in the first place.  Since I can’t set what hours it notifies me, I’ll simply turn off all the notifications. Might just delete the app. Facebook over reach.

title: Constant crashes, practically unusable
review: Facebook as an app has been garbage for a while what with separating messages and forced non-chronological newsfeed viewing. This version expands on that garbage with crashing constantly and logging users out at random. It's also added an exciting 1999 era feature where videos auto-play audio! It says you can turn this off in settings but of course that option doesn't actually exist. I only downloaded the app again to keep up with a friend but for all this trouble I'll just call them instead. Worthless app is worthless.

title: Group abilities
review: With the last update we were able to do scheduled posts and edit scheduled posts in groups I manage or at least that is when I noticed it. When my phone did the most recent update today the ability to schedule and edit scheduled posts on groups went away. Please bring those back! I appreciate being able to do everything from my phone that I am able to do from my computer.

title: Unstable
review:
Could use a popup for messenger rather than taking up even more space for a separate app, just having it all in one would be nice. Might make it more unstable though. 

Very hard to type on the app. It lags horribly and will erase half of what i write if it lags too much. The cursor also moves of its own accord under these too common circumstances.

I have an unlimited data plan on my carrier, live in a rural area, and don’t have regular access to WiFi. This is an extremely annoying issue that should be simple for the developers to correct. Give the user a choice on how they choose to connect for updates. I can download updates over 3 times larger than the Facebook update in less than a minute. Put a switch in the app settings for crying out loud.

This app makes you extra taps just to get almost any task done. For example I want to dislike a page, I’ll have to go inside the page and then click on options button then dislike and then confirm dislike, which can be done in just maximum two taps. Same goes with the block feature, you cannot block a page/person, just from your timeline.

To use it, you must buy it from the App Store”. When we click on “view in App Store” it goes there, you click “open” and it goes thru the same thing. This is ridiculous!!!! title: Notifications not working
review: Hi there. I am a Facebook addict. And I am really getting upset that the notifications will not post to my phone notifiying me of something when I have the app closed. Every other app I have will notify me of comments, or notifications.  I am wondering if this is a bug that needs fixed or if there is something I should do.

title: Newest update
review: Ever since yesterday’s update my app has been acting crazy. When I comment on things the send button is not there. When someone has a long status and I click see more, it does absolutely nothing. Also it’s still tiresome seeing statuses three days later, I should be seeing a status from some on Thursday when they wrote it on Monday. This is a common complaint I see on my timeline so I don’t understand why you can’t address it.

title: The continue watching feature has to go
review: I’m hard of hearing so I rarely click the video and will watch it with subtitles and if the video doesn’t have subtitles I will just keep scrolling and Facebook wants to force me to click on the video in order to watch full video and I know it’s not really that big of a deal but this whole continue watching feature is making scrolling through not really enjoyable. Won’t delete Facebook because it’s how I get in touch with a lot of ppl but definitely won’t be scrolling through my timeline anymore.

title: Addictive Apps With Minor Setbacks
review: Great app. Plenty of downfall inside the app alone tho. One where is Night Mode or Dark Mode. Secondly, why can’t I decide if I want to see my feed in most recent or the bs algorithm that you think I wanna see. Lastly, please allow for me to share to other apps like Instagram and Snap directly from the App. Every App connect to Facebook but Facebook doesn’t backwards reference anything and they own Instagram now.

title: Buggy and intrusive
review: I used to like the Facebook app, but pretty much all updates in the last few years have really sucked.  Plus it tries to auto update constantly, which is super annoying. I suspect every update is intended to put more ad revenue or collect personal data. Delete the app and use the browser based interface, which has gotten progressively worse as well, but not nearly as annoying as the app. Don’t tie ANY other accounts to FB logins. Pretty worthless as an app, I’ll just pass. I only use FB to keep up with neighborhood watch groups and for Marketplace.

title: Sucksss
review:
You should probably update your rules make them more specific and equal to men and women. 
Maybe fix a lot of your issues you been having. I’ve went to the help center and reported issues with my profile multiple times and never heard back. What’s the point of having FB if I can’t actually use it? I wish there was other ways o could talk to my friends and the kids parents I babysit but I can’t and I can’t message them because for some reason I am temporarily blocked from doing so with absolutely no explanation. Fix your crap FB. You already sucked beforehand.

title: App keeps freezing
review: With the last update, now the app continuously freezes and crashes. Tried uninstalling\reinstalling and this does not fix the issue. This is a complaint in a long line of such about bugs every time the app gets an update. How about instead of changing my icons and fonts 10 billion times an update,  or figuring out a new way to jam an add for useless products nobody actually wants, fix the issues that have made the functionality of the app crap since day one of its launch.

title: Too many changes
review: Sick of new changes - suggested friends is annoying / distracting at top of feed and repeats the same people constantly even if I x them out, and now I have to double click images to expand them (first click gives it a black border with a “more photos like this” caption which doesn’t lead to any photos, and then I have to click again to actually expand). Just annoyed with it becoming less user friendly.

title: Loved it for years, now not so much.
review: I have been on Facebook for 10+ years. I have loved it until recently. Social media is how I get my business out there so it’s important for me to get notifications in case people are asking questions. Lately my notifications are not working. I will post something, and if I go to my profile I can see that people are reacting & commenting on it, but I’m NOT being notified. I’ve reported this multiple times and it has not been fixed. I’ve done all the troubleshooting as well. App is up to date. There’s nothing more I can do. VERY unhappy.

title: Dominoes Has lots of basic wrongs
review: I’m an avid player of dominoes. I also know that the creators must not be Persian as this is a Persian game. That is because there are lots of wrongs in a basic dominoes game. Your game gives fouls for no reasons, it’s indistinct, and it’s favoring newer players over veterans. I’m forced to change to a different app for this game. I’ve tested this game with two phones. Beginners are getting better chances(I assume for encouragement) and older players like me are to draw up to 10 tiles from the deck, whilst the opposing player draws up to 1 or 2. These are my complaints, and I have log stopped playing your games.

title: Blank screen
review: There is something wrong with the app lately. Many years, when I click on the menu to look at my profile or videos, the page doesn't load except for the word 'Menu' and I'm unable to click the home button. The only thing to do is close out the app. However, when I reopen the app it will be blank, so I have to open and close the app three or four times before it will load. I use an iPhone.

title: Takes up space for no reason
review: With the amount of updates this app gets you would think it would run smoothly. That is not the case here, my biggest complaint so far would have to be stories, each time you start watching a story for some reason it’s on mute and once you turn up the volume it confuses it with the phone ringer! Makes no sense! Also when watching videos I really hate that you have to scroll all the way up just to get rid of them. Sometimes it will freeze as well and you have no option but to restart the app.

title: Why?
review: On the App, they only allow up to 4 featured photos on iPhone but on Samsung and all computers, they allow to 9 featured photos. This isn’t right it nearly seems like the app is discriminating each person’s account by what device they are using, everyone should be allowed to feature the same number of photos on the featured photos section, 9. Please fix this, it isn’t fair to other users since many users like me uses both iPhone and computer and my iPhone Facebook app only allows me to display up to 4 photos while my computer allows up to 9.

title: It blocks you from comments you wrote months ago.
review: I got put on a 30 day block for a comment I wrote over 4 months ago.  There needs to be a time limit on how far out something can get reported.  My comment wasn’t trending or anything.  Someone who doesn’t like me just went on a search to find a comment from months ago.  They need better evaluation on how they deal with these reports.  My comment was in a Facebook group.  Why wasn’t I just banned from that group?  Why am I completely banned from everything on Facebook?  I need to communicate with my family.

title: Stop with the changes
review: I've had this app for years, and I've never had much of a complaint. ENOUGH with screwing with the timeline! Today all of the comments are messed up, and I'm at my breaking point. I can't even read things in the order they were written in because now they're all appearing newest to oldest. Good grief! It's bad enough that I randomly don't see what people post unless I "interact" with them to Facebook's satisfaction, but this is taking it too far.

title: Getting annoyed
review: I love Facebook but picture on peoples stories won’t work when I click on them it won’t load no matter how long I wait at 2 locations that both had great WiFi and I had great cellular data service and still not working. Also was trying to watch a video and and it played for a few seconds and then stopped so I waited a few minutes pressed play and it replayed a part of the video I already saw and went black and said 0 like it was starting at the beginning even though it paused and went black a few seconds into the video

title: Frustrating Privacy
review: It’s frustrating that I can no longer use the market place because you ask for location services. I deny it and am brought up with the option of a radius around me. I enjoy this option better and choose my distance. Only to be shown with the same pop up asking for my location and then the radius again and again and again. If you’re not going to take no for an answer then don’t give the option. Better yet let me use the radius option and let me see the options first before you pop up.

title: Irritated

Facebook is the ONLY app that has issues playing videos whether i’m in wifi or not. this has been going on for a while which is what stopped me from even using facebook for a few as i personally get on there just to watch videos. but i get on today to see that same issue is still going on with every. single. video. it’ll only be a few seconds in when it starts and it’s so annoying.

title: Annoyed

You say you update this for what? Clearly not doing anything important with the updates because a few months go by and I’m having the same issues I was before. title: Why can’t we see newsfeed chronologically on app??

Through al the changes in Newsfeed, one of the most annoying Is seeing posts pop up based on Facebook’s own algorithm. Is it too much to ask for posts to appear in the order they were posted?

Researched online, signed into my desktop just to set my preference as Newsfeed=chronological order. But it DOESN’T translate to the app. Why??? 

I keep reading the same posts over and over. Random posts that I don’t care about keep getting prioritized and popping up first.

title: No response and constant problems!
review: I use Facebook to help rescue animals and buy and sell items to support our rescue group. I’ve used fb marketplace for two years without any issues and never broke any rules, but in sept, marketplace just disappeared off my page. As the other person who reviewed fb, any and all requests for help with this issue have been answered by an automated response which helped nothing. Now, I’ve had to reload fb and it’s asking for id. I’ve NEVER had to do this before and don’t like giving my info out over the web. Could this app get ANY worse???

title: Terrible communication when you have a problem.

I had 2 step activation hooked up and I lost complete access to the phone number needed to verify that it is me trying to log in. I have sent a photo of my id twice as asked, and I haven’t even got an email saying that they’ll work on it or that it’s been checked/being checked. I use Facebook to keep in touch with my family and I would really like access back into my account. Please help 😥

title: New update version is horrible
review: It’s just like the recent messenger update with the bulky bold letters like all of a sudden we’re all blind and can’t see crap, I wish the new update version had a font size option because I like my font and text size to be small and not all huge, bold and bulky. I refuse to use the Facebook app until it changes back

title: Glitches Galore
review: The notifications won’t let you scroll further than the first 15 or so. And then if you want to revisit one you previously clicked it’s gone from the notifications list never to be found again, unless you get a new notification about it. In previous versions the visited notifications stayed in the list and you knew you visited them by the grayed out look, but could could revisit them. It’s so frustrating because I often revisit my notifications and now am unable to do so.

title: Photos on news feed
review: The new update made photos cropped on your news feed when you upload them. And you have to swipe left to see them and even then after a few you still have to clock to view all of them the old way by scrolling down. Just bring back scrolling down to view friend’s photos on the news feed. It looks so awful when you view the first photo. They make them square and you have to click to view the whole photo. It was so simple before and they didn’t get cropped all stupid before. Please please fix this.

title: No support ... at all
review:
You don’t notice until you need it. I’m a small business owner, so it feels more important than if I were, you know, uploading cat memes. 

Reminds me of when I left both my suitcases in the Uber on the way home from LAX at 1AM. Tried to find Uber support and got, “don’t call us, we’ll call you.” With Facebook’s disastrous privacy and personal info problems in the news, makes me think, who would I call if I had that problem? Certainly not Facebook, they’re very busy, can’t talk to me, why don’t we redirect you to a forum where other people are suffering without help? 😑

title: Notifications but not there
review:
Every time I’ve opened my app recently it says I have a new notification, I click on it and nothing new is there. It’s very frustrating. 
Also I have always hated when I close the app or lock my phone even for a few mins when I open it back up it goes back to the top of the news feed again. I spend 30 mins scrolling thru a days worth of stuff just to close my app and have to restart from the top it’s very annoying. Make it so it stays or locks in place.

title: Facebook update is dead
review:
Latest update won't load, can't make it install, can't open it, can't make it go away. Says the latest update will address bug fixes; instead it IS a bug. Looks like everyone else is having the same problem.

Every time I update Facebook app it gets worse not better. It gets annoyingly slow even to the point where I don’t have enough time to wait...and I’m talking about up to a half hour even if I quit and come back to it. As someone else posted, it IS a bug!

title: Video orientation annoyance
review: I’m surprised this is the only app that does this where i’m watching a video and I rotate my phone so I can view it in full screen, and I move slightly more and the whole screen flips back to its vertical state. NO ONE WATCHES VIDEOS ON THEIR PHONE UPSIDE DOWN. If someone does that’s fine but at least put a full screen option or let orientation lock be compatible with the horizontal screen mode. It’s annoying when i’m laying down watching something and the whole screen flips as if I wanted to watch with my phone upside down.

title: Read your viewers comments
review: Reading through the numerous comments/suggestions from your viewers and they are spot on. Numerous comments regarding Tarik and especially Christina. Consensus-get rid of her!  But there was a wonderful suggestion to remodel spaces for handicapped folks and the man said his wife wanted to be on it!  Wonderful idea - check it out and read these comments that people are taking the time to let you they are watching .  It’s called courtesy and most of your audience will appreciate it. Have a show reading email but no more extensive repeats!

title: Updates
review: It’s beyond annoying that every other week there’s updates including for messenger. It’s getting out of hand & I’m not alone by saying so. What if people don’t have enough memory on their phone. Surely with an IT team for such a huge company you all could minimize how often the updates are more efficiently. Also it would be nice to not have the bubble feature in messenger. We don’t need to see who’s online by seeing their bubblehead at the top.

title: Malfunction with Facebook, horrible app.
review:
The app used to be a great way to keep in touch with friends and family. Not anymore. For about the last month the app only shows about 5 people that post on my news feed when I have about 200 “friends” on my list (actively associate with about 50). 

Also, the app just stops loading posts and orates after I scroll down about 20 posts. That’s it- it’s just done. No errors. Nothing- done. 

I’ve uninstalled and reinstalled 3 times, updates FB, updated my phone, rebooted the phone- to no avail. This app is horrible now.

title: Algorithm
review: Obviously this new algorithm was intended to sell more ads, and eliminate businesses from being able to utilize the app for marketing. HOWEVER, two years ago I used Facebook as a main means of getting information during Hurricane Matthew. I would get real time, up to date info from both local officials and community members. Now, they don’t show up on my feed. I have a photo of a friend that I liked two weeks ago, but not the lifesaving information from officials trying to use the platform as its intended- a social network. You all need to get your priorities straight.

title: Crashing
review: This is the second time in 24 hours I’ve had to delete Facebook from my iPhone 8. It crashes almost instantly upon opening, then refuses to update. Sometimes for several hours, when I know friends are posting and my feed should be updating. It crashes at least once a day, often while commenting. This is extremely annoying, and I’m to the point of just retrieving my pics and deleting the app permanently. It’s nothing but political hated and bigots screaming about their victim hood anyways.

title: iPad vs iPhone difference
review: I run my own business and I use social media a lot. I can’t schedule photo posts on my iPad but I can on my iPhone. This is hugely inconvenient for me. I would like the usage to be the same. I also can’t access albums in groups, or delete albums in groups on my iPad but I can on my iPhone. I would be much happier if I could use my iPad the same as my iPhone. Hoping this is fixed soon.

title: Can’t see all pics
review: Idk why but when I scroll through pictures, when I get to the last picture in the list it automatically takes me out of the list and back to my newsfeed. Whenever I try to go slowly to view the last picture again it does it again before I even reach the complete bottom still making me unable to see the last picture within a post, which isn’t too fun if I must say.

title: Platform for garbage
review:
This site is no longer about connecting. It’s about fake news, false narratives, click bait, ads, the control content in some cases, and it’s not very useful or used for its original purpose. The market is pretty nice and certainly useful, but half the people that say they want something don't show up for the item. You either mark it sold so you don’t get further messages, or keep people in the pipeline and deal with the “I’m interested, is this item still available?”

Step it up, clean it up.

review: Facebook need to get their act together, both app and webpage. There are people who want to see their feeds in newest order,  not top story.  And yet, you are forced to use top story.   Every couple of updates, they change the order and what is shown in “More”. With the latest update, I now have to hit more, each time, but now I have to hit show more, then scroll to the bottom of the list. If you are going to make a change, give people the option to adjust it to fix their usage,  not what you feel they should be using.

review: No one wants to see your honor student sticker you just received from your kids elementary school. Newsflash! No one cares! title: Facebook
review: New update is is ok but now I have to click on the notifications one at a time when last year all I had to do is swipe down to make them read. That is a pain if you do not check them after a few hours or at night. Even when I click on the notification either on my iPad or iPhone I still have to click on it to say it is read .

title: Random Crashes During Videos
review: Every time I go to start binge watching videos about Video Games, Life, or just plain things to watch, it seems as though I can get through the first minute of the video and then the Facebook App will crash and I’ll have to open it again. And every then that doesn’t help. I’ve deleted and downloaded the app again but it hasn’t seemed to help. It’s been doing it for two nights now and would like to know why or how it can be fixed. Getting very very very annoying.

title: Worse than previous versions
review: Since I upgraded to iOS 11, I still get alerts as normal. But when I go to the post where there’s a new comment I was alerted to, no comments can be found. I’ve done the force close and restart the app but still no comments. I go to my desktop browser and the comments show up instantly. Worse than that is it seems to be random. I see some comments on some posts but no comments on others. The only reason I think this may be is that the ones I see comments are on my timeline whereas the ones I don’t aren’t on my timelines

title: great platform, stop changing thing.
review: please remove the swipe left for video chat. almost no one needs it let alone needs a easily mistakable and errorness hotkey to such a thing. Wow to the new video player, like wow is it super annoying. With the auto play and random videos that play after the one you were watching. Oh and it's impossible to edit comments on video's now and it freezes up. yw for the free beta testing feed back, I will be using your app alot less or not at all until these things are fixed.

title: Needs better share options etc.
review:
Actually, I think we need more reactions too. “Like” “Laugh” etc... we have more emotions than this, so have a little more fun with them for Pete’s sake. Needs more to be a truly good app, but it’s not too bad in my opinion.

review:
I only give one star because they ban my account without any reasons. They ban for calling my friend a son??? title: Promoting Zionist Agenda
review: I've been a long-time user of Facebook, but lately, I've grown increasingly concerned about its editorial decisions.
