title: Fb is only social media that everyone has
review: I hate this app so much. When it first came out. We all though it would be cool and such a great platform. Since then, there has been nothing but glitches, or issue with the app itself. Constant change of where everything is, yet companies like google don’t have this issue. And they keep it simple. But you come to FB, there is too much and too many problems and headaches. It used to be a great social platform to use. At this point. Idk if I want to use Facebook again. I hope they get their act together for once.

title: New App modifications are obtrusive
review:
The more ads, pop-ups and large icons that this developer chokes the viewable space with, the less inclined I am to use this site. 

The large “F” at the bottom might as well stand for failure. Also, this is not a news site, but seems to want to be a part of every socially noteworthy topic. Looking for news on Facebook is like trying to buy donuts at gamestop; there might be some tasty edible looking and/or smelling items for sale, but they’re not edible, and likely made of foam, because it’s not a donut shop. Stop recommending COVID, Census, or other news related suggestions to my feed.

title: Continue on watch
review: I normally don’t do reviews but this is driving me absolutely insane because I really enjoy watching the videos that appear in my feed without sound (most of the video have annoying background music). But now after 30 seconds of watching the video it stops and says “Continue on Watch” which is driving me crazy because if I wanted to watch videos on watch I would’ve switch to the watch section of the app. Please Facebook stop ruining the app. Just fix the bugs stop making changes to a working version of the app.

title: I need help to change featured collection to featured pictures please!!
review: Recently my featured pictures on my profile, which allowed me to upload up to 9 pictures from my camera roll, has changed to featured collection, which i can’t upload any picture from my camera roll but available pictures that are posted on facebook by me. I don’t like this version and it really bothers me. So please help me if anyone knows how to fix this. Thank you!!

title: Let me login to my account!!!!!!!
review: If I could give Facebook 0 stars I absolutely would!!! I recently got a new phone and ever since then I haven’t been able to login to my personal account which also has a business page linked to it with over 20k followers that have no idea what is going on & probably think I just disappeared! I’ve had my personal account for over 10 years an never once had a problem logging in until now I think I’m completely screwed because Facebook help center is complete garbage!! They don’t help with anything at all!!!

Honestly, I have no problems with my Facebook. The only thing that you should fix are the fake accounts don’t let anyone make one don’t even let it be possible for them without showing proof it is really them and nudes are a big problem on there as well, other than that it’s all good I recommend this app.

title: The app is fine but not finished
review:
Two problems affect my user experience an awful lot:

1. In landscape mode (iPad’s default mode with a keyboard case), you can’t scroll to the right of the ads. 5 3/8 inches of the screen on the iPad Pro is DEAD SPACE. Unacceptable waste.

2. When posting articles with comments from the in-app browser, the link often drops and only posts the comment. This leaves orphaned comments with no context. Also unacceptable from a company whose ability to repost articles is a large part of what they do.

title: Facebook never addresses the app problems
review: For months the event tab on the upper right shows birthdays  that have passed and also you cannot go to a persons page from it. Not going to change my life, but is a little annoying. The only way to update events is if you delete the app and then reload it. You would think for all the money Facebook is worth they would be able to figure out how to fix this issue

title: Censorship
review: Facebook is an entity which only divides the American population further, it keeps us distracted,  Facebook doesn’t protect its users vis-à-vis the Russian bot hack during the election. Facebook locks me out if I say something about white people... no cussing not vulgar language... Facebook censors people spew wading the truth. Marc Zuckerberg, takes not social responsibility, he is only concerned with his wealth and becoming a member of the power elite .. I’m only trying to get back into this garbage app because I’m looking for a friend I haven’t heard from in a while and I want to make sure she is ok. But Facebook is the devil and you all know it

title: Problems 🙄
review: Once on my timeline scrolling through, the post will just stop loading. Sometimes I’ll only have 2-3 post on my timeline and then it just stops. Even when I try to scroll down to load more it doesn’t even happen. It’s just like a dead end. Even when I close out of the app completely and go back in it does the same thing. For the past couple weeks it’s been doing this, I might see 10 post in my newsfeed for that day (I have 800 friends so I know there’s way more post than I’m seeing). It’s so frustrating 🙄 And yes my app is updated.

title: Thank You
review: I really have to thank Facebook because thanks to them, I have been able to find all my family. People that I didn’t even know existed. I was able to make a family tree with everyone. 200+ people in the family tree, 150+ are cousins that I don’t know until we reconnected through Facebook. Thank You Facebook.

title: Marketplace
review: I own a IPhone 5s but I don’t have a marketplace button like my friends’s IPhone 6. When I press the bottom right button on the app and it shows up groups, memories, and such but there isn’t a marketplace button like on my friend’s IPhone 6. Why does my IPhone 5s not have a marketplace button? I can look up marketplace and everything but when I go to look at a listing it tells me it isn’t available anymore, and it does the same thing for all the other listings. Please fix this and I’ll give more stars.

title: FB
review: With a cat 5 hurricane approaching us in Florida FB has decided to block me for an generic statement aimed at no one at all or every one  putting my life and my family’s life’s in danger as messenger is all I have to keep in touch with family and friends durning this tragic event thank you once again FB for your lack of concern and understanding for the life and health of your users have a great safe day

title: iPad App keeps kicking me back to the lock screen
review: I have been to the Apple Store and had my iPad replaced (the iPad was only a couple months old and had no issues until recently with the Facebook app). The issue is whenever I am on Facebook Marketplace and I am scrolling. The iPad screen goes black and then shows a spinning wheel. After a couple seconds, my iPad is on the lock screen and Facebook is closed out. I went into the Apple Store and had the iPad replaced and even set it up as new. I downloaded this app and the issue is still present. Please fix this issues!!

title: Account deleted for no reason
review: As the title states, my account on Facebook was deleted for no reason. They never really explained as to why it was deleted and I know I didn’t do anything that violated their terms of service and yet I wake up to my account being gone with a message saying I’m “ineligible to use Facebook”. Apparently I’m also IP banned because I can’t even make a new one. Trying to get in contact with anyone to help you is a useless effort because their help service garbage. We definitely shouldn’t have left MySpace because Tom wouldn’t have let this happen.

title: Problem posting to FB
review:
This app no longer provides the ability to post a link to an article with a pasted copy of some text from the article accompanying the link. I now have make doing this into a multistep process, e.g., post the link to FB from article site then open the FB app, navigate to my post, click on editing the post, paste the text, click on Save, then leave FB and return to the article source.
I was able to do this in one step with my prior iphone which worked on an older iOS.

title: Why did the in-app sounds get a +100 volume!?
review: One of the recent updates came with some sort of a gigantic increase of in-app sounds. For example pulling down to refresh feed, clicking “like” etc. even with my sounds at 2/10 the volume is overwhelmingly loud! I mis other alerts because the Facebook sounds are so loud that because I turned things down my other alerts like for text notifications are inaudible in volume. Please fix it!! Omg it is unbearable! I use Facebook less because of the issues on volume. Please fix it!! Turn down the in-app sounds volume!!

title: Bring back the old one
review: I don’t know what the fk happened to the old app. I don’t know how the developers think. My account has happened like every time since the new update . I mean whenever i open the app, all the posts disappear and the app becomes white. All the pages, feeds gone white boxes. I can do nothing with that. That happened in the older version too. Hey Zuck, if you are reading this( i hope so ) please just try to improve in communication for the users. Don’t just think about the ads and making the reacts look awful and trash. Bring back the old reacts.

title: I would give 0 if I could.
review: Facebook is a joke. I’m sure there’s plenty of lovely people out there who did and do hard work on the app, but it has now sold out so to speak. And not with typical “ad free” costs or subscriptions, but with the information of its users. The Cambridge Analytica scandal was only one of what I am sure are many examples of this app obtaining your data and selling them to third parties to do whatever they wish. This company has lost all my trust. Stop putting personal info on Facebook, stop verifying apps with your Facebook account. Cut it out of your life. It’s not worth it.

title: Not good Facebook.... not good.
review: Every update seems worse and worse!!! It’s super ugly now, like some baby blue color? What?!?! Annnnd not to mention it looks like a boring news article. It’s awful. And the reacts are god awful. Let’s take a terrible trip back to the 2000s and only take what sucked, then add it to Facebook. Seems like what you’re doing and it’s not good. Someone else makes something similar to Facebook... and I’m hopping off cause this is UGLY. Quit ruining it. Was totally fine about a year ago.

title: Not for everyone, one giant “safe space”
review: This place went from being able to share everything you wanted with your friends to you had better step on egg shells so you don’t offend anyone, I just recently had 4 post that were over 5 years old put me on time out for 24 hours because NOW they didn’t meet facebooks guidelines when they met the guidelines 5 years ago, if someone made a comparable platform I’d jump ship and bring every one of my friends with me and hopefully all my friends would bring their friends and make Facebook end up like MySpace...

title: Mandatory location services for market place
review:
Looks like Facebook just changed something requiring location services to use the market place. When clicking a search you will be prompted to enable location services and if you click cancel it will give you the map to select your radius on, applying the radius just brings the pop up to enable location services back up. 

Considering I have not used Facebook to keep up with people for some time looks like it’s finally time to uninstall this app and I’m also considering deleting my account.

title: New update?
review: I’m not sure why but my Facebook app has been glitching and it’s been stuck on trying to upload a post with just a few sentences and three pictures. I’ve turned off the background usage on the app, turned on and off my phone, deleted and re-downloaded the app and its been stuck unable to load my newsfeed or post the original post. Any other suggestions or do I need to wait for the next update and hope it’s fixed? I already have the most recent version.

title: its a mess
review: Everything was going along well with Facebook until a few months ago I started getting requests from people who were already friends! If I don’t answer them I don’t get any of their posts now I find out that I have to set up a new account to communicate with them when I already have a Facebook account which works well except for people who have Re-– requested friendships. It’s so messed up I don’t know what to do! Why are there two Facebook’s? And why am I getting requests from people I already am friends with? Please straighten out this hideous mess.

title: Blocked from liking or commenting
review: But I can still comment? So why can’t I like videos.. 24 hours with zero explanation. Zero help from you or support. I found help through google. Also you guys banned people too much especially when it comes to them calling nasty child predators out. You guys need to fix that. Kids need protection; not predators. Keep up the banning because you’ll just lose profit. People aren’t going to put up with it. Same with deleting posts that we share without warning or explanation. Maybe you guys should just give up.. you get worse with age.

title: Add to album option for a picture already posted
review: Add to album option for a picture already posted on timeline is still missing after all these updates. It used to be there so when you forget to add a picture in an album after you post it, you can always go to edit and add to an album. It will then give you the album options you have and add it on. It was nice way of keeping up memories and for some reason, there’s been so many updates since I noticed it was missing but yet still not fixed. It’s annoying.

title: Attacking breastfeeding moms...
review: I’ve been one Facebook for a while now, and I’ve never had a problem until now... I’m a mother of 2 boys and i breastfeed, with that being said, I’m in groups about breastfeeding and all of a sudden we are gettin out photos and comments and post targeted for “sexual content”... since when is breastfeeding sexual? The Facebook Community Standards they say that they allowances for breastfeeding pictures, including nipple, but then we get our pictures and post taken down for “sexual content”... how does this make sense? Think they need to brush up on their rules about breastfeeding...

title: Need to fix sharing post feature
review: So when I share an article or a funny video I like to write a setup so my friends know why I think it’s funny. After a recent update now when I type the thing won’t move to the next line when I hit the space bar. To get an actual space I have to hit the space bar twice. It’s very awkward. Also when I double space a period doesn’t show up and I have to literally type a period. This only happens when I share posts. It’s almost like Facebook doesn’t want me to type stuff when I share posts. Sadly guys I LOVE SHARING POSTS. FIX THIS NOW!!!!!

title: Nonexistent Notifications
review:
The app is generally okay. 

I haven’t been receiving notifications since mid-September yet my phone and app are fully updated, I’ve turned push notifications on and off, logged in and out of the app, deleted and reinstalled the app and resettled notifications, still nothing. This wouldn’t be an issue had I not have missed important updates on events and family reunions. 

Please fix this ASAP. This has been happening to iPhones for a hot minute and I had the issue on an iPhone 7 and a Xs.

title: Annoying
review: I’m super annoyed that when I put things up for sale and I can not edit the post when something has sold in that post. So I have to end up redoing the entire post every time something sells in the picture. I have an iPhone 6, my mother also has an iPhone 6 and she is able to edit her items, but I can not. It’s very annoying and frustrating. I got this phone specifically for this reason and it can not do what I need it to do.

title: Facebook annoys me to no end
review:
The service that provides me with endless social interaction with those closest to me is great, but comes at the greatest cost of being constantly annoyed and pestered with emails and push notifications for Facebook Video, which I am wildly disinterested in (their new tab bar item that populates random attention-grabbing (its a trap!) notification badges). 

Facebook Messenger is also poisonous to my highly-revered peace of mind, though its review does not belong here. The treatment of customers really is quite poor. The endurance of notification torture truly is the price we pay for this free service.

title: An update always means a sacrifice.
review: Every time one thing is improved, something else is removed.  Too many steps now to enable post sharing.  And going through the steps to choose recent, is a waste of time because it only shows limited posts, and then the dates again become out of order.  The timeline is not chronological and dates are greatly out of order.  It’s harder to find the option to access photo albums. Scaling the size of profile and cover pics is very limited.

title: Please Fix Notifications
review:
I do not like how you’ve changed Notifications to immediately remove the ones I’ve looked at. Sometimes I need to go back to them. Many times new notifications will appear for a second and then disappear so I don’t even know who has commented on what. 

Also I don’t like how if I don’t look at a Notification it just stays for days until it’s finally moved too far down the list to see. 

And I can’t make it too far down my list because there’s a weird glitch that stops my scrolling when I’m not very far into Notifications.

title: Brenda Hymel
review: I’m locked out of Facebook and I haven’t done anything wrong except to try and try over again. I’m 69 and I know little about all the things on my phone. I sometimes press the wrong buttons. I depend on my daughter and granddaughters to fix my mistakes. My phone number and password are not excepted. I don’t know what to do. Can someone please help me, please.

title: Love FB
review: What can I say... despite the scrutiny over privacy, I still love FB and the way it keeps me connected to such a diverse group of people (family and friends) from throughout my life.  Interface and performance is always great, and I also leverage many of the business tools and manage several group pages.  Can’t imagine life without it!

title: Notification Alerts!
review: I keep getting notifications for items that I have already viewed and acknowledged. This happens every time I open the app (since I updated to this current version), there is the number in red alerting me that I have new notifications however when I click on it all I see are the same notifications that I already viewed. Annoying!

title: Update made it worse
review:
Last few updates have made the app a lot worse off. Besides being kicked off every 3 mins. The screen locks up and boots you. 
You news feed only shows you a few new post now and will miss everything else. 
Most recent post only show maybe two or 3 new ones. Only adds post if you load it up and not many. 
Searching for people now dose nothing, on app or on a computer now. 
Far as I can tell, updates just take more room and for them to get your info. Otherwise the updates should be called downgrades.

review: One of my friend on Facebook named Mon Kyaesorn(his profile pic is him with a new haircut and looking like he dapping) his account got hacked and the hacker started sending links to everyone one of his friend. Please please please please please I’m begging and tell me if there is anyone he can contact to report about hacked accounts

title: Annoying wi-fi connection
review: I hate the fact that you HAVE to be connected to a wi-fi to download AND to update the app. I wish there was a way you can remove an entire list of ‘friends’ rather than doing it once at a time and each time being asked twice if you’re sure or not. (Because I need thousands of friends deleted ASAP) It’s terrible at alerting you of unfamiliar log ins, I have people logged into my account from places I’ve never even been before. Also if you’re in a relationship as a your status you’re going to get spammed by your partners activity.

title: Notification settings
review:
Both myself and my wife (and I’m sure there are many more) no longer get close friends notifications. I put a request in for the community through Facebook and no help . Tried to get help through support , no help or way to do that . 

So here is the issue : settings / notification / close friends 

My box is unchecked ( something I did not uncheck ! ) so when I check the box a red banner appears that says : your changes could not be saved 

I’ve been a Facebook user since like 2009 and actually considering deleting it due to the lack of support . Seriously ! What is Facebook if you can’t interact with your friends and family ? So now I’ve become a stalker of sorts because you have to actually look up the friend and scroll through their page and do the things that you’d normally get notifications for . Come on Facebook ...... FIX THIS !!!!

title: Discouraged to the max
review:
I have been blocked from posting the s tuque jewelry and decorative items that I was inherited. My posts have not been visible for a month or so and I have reported this over and over Joined the help communicuty forum signed the petition did everything possible and all I receivedis a thanks for reporting we are working to fix this feature 
I am quite upset as many people across the globe are having this issue
There s no FB customer service or support for us to go to and more importantly be hear and get these issues fixed
Please FB step up and fix these issues

title: Freezing app
review: There isn’t very much to complain about when it comes to this app...I use it daily (more than I should) and it works really well most of the time. However, I have found recently that my app will just not load about 4 times a day. I’ll quit the app and reopen it and it’s fine. It’s not a huge deal but it is pretty annoying and I’d love to see some improvement in that.

title: Too many notifications
review: I have always loved Facebook but there are way too many notifications I don’t want. This past update I started receiving notifications on people I don’t follow or pages I have never even liked. Just because I don’t like or view many pages doesn’t mean I need notifications on thousands of different sites. Also, the live video notifications from friends need to stop. I don’t want to see those notifications every time someone goes live. Please fix this problem

title: Too many fake sales Sponsored Ads.
review:
Too many sponsored ads that seem like legit places to buy stuff turn out to be scams. Please start checking the credibility of the “sales” ads before allowing them to go out to the public. Also when I select a way to view my feed (newest) it should remain that way. Not revert back to show me things from yesterday or 3 days ago simply because someone commented on it. Just give me an alert for those and then I can sift through what I want to rehash. 
Other than that great app!!

title: Stop refreshing!
review: I hate that now when I “step away” from the app, say I briefly check something else and come back, the app refreshes! I can’t tell you how many times I’ve been reading an article or something and I get a text and I go to check the text and then when I come back to Facebook it’s refreshed. And of course the stupid algorithm Facebook uses doesn’t just push it farther down in my feed. It gives me like a completely new feed. I can never find what I was looking at again unless I know exactly who posted. It’s so annoying.  What is the point of that?!??

title: Mixed
review: Part of me loves Facebook because I’m able to connect with family far easier than in the old days when you wrote a letter. However, I too am finding the ads relentless as well as the requests for new friends, who happened to be friends with some of my other friends. I don’t wish to friend my friends, friends, nor do I want to see the perpetrator of a crime against me because he is connected to a friend, SO I BEG YOU, stop asking me to friend my friends, friends!

title: Uses location without permission
review:
So this app is very vey sneaky. I told the Facebook App (within the app) to NEVER use my location because it does not need to know. Randomly I’m noticing that this or that person is doing something near you showing up quite a bit. I immediately double checked my location settings (on the phone) and mysteriously Facebook was not there.

It appears that even though Facebook was told to never use my location, because it didn’t check in with the phone it was utilizing my location anyway. This is not a mistake. You don’t just forget to check in with the device that is supposed to share its location.

I had to enable location services for the iPhone to see it and then disable it again. Let’s see if that fixes the “mistake”.

This app is crap. I may just delete the Facebook account and forget using Facebook as a business medium.

title: Threatened
review: I’ve not been able to access my Facebook account several months, I called the customer service number and was told my account had been compromised. The conversation turned to someone in Florida and Bitcoins, VERY WEIRD! I gave access to via a secure site AnyDesk, conversation got stranger involving CashApp. The called dropped I call back and the second representative said “ma’am don’t call this number again” silence and the call disconnected. I’ve never thought a social media site would conduct their selves in that fashion. EXTREMELY disappointing

title: Restriction
review:
Let me just tell you how the last two days have went . I was restricted for 24 hours 
With no explanation why (not in my alerts) I reported it with no response, stayed off restriction for 8 hours and then put right back on it , in total I’ve reported this now 8 times and gotten no response, not only did you restrict my page you got my business page as well ! That’s how you treat small business it’s pitiful … there’s no one on the other end of reporting to help us and I’m truly over it and you should be ashamed

title: Facebook
review: Why is the Facebook app not opening up like I’ve gotta uninstall it and install it back just to get it to open after i sign back out it don’t load till I uninstall it and install it back like it’s getting old to do so if it’s not fixed I’ll probably just delete the app for good

title: SCAMS EVERYWHERE
review: Scammers have ZERO mercy. Every single day WITHOUT FAIL I am getting spam messages from people via messenger marketplace, and even the comments section of a post and it is getting worse by the day. This app is literally horrible. The Facebook management team is not doing anything against the constant spammers and at this point, old people can’t even use this app. This app is also constantly fact checking things that shouldn’t be fact checked. These people running this app is very hypocritical. Avoid this app at all costs!!

title: My dating profile disappeared
review: Today when the new Apple update became available to me, my face oil dating profile just disappeared. I’d been using it this morning, and then it just restarted like I’d never set it up before. This is beyond irritating, as I had already started connecting with people and I had my profile set how I wanted it… now it won’t even let me reset— I just keep getting error messages each time I try to redo it.   It’s like it’s completely crashed.

title: Leave well enough alone!
review:
Two updates since the scrolling stopped working and it isn’t fixed yet.  What exactly are these updates “fixing”?

After the next to last update scrolling is buggy and laggy when using the Feeds view. And even though it’s been gone for years the ability to make interest lists needs to be added back!

title: I stand with FaceBook
review: We recommend refraining from using Facebook if your behavior is detrimental or unethical. However, if you demonstrate kindness towards others and consistently show care towards animals, the elderly, or children, you can rely on the fact that there is no cause for concern. The decision is quite straightforward in this regard.

title: Logging in
review: Literally the app was fine until I had to re login because I got a new phone and it said my password was wrong but then it wouldn’t even let me reset the password. And I keep trying to re login but it’s not working. It won’t even let me make a new account and I’m literally about to cry to try to get my account back because I’ve done everything I can to try to get my account back and Facebook is just a horrible experience overall and I would not use this app if I were you

title: Horrible
review: This is the worst app. First of all my account was hacked not once but twice and I got completely locked out by hackers.  They changed my recovery email and cell # so I had no way to get back into my acct. I started a new account and I got hacked AGAIN about a week and a half later. I’m constantly seeing people get hacked. Do better Facebook. This is ridiculous. Second the amount of ads that were on my page was just non stop. I saw more ads than my friends posts. I’m done. Deleted the app off my phone.

title: Wish you could see more of cover picture at the top
review: I enjoy the app. I just wish you could see the full cover picture at the top. The profile picture needs to be moved down a little.  It’s impossible to fix it where you can see my whole family of six up there or even just my 4 children.

title: App has become difficult to navigate
review: I haven’t used the app in a few months and have found the new design update to be very frustrating. The “Add friend” button changing location as you scroll has caused me to accidentally send multiple friend requests when I was trying to find someone’s profile. It’s also become harder to navigate privacy and security settings, as they’ve been broken up into different sections.

title: Notifications
review: What’s up with the new Notifications area on the app. It doesn’t go away when you see the notification and it never changes and keeps the old stuff up. This is the worst “improvement” made because it’s just annoying to think there’s a new notification and it’s just the same crap you’ve seen 100+ times. Please take it back to the way it was or fix it with something better because it’s just annoy.

title: I agree too many ads.
review: I agree there are too many ads. If I try to watch a video they are interrupted two or three times. Even it it were something might be interested in I won’t buy because the ad is a nuisance. I want to buy something I will look it up when I want to check it out. Show one ad before the video and charge a bit more as I am more receptive and likely to sit through a 20 second ad but to hit me with a barrage of ads Interrupting the video I quick and move on to something else.

title: Overwhelming numbers of fake accounts and lack of ability to help
review: In the last few months, I have been overwhelmed with the amount of fake accounts of people I’m already friends with being created. The frustrating part is when you report it, Facebook doesn’t accept your reports, which is ridiculous. The end of this app seems to come closer every day because of the lack of quality control and the overwhelming policy control that they seem to care more about.

title: Too many suggested for you posts
review: There are way too many “Suggested for you” posts, which makes it much harder to see posts from friends and family. An easy fix would be to allow users to turn off suggested posts, or snooze them like you can on Instagram. Of course Facebook also has much more systemic issues, especially with content moderation and misinformation, but the “Suggested for you” thing seems like a relatively simple thing to fix that would at least make Facebook useable.

title: Needs dark mode bad
review:
I’m use Facebook on my phone several times a day but every time I try to use it on my iPad everything looks terrible. I just use my browser for now but leave the app installed for notifications. Right now the iPad version of this app is unusable to be without dark mode. Unbelievable that they still haven’t update yet. If they have it for the phone app is it really that different that they can’t update the iPad version? Ridiculous and embarrassing honestly.

Update: April 8, 2023 - Still no dark mode

title: Sad
review: Do enjoy a feed of sponsored ads and weeks old reposts from TikTok with a heathy does of low effort poor quality angry right wing boomer memes that you have zero interest in? Maybe see an occasion post from people you actually care about with no chronology? Perhaps you enjoy supporting a company with no ethics who have disrespected their users privacy and have brought zero innovation into the social media sphere for decades, and who’s only new features in the last ten years has been trying to tack on what made their competitors popular? It’s Founder has my highest respect as an intelligent, dedicated CEO young enough to remain vibrant and independent in the fast paced and often politicized arena of social media.

review:
I click on the icon app on my iPad but it refuses to open since the last update. I do not get in more than a couple of times a week so I did not realize this right away.  Do I need to delete the app and reload it?

Also I clicked on the email notifications and got in thru my browser only to find the new and improved version is completely changed. FB deactivated my account and they are asking for personal information to possibly get it back. Things like my drivers license, birth certificate, passport, etc.  I didn’t want to do that so I was going to create a new account. review:
Face book could be a positive way to connect and communicate with friends and family, but unfortunately it’s a non stop stream of trash adds and marketing garbage. 
It looks at you contact list and makes suggestions for friends based of the phone numbers you have. If that wasn’t creepy enough, if you even mentioned anything about blow drying your hair around your devices with the Facebook app, it’ll immediately start bombarding you with hair dryer adds. Thanks Facebook, just what I needed....

So now I’m constantly Searching for any apps I can find to bridge the wireless-ness of it & meanwhile FB “updates” 3 times a week & is in constant download mode,  so I’ve been using messenger only til they can get this fixed & finished

review: Facebook keeps crashing. Has an save post button, but every time I go to saved none of the content is there. On top of saving info I did not give permission to do so. Seems as though the minute I selected for Facebook to not receive information my Facebook spontaneously shuts off including messenger. I have to literally power off my phone and turn back on just to get a decent TL w/out any issues but that only last maybe an hour. At this point seriously considering uninstalling the app and going back to website login

title: Got what I paid for 😢
review: Yep, it’s free. Yep, it’s constantly seizing up or shutting my iPad down. Yep, I really enjoy my gardening and travel groups, as well as videos and marketplace. Yep, still free. Yep, the weird, usually completely useless additions/changes to marketplace are worth less than I paid. Free. Don’t get me started on the ridiculous bots blocking ads for photos of birds but allowing marijuana paraphernalia and endless counterfeit designer handbags. Still free. Yep, customer service is rudely non existent. Nope, don’t even try. I try not to have unrealistic expectations, especially when it’s free, but wow, why is FB getting worse and worse? Worse. Yep.

title: Force Closing
review:
For weeks now the app constantly force closes any time I open a post that is a link to a site. It also constantly refreshes the site if it doesn’t close the app immediately. 

I also can’t go between apps on my iPad for even seconds without this app refreshing and going back to the top of the feed. I mean literal seconds too because I will open a link and click to open in safari to be able to read it, click right back on FB and it will start over again.

title: Nasty bug not fixed
review:
IpadIOS 13.4.1 most recent release makes Facebook useless. The notifications list freezes when it tries to load the list, leaving a blank page.  IPad Air 2.  Unfortunately, Facebook is useless without the list as you can’t figure out to who you need to respond. Worse, running in a browser mangles the text you type in  when autocorrect is on (and it always is). So, in effect, no Facebook on this device. 

You’d think with its ton of brilliant developers (lol) they could fix a minimal problem like this, but no.  Apparently, no time for it.

title: Fast, Simple, and Purposeful
review:
No major complains. The app is easy to use, has a ton of features and functionality, and still manages to feel fast and smooth, making the user experience seamless.

Facebook Watch seems promising but it needs more high quality content to compete with the big boys in the media streaming business.

title: Ridiculous updates all the time
review: The last update now forces you to click to continue watching a video even though I’ve already stopped scrolling and I’m watching the video in silence in my news feed. When you click to continue it takes you to another page and automatically adds noise. There’s a reason most videos have subtitles, so you can watch them without disturbing people around you or interrupt a meeting at work. Think about your audience before you make silly updates just so you can say you are doing your job.

title: Boost and friend suggestions run amok
review: Annoying new problem: as I scroll, iPhone app shows me the same things on my feed after every four or five posts. My profile is connected with my workplace page, so I am constantly goaded to boost posts that only show up there. Also, it shows me “people you might know“ - suggesting I friend people -  every four or five posts. And yes, I click “hide this” and “show me fewer of these” over and over but they keep showing up  in my feed at intervals of every 4-5 items.

title: They can’t fix marketplace.
review:
Just got a brand new iPad. Facebook had been crashing the old one every time I opened MarketPlace. Guess what? It’s not the iPad. Yeah, I assumed it wasn’t, but I would have thought a fix would have been forthcoming by now. If I were one of the paying advertisers on the platform, I’d be screaming bloody murder.
This has been an issue since they launched it. You’re a multi BILLION dollar corporation. Either fix it or scrap the whole thing and start over.

title: Facebook is GREAT
review: Facebook is a great app to use if you are trying to keep up with classmates, colleagues, family, friends and employees. It helps you keep in contact with old friends and relative, also keeps you up to date about current events and news going on in your area. I recommend this app to people over the age of 18

title: Lots of glitches
review: The Facebook app seems to have a lot of glitches. Sometimes I type a comment on a post and it doesn’t send. Sometimes I type a comment and it posts it twice. They experience system outages apparently but never post an advisory so you think something is wrong with your phone. Most of the time, I’ve now learned that the problem is FB. How about investing some of your billions of dollars in profits into your equipment Facebook???

title: Public Group posts
review: I wish you guys would allow me to decide who can see my posts on a public group. For example if I would rather the members of the group to be the only ones to view the post then there should be an option saying that Only Members Can View This Post along with the public option. If I have friends that are in the same group as me then they would be the only friends that can see it.

title: Marketplace
review: Ever since the last update, I’ve had problems with Marketplace and the other seller groups. When I want to make a change to my post and click on “Save”, the screen goes black. And the only way I can get back in, is to turn off my iPhone or iPad to get back into Facebook. In addition, the change/s were not saved. The only way to truly make any changes is to delete the post and repost. Very frustrating.

title: Not being able to post pictures
review: I can post a normal status update but once I add a picture to it, it doesn’t post. I’m not a bot, I have full bars and WiFi, and it was working fine last week. I’ve tried reporting the problem multiple times, there’s no number or email that I can find for help on Facebook. It’s getting really irritating not being able to share pictures with my family about life events that are happening soon. Please get this fixed, my pregnant self is not in the mood to start cussing and over reacting on this. GET IT FIXED.

title: Facebook is Trash Now!
review: Doesn't even deserve a 1 star. They have shut down my account by saying im not who i am after giving them my ID and 100 other things. Then i delete my old account thats 7 years old to make a new one then they want me to verify this account cause apparently I'm not who i say i am and want me to add my phone number i do and they say its not a valid mobile number? So now i cant even access my account. Some people dont even have mobile numbers smh. Dont even waste your time download one of the other 10 social media platforms.

title: Logged out accounts
review: The app overall is amazing, I use it daily! My only problem is that sometimes I let my friends use my phone and they sign into their accounts which is fine, but I don’t like that when you log out you still get that account pop up, like their logo. I would like to eliminate those other accounts but there is no option for it

title: Unhappy with New Updates!! October 2019
review: The last update messed up the Notifications. I click on the bell & click on the new update and it is NOT taking me to the new comment... very unhappy with this! If you make frequent posts and you try to stay up to date with the comments of others, you have to scroll through EVERYTHING to find the posts you commented on and have to check each one because the notification is not working correctly. This is only happening on my iPad, my Samsung Note & Laptop are both fine... Please fix the iPad app!!!

title: Quails
review: You gave me a print of a painting you did probably 40 years ago to thank me for taking care of your children for a day when we were neighbors in Hampton, Va. I can still access and purchase on marketplace, and I can make a post on marketplace but absolutely no one can see it or find it. Same goes for buy/sell groups. I’ve tried reporting probably 8 times with just a generic feedback message. I want my account back! Deleting the app until this is fixed, otherwise I will continue to stew over it even more.

title: Getting worse
review:
The newest problem is when I receive a link to a Facebook page through messenger and, when I try to open it, FB takes me to the profile page instead of the actual post. So I have not been able to see the content in Facebook or messenger for many posts I’ve received the last few weeks. My work around, was to delete the app, and now the messages display in messenger.

Also, battery drain is remarkably bad and the app stores too much data.

Thanks

title: Does everything except what you want
review:
This app no longer lets you do the things you most want to do, like wish friends happy birthday quickly and easily, now you
just make a fancy card even for old acquaintances. You can no longer look at your own photos. Seriously. Try to find your photos and photo albums other than your profile pic. Can’t be done. They always take things that aren’t broken and break them—or remove them. And then add tons of distractions you don’t care about. Every day I contemplate ways to walk away from this thing.

title: Facebook news feed won’t load
review: It was working fine and now it won’t load the news feed. Please fix asap also the activities/feelings section isn’t working. I tried to load something about a movie I was watching, so I went to that section and hit watching then hit the name of the movie and it never showed up on newsfeed or hone page, this is a problem that needs to get fixed now!!! Also this problem is only not working on my home computer my cell phone works fine but it needs to be fixed on my computer now!!!

title: Performance slow now a days
review: I feel that there is some change either the technology used or due to heavy load but I feel that Facebook App performance has dramatically reduced. For loading few uploads now a days it’s taking more than 30sec - 1+min. Initially I thought it was my mobile problem but I feel the same with other phones and even on laptops with different OS. It good to keep changing and secure as users growing but user experience and latency matters a lot to. Hoping to look for better performance.

title: “Post as button is gone in app version”
review: I run an art page separate from my personal page and since the last update the “post as” button is gone... I’m no longer able to post as page creator, only as my personal page profile which moves all of my posts to “visitor posts”. I tried to submit a ticket to fb about this issue since the last update but when I hit submit it said “unable to process your request” this is not helpful. We update the app to get rid of bugs not to loose the ability to post. Please fix this.

title: Another unnecessary update
review:
Horrible update!!

I have disliked each update. It was so much easier and user friendly when you could just open FB and get the most recent feeds. Now, when changed to most recent - the screen is totally different - as in a mirror image of the desktop version. To save a picture, you can’t just click on it to save - you have to go through 3 steps. Why can’t you just set your preference to most recent instead of ‘top friends’? Getting worse and more tedious to use. Using other social media more and more.

title: Don’t even bother
review: You know Facebook use to be a great social media page but here within the last couple years it has really gone down hill. I remember a time where it would run smoothly with hardly any bugs. Seems now that there’s a different bug with each and every “update”. I’ve finally decided to delete the app from my phone. Not gonna miss much since it hadn’t been working correctly anyway. So social media community get rid of this trash app and we can only hope there’s an alternative being thought of in the works.

title: Most recent
review:
Someone on the development teams needs to learn what “most recent” means. Stop trying to force us view things you think are relevant. Most recent means that the newest posts go on top. Not a post from yesterday that no one has even commented on. Or a post from a page I like that was posted 12 hours ago. 

It’s frustrating enough on Twitter but at least there’s fewer sponsored posts to annoy me. I’ve found myself spending a lot more time there because your new formatting and structure are ridiculous.

title: Broken and frustrating.
review:
The official Facebook app malfunctions badly when typing and editing text, frequently erases unsubmitted entries when switching back to the app from a link I want to share, and is generally unreliable.

I get multiple notifications from the same update in a Group. I have to manually refresh the Group page to even see the new posts, even when visiting for the first time that day, and notifications are not bringing me directly to the items they represent.

Everything is chock-full of ads, and it’s all just a huge hassle.

Their system needs to be updated or something better because I don’t wanna wait weeks till my Id is looked at to get my Facebook turned back on. This is ridiculous!

review: I don’t like Facebook because they look through my phone and get information about me it keep asking do I wanna add my number which I never gave them but they have it any way. Also it give me ads on stuff I visit on the web. Instagram is way better. Set your settings to private and no worries of anyone but your friends can see your stuff. You have to go through all those settings to put your stuff private on Facebook. That’s why I have the app and don’t use it. Also comments on blacks videos are turned off. Why????

title: Notifications bug and lots of issues!!
review: Used to work swimmingly, but when I have 1 or 2 notifications the app shows me I have “14+” for the app. Also, you have it showing 1 notifications within the messenger app with nothing there when clicking on it. Finally, you cannot delete people from the messenger app that you have a conversation with but do not have connection on Facebook, they pop up on who’s online to talk to and there needs to be a way to delete people from your list who you are not fb friends with! It should be an option!!

title: Awful
review:
I will agree with almost every other complaint about huge updates weekly. If you must force us to update weekly, then give us specifics instead of the same “improvements” speech for the update description. 

Also, NOT A FAN of the new pictures look on the newsfeed! It is awful. The rounded pictures that look so strange having to swipe instead of a collage look like it used to be. I do not like it one bit. 

And I have reported this issue many times before and saw other complaints of other fellow users that the newsfeed doesn’t load all the way. Last night I refreshed the newsfeed and TWO posts showed up. Just two! I don’t mean it just added two new posts to the previous ones, I mean there were only 2 posts showing on the entire newsfeed. Crazy. Please FIX!

Facebook, you are edging me closer and closer to deleting the continuously worsening app.

I also have a issue of even updating I’m not seeing current post it shows me week old post!! This is bs I’m also not receiving tags

review:
First thing is that Facebook releases updates on weekly basis, people who are on limited budget they can’t update it every week, so they should launch updates at least on monthly basis..

The second issue is its size being gradually increased, it’s now almost half a GB.. I don’t know why it’s to be 519MBs.. So, the size of both the apps Facebook and its companion messenger app must not exceed 100MBs so that people could download it over cellular data plan..

review: I feel like cattle. Cattle in a heard of other cattle just watching ads all day. What happened to Facebook? I honestly can’t stand it any more so I’m just going to significantly reduce the amount of time I spend Facebook indefinitely. Although it’s a tiny revenue drop, I was a heavy user of the app. Maybe I will return someday when I can focus on the content and not be constantly interrupted by ads.

review: I stay getting locked out of my Facebook accounts saying they are “reviewing” my profile for security purposes when it’s ME I have a quite big amount of friends in fb and have always been really popular on Facebook and there is a bunch of fake profiles of me that have NOT been taken down but when it’s legit me I keep getting locked out they should look more into all this security stuff because they are doing it all the way wrong I love Facebook but this is extremely annoying

title: Ads
review:
I would like to know since when did Facebook became a “Adsbook”? Not only I am bombarded with adds daily that I am definitely don’t want to see but also Facebook limits me how many of them I can delete/remove.
This is ridiculous, I turned of everything I could find not to receive ads and I still have a ton of them dropping every day....plus, when my info is being sold then why I am not the one benefiting from it??? This is an outrageous act from you geeks, if there would be option to give you a negative 1* I would give it to you....you deserve it!!!

It is impossible if you are involved in many groups & posts to follow any comments or likes. I even uninstalled & reinstalled. This is making it unbearable trying to manage the support groups I moderate. Fix this pleeeaaassseee!!!!

Put up more suggested pages I might like based on the pages I already like and show pictures or memes of those pages in the newsfeed to catch attention. Keep suggested friends in newsfeed.

title: App closes every 5 seconds
review: Since last update the app closes frequently taking you back to your home screen causing you have to reopen and losing the order and what you were reading. I posted on FB if anyone else is having the problem and a lot of my friends are no matter their providers. Some as much as every 15 seconds it closes some one to five times a day. It happens on both my husbands and my phone we thought it was our phones. It apparently is not as so many others are having the same issue. Come on FB fix this bug

title: Nothing loads and keeps kicking me off, even with all updates
review: I’ve tried for 2 weeks to report several problems with FACEBOOK, and I continue to have the same problems.  Nothing loads on my newsfeed, and I am now constantly getting kicked off.  I’ve deleted the app, reloaded the app, deleted all data, updated everything and have the latest FB updates.  Frustrating when you use FB to keep in contact with family members and friends. title: Not bad, needs a little work
review:
Facebook can be wonderful and useful.
This app does make it easier on smartphones however were are all the app settings under settings? They've been gone for a while now. 
and SERIOUSLY important.... Why does the app insist on refreshing when I'm reading something, go to another app (like to answer a text) come back and what I was reading is gone and I'm back to the top of the app. BTW turning off Background refresh in OS x, has no affect.

title: Will it EVER not be terrible?
review: Years in, this is still one of the most awful, maddening apps from a major tech company. Searching for anything returns wildly polluted results, sometimes it imports contacts, sometimes it doesn’t, no matter how many times you reject a suggested friend they just keep reappearing. My much-detested ex is there staring back at me over and over and over again. It just shows you that when there is only one giant player and no realistic competition, they have zero compulsion to produce a good product. This really is a terrible app that is unlikely to ever get better.

title: It's cool
review: I certainly get more value out of this app than not. Helps me stay in touch with my clients friends and family. I use it to find out intimate details about my prospects and clients which in turn allows me to make a very agreeable living since my entire income revolves around genuine relationships. Thank you Facebook for helping me stay in touch with everyone.

title: Tired of pop up ads!
review: I love Facebook but I get angry and frustrated when I am trying to read a news article or a medical article or a political article and I have to scroll past sleazy advertisements for products that neither I nor any of my friends would want to purchase. title: bad
review:
I have to say, I recently downloaded the Facebook app and it's been a real hoot! By "hoot" I mean, it's been like watching a trainwreck in slow motion.

First of all, I can't seem to scroll for more than five seconds without seeing a political argument or a post about someone's cat. And don't even get me started on the "suggested friends" feature. Apparently, Facebook thinks I want to be friends with my ex's new girlfriend, my dentist's cousin, and my neighbor's dog.

But the real kicker was when I accidentally hit the "like" button on a post from 2012. Suddenly, all my friends were notified that I was into "Gangnam Style" and that I had a crush on Justin Bieber. I haven't lived that one down yet.

Overall, I give the Facebook app two thumbs down and a recommendation to uninstall immediately unless you want to embarrass yourself in front of all your acquaintances.

review: Facebook used to be good… Until it got political. To me it’s just another dying app. This app is basically a retirement home cause the only users left are our grandparents reading fake news articles believing in every single word cause they don’t know how to verify or cross check references to see if they are true. review:
I am fully disappointed with fb after 14 yrs. The list is loooong, but I will list a few. I am absolutely shocked that fb and instagram are hiding all news/info about the current boycotts in France!! title: Fix a few features
review:
Wow the spambots for IG really took over here! If you think these reviews are genuine o feel sorry for you.

title: Lost It’s Foundation
review: The app used to be about keeping up with friends, but not anymore. It’s about influencing a greater political divide, sharing news articles full of click bait, and selling items. You don’t see all of your friends’ posts, as the app will decide for you who you do and don’t see, but don’t worry, it shows you all of the ads!!! Facebook is out to shut down other social media sites too because it can’t compete anymore. Stay out of our government and go back to just being a website.

title: No engagement
review:
While automatically seeing updates about friends and family is nice. The algorithm they use for recommendations is less than useless. I don’t know how many times I have been show the exact same post. Some keep showing up year after year. 
The communities centered in Facebook are always slow and unengaging. Pages with millions of followers may get a post every other week.
News is unvetted and bias, content is low is quality, and outside your real connections there is no engagement.

title: Facebook
review: I loved the app up to about three days ago.  Then out of nowhere the app no longer has the videos to watch icon.  Not just the shortcut but the entire thing is not even an option.  I find it suspect as my wife and my son still both have this option, I have the same phone with the same updates yet my option for this is gone.  Can someone please explain?  I had it earlier in the day and then by early evening it was gone.  Absolute trash without this option for me.

I get barraged with ads and “suggested for you” Posts though. The news is terrible too, if there is a breaking national or global news event, you have to go searching for it. I have blocked what they call fact checkers cause they only check what they want not everything or they do not call out stories when it aligns with them even if it’s not true. Seriously disappointed with the site and wish I had another avenue to reach my friends and family on such a large scale without the sensor hounds .

review: I love sharing posts with family and friends.  Also a great way to record your family happenings to look back on when memories are shown on anniversary dates.  It had been a good site to keep up with news and happenings, but their censorship has killed this function as they tag or delete posts they don’t agree with.  Very in-American and may lead to me dropping Facebook soon.  Alternatives are coming available and it appears to be just a matter of time until Facebook shoots itself in the foot and reloads.

title: Censorship
review: Facebook has become like something that I would have never thought it would become. Many people have a Facebook to share things and express their concerns. I don’t know why Facebook needs to censor anything at all. People have the right to their own opinion but Facebook doesn’t believe that at all. Some people need to grow up they are not in elementary school and should put their big panties on and quit being such wimps. If someone has a different belief then their own they should be able to scroll on and quit whining!!!!

title: Fakebook has taken a down turn
review: First of all, our business account was hacked, email and phone number changed .There is zero support and we are now at the mercy of the hacker. Secondly, the platform has gone downhill from even a few years ago. My posts are sensored, I’m not seeing friends and I am being bombarded with nonsense ads and political bs without asking or even searching. The algorithms are skewed and I am seeing posts from people I’m not even friends with . Time to move on to better more open platforms that allow free speech and don’t try to gaslight me.

title: Disgusted at FB deciding what I can watch
review: If I wanted some random company to decide what I could and could not watch, I’d move to China. Facebook should be ashamed of themselves for taking it upon themselves to censor posts (beyond the obvious expected removal of sick stuff like child porn or real murder or torture or something). Cannot believe they are removing pages that have been up for years and have high levels of followers. Sickening that FB has decided they are in complete charge of my media decisions. Shame on each participating employee that could stand up and fix this issue and hasn’t.

title: No first amendment rights allowed here
review: I used to love Facebook but things have been going downhill for years and 2020 has been the worst! We have no first amendment rights on this platform. I highly recommend you look elsewhere for your social media needs. If you want to talk about freedoms, patriotism, natural health, conservative values, etc. it’s not allowed on this platform, this is communism pure and simple. This is not a platform that supports all Americans and their freedoms. I’m so disappointed to see Facebook become such a useless platform when it used to be a great place to interact with others!

title: Fascistbook loves to censor
review:
I had Facebook for roughly 14-15 years. Same Facebook page, same pictures. It wasn’t until very recently (within the past year) that decided to do their own censoring and blocking people that don’t fit into their category or agenda. 

They are a very biased company that will only cater to their own people that follow them blindly like sheep. 

Now that I haven’t had it, I’ve found time to do other things. So I guess in a way, I should be thanking them. No more sinking my time into their useless social media. There are better apps out there, like Parler and MeWe.

title: Why would we?
review: Facebook wants access to all use and activity on our phones, yet they want to censor and control what we believe, what we see, who gets promoted and who gets deleted.  This, on top of the fact that the app operates so poorly now that they have put all of their censoring filters and lying fact checkers in place that many pictures are “not available”, the feed is so slow it is nearly inoperable and now, pharmaceutical company ads are filling up our feed.  No, thank you.  Deleted, along with your intrusive and data collecting messenger app.

title: Cmas
review:
I’m giving them a 1 star.   Would give them 0 if available.   Tired of being censored even when I know that what I post is verified.   I do not want big tech companies controlling what news and info I am allowed to see.  I am quite capable of doing my own research on “any” information that is posted.

They now just refuse to let any post they do not agree with be posted on the news feed.  They do not post any comment about not being facts because if they do they lose their immunity as a information platform and become a publisher, which can be sued.

title: Latest update
review:
Your description never tells us what is “improved”. Some of the changes are not for the better. Some of your changes are ill advised. Seems like you make changes for the sake of change. If it ain’t broke don’t fix it. Now I’m seeing friends post that I have unfollowed because I didn’t want to see their posts. Now if I don’t want to see their post I have to unfriend them entirely.
If only there was a better platform. Oh wait.  There is a better platform. And they don’t censor.

title: Censorship
review: I’m not one to post a lot of political comments these days, as times are so raw right now. However, I used to be able to click on articles and read just about anything that I liked. Nowadays, if those articles have been deemed false by some invisible individual, probably half my age, I can’t even make the determination, as that article has already been censored. Feeling a little bit like we are in Communist China. Wondering if this comment will also get censored. Is this really the United States of America? I thought Facebook was supposed to be a publisher.

title: I Will Not Be Censored ! ! !
review: When I first came to Facebook 10 years ago, I was amazed and very happy that I could reconnect with old friends and family that I hadn’t talked to for years. All the way up to the 2020 election, I thought Facebook was the greatest thing since sliced bread, but that was when the whole thing went Socialist, and straight into the toilet. They have categorically ended our rights as described and guaranteed by the 2nd amendment of our Constitution. They have blatantly usurped authority that they are not entitled to and I hope everyone who was a party to this theft goes to jail, is heavily fined, or both.

title: Unfair restrictions on account
review:
On a Political page making a comment on who I supported for POTUS and why. Had a man come on and replied to my post being very vulgar making sexual comments toward my wife and kids. I made the comment that he wouldn’t say that to my face or I’d knock his teeth out. 
Account is restricted for 30 days? 
He is still online making vulgar comments while all I can do is view until my 30 days is up. 
Well I say enough censorship from a group that is one sided. Either you agree with FB or you bow to their decisions that is a socialist run company so bye bye I’m off to WimKin

title: Biased and Controlling
review:
I hate the fact that I can’t see the post of my friends because I’m limited to just a few I hate the fact that Facebook now has fact checkers that post things that are blatantly untrue about the election. Stay out of politics!  Open up your program so I can see all my friends and posts.
I also hate it that Facebook allows all of the Chinese companies to take advantage of us they are pirates and they advertise clothes and send you something completely different or not at all and steal your money. It is horrid that Facebook allows it!

title: Disgusting
review:
I grew up in a socialist country, where moderators censored your words and your opinions. I find it disgusting to see how Facebook utilices the same techniques for the same purpose; to control the voices of free people for the advancement of Socialism, an ideology that is foreign to this land and has been proven to be a failure around the world. 

If you want to continue to control what people say and press the button of censorship denying The People their freedom of speech then why not move your operations to a country that is more in tune with your ideas. 

You are a disgrace to the rights and freedoms this great nation has always stood for!!!

title: Go to Parler, MeWe, or some other app...
review: Facebook censorship is unreal! On November 13th I posted a historical even link that happened on that day in 1966 during the Vietnam War from Wikipedia and  my account was suspended for 3 days... title: Dear FB
review: Like an abusive, gaslighting, narcissistic, addictive relationship I’m leaving you. You have betrayed my trust, stolen my information and sold it for your own gain, lied to me and to my friends and family. You’ve scrutinized everything about me all while acting like you like me. You spy on my every post you ban me from speaking my mind when it’s not what you think is right. You sell a lie wrapped in commercialization and fake friendliness all while creating your own agenda of division through your manipulation and lies. 8 years of being a frog in the boiling pot of water and I’m jumping out.

title: Not a fan
review:
Facebook suddenly decides to censor EVERYTHING. Not even just political stuff -‘tried to post some clothes for sale on marketplace and they were flagged . Thank you, Mark Zuckerberg.

title: Inconvenient
review: I’ve dealt with Facebooks inconsistency when it came to properly loading pages, or not updating notifications. But since the last update Facebook has been randomly force quitting, it doesn’t allow me to change privacy on post, and it’s repeatedly logged me out of messenger and I have to log myself back in. I mostly use Facebook to stay connected with my family but if it means I have very little control as to how I connect with them I think I’ll end up erasing it.

Especially because it only works 5% of the time and shows me the same posts or posts from days ago instead of the most recent items, regardless of my settings.

review: The app is closing on me over and over. I go to the App Store to update the app and it doesn’t update. My phone has a software update that I’m manually tryin to do but it won’t yet. I can be in the chat watching the messages pop up and won’t get a notification from messenger but will still get a notification from Facebook saying so and so sent you a message. It gets annoying fast. I can’t remember when it started really. But if there is a way you can fix this please do!

title: Same posts even if I refresh
review:
I’m getting the same posts over and over even if I refresh the app, restart my phone and close all of my apps. I have something like 500 friends and likes so to keep having to see the same 5 or 6 is annoying. 

Also when I am reading something like a link or post, the app will randomly refresh and there is no rhyme or reason to be able to get back to it. I don’t like the algorithm that’s happening right now. Let it start from most recent and go from there. 

Also, I get random notifications that someone has posted in a group and when I click on it, it takes me to a completely random structure of posts and doesn’t take time to the post I clicked on. 

If I don’t open Facebook on Saturday and Sunday, I don’t want to keep seeing the same 5 posts that people posted on Saturday or Sunday over and over.

title: Fb event notifications are GONE
review:
Fb constantly has post from 5 mins ago, yesterday, a week ago, followed by 2 seconds ago?!? What the literally F?!?

And now I get ZERO fb event notifications and I mean ZERO!!! It doesn’t tell me when someone invites me to anything but yet I ALWAYS. Get notified when Ellen updates anything why idk? To see when I get events I have to be aware and click the events tab!! Then if anyone posts to the event I NEVER get the update 🤬 or reminders! I have missed SOOO many events!!!

title: What has FB become?
review:
Used to be a great place for engaging with friends, used to be able to spend so much time on here. Not now, I can’t stand it for more than a minute. FB has become some sort of brainwashing tool that makes the general population dumber. It’s all propaganda. 
News feed is filled with nothing but advertising, and political paid for ads and BS. People still log on because it’s how they have kept up with people for years.... but Soon, someone will develop a new better product because everyone is looking for it, FB will become the new myspace.

title: Guess it doesn’t want me to use it?
review:
So when I try to log in since the most recent update it pops up message saying I can no longer use the app for free and I need to purchase it in the App Store, when I click take me to the App Store it says I own it and to open the app, which then starts the cycle again, even after I uninstall and reinstall.

For a while I’ve been debating uninstalling because of the privacy violations with it staying in the background and collecting information (such as our banks) but this just makes it that much easier.

title: Notifications bell
review:
I thought maybe I'd try here. 
I was really enjoying the FB app until the notifications bell at the bottom of the app just stopped working. 
Now I don't know when someone likes my posts or comments. I don't know when someone comments on my posts or replies to my comments. I don't know when groups I belong to put up new posts. 
All I can do is scroll through my home screen or check on my past posts or individual friends. 
Using FB was supposed to help me stay up to date on my friends, family, and groups. But now it's just a pain to try to figure out what's going on. 
I'd really love to get this fixed. 
I tried to look on the FB app for help. That section is awful. I've tried googling. Seems others have had this same problem, but with no real help or resolution. 
It's frustrating. 
If FB fixes it, I'll upgrade my review.

title: No info in new updates
review:
When there is a new update for Facebook app or messenger there should be an explanation what exactly is being done/fixed and not some generic same sentence each time “We update the app regularly so we can make it better for you. This version includes several bug fixes and performance improvements”. 
We want to know what bugs you are fixing and improvements you are making. Please list them all specifically for all your apps (Facebook, messenger, Instagram) like most other companies do for their apps.

title: Still a slow bloated app...
review:
Still a slow bloated app. Now all I can see is one or two recent posts and then it just hangs. Plus the new “ continue watching “ makes you not want to watch videos on this app. Just as bad as the annoying mid stream ads. 

How can you constantly screw up this app?  It's pretty much unusable after the recent updates. It freezes and is really slow. I don't understand how you can be this bad at keeping things as they were. We want a stable app, not one that changes every week. Fix it and leave it alone!

title: Maybe it’s just my account?
review: I can’t change my life events and when I try to update my college status to graduated, the screen turns blank white with no buttons for me to click so I have to clear the app completely. It’s been like this for a month and I’ve updated it so many times it’s driving me insane. Also I can’t change my password it keeps blocking the option to allow me to change my password.

review: *facebook dating is interesting but i should be able to view all of them the people who “liked” me instead of deciding whether i “like” someone or not before being able to see who the new person is?? i should be able to view all of the people who liked my profile in facebook dating without having to automatically “like” or “no thanks” them! Basically I’m not using the dating part of the app anymore until that problem is fixed!

title: Stop turning sounds back on with every update
review:
The in-app sounds are annoying.  I turn them off, but every time I update the app, they turn back on automatically.  Please leave my settings how they were before the updates.  If you really want us to have them on, you could ASK.  “Your in-app sounds are set to off.  Would you like to turn them on? Yes/no”

What are you doing to my other settings without my knowledge?

title: Adds
review: I enjoy this app and use it daily to stay in touch with family, friends and community. I also find out about other countries and people. The adds in the middle of a short video are very annoying. Sometimes I just don’t finish watching it and go to the comments. It would be much better to have adds in the beginning or end of the video.

title: Doesn’t update information
review: I’ve had a Facebook account for about three years now. It’s worked fine for most of those years. Recently I updated my information because I started college. However, when I go to my profile, it still says my old information. Same goes for my computer. I don’t know why it’s not displaying my information but I’ve double and triple checked, and it’s not my mistake. Please look into this ASAP. I just want my information to be correct.

I’m stuck looking at the same posts from a week ago. And I know it can’t be my WiFi. All my other apps work just fine. I even deleted and reloaded the app but now it’s just a white screen that tells me something went wrong. Highly annoying and inconvenient since I’m currently away from my family and this is the main way of keeping in contact since my cell service won’t work out here.

95% of my videos are freezing the sound continues on but not the video - I’ve asked for help - I’ve deleted apps on my iPhone to see if it was perhaps space and checked my isp which is all fine as other apps with videos play fine - I deleted the Facebook App and installed again - not sure if that would seeing that it’s coming from iCloud - still the same - so now am accessing FB from safari and there is no problem with video freezing - please fix your app

review: I’ve noticed the latest update makes my Facebook refresh every single time I leave the page, even if I’m gone for less than a minute. It’s incredibly annoying to have to restart going through my feed every single time I have to reply to a text message. Even if I have a link opened up it will refresh the second I get out of the app. I wish it would have a time limit of some sort, so that it only automatically refreshes if I’ve been off of it for more than 5 minutes or so.

review: It’s loading differently on my iPad than on my iPhone.  When you click a notification, it doesn’t take you to the comment or post on the iPad.   It’s also not loading the feed the same way and it doesn’t always go back very long, even when you try to refresh it.   I’m finding I have to use my iPhone to find a notification instead of scrolling and scrolling to find or even guess where the notification is hiding.   Very annoying and very glitchy.

review: I updated this app and the first time I opened the app, it did some strange things and then closed (I did have it closed out before updating it). All day today, I haven’t been getting notifications of friends liking/sharing/commenting on posts. Every once and awhile a post comes on my wall and there are no pics just white??? I believe that it might be time to go back to the drawing board and start back over and let’s make this app better and more user friendly.

title: Ads
review: I get the need for ads to make revenue but the way they’re done is highly frustrating/annoying and way too long. YouTube’s never really annoyed me since I could usually skip after 5 seconds and only popped up every couple of vids but it feels like I get one during each video and they’re always at least 15 seconds. Doesn’t seem like a lot but when you’re just trying to watch a 2 minute vid, it is.

How many updates can you have and still not fix the most recent?

And I get through one or two videos and then my sound is just gone. I just turn everything up, my volume, make sure the speaker on Facebook is not muted, and made sure my sound wasn’t on silent. And it’s still doing it. What is this? Please fix this ASAP or I’m done with Facebook. I’ve been a loyal Facebook user for over 10 years and now this. I think this is the most annoying glitch ever. 💯

title: What a horrible user experience
review:
I remember when Facebook started... I remember switching from MySpace to Facebook. The simplistic design and the catchy features are what enticed you to like the application and connect with old friends and family that you haven’t spoke too in awhile.

This new application fast forwarding a few years is absolutely horrible, you literally only see a combination of advertisements and the same 10 people over and over. Facebook was ruined by Facebook...and has made the user experience absolutely horrible. Redeleting the app...
