The descriptions at the bottom, the swipe to see more pictures, just leave it how it is, I hate how you guys are always changing it, you’re single handedly destroying it and for some, this is where we keep and share our most precious memories and moments with our friends and families and you’re making us NOT want to use it.

review: The app works fine on my iPhone 7 plus with the latest software. However, what I have been noticing for months now and it has not been fixed is marketplace. Every time I click on see all vehicles it does not load. I was hoping new updates would fix it but nothing had been fixed for over 6 months. Facebook, get on it.

review: So many glitches.  My newsfeed will only load a few things at a time and will not refresh even if I completely close out of the app and bring it back up. I have to delete the app and reinstall and then sometimes it still doesn’t refresh which makes the app useless. It tells me I have so many notifications but when I click on the app I really only have 1 or 2. So annoying and it’s been going on for so long. As many times as this app updates it shouldn’t be having the same issue repeatedly.

The app keeps telling me I have 10-25 notifications and there will be none. Or when business group posts I miss out because the app decided it wasn’t important but the 25 imaginary notifications are. Fix this everyone is annoyed.

title: Notifications
review: It’s become less fun and more of a chore to use FB. I see only posts from maybe 10-15 friends. I constantly see notifications from 24 hours previously with current notifications placed within the timeline of the day before. I shouldn’t have to constantly see the same notifications for 2 and 3 days straight. I don’t understand who comes up with these changes but they’re horrible. It’s no longer about keeping in touch because you can’t!

review: I can't figure out for the life of me what Facebook has done with their app. It started off by not giving me my notifications and limiting updated ones... We're now at not posting photos at all. There had been back to back errors. Not only did I uninstall it, but did it on the premise that I could reinstall from scratch... Not the same version from the cloud. There is no pending update that I can see. I will update this app rating once it is brought  back to a stable state.

title: Please fix this
review: Since the last two updates I have not been able to put my concentration of major next to my school. Please update it back to where it used to be where you were able to put your areas of study. Other than that I love this app and use it everyday.

review: Facebook keeps putting up updates too large to download over my unlimited data plan on the iPhone 8. I do not have the luxury of using WiFi on a daily basis and this is getting very old. Stop with the huge updates on a weekly basis! There’s little or no change to the app after an update so it really makes me wonder what it is they’re doing... probably grabbing more info about me out of my device and selling it off to the highest bidder. 🙄

review: I truly used to enjoy this application as I could go back into the previous day when I left off Facebook, now I know longer know what happened the day before or the day before that if I do not login every 20 minutes. I feel this limits your Facebook experience greatly by not being able to see what happened from the last time you were logged in to Facebook

review: I am getting SO FRUSTRATED that for the past month the app icon shows that I have 5 notifications, but when I open the app, I have 1. ONE NOTIFICATION. Also, I am REALLY sick and tired of getting notifications about the stupid Facebook Watch videos when I never even signed up for that! I never “subscribed” to any Facebook Watch Videos crap! Let your users be able to choose what they want to be notified about and stop invading their privacy and assuming what they want!

review:
I AM SOOOO SICK of getting notifications about people going live. LIVE VIDEOS NOTIFICATIONS!! Why give me an option if it doesn’t work?! 

My Facebook icon will have 8 notifications by it but as soon as I open Facebook, 1 or no notifications at all! I don’t know what is fixed during each update but CAN YOU FIX THIS PLEASE!

review: I've never had any problems with this app. Ever since the most recent update the app just crashes every time I open it. This doesn't just happen once but multiple times. I open the app just to have it crash and throw me out back to my home screen. And it will do it within seconds of opening the app. Then I have to spend forever repeatedly reopening the app until it decides to let me use it. The next day, I’ve received “unusual account activity” and my account got suspended. Guess when it happened? review:
Your troubleshooting isn’t conducive to problems like the app crashing. review: I will not give a star at all . Terrible update. Ever since Facebook was updated for Apple phones, the app crashes. Constantly crashes now . I have deleted it and reloaded several times and on different days. Now I will not reload it on to my phone. I already have enough daily stress. Facebook works fine on my laptop. If I could add negative stars I would, probably five. Perturbed, worked fine months ago. Never again. Good bye. In order to send I am forced to give a star. Not fair.

Still, I can only see about three posts, before it can’t load anything else and just shuts down. This has been happening for several weeks. I would assume by now a multi billion dollar company would fix an issue like this. I have about 50 other apps working just fine, so I’m going to assume it’s the app, not the OS. First, love FB. I rarely have issues with it. When I do, normally it is caught & fixed quickly.  

Suggestion: whenever someone comments on a post, it won’t give the actual time until after 24 hours. So instead of saying “commented 5 hours ago” can the time actually be put in?

review: Marketplace is denying many people’s posts and don’t give direct feedback as to why it’s being denied. There also isn’t a direct way to contact customer service and only offers a forum and help center that gives minimal and incomplete help. That makes the pinning option pointless. And there’s really no reason for the spaced-out menu itemization and list - if I wanted to lose all of that content volume, I’d have just set my phone text size setting larger, but I didn’t.

review:
Every time there is an update, the favorites are rearranged. Quit messing with that function or let the user be able to arrange them as they see fit.

Now, with the updates you get to see whatever FB decides you should see. Please quit trying to figure out what the people want to see and let them choose.

Then got a screen saying my info was compromised so my only options were to log out or complete security questions. Obviously chose the latter but that just logged me out too. No number to call or any way to get around it. No way to log in to my account. Completely bs app, but honestly what do you expect from a social networking site popular a decade ago..? Every friggin time FB updates I have to reinstall stickers except the basic smiley and Pusheen. It is exceedingly annoying. So I end up just GIFfing everything cuz I don't wanna waste anymore time hunting them all down. OVER and OVER.

I have a camera I use to take pictures. I don’t do live FB, so I wish I could turn it off. It’s like an accident waiting to happen.

review:

review: Why does FB have to constantly change the app?!  From preventing commenting with a keyboard that covers half the screen (especially what you're typing), to videos that randomly stop playing while the audio from something else starts playing instead, it seems this app is quickly losing its edge. Maybe they should spend less time on censorship and more time on FIXING BUGS and IMPROVING USER EXPERIENCES!

title: Too Many Notification Bugs
review:
Since Facebook and Messenger split between apps, both apps are very buggy! 

My notification badges will not go away even if I have no new message. 

I tried everything Google and Facebook recommended to remedy this annoyance, but messenger still shows I have 1 notification waiting. 

Messenger will also give new notifications for old messages from marketplace. 

There’s also way too many fake profiles popping up and many friends of mine have been hacked multiple times, to where they can’t get their account back so they have to start a new account. 

I wouldn’t post a lot of personal info on this app in case hackers get ahold of your account and try to extort you. 

All it takes is clicking a wrong link and they have everything and can pose as, you.

title: Just use a web browser instead.
review:
This app is terrible.  You get better functionality just through your web browser.

One problem is that there’s no way to turn off video notifications.  I’m not talking about “live videos”, but rather the video icon in the middle of the bottom of the page.  You can try to turn off all notifications, but there’s no way to “save” those settings, so any time you go back or restart the app, there they are again, all turned on.

Another problem is that there’s no way to access Facebook messages from this app—they force you to download the separate Messenger app instead.

Just avoid all this nonsense by using the webpage, where you can use the messages feature without having to download another annoying app.

title: Facebooks safety and usage features are decreasing fast
review:

There’s been countless safety issues and security issues. Hacking. Fake profiles. 

The reporting feature is a joke. You’ll let videos of animals being skinned and burned alive circulate but you’ll ban people over memes. This needs to be corrected. 

The loading of this app is also a mess. Half of the time it works. Half of the time it doesn’t load at all. Notifications disappear. Takes forever to load. And crashes constantly. This needed to be fixed.

It’s a great app for connecting friends and family but, the features and such of this app have been deteriorating fast the last couple years.

Share a link questioning Facebook staff’s view on something like covid or election security or LGBTQ issues? Your post will likely be flagged to your friends as misinformation. This is no longer a platform for free speech; it actively throttles free speech and smiles while they’re doing it.

My recommendation is to sponsor and support alternative platforms like MeWe. Don’t support these guys until they demonstrate they believe in real freedom of expression.

Instead of the official app they push a malicious version of the app that has been modified and allows for further exploits through methods like heap and stack spraying, kernel mode exploits, and WebKit exploits along with a handful of zero days that lead to the initial access vector. 

Facebook is one of a handful of mainstream apps affected by this exploit chain.

So if you are going to use Facebook on iOS at least make sure your device name is not your real name and consider turning off IDFA.

I’ve tried deleting the app and re-installing, turning off my phone, & even resetting my network settings. Obviously, something is wrong with the app. I am wondering, when will it be fixed?

title: Wish it had - stars!
review:
What’s with the huge updates that won’t even download over the cell network?  Your trying to push content upon me is getting very old. I have friends for a reason and when all I see is crap ads and other junk you shove in my feed it pushes me another step closer to remove you! 

Update: Still huge downloads and they’re coming every few days it seems like. I will not update it again! I’m getting the impression Facebook thinks it’s too big to be the next my space.

title: Payable Version
review: Could you please create your application but make us buy it for $10-$15 but it never has ads? Like please, ads are the worst. So those who hate them can buy the app and not get ads and those who don’t want to pay can have all the ads? That would be great :)

title: Usually great
review: Works great. My app just crashes when I try to click a picture comment to view up close. And I wish they would bring back the feature when you are posting to your timeline, being able to select photos from other photo albums in your phone and not just gallery.

title: Needs work
review: I have an iOS updated iPhone 7 Plus. Since I updated the Facebook app, it quits often. Sometimes in the middle of commenting on someone’s post. This has never had to me before. When I scroll down the newsfeed, I only get to see 2 or 3 posts, because it just hangs. Maybe it is too busy? These are all new problems. Very unstable. Quits on it’s own often. Very annoying. Worse than ever. I never had this issue before. An awful update.

title: Locks up my entire phone
review: This app used to be really good, but for about the last year it has completely locked up my phone when ever it uses data. I have an iPhone X so I shouldn’t have any hardware issues. Was doing it on my iPhone 6 and I was hoping the upgrade would fix my issues, but it did not. This is the only app I have issues with locking up my phone. It is bad enough that it prevents my home screen from running or accepting input and I can’t even sleep the screen when it gets in that state.

title: Latest update worst ever
review: The latest update, March 15th, has froze Facebook on my iPad mini. Tried to delete FB but it wouldn't let me, tried to check update, it wouldn't let me, tried to sync with iTunes on computer, wouldn't let me. I guess I will have to wipeout iPad of all data, and reinstall all my apps., music and have already backed up all the pics and videos, just glad it didn't freeze up the entire iPad. Stop doing updates before testing them.

title: Continuous crashes
review: Facebook is the one app on my iPhone X that continues to crash. Try to post a comment...crash. Try to watch a video...crash. Try to make a post...crash. If I’m lucky I can look at other posts, maybe through 20 of them, and then...crash. Facebook needs to simplify. It started with trying to get rid of spam, now Facebook live and stories need to go. If I can’t go on the newsfeed or timeline, it needs to go. Also, ads in the middle of videos?!?!? Worst idea ever. I rarely even finish videos anymore.

title: Please fix market place - vehicles
review: When you specify to look for vehicles only, cars from dealerships are now the only results that appear. All private sellers are gone. Earlier this week there were over 100 used cars in my area and now there is only 1. Also, when the ‘dealership’ option is not selected, it would be nice if dealerships are excluded from the search results. Just a thought.

title: Not Suitable for iPad Pro 12.9
review: After recently upgrading from a 9.7” iPad to the 12.9” iPad Pro, this app has NOT been optimized for the larger screen. Everything looks scaled up and blurry (imagine running an iPhone app on the iPad). This is just a sign of laziness on the part of Facebook. If they really cared for user experiences, then this would have been fixed months (or years) ago. Instead, users are left with a subpar experience while they focus on other issues.

title: Fake news cesspool
review: Facebook was fun during the first few years. Great way to connect with friends and then family. Then came the marketplace, where they turned it into a market ride with scams. Then came the ads, that used cookies to basically stalk you. Then the fake news which so far, they’ve done nothing about. It’s unusable now, and I deleted it to maintain my peace of mind. Nobody likes being bombarded with stories from fake twitter account bots, yet Facebook had pages with over 30k “likes” sharing and spreading this stuff like wildfire...

title: Leave it open to upload problem
review: So I’m always going live and when I’m done I at times like to upload the video instead of erasing it immediately upon completion. However since some of the updates it constantly rings my phone up telling me to “leave the app open to upload faster” even if the video was deleted or already uploaded to my wall. Sometimes it’s up to like 20 notifications of this in one day! Please fix this!

title: Updates are terrible
review: The recent few updates have brought nothing but problems. At first, the app would crash about 5 seconds into any video I would play, and after that finally got fixed, now links won’t open up. I can click on a shared article or site someone posts and the page never loads (but works just fine in safari). This “update every week” thing has had more bugs than ever before.

title: Useless
review: At first I thought it was my phones, but I quickly realized that it was in face the Facebook app itself. It freezes very often now, even the updates do not make it better. If you’re in the middle of making a comment and have to pause, say maybe for a call, you lose what you were typing as well as the post. It takes you all the way back to the beginning of the page. Facebook has become more difficult to use and less appealing. It is a waste of time.

title: Great social networking, poor app storage.
review:
Yay Facebook on iOS - I can keep up with my friends online!

However, I’ve seen this app take up 500 megabytes. For someone who only has 10gb for photos and videos, I cannot put up with an app that provides no way to delete cached data. Please fix this.

title: Issues with files
review:
If you're in a group you cannot edit a file from your mobile device (either app or web browser). If you HAD to remove the groups app because you didn't want to support it please provide the ability to let the users update files via the apps. 

Otherwise the app itself is OK. It crashes sometimes but generally works. I don't feel like it's super intuitive and it's sooooo hard to find people's birthdays.

title: Images of shares from non-Facebook posts not loading
review: Of late, images of posts to my timeline and friends made from other apps and websites do not load whereas images of shares made from the newsfeed that appear on my timeline do load. This needs to be fixed. This is happening may be due to the latest iOS. I do not have any idea.

title: Consistent, long term problems with news feed not updating
review: In addition to the numerous ads, I’ve had consistent problems with my news feed for the last couple years. I’ve reported the issue many times with no resolution. I won’t see posts that my friends have seen and should also be in my feed. A lot of times I’ll get posts dated the day or two before that I should have seen the day it was posted. I know I miss out on a lot of posts.

title: Forcing me to “follow” people!
review: A few months ago I noticed I suddenly had started “following” a few random people on my friends list. Then more were added to my “following” list. Now all these people are constantly on my newsfeed that I don’t want there! It won’t let me unfollow any of them. I tried uninstalling the Facebook app and reinstalling and it still doesn’t let me unfollow them. This is annoying. I have a separate feed for my friends and that’s where I want them to stay! Lets get a fix for this ASAP please!

title: I use my browser
review:
I deleted this a long time ago when my husband said it was bad for my phone battery. 
Now FB has so many new features I can’t use on a browser so I thought I’d give it a shot again.
WHAT IS THIS?  The layout and appearance is so off, I have no idea how to use the app.  It really should be so simple.  I deleted it immediately.  Back to my browser, and if I miss out on the fun stuff, so be it.  I need to use less FB anyway. My news feed is 95% likes and comments on people’s families that I don’t even know.
STOP SHOWING ME FRIENDS’ LIKES AND COMMENTS!

title: Lenovo app comparison
review: This app is so much better than the app on a Lenovo laptop.  I can look at events.  I can use more than just the like feature for comments.  It still backs out and then I scroll back down there, so maybe it should only be 4 stars, but nevertheless, it could be worse.

title: Please feel the album feature or get rid of it!
review: I strongly dislike using the album feature because it's so counter intuitive, frustrating, and incompatible with some browsers. It's a terrible experience when you spend some time setting up your pictures just to get them removed when you click the post button. I've made terrible mistakes just trying to post several pictures, as they get posted as albums when I was not trying to make one. Terrible, terrible, terrible.

title: Advertising
review:
I am so tired of being tricked into thinking I am going to read a text from my friends when in fact I am tapping on an advertising scheme. What is going on with all the junk I am seeing. I am frustrated and fed up. Please do away with it or pretty soon I am going to opt out of FB. 
Honestly I am fed up.

title: Suggestion
review: I love the “save” feature for sure. But I would love it even more if there was a capability to organize saved pages/articles into categories. For example I maintain a page for work and it would be great to save some things for my personal posts, “read later”, share for work, “recipes”, “shopping”, etc.

Was on it for about day and half which today got blocked out. For me to get back FB is telling me I have to send some kind of photo ID. Well why the heck would I do that when it sounds like someone as hacked to my account.

review: If a reel is from Instagram you can no longer click view on Instagram, instead they want you to link your accounts together so you can comment. Low and behold every attempt I make to comment after linking is followed by "failed to post" what a bad integration and waste of time. Then even though it clearly says posted from Instagram I go to the IG account and sift through all 355 reels atleast 3 times and it's not even there

If someone makes a public post and they don’t limit their comments - it will be blown up with comments from scammers and spam.  BUT… if you post a political opinion that goes against what Facebook believes you will be shadow banned or put in Facebook jail.  This is an absolute trash company.

I've never had so much trouble getting another business to take my money.  I will probably never use Meta for ads again.  I've never been more frustrated with a platform.

I do miss posts from the groups I am in and interacting with my friends, but the decline of Facebook is not something I will miss. I deleted the app from my devices and haven’t looked back in over a month.

META HAS DESTROYED BOTH FACEBOOK AND INSTAGRAM!

Also why is it that I have *individually* muted and turned off stories for everything that isn’t friends and family yet every three months or so they automatically turn back on.

The moment this app starts to charge money for being a user, or my family finds more effective means of communication, I’m deleting my account and removing the app.

(I have so many other issues but I’m not wasting any more time on a review no one cares about anyway.)

title: Such a pain

To search for things is difficult, the amount of ads has gotten ridiculous, and I see the same posts over and over again while at the same time can’t find a particular post I am looking for. review: I have been using the Facebook app for years. I just got a new phone and now my dark mode for the app is gone. And it is no where to be found to be able to change it back. When you look it up on Facebook it tells you where to find it but it’s not there. Super frustrating.

review: My notification section has been completely scrambled the past few days which makes it impossible to keep up. I don’t have time to search through days worth of notifications to find the new one. This makes FB no longer convenient or useable. Lately I’ve found in person communication and posters hanging more useful the FB. Clearly the world is going backwards which is probably a good thing.

review: I think they’re business model exploits human psychology but I need to buy a dresser for cheap and they also manage to monopolize sales by moving sales from the physical space to their retail space. review:

review:

Update: Really, Facebook? Your response to users’ complaints about “Suggested for you” is to change it to “You might like this”? Just give us the option to turn it off already! Give me a break.

review: Beware: this app connects to your home Wi-Fi! This app is a dangerous data stealing. If I even dare speak of something near the Facebook app, you will get an add relating to what you spoke of in your out loud conversation on Facebook.  It also tracks search history outside of using the app. Americans spend on average 31 minutes per day on this app; we have to take care of that and make it 0. After all, data protection is very important and we can’t risk taking this any further.

title: Coming after my favorite app isn’t gonna save yours.
review:
So if one social media app gets banned they all should get banned. Facebook, Messenger, Instagram. Etc. I know people on a daily basis that have their account hacked on Facebook. Never heard of anyone having that issue with TikTok.
Only reason why I even kept this app on my phone was because of certain family members. Otherwise i would of deleted it a long time ago. Come after TikTok and I’ll delete all 3 of yours.

title: Not to be downloaded!
review: This outdated app has been the bane of my existence for years. I’m so glad I finally deleted. Facebook used to be a place where I could gather photos and experiences to share with my families. But the company has sold out to ad sponsorships and mega corps; all I see are ads I don’t care about, things I’ve said out loud but never searched, ads influenced by text messages or searches on other apps. It’s incredibly invasive and uncomfortable. Deleting the app!!! It’s horrible.

title: Facebook is terrible
review: I have used this app for many years. But I am deleting the app and I wish I could give it a 0 star rating. I hate that I see so much censorship of real world problems. And I hate that my privacy isn't protected and sold to who knows who. I see so much gruesome/gore things on Facebook more than I do any other app. This is so unfortunate, and so frustrating. Cause I shouldn't have to give a app this rating. But there is nothing getting fixed about this.

title: Power leads to Corruption that leads to control
review: Facebook was pioneer of social media in the early 2000s and has slowly built one of the biggest empires over the years. Facebooks business model is surrounded by data mining and contracts of adhesion in which the users retain no privacy. With this great power, Facebook has hired lobbyists to infiltrate Washington by feeding politicians false narratives for their political and economic gain because of the fear of competition. I can no longer support a company that seeks to monopolize and control the American people.

title: Do you love Ads? Facebook is for you
review: I’ve been on Facebook for years and have noticed that every year and every update they keep adding more adds to your feed, videos, and articles. This app is so annoying now, every video you watch has ads to the max. Want to read an article? Be prepared to bombarded with ads. Facebook just wants profits now over providing people with a good way to socialize. Waste of time, other apps like Tik tok are so much better.

title: Too many privacy concerns ‼️
review: Meta as a whole collects and sells our data without our permission. I’ve seen too many targeted adds after mentioning that I may need something without even having the app open… Facebook has become a cesspool for misinformation & propaganda. They also lobby congress to ban other apps when their usage is down instead of doing the common sense thing and making their app better. If I could give Facebook ZERO stars I would.

review:
Boring app, full of ads, non of my friends or network uses it. Plus the CEO thinks pushing metaverse is a good idea while only 4/ 59 graduating class of physics majors can afford rent.

title: They connect to Wi-Fi without my permission
review: They sell your information, they listen in on your conversation even when the app is closed and they pay politicians to attack their competitors. This app and company are the epitome of sleazy, sneaky, spyware dolled up to look like a boomers version of MySpace. They desperately try to copy popular forms of social media but just can’t get it right. Probably the greatest threat to the internet is Facebook and their parent company Meta. Don’t bother with this waste of time late stage dementia app.

title: Sludge pile
review: I joined FB Summer 2008 so that family and friends could share the news of the birth of my second child. Over the years I’ve reconnected with old friends. But in the last few years the forum has become toxic. So much political vitriol and disinformation on it now. I’ve seen female friends get locked out for 30 days for saying something is stupid while men are free to call us all kinds of profane and vulgar names (think B and C words) with impunity. title: Everything is awful
review: This app barely ever opens with out crashing, and when it does open in 2 minutes it freezes for 5 solid minutes. The news feed is terrible I miss so many posts that I want to see. It needs the recent tab easily accessible again. It also shows to many ads like over half of the posts are sponsored and no I don't want to see any of them. This app has just turned into a giant pile a garbage.

title: Goodbye, Meta…
review: What happened, Mark? You were once an ambitious and important pillar of social media. Now, you’ve turned into a greedy and petty coward who would rather completely destroy your competitor by force than to actually try and compete. This TikTok ban may give you short term happiness, but your dishonor and lack of integrity will be long term. These are dark times, and proof that with unregulated capitalism, bad people can and will buy themselves out of pickle while leaving everyone else floundering. Goodbye, Meta.

I have seen a side of Facebook I prefer to have never seen and if I didn’t need it for work right now it would be deleted forever. Shame on Facebook

review: I have always enjoyed Facebook up until they have begun to direct my friends account away from my normal daily viewing. Instead all I see is adds and a lot of censorship with very little facts. I can verify my own information and do not like how this platform is pushing politics as they see fit via mainstream media’s false reporting. Who is authorized to become a fact checker and what are they using to validate this? I am currently looking for a non bias platform now as I feel my rights are being infringed on.

review: I am tired of Facebook thinking they have a right to pick and choose what is news and what is not news. The fact that you are so blatantly against Trump shows that you are not impartial. You will allow anything to be said about Trumps administration and family and not a thing about the fraudulent dealings of the Biden family and do not even get me started on the Clinton mob family and a host of other Democrats that get a free pass. We see who you really are and what you really think of this country!

review: Sadly, Facebook has transitioned from a fun place to share images and words with people all over the world to a tightly controlled and censored behemoth where Zuckerberg and the powers that be condescend to believe that they can stifle comments and thoughts that don’t fit their narrative.  They have so much hubris as to not care who notices it because they have no real competition and figure that folks have no choice but to stay. They disrespect us.  I am rooting for alternatives like MeWe and Parler to take root and provide credible alternatives to Facebook.

title: Highly dissatisfied
review: I am so disappointed in Facebook and how you have, rather than being a platform of social media during the 2020 campaign and election, have created a hostile environment for Conservatives and anyone who questions or disagrees with the biden/liberal agenda. You have trampled on Free Speech and harassed members by constantly flagging posts and removing anything that supports President Trump or Conservative ideas. What once was a pleasant place to connect with friends has become a political tool and it has lost the appeal for many users. Shame on you!!

title: Conservative Censorship/ Liberal Bias
review:
To Facebook and Zuckerturd. 
Why do you think you have the right to censor conservative view points and continue lying and spreading liberal propaganda? We are supposed to have freedom of speech in America whether you agree with it or not!! Way out of hand with all your false fact checker post/ false election results etc etc and lies. You are losing hundreds of thousands of people because of it. Oh and all the corruption from Biden, liberals and demonrats and you bias platform will be exposed. I would do 0 stars if I could!

title: UnAmerican censoring
review: I would have rated negative stars if it were possible!  I have been on FB since 2009. I  used to love it! It was a great place to connect with family and friends.  But when they feel that they need to not only censor, but put "fact checking " ads on every election post. Or any post that is Christian or not democratic, that is suspect to me.  And the so called fact checkers must be democrats because most of them are lies.  I am happy to have deleted my account, and I hope that they are sued for election interference!

review: This app is more or less living under Communist China. You can’t post what you want to they censor you.I posted six post the other day not one of you not one friend like that. When I posted just an every day post I got some likes and comments to where I question them about not seeing the others. The truth will defy you free, they’re afraid of being free. Which is the greatest gift of all but they still control the messages being put out. Wrong on them

title: Lovin it ! 😃
review: Really loving the new layout . I am able to navigate FB a lot better then before . A lot faster and I accurately get my notifications unlike before so I recommend this to every1 who doesn't have it . Can y’all add the dark mode option to IOS users?

review: I am particularly fed up with the new format of Facebook Marketplace.  It used to be nice and easy to list and monitor items to sell, and to browse items to buy. Now it’s such a hassle I don’t want to bother.  If you’re searching for an item and find one I’m interested in and click on it for more details then I can’t get back to where I was browsing.  It goes back to Facebook itself so I have to start all over. Ahhh!

review: Suddenly about 4 or 5 days ago my notifications stopped working. This is an issue both on my phone and tablet. It is very frustrating, for example I didn't know I was invited to a friend's future birthday party because usually it shows up in notifications but I only found out because they asked if I had responded. I have tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app however this did not fix the issue. Please fix this as soon as possible!!

review: I understand that it is important to under go consistent updates but I feel the app is constantly changing just to make pointless changes. Almost every time the app is updated a new problem is bound to occur that seriously interrupts the experience. Videos don’t play with sound, random app crashing, and failure to load pictures even on a fast stable internet connection. Figure out a stable version and keep it that way.

review: Using the app on a brand new iPad. When looking at my wall, the app works fine but as soon as I start scrolling through whats been listed on Marketplace the app crashes and reboots the ios system to login. I have reported this glitch for over a year and Facebook has yet to fix it with updates. For a company that’s worth billions to only do this thing well, this is pretty unacceptable. FIX YOUR APP, Facebook!

review: With no given reason . I can send friend request, accept them and deny them . I can post Facebook stories . I still have no access to market place . I have no reason as to why I have been “temporarily “ blocked from posting . I still have no access to marketplace and I’m unable to get any help or a reasoning as to why fb disabled my account half way . Facebook is really getting worse and worse each passing month .

2 updates ago there was a great feature a drop down menu letting me see the most recent posts first...gone... must be fb wants us to see THEIR timeline not the one i want to see...privacy 😂😂😂😂right those settings are buried and less than they were several updates ago.

title: The Trouble with BIRTHDAY DATES!!!
review:
Sometime in early March several friends at church came to me and wished me Happy Birthday. 

That’s great except my birthday is in early January. 

I tried to find where my birthday is stored to no avail

I looked everywhere. 

++++++++++++

STUFF CAME UP THAT BOTHERED ME AND I GOT PARANOID ABOUT FACEBOOK. 

So I deleted the account permanently. 

Every option I was presented with I chose the most permanently deletion. 

++++++++++++

Today something suggested I load the FaceBook app for convenience. 

I did. 

And would you believe my account was still there with a window that said my birthday is February 16, 1994. 

Now on that date I was at least 52 years old. 

I tried to change that date but could not. 

My question is “WHAT’S GOIN’ ON HERE???

Respectfully,

Dennis McKnight

review: There are constant updates to FB and always the same “update information” given : “bug fixes and performance improvements”. This is totally non-information.  How can there be ongoing bug fixes time after time?  How many times does it take to find and fix the bugs?  And how bad is the performance such that it needs to be improved so frequently?  Either explain what the update really does or stop giving the same bogus explanation. It insults your users.

title: What’s with the Ads?
review: And more specifically the ads in the MIDDLE of a video I’m watching. I hate watching the videos now because of this tactic. If I’m watching a video and I get the “ad starting soon” message I skip the video. Which I hate cause I was interested in the video. Don’t get me wrong I’m fine watching ads. But put it at the beginning! Don’t put a 30 second ad in the middle of a video I’m watching. I was actually gonna rate two stars but typing this out has upset me so I’m giving it one star.

title: The search feature is making this app for iPhone non-user friendly.
review: The new design of the search is very poorly made compared to the old one. You can no longer check by years and now you can’t even click on previous searches. I just wanted to find an art page I searched for after finding its name and I can’t go to my previous search to click on it or even find out if they changed their name because of this. Please fix it.

title: I’m still waiting for them to fix this issue.
review: I normally enjoy Facebook very much but after numerous times of writing it in as a bug and it still not being fixed, I decided to try on here. I’m having a issue of when I click on a notification it will only take me to the group page instead of the actual post it’s super frustrating. PLEASE RESOLVE THIS ISSUE!

title: Keeps getting worse
review: I’ll get a notification of some activity in a post on a group. I tap on the notification. 9 times out of 10 it’ll bring me to the group and just sit there at the top of the group instead of going to the post. I have to scroll down and guess which post it may be if there’s multiple posts I’m following. Groups that aren’t so busy isn’t so bad but the bigger and busier groups it’s near impossible. Facebook should never have gotten rid of their groups app.

title: Meh?!
review: My app doesn’t let me like every and all my posts. It has what appears to be a limit counter. My app also signs me out unexpectedly and and doesn’t let my posts go though. It’s a good app. These NEED to get fixed or else this app will eventually die out and fade into nothingness as better apps with less bugs takeover the social media game.

title: New Idea
review: You guys shouls integrate a way for sellers to find buyers. I have alot of trouble finding a seller and when deals are made it frustrates me. Instead why not make a way for sellers to find a buyer that fits their likings. Wether its in house finance, dealers, pawnshop people, etc. But if yall use it all i want is for you guys to advertise my music crew 😂.

title: So annoying
review: I don’t get the number at the bottom that tells me I have notifications. I have to click to see if I have any. Also, if 50 people liked my status and I check to see. It only shows one person. No matter now I try to refresh it. The fact that y’all also only show “most relevant” comments is so stupid. Just show us everything. I’m using this app less and less and going back to twitter and ig.

title: App keeps shutting down
review: The app recently updated and ever since then, it closes itself after a few minutes.  I went through all of the steps to fix it, but nothing has worked.  Apple support said it’s a developer/app issue.  Everything else on my phone works fine.  Time to stay off Facebook and Facebook Business for a while....🙄

title: Where did my pics go?
review: So I don’t have an option to look at my own photos now? There used to be an icon on my profile that I could access the pics I’ve put in Facebook, and now it’s gone? I’d hate if this was an update because; well it’s just dumb if it is. Plus why is the newsfeed all jacked up? I’ll have a post from a few minutes ago and then the next will be a post from a few days ago?

title: Since the update.
review: Ever since the update on the 20th my roommate and I and every one else who I have talk to about it cannot see all of the people who like our posts.  It will show all the thumbs but not the hearts. Or all the hearts but none of the likes. It’s pretty annoying. I have tried turning off my phone and restarting it, closing the app and reopening it yet it still does the same. Hopefully this will be taken care of the next update.

title: Yet another update
review:
Battery usage is TERRIBLE. I deleted this app last night and my battery has been incredible today. I can’t say I’ll be installing this app again until some serious improvements are made. 

Birthdays are no longer visible as a list. 

Updates are so pointless. They are enormous in size yet nothing ever changes. Nothing gets fixed. I’m really growing to hate Facebook. Seriously, release updates when there’s something actually worth rolling out to your users...such as fixes that are desperately needed. 

Stories is so stupid. Please let me remove this from my newsfeed. I also want to get rid of the suggested friends. I already have the friends that I want on my Facebook feed. 

Why do I need a separate app for messenger? Please put it back. Nobody asked for a separate app.

title: Very disappointed
review: I changed my birth date on Facebook to my actual birthdate so it would be my actual age. Little did I know you had to be 18 to access marketplace. I’m 15, I know it may seem stupid to some but I used Marketplace daily and I’m currently dreading not having it because I recently bought a vehicle and I want to look for parts on marketplace. If the age for marketplace was lowered to 15, you’d probably have a few more happy customers. Just an idea

title: The in-app sound keeps turning back on
review: I HATE the in-app sounds when I hit like on anything, and I have to go into settings to switch it off like almost every day. Why doesn't it stay off?! And if it's gonna keep defaulting to on so often, there should be an easier way to turn the sounds back off without digging through the settings menu to find it.

title: Facebook update
review: It shows my Facebook is updated but it did not update it does not have the new look please help. I have logged in on my friends phone and it is still the old Facebook but when she logs in it the new Facebook. I don’t know why can’t I get help.

title: Exactly what Jascakex said!!!!!
review:
Please read his review TWICE!! 
Also..selling on Marketplace was much easier before. Now, each time I post an item it turns up “in review” I spend more time trying to figure out why, while my post is being held back for days. Completely ridiculous! Make a customer service contact option so we can at least know what’s wrong with the post if they aren’t going to communicate with us about it.

title: Not satisfied
review: I’ve had a Facebook account for years. Randomly out the blew it asked me to do a Security check with all my old numbers. So I can’t recover my account because every time I do and used my email it makes me change my password and then ask me again about the old numbers not giving me a option to use something else. And I can’t get in contact with no one from fb to help me. None of the support forms are helping it makes you not even want to use the social media.

title: Bug fixes? It’s worse
review: **** update two new updates later, this app Is still awful! No friends, cant tag anyone, can’t view timelines, can’t view their comments on my post———go Ever since the new update, Facebook says I have no friends, and it will not allow me to post anything. Every now and then it’ll say I have a notification; however, once I click it, it’ll say said person isn’t my friend (when they are), and that I’m not allowed to see private posts. Worst version yet.

title: Needs fixing
review: Lately a lot of stuff has said attachment unavailable even if the person didn’t delete it or change privacy settings and I can’t share anything because it tells me post failed and when I click on see more it says “Duplicate status update. This status update is identical to the last one you posted. Try posting something different, or delete your previous update.”

title: Photo posting
review: Since the last update there’s no option to pick an album when you post pictures. You have to navigate to the actual album and then add photos to it that way. This is super annoying and inconvenient. Can we get this feature back please.

title: Trash 🚮🚮🚮
review: After all this time we still can’t get “most recent” to function properly. I’m almost certain people should find another app to replace FaceBook at this point. You guys are pathetic now. You sell ALL of our information. The updates are just there to take up space they aren’t even updating anything. When can we get anything worthwhile. Really dissatisfied. I hate missing important events or gatherings because I’m seeing posts anywhere from 3-7 days old.

title: This app violates the 2nd Amendment all the time
review: Use to be a good social media platform until FB got greedy and starting pumping ads like a fat kid in a candy store. Every 2-3 posts you see, it’s guaranteed you’ll be bombarded with ads. Mostly irrelevant ads. Not to mention, FB got in trouble for its data breach and gave away user’s confidential / personal information by releasing the data to a company working for the Russian government and inadvertently, helped trump win. FB, you’ve lost your grace. Let’s see if you can come back into the light.

title: I loved a lot more before...
review: Please bring the the option to see what your friends commented in other post/photos. Before you could type in the search box “photos like/commented by(friend name)” and it show all the photos/ post your friends commented and liked. Please Facebook bring the option back!!!

title: HUGE PROBLEM!
review: Someone needs to fix the app! I am sick and tired of not being able to my my own profile or my friend’s profile. Literally nothing shows and it keeps loading forever! I can’t see pictures either or posts that contain pictures, it’s almost like they don’t exist. Every time I try to go see if my profile is ok, old and random post pop up, posts from years before all not in order and the recent ones gone!  I might just delete it if it’s not resolved.

title: Videos
review: I go to watch a video on Facebook and it buffers constantly or says I have poor connection. I am connected through WiFi and sit in the room with the router and my connection is full bars always. It gets frustrating when I’m watching trainings for my job and I can’t even watch the whole thing so I almost always have to switch to a computer.

title: TRASH!
review:
I’ve been using the Facebook app for quite sometime now, mostly since I’ve had a smart phone with that capability.

Recently and I do mean recently, I have a problem with the app crashing all of a sudden, I’ve uninstalled and reinstalled the app several times to no avail, it’s getting tiresome opening my web browser typing in Facebook, entering my info, and signing on, if your app worked properly I wouldn’t have to do such silly stuff as that, in conclusion fix your app it’s complete trash.

title: Aggravating
review: For the love of good stop the auto refresh when I either, reopen the app ( not close it out) or Go back to the main feed after view one of the groups on with, or sometimes just cause it can. Just stop the auto fresher crap. If I want refresh it to see new news feeds then I’ll do it my self. It’s so aggravating when I try to pick up where I left off and boom refresh and now I have to start all over again.

title: Update failed my iPhone
review:
Since new update Facebook hasn’t worked on my iPhone. I have but 4 items on my newsfeed and if I’m lucky one or two are there . The rest is blank. My families work but mine is not..
The blanks waver and then my app shuts down and brings me to home screen.

title: Used to work. Not anymore
review: Until recently, I hadn’t had any problems.  Lately, however, I am only able to see one post and maybe 1 ad on my newsfeed and nothing else.  Impossible to scroll down.  I’ve reported the problem at least 3 times to Facebook and I know my family members experience the same frustration but nothing appears to be working and nobody cares enough to respond to our complaints.

title: I haven’t been in Facebook for weeks
review:
I haven’t used fab for weeks because I can’t get into it since you did the update-bug fix. This is the only way I keep in touch with friends and family. So merry Christmas everyone, if you have problems too, you may see my post. I hope everyone has a great holiday season.

Remember when facebooks ok was created; they said “free and always will be.” Ha!! They took $300 for a free game. I don’t enter my bank card info, so that’s prob. An inside job, but I file reports. Remember that.

title: Most Recent News Feed
review: If you are going to make a “most recent” news feed it should always be the most recent stuff down to the minute not from 12 hours ago or earlier from the day before. This has always been an issue that needs to be corrected. New version needs to come out sooner than later to fix this.

title: An app that just doesn’t care to work well on iPad
review:
I’d love to rate this app with minus 5 stars because it simply doesn’t work well on iPad. Pictures rotate when you try to see them, you can’t type anything without constant bounce backs for no reason at all, the app resolution doesn’t fit the screen and some other issues showing that Facebook simply doesn’t care about iPads.
It’s absolutely the worst app I’ve ever used on iPad and I’m seriously going to look for an alternative or simply drop it

title: Every update gets worse and worse
review: I spend forever trying to type the simplist of things cause somehow your app is the only one that screws up my keyboard. Now the app doesn't even refresh. Just says error. I keep getting notifications from the app but, guess what? I can't open them because the app doesn't respond. Just out everything back the way it was and stop trying to make it "better". No one was complaining until you tried to make it "better". IT'S WORSE NOW THAN EVER BEFORE

title: Can’t play videos!!!
review: After the new update, I can’t play ANY videos at all. This is super annoying, especially since you make me update the app every other week. I also had to turn off my notification badge since the app keeps showing 10+ notifications when I only have 1 or 2.  Very silly updates, and useless to say the least. The fact that I can’t even play a video, which is one of the only reasons I go on the app anymore, is irritating. Deleting Facebook 😒

title: Facebook is a mess
review: So a long time i deleted my account permanently, and I decided to do a new account, I tried to open a new one and Facebook asked me for a picture, y though that was really strange, why they need a picture of me? For what? Anyway i send the picture and then tell me that I can’t use my account for the moment for some thing of privacy, i was so mad, please fix this thing because i swear im not gonna use Facebook again, this is a big mistake that haves to be fixed, please I want my account.

title: FB has gone steadily downhill
review: FB is really going down the rabbit hole lately.  It takes forever for new posts to load and half the time I get a blank screen where pic should be.   FB has gotten increasingly frustrating and I’m thinking its time I’m just done with it all.  It used to be great but now it’s just filled with ads, inappropriate posts (which they SAY they regulate but they are full of it). Not to mention it seems to be increasingly easy for accounts to be hacked.  Not a well run site anymore, sad to say.

title: Not getting newsfeed
review: What is going on? I have Facebook on my computer and my ipad, plus the ipad app on my ipad. Suddenly I’m not getting or keeping newsfeed in the app. Feed appears, then disappears. Nothing stays. When I go to my newsfeed I may get one or two stories, then they disappear. No ads. I deleted and reinstalled. Same problem. Suddenly newsfeed appears, then disappears again. I can get my Facebook page on my ipad. Just not the ipad app! What’s going on?

title: Worse! Again!
review: When this new pop up story platform was introduced I noticed my battery dropped 8% within a minute of opening stories. I have attempted to contact fb to see how I can stop this from happening. I’ve received no response. I did another update hoping it was fixed. Now it’s worse. Contacted fb again. Again no response. Now I open nothing. Why was this battery draining pop up introduced? Why will they not answer my inquiries? Time to leave and go to Instagram only.

title: Fix the Most Recent Feed!
review: This is so annoying some of us just want to view our newsfeed from newest to oldest but now even my most recent feed will show posts over a day old at the top and right below a post from an hour ago and below that a post “just now” like seriously fix the dang order to make it actually display “most recent” like the feed is supposed to be! It’s bad enough we to have that feed hidden away in a menu but now it doesn’t even work as intended!

The worse update for this app ever , what kind of developer is that , I can’t scroll down freely it is always reloading and it is not the internet problem it is your worse update , when I see the notification I don’t see my own post with it , what happen? Don’t add regular update if there is no added value ,

title: Usually like Facebook but not the recent version
review:
It was difficult at first to see where to like a post, it’s in a strange spot, please move it back to where it was. 

Also, when looking for my friends to get to their page, why do we have to look by last name? I liked it when no matter if the letters were last name or first we could search them. I thought a friend had unfriended me, till I put in her last name.

title: Can’t view caption on original post
review: Since the update it’s been horrible! When you create a post and go back to the post your caption doesn’t show only if you attach a photo! Also sometimes when you try to create a post and go to your camera roll it shows zero photos in your camera roll. You end up having to completely close out Facebook, open it up again, create a post in order for your camera roll to show. One of the worst updates yet 🙄

title: okay
review: While the app works very well and most times I don't seem to have any problems, that doesn't mean it's perfect. Some of the times it will force close while I'm typing out a post. And more recently, I've noticed that if I make a Facebook post with a photo, my caption disappears. I don't think it's deleted because other people can still see the caption of my posts, but I can't?

title: What’s the point?
review: This review is for iOS users. So these so called “updates” are made to supposedly enhance the experience. I haven’t updated this app in almost a year. I still have the so called “updates” being pushed to the app mobile version (even though I don’t install them). With the pathetic privacy policy and concerns sharing data, I’ll check the app from a web browser with a computer. This app really hasn’t changed much since 2012. More advertisements same experience 👎🏼

title: Photos now inaccessible
review: The newest version of the Facebook app does not allow me to view my photo albums or photos on my profile other than the Featured (public) photos and profile pictures. I have years of memories in my FB photo albums that I need to be able to easily access. Photos are also a key feature people look for when looking at others’ profiles. Please bring back the ability to directly access Photos and old albums/uploads.

title: Annoying
review:
Still really slow and all the extra ads don't help.  
Market place needs to show price and allow me to hide items without opening the whole post.  When I hide an item it should not show in searches later nor should they show up on the default list that is really just a one big advertisement camouflaged as a list of items now.  I also don't want searches to show items in central Mississippi nor south Louisiana,  I have the 19 mile limit for a reason.

title: People are not real, remember that!
review:
I find some old friends on FB then I remember why we never speak. We never really liked each other. The new people are the fun part but most never tell you the real story. They are just passing on thru your life like so many other people have.
Privacy or lack of is not a problem. Every thing you say on most websites are public so if you need it to be private then shut up. Easy to deal with that.

title: Comments
review: What the heck is up with only showing “most relevant” comments. Why not have to opt in to the most relevant? What super secret and ridiculous algorithm decides that? I get it, most likes, most relevant but still super annoying. I’d like to see all comments on a public post and opt into seeing most relevant if I choose. It seems like another way y’all are trying to control what we see.

title: Concerning
review: Facebook does NOT give people any pricey at all. If your search up a place or product or will show up on your Facebook page as a recommendation. And Facebook knows where you are all the time, my dad was on a few days ago and he got a request from someone who was in the same room ( that person never sent a request) otherwise I like this app so you can share stuff with friends and see what they’re up to. But I wish that we could enjoy that without worries

title: Some lizard
review: So some lizard robot thing called the Zuckerberg tried to steal my data and then some weird corporations tried to buy it and sell there crap. One time I had a dream about crayons and the zucc boi tried to sell me crayola crayons because he stole my dream data. 5 stars because zucc can come steal my dreams any night. 😏

title: Recent  updates
review: It looks like the newest most recent updates have created havoc on FB. Almost everything is not working well. Please review it and fix the issues. My like/love buttons don’t work. My posts and those of others are posting twice. The photos are not showing right away. As a matter of fact some event photos posted hours later. I checked to ensure all my updates and the iOS update were current. I don’t know what else to do. Just FYI this FB needs attention.

title: Latest Update Doesn’t Work
review: Since the last update, I’m having issues with the same notifications appearing as new ones, problems tagging, the search function isn’t working within groups at all, the app crashes when I’m scrolling and reading through comments, I’ve had problems with marketplace, and the search function there. I used these with ease prior to now. Please fix the glitches.

title: Adding Video to Existing Albums
review: Please can you all add this feature?! I run my church’s facebook page and I would just love to add video to the many albums I make for our events. Even in my private life, adding cool videos and photos to one album “Summer ‘18” or whatever would make it more complete. PLEASE ENABLE ADDING VIDEOS TO EXISTING ALBUMS! Other than that, I guess this app is good.

title: Not a fan of new update
review: Haven’t had much reason to dislike Facebook, but the new update has made it such that old notifications don’t go away when I’ve seen them. 9+ notifications pop up when there actually aren’t any new ones. Please fix that, and make suggested friends something you can turn off. I don’t want to see a bunch of people that I don’t actually know in my notifications all the time.

title: Video Platform
review: I’m giving it two stars currently because I am absolutely HATING the new feature of watching videos. If you want to watch them, you have to tap on it and then tap on it again because apparently the video takes you to another page, I don’t really know what it is, but It irks me that I have to tap twice just to watch a 15 sec video. Go back to the regular platform. Whoever thought of the double tap should be fired

title: Notification problem
review: Since the last update I am having problems with Facebook remembering which notifications I have already looked at.  Each time I close down Facebook the number of notifications on the Facebook icon returns to the number it had been before I went through to look at them and when I go to that page they are all highlighted as if I had never looked at them.  HELP!!!

title: Use to be great, now it never works
review: Message notification never clears. I’ve tried deleting all messages and still shows i have a message notification. I’ve deleted and downloaded again with no luck. Regular notifications won’t load right. It says i have nothing or it will say i have over 10 when neither is accurate. It is constantly glitching when i scroll so its impossible to view anything.

title: I'm still being generous
review:
I don’t know why I bother writing anything. Nobody will read this. 

I’m being forced to update even though the version I’m using is fine. All stories are still in the order FB wants. Who the heck is the customer here?  People have been clamoring for the chronological order of postings for FB, IG, and anything else these “people” make. But, nobody listens. 

I said it before, and I’ll say it again: We knew that monopoly wasn't good, but this is ridiculous! Facebook, get your act together. Why do I bother!!! 😡😡😡

title: Notifications
review: I keep getting notified by the same notifications. When I go to tap on them they get marked as read, but the minute I go back onto the app the get highlighted again as if they are new notifications. So you loss a star from me for this.

title: Notification fails
review: Facebook tells me that I have notifications all the time and when I go on to check I have no new notifications. It’ll say I have anywhere from 5-8 and literally it’s the same notifications i checked hours before that. Unless I’m getting new notifications and it’s not showing me? I’m sure I’m not the only one with this issue and it should be resolved or I’ll take my social media elsewhere. Instagram gives me no issues. I think I’ll post there from now on....

title: Oh Facebook, why?
review: My Facebook app consistently crashes, freezes, and refuses to load my time line like it did with the previous installment. I’m left with the same posts over and over again instead of obtaining new content that I’ve never seen over the whole day. I read one status or watch a video and it crashes or freezes. Restarted my phone, deleted the app, reinstalled the app, and unfortunately no change. Please fix this as I love using Facebook for the good memes!!!!

title: Whats going on?
review: Is it just me or is anyone’s app keep force closing? I deleted the app then downloaded it again and restarted my phone...it would happen randomly only the first post on the news feed shows and tries to load the rest but force closes on its own before loading news feed

title: iPhone X
review: The app keeps crashing. I open and use it for a moment and then it just shuts down. Apple says to contact app support. I cannot figure that one out. Just keep seeing comments. I have uninstalled and installed the app with no changes. All started today. Please help.

title: Hacked? Glitches?
review: Who knows? They ask you to describe the problem and never reply much less fix. My app keeps crashing and when I go through the security portion it tells me they noticed unusual activity and directs me to review posts,but when I click on that option it says something went wrong and they’re working on it. Reset password. Added passcode. All suggestions from them. All my apps are downloaded from App Store. I give up. Have no choice but to delete my account now.

title: Keeps kicking me out
review: Ever since I downloaded the update Facebook keeps kicking me out. As soon as I open it start scrolling it kicks me out. It started when I was scrolling then it had a mind of it own it would not stop scrolling pages by it self

title: I want my previous version back.
review: I have resisted doing a FB update for a very long time and I wish I would have kept resisting. The new version crashes repeatedly. It frequently shows me the same updates even days later. And where the heck is the ability to edit the color settings on my photos? I don’t need a bunch of frames/words/whatever. I find myself spending less and less time on FB as you guys try to make it less and less useful. Try listening to people.

title: After careful consideration
review: I reported an account that has some random name but my cousins photos and told them I have proof that this was a fake account I received an email a week or so in stating that “after careful consideration we have determined that this account is not fraud and will remain open” like I showed them proof and everything but of course they have “strict rules against fake accounts”. Another thing after this update it doesn’t work AT ALL.

title: Awesome
review: This app is so great you can share story’s with your friends and family and you can see a ton of things that are happening around the world also you can go live so your family and friends can have the same experience with you!

title: Featured photos
review:
Put back 9 featured photos! I want the 9! You should let it be an option on 5 or 9. I tried to change a picture from my 9 and now it says I can only have 5! Its frustrating. If I wanted 5 I would have 5. Other than that no problems with the app.

Edit: okay now all of a sudden my app is constantly crashing. It’ll load four or five post, then why I try to scroll down to see more it just crashes. This is ridiculous I know I’m not the first to complain. Fix. It.

title: Won't stay signed in for calendar
review: Normally this is a good app, but lately I have to sign in with my password frequently on my phone to get the app to post events into my iPhone calendar. I had to do it again today and it immediately signed me out and removed the Facebook event I had "interested" in the app. I am missing events because of this. I have to resort to manually putting in the event myself in Calendar until this is resolved.

title: App needs to stay where left off
review: I don’t know how many hundreds I f times this happens to me each week. I’m ready a post, switch apps (because, you know, multitasking) and when I come back Facebook refreshes and I lose that post. Sometimes I wade through all other posts to try to find it again...if I even remember who posted it...other time I say “Eff-it, it’s not worth the hassle”. Let the user have control of when the app refreshes!!!

title: Saved Items Crashing
review: I love the marketplace, but everytime I go into my saved marketplace items it crashes when I scroll a quarter of the way through them, it really bugs me because I hate having to go back to find the items I saved, the previous version of the saved section worked excellent, a fix would be nice then I would rate 5 stars

title: Old news
review: It seems like the only thing I see anymore are posts from several days ago that I’ve already seen. How hard is it to keep things in chronological order? Tired of seeming third party posts from people I don’t even know or things that I’ve blocked/hidden that still keep showing up. Facebook tells you have control over your news feed, but when it doesn’t work, you can’t get in touch with them and they don’t fix it when you report it.

title: Notification link busted
review: I update my app today and immediately noticed when I tap on a comment notification it only takes me to my profile pictures and directly to the comment. title: #DeleteFacebook
