Everything else is fine and for anyone complaining about the drama and what not you just have to get over other people having opinions. If they fix the video issue then the whole thing would be 100% better

title: Rotten change to a formerly acceptable and pleasant experience!!!!
review: I can’t even play Words With Friends anymore at all it automatically adds letters to the ones in there already faster than I can get even one letter in!!!!  This is ridiculous!!!  I am so sorry I bought this iPhone.  Smart phones offer much more info and are much easier to use!!!!!  You have managed to screw up something that used to be fun and enjoyable to a huge fiasco!!!  My worst regret is having purchased an iPhone!!!!!!!🤥🙃🤯😢🤬🇹🇰

title: Video Freezing
review: I have been having SO many problems the past few months where 8/10 times I go to plan a video with sound it automatically freezes after 2 seconds every time I hit play. This has been happening for months and despite continuously updating the app it does not improve. This only happens on the FB app for me.

title: Cannot Search in Groups
review: Since the new update 2 weeks ago I can no longer search in the Facebook Groups I belong to.  It is so frustrating.  I reported the problem right after the update and got the generic response “thank you for submitting your issue”. Please fix this!  Most of the groups I’m involved in are very active and don’t want the feed clogged up with questions that have been asked a million times.

title: Welp still not great
review:
The functionality of the newsfeed seems to be improved over the last update I can actually watch videos now so that’s nice. But the saddest thing is for some reason in market place I can’t change my search location when ever I want. It may work every 10th time I try. I just don’t understand how this company can’t get the simple stuff right.

Update they broke the video player again 🤷🏻‍♂️

title: Facebook
review: I love this app a lot there is a lot of funny stuff and my friends are on it but the thing is that I got hacked like twice on it so if people better be careful so they don’t get hacked themselves and wished I could continue using Facebook app but I can’t cause I got hacked like twice.

title: Photos
review: When I’m trying to scroll through photos on a page, I keep having to click on each one individually. Like, I used to be able to click on the first one and then scroll through them. Now when I click on the first one, it takes me to a screen with the photo and comments, and then I have to back out of it to click the next photo. Really frustrating and I have no idea how in the world anyone thought that it would be a good idea.

title: Remember the good old days
review: when your feed just appeared in time order and you couldn’t scroll through all the posts? Now I look at the same few posts for 20 hours...same posts, same ads, every time I sign in. I’ve tried different devices and still the same. Then I’ll go check one of my relative’s pages and there are posts I haven’t seen! Just knock off “the algorithm” crap and show the posts!

title: App is becoming a mess
review: With so many updates you’d think that the app wouldn’t have so many problems. They’ve switched around the notifications format so now my most recent notifications are at the bottom of the notification screen. I can’t watch a video with it starting and stopping every 2 seconds, despite my internet connection being strong. None of my pictures or comment will load.

title: Design is still old
review: Why won't my Facebook app update the design is still the old one. I’ve tried everything from deleting the app, deleting the browser history and I even restarted my iPhone Nd it still looks old. I have an iPhone X

title: Breaking my addiction
review: I’ve been a Facebook user since you needed an approved college email to have one. That was over 15 years ago and I wonder how much of my life I have wasted using this site. How many pivotal life moments I’ve missed because I was staring at the same posts over and over. Today I deactivated my account and I can’t wait to see how much happier I am because of it!

title: Force close and no photos
review:
I wrote and entire response and at the end it freezes then force closes my whole app.  Happened several times now.

Also when I choose to select a photo to share none of my photos show up.

What is the issue and my app is up to date but the force close has been gaping since your last update and no pics available since this morning.

title: Notifications?
review: It keeps saying I have 3 new notifications but isn't showing any new notifications...this started last night and it finally showed some notifications this morning but they couldn’t have been the same ones cuz it said 10-11ish pm. So I’m confused...it stopped showing that for a second and now it says 3 new notifications again I’m confused?

title: Facebook my entire FB And messenger has been completely removed Yesterday and today
review: Everything removedFace book put my news back and get this stupid market place off my phone I never gave you the right to remove my news and I had a local marketplace looks like the only thing I need to remove is Facebook if you mess with my set up again put it back now I’m elderly and disabled you have messed up my  yes I said my phone set up put it back that has nothing to do with FB AND YOUR CENSORSHIP !!!

title: Disappointed
review: I love my Facebook keeps me in touch with family that live far away but since this new update it won’t let me open the app!! The last update on May 11th 2019 was fine till today’s... please look into this thank you very much

title: Reaching
review: They seem to be desperately reaching to stay relevant and used. Almost everybody I know only has a Facebook “so their mom / grandma / dad / grandpa can keep in touch.” Every update adds another attempt at grabbing users attention in decreasingly meaningful ways. Notifications on things hardly relevant to you, that reappear as soon as you close the app to keep you constantly coming back in case it’s a real notification. The usage of this app is becoming increasingly manipulative and less useful by the week.

title: Support team is nonexistent
review: Facebook has a nonexistent support team for issues that are not fixable by users. I’ve been trying to fix an issue for several days for a business, and I’m unable to do it myself. There literally no access to real support- only support forums where other users are asking for advice, but no one has figured it out yet. What’s the point in building a social media presence of 100k organic followers if you can’t use that platform in the way Facebook was built for?

title: Disabled my account
review: I woke up yesterday to a disabled account never violated any terms. They still haven’t gotten back to me an i used my facebook for my business. I made a new profile an i can’t even login on the app or messenger. Couldn’t find a way to even talk to anybody. I lost my legacy contact for my mom my moderator over my band page an 3,900 friends plus my instagram went out to. I have already lost so much money due to this wish there was a way to actually talk to somebody to get it fixed.

title: Why the change?!
review: I always enjoy the updates, the last one I got, you click on the bottom and have a line of shows that you have or haven’t watched yet. And now with the new update it’s gone!! Bring it back! Every morning while getting ready, I would play little clips on my phone... now I have to go searching?! I honestly don’t care to see the groups I’m in, rather see what’s new in the “channels” I’m following.

title: Not working
review: After the most update done on April 14,2019, when I go to my screen it is a white screen. I am unable to get anything that the app has for Facebook when I click on the icon.  I have turned power off on my phone and back on, still nothing! I think they need to fix again the app so it will be working properly for all users.

title: I think notifications are finally getting fixed
review: Since the last update I'm finally getting badge notifications now! It's been over a year since I've last seen them and so far so good. I'm very happy right now :)

title: Not allowing me to login to my account
review: It keeps saying that there is an error when ever I try to log into my account or any other account. It has been doing this for weeks now. I delete both the messenger and Facebook app re-download them and it still does not allow me to login. I don’t know what the problem is but it is very annoying. I can not check any of my messages or notifications. But it does let me change my password to my account that is all.

title: Marketplace and groups are not improved
review: Marketplace doesn’t allow searches without  turning location services on. I can’t select a dot on the map and range to search.  Now my groups are so hard to get to. I used to be able to keep a few as favorites and now I have no control what I see.  If I want to go to a specific group it takes me several tedious clicks to get there. This “update” is lacking in the improvements department. Not even interested any more Facebook.

title: Not getting any better
review: I have an iPad Pro 10.5 and you would think this would load the app fast and not hesitate to work flawlessly??? WRONG It takes forever for the app to load, 20 seconds or more! Really? I have a photography page and I don’t receive any messages from my clients for a day or two. Not good for business. I am not happy with this!! No disrespect but on my galaxy note 8 I have no problems. Please fix more features don’t mean it’s a better app. Good running app is what I want

title: Constantly having issues
review: It seems like there are constantly issues with this app, getting notifications and then when you go to see them they aren’t there then if you are lucky they show up two hours later. Honestly if this was the beginning of Facebook I wouldn’t even bother using it. Social media shouldn’t be a hit and miss app, maybe you see what’s on there maybe you don’t...

title: Pictures blurry
review:
I’ve been using Facebook for pictures and since the last update they are all blurry when trying to take a screenshot. Please fix it. Also, please let us filter by month, not just year. Thank you!

Also, as others have mentioned, you can turn off your active status, but it still shows people you are active. It just switches back on. Please fix this also.

title: Facebook app chat red numbers won’t go away
review: I have uninstalled and installed the Facebook app and the Messenger app and it is still messed up. It keeps saying that I have unread messages and I do not have any unread messages. Please fix this!!!!!! It is really annoying to see the red numbers knowing I do not have any unread messages.

title: Version 209.0
review:
Version 209.0

This update has made it to where I can’t share posts to someone’s messenger anymore. Other than that, things are manageable. I don’t get notifications for about 10 minutes when the app isn’t running but I don’t need instant response to someone’s comment so that’s fine. Really just annoyed by not being able to share posts in messenger.

title: DISCUSTED
review: My fb account has been hacked!!! Hear that a lot I know. Mine is now owned by someone in Korea!!! My name, my PHONE NUMBER, my password, but it’s not me!!! And how do you get it fixed???? I would LIVE YOU KNOW! Since fb doesn’t offer a phone number, email address nothing to fix or better yet to attempt to STOP the problem. Fb tells me to go into my fb account, that has been taken over!!! I feel like I’ve been robbed! Anyone have a solution I’d love to hear it. Ive tried everything I can think of, and have came out empty

title: The worst and phasing out as a social platform
review: You get constant notifications that you do not care at all about (e.g., so-and-so also commented on a photo you commented on), and there’s no way to turn them off. There are so many stupid ways that they get you to log back in, without the ability to turn off a majority of pointless notifications, and every time you log in it’s for no reason and a waste. I delete the app often, but only redownload it to connect with family.

title: Annoyed
review: Every update you guys have offered is trash . I don’t want a button for short videos . And I don’t want a button for my groups ! If I want something I would like to go into my search . And now these stupid buttons are saying I have notifications like I don’t care  especially if the notifications are already in my notifications button ! You guys should really make it so I can choose what shortcuts are there because I’d only have my profile , homepage , and timeline .

title: Marketplace posts that get rejected yet are no where near against policies
review: Facebook has become impossible, I used to post things in market place, antiques vintage items none of which are offensive, or drug related or anything like that and recently everything is getting flagged and rejected and when you appeal it it never gets a response!! Its a joke I see things posted all the time offensive yet my stuff is being targeted its so unfair and really making me feel like facebook is a waste of my time!!

title: Reviewing My issues
review: Patti’s Review I love Facebook because I am able to keep in touch with Friends and Alumni & out of State Family! The most trouble I have is when new things are done and I have not been notified! Is it your responsibility to notify me or mine to Search and see?

title: Annoying updates.
review: It seems every time facebook updates I have to put my password in twice or thrice for it to actually let me log in. And then it keeps saying I can’t do stuff. I try to like something. Sorry u can’t do this. I say okay or that it’s a mistake an it just keeps happening. It’s annoying and it only happens when Facebook is updated.

title: iPad Pro 12.9
review: I know a lot of people have begged for a desktop view on the iPad. However, I much prefer the mobile view. How difficult would it be to give the option to switch? After the new update text is very small. Plus I like to scroll using my right hand. This isn’t possible with the right column information there. Please give us the option for a full screen mobile view back.

title: Gets worse and worse
review: This app just seems to keep getting worse and worse. The ‘most recent’ feature doesn’t work anymore and I regularly see the same posts from days ago while attempting to scroll through my newsfeed. That’s only when the newsfeed actually loads, as it frequently just stops and becomes blank. It’s ridiculous and makes me want to stop using Facebook altogether because the functionality is so poor.

title: This has gone down hill, fast
review: They don't reply to support tickets, I can't send videos because there's no sound. I can't add people anymore. That is not even mentioning there security issues. They allow hate speach, incorrect medical advice and censorship while selling out information for adds. I've been asking for help for months with problems and never got a reply. Deleted the app, the data, changed the permissions and settings, nothing. Thanks Facebook, guess another one bites the dust. 🌬

title: Horrible app
review: Every time this app updates it gets worse. The newsfeed won’t load, when it does you’re not seeing all your friends, just whoever the app thinks you should. And it’s never in order, the first few things will be posts from a week ago. Also, I updated my notification settings because I don’t want to be told when someone is “live” or there’s something for sale in marketplace that matches a former search . Still getting notifications.

title: Can’t watch videos
review: For months now when I watch a string of videos on Facebook several of the videos will stop for no reason part way through the video. It’s not loading I’ve ruled that out a long time ago. The only way to continue to watch the video is to skip 10 seconds ahead which is tend to miss important parts of the video. Please fix this before I delete Facebook forever.

title: Stupid
review: For being the largest social media site I would think it would be a smooth running app, no even close!! Come on facebook, get with the program, wish someone else came up with a better app for facebook,  one star is only cause I can't give it -⭐️, freezing all the time, always crashing. Feed not coming up. This app over all is just junk. Maybe you should work on getting the basic app working correctly before adding a the "bells and whistles". Pathetic

title: An absolute dumpster fire of an organization.
review: This organization is nothing more then a dumpster fire disguised has a “friend”. The leadership cares nothing about its users because they are not its customers. For its customers are actually the advertisers to whom pay Facebook billions to snoop, spy and invade your lives in hopes you’ll buy their shiny new product. Do yourself a favor and delete Facebook (and all of social media for that matter) from your life. It’ll be hard at first, but you’ll be glad you do in the end.

title: ***LONGTIME*** Newsfeed Problem
review:
I, like other reviewers have mentioned, have a terrible, continuing problem with the main newsfeed page.  
Some days when I go into FB, it only brings up one post.  
Some days it will let me scroll down through couple days of posts, then it just stops.  I can never start at the top and then keep scrolling down to posts more than a week or so back. 

This has been doing this for months and months and months.  
I keep thinking they will fix it, but it’s never happened.  

I, like others, use FB to keep up mostly with family and a few friends.  It’s so frustrating when you can’t go down through more than a few scrolls, and it refuses to go any further.

title: Super glitchy
review: Love the app, but it’s very glitchy every time I try to type, like the space bar is nonexistent when i type on this app. Also my statuses and captions disappear very frequently. So I when I check my notifications I can’t see the status I wrote that someone is commenting on or the caption that I wrote on something I’ve shared unless Use a browser or something.

title: Same notifications keep popping back up
review: In this newest update, I keep getting push notifications on and in the app but it’s the same ones I’ve already seen. They seem to only clear when I press the notification but it’s so unnecessary because it’s usually “someone commented on someone else’s post” or “this person liked your status”

title: Update
review:
Facebook updated today. AGAIN. And it’s messed up. It runs everything you’re typing together as one big long word as though it can’t recognize the space bar. It closes out posts midway through typing them. It’s taking forever to load. 
Always “fixing” bugs only to create new ones. It constantly show that o have a ton of notifications yet I open it and I have 1. Today it had 17 notifications showing. I actually had 1. This app is messed up.

title: Newsfeed won’t load
review: It started this week on Monday where my facebook wouldn’t load the news feed it just shows me 3 things at a time. Iv had my Facebook for over 9 years. Never had this problem. This week Facebook even teleported one of my comments because it said “my boys are beasts” nothing wrong with that comment at all. Iv tried everything to updating deleted the app, logging in and out, nothing is working!

title: Posts disappearing
review: I’ll get a notification that someone liked a link or photo or status... when I go to said post, the actual words I posted are gone. The link/photo/post is still there, but my attached words or caption is missing until I reload it from my timeline. I had someone comment on a post and when I click on the notification, it shows the comment, but not which post it’s for??? Fix it!

title: Still no proper support for the 12.9’’ iPad Pro
review: Three years ago, almost to the exact day, Apple released the iPad Pro 12.9 inch version.  Since then, Facebook has not released an optimized version of their app for the large iPad.  It really makes a significant difference when developers take advantage of the differences between devices.  I loathe using Facebook on my iPad, despite loving everything else about my iPad Pro, I *hate* Facebook on the iPad Pro 12.9 inch model.  Get your lives together Facebook and release a proper app!

title: Oh, Lordy.
review: This app has gotten so much better in the past couple of years, but there are still so. Many. Bugs. Especially in this version, it seems. A lot of my posts show up as absolutely nothing! No text at all even though it is there. It happens when I click on friends’ posts, too. That is one wild problem. Some webpages won’t load, and none of the browser-based Facebook setting will load. Ah.

title: Uses a large amount of battery
review: Even true genius at the Apple store said it won’t use this on his phone.  He uses Safari to look at Facebook.  This preserves battery for you at a time when people who don’t want to spend $1K on a new phone but have an aging phone battery of previous generations.  Developers and software designers need to keep in mind that people will see the resources this app wastes and stop using it.     Just my input.

title: Latest update
review: What’s with not being able to view the post attached to a photo when clicking on it? Is it a bug with the latest update? It’s super annoying. You have to go to the friend’s page and scroll until you find the post in order to read the text that they’ve added to the picture.

title: Need update for XS MAX
review: I’m having the hardest time with loading photos. When I click on someone profile the photos are grainy! Then about 30 secs later I go back to the same photo and it’s full resolution. Facebook, why is it taking so long for the photo quality on peoples albums so show? This should be instantaneous since I am on giga bit WiFi. Please fix this issue, super annoying to wait on picture quality to load!

title: It's good but you miss two more things here!
review: It's good but the two more things missing in here is that the about me section on Facebook profile and favorite quotations must be visible to all mobile device users and also when visitors visits your profile, they will get a chance to read the about me section and also the favorite quotations and it's missing

title: iPhone Users Beware. Live Photo = FB AP Killer
review: So I posted some Live Photo’s on FB, attempted to any way a few days ago. It attempts to process the post and crashes the AP. It is stuck in a viscous cycle with no end in sight. I haven’t been able to get into the AP. I attempted to reach support via the website. So far it’s been several days and I haven’t been so much as seen a notification they received my complaint. I had to delete the AP entirely from my phone, then reinstall it. Hope this fixes it. If not, cie la vie!

title: Too easy to hit the wrong thing & lose a post one has been working on
review:
It is too easy to hit or swipe the wrong thing and lose something one has been working on for an hour or so.

I fully recognize that I screwed up and hit the wrong thing—but once the post was gone it was gone, and I can find no way to get it back. I was proud of it and looking forward to posting and getting comments on it—but now I would rather not waste my time trying to re-create it.

title: This app is just silly
review: Why are we at version 192.0?  Because Facebooks app developers don’t understand what a version history is.  Every update tells us there are improvements, but doesn’t say what they are, or if they’re rolling back a previous update to a more stable state.  It is unacceptable that a company this large is so unwilling to let us know what it is doing to their own app.

title: Easy on IPhone
review:
FB application is very easy and handy. Even if you are loading pictures, does not take a lot of time. I can update my status quickly. I love it!!!
Update: FB lately has been allowing many advertising while watching a video. That’s a huge time consuming and I don’t see the point in having advertisements everywhere you go on FB. Horrible!

title: Notification Errors
review: Keeps showing i have 5 notifications for 1 when I open the app. So it’s showing more notifications outside the app and once I go in, it’s less than what was displayed. Has been happening for awhile off and on and my apps are always updated, just a minor irritation for me.

title: Still Frustrated
review: I have the most recent version of FB. Still not able to see all notifications- comments and likes on what I have commented on or shared. I see a crap ton of history from mostly one person and then 2 recent notifications that often disappear a few seconds after I view them. Will this ever be fixed??? My notifications are pretty much useless at this point.

title: why we can't have nice things
review: Most of my biggest problems with Facebook are related to the idiots who use it to spam my feed with SJW nonsense. That isn't Facebook's fault. What is their fault, is the fact that they've changed their APIs in a way that prevents 3rd party apps from scheduling posts. If they aren't going to let 3rd parties do it, they should at least give us a way to do it in this app. So... please give us that feature oh mighty demi-gods of Facebook.

title: App kicking me out
review: Lately, the app keeps kicking me off as I am scrolling down my feed. I haven’t been able to get past more than 3-4 posts before it shuts down and I’m kicked off. I deleted it and will download it again to see if it is better. If not, I’ll be taking a long break from Facebook. More and more join Instagram everyday so, who knows... maybe I won’t even come back. You can do better than this, Facebook!!

title: Awful app
review: You’re better off saving the link in your phones browser. This thing amassed over 100mb if additional memory space every other week of casual use. It keeps adding up. It’s ridiculous. It’s heavily buggy, memory hog, bandwidth hog and extremely aggravating hey way they’ve set it up. I seem to remember some day in ...say 2010... this app was brilliant. Reminiscing on better days. It’s a waste of a download. Don’t even bother or stick to the desktop version at home. Spend your time more wisely.

title: Facebook and Messenger whacked
review:
For over a week, when I am on FB or Messenger, it says I have to log in again (session expired).  When I try to, it says suspicious activity detected, then account gets locked out (again).  I am using the app on an iPhone and an iPad.  

Something is wrong.....  I can’t log in to report this through the app since I’m locked out, therefore this review. App is up to date and software is up to date, and we have tried deleting the app, and then adding it back on devices.

title: Not as good as it used to be
review: Facebook used to be the fun, all in one application to use. Now they require you to to download an extra messenger app to even view Facebook messages. There are too many advertisements, and now I get so many notifications telling me that a friend of mine commented on another friends status? I don’t need that.... I would rather just use the safari website if I happen to need to use Facebook nowadays.

title: Getting progressively worse
review:
It seems the more updates that come out, the worse the app becomes. Anything from notifications that won’t go away to not even being able to comment on my own posts. 

Kind of pathetic of a app that has been around for years and it seems with many of the recent reviews, I’m not alone in my assessment. May be time to be on the lookout for other platforms.

So I’m always using Facebook to keep up on life with friends and family. Recently Updated Facebook on the most recent update and now I’m having issues with the notifications. The same 3 notifications load and that’s it! It’s annoying. The notifications keep showing that I never opened it when I clicked on it. Every time I open Facebook it loads the same 3 notifications. It’s very annoying...

title: New update feature
review: The new update feature that causes the top bar with the time and battery percent as well as WiFi connection and location usage to be hidden while using the app is very inconvenient and unnerving. Almost like they’re trying to prevent you from seeing if they’re using your location data or trying to keep you from realizing how much time you’re spending on the app. Do not like I would delete the app but I have to use it for school groups.

title: Notifications Out of Wack
review: I don’t usually have a ton of issues with Facebook but recently I keep getting notifications for old notifications that I’ve already checked. So I would see that there are 6 notifications but they would be at the bottom where I’ve already checked them and appear as new for some strange reason.

title: Each update
review: Every time there’s an update it messes something else up. Twitter no longer post to Facebook and my notifications pop up several times even after I’ve checked them. You want to correct something correct messenger from notifying you when you don’t even have it installed and correct the way people reply to your story from showing through messenger. I’m about to delete Facebook entirely and use one of the other social media platforms

title: App keeps crashing!
review: For about a week now every time I go on the Facebook app from my phone it just crashes and sends me back to my home screen. If it does let me look at something on my news feed it will show me one post and won’t show me anymore and then crash. I have tried updating the app, my phone, turning my phone off, and deleting and reinstalling the app, nothing has helped and it’s getting old.

title: Horrible!!
review: Okay, I downloaded your stupid messenger, but now you've completely ticked me off because when I click on "most recent" from my phone, it is showing me stuff from hours to days ago!!!!  I just want most recent in my newsfeed! Seriously!?!!? This is ridiculous! There is absolutely NO need for you to have to update the dang app every week! Haven't you ever heard of leaving well enough alone!? I've never been so angry with this app before! Stop ruining it, you've done enough damage! Idiots.

title: Why fix what wasn’t broken?
review:
So I have had a FB acct since Facebook started! And so many times spam pops up trash talking, Ect . 
And a big change that makes no Denice happens!
Not when security is a major issue?... it’s change up what wasn’t broken, and still the trash talk sits!!.. and security still isn’t better 🤕 so let’s just fix what’s broken... leave the rest alone

title: Terrible app with issues
review: I have been using this app for years. All of a sudden, after the last update, the app is closing and crashing. Unfortunately, there is no support available to fix this extremely frustrating issue. I deleted and re-installed the app, did a hard reset and finally erased all only phone date and the app still has the same issues. A terrible app when there are issues and not help except advice on the internet to troubleshoot.

title: Face book
review: All in all face book is an awesome app but when I go to my saved list and n market place it keeps closing out and I don’t have time to find what I’m looking for before it closes out back to the home screen on my phone I have an iPhone 6 less than 4 months old and the latest IOS update

title: Crashes often
review: Since the last update I have had problems with the app. I have uninstalled it and reinstalled it. Nothing works right since the update. The app keeps crashing or freezes up. I can open the app and by the time it loads everything which doesn’t take long it crashes an kicks me out. I know it’s not my phone since I just upgraded my phone. Facebook needs to fix their app ASAP.

title: Blind Facebook user
review: Are use voice over on my iOS device and when I try to copy and paste or attach a link to a comment it would not allow me to do that. There are no options given to voiceover users for these things. It would also be nice if we could read the text that were attached inside of photos that are shared.

title: Bug on Facebook Business Page
review: Please fix the bug that prevents some (or in my case, ALL) reviews on a business page from disappearing. I have a new-ish business page though my business is several years old and I’ve been told by potential clients that they didn’t request my services because I didn’t have a single review. This makes me look like an amateur and is affecting my business. I have looked into it and see that I’m not the only one experiencing this issue. PLEASE fix!!

title: Facebook app keeps crashing
review: The facebook app keeps crashing 30 seconds from opening the app. I was barely able to send the report a problem but I haven't heard back from facebook. It just shuts down. If anyone knows of a fix please let me know. Its on the iphone. Its started a couple days ago but got worse when they updated the app. I have logged out removed the app and re-downloaded the app and it still crashes. I have plenty of space on my phone too.

title: When are you gonna fix this issue!
review:
For years we are plagued by the annoyance of having to restart our scrolling of our wall from the very top because we slightly scrolled towards the left while scrolling downward?  
We get forced into another menu and once you go back to the wall, you have to start from the top. 
** Suggestion: how about changing the menu to the left into something from the top menu option ** 
Wow, such a simple fix to a major annoyance.

title: Friends list feed
review: What is the point of being able to make a list of certain friends, if you can’t access that friends list from the app anymore? I can only access my friends list feeds from the desktop webpage.    Come on app developers get this thing working the way it’s set up on the website. App becomes more and more useless

review: The iOS Facebook app leaves several things to be desired, but the main one for me is the lack of ability to clear all notifications all at once instead of opening each notification individually. For that reason alone, I usually access Facebook using a browser; it is possible I just don't know how to do it using the app.

App cannot load The lastest news or there is nothing to show even if It has already updated to the lastest version. I tried many ways to deal with it as delete browser history in account setting, re-install or force stop but it’s all unuseful.

review: I can't even begin to imagine how many gigabytes of bandwidth I've spent updating this one app. How about making sure it's right before you release it? I can understand having to deal with iOS updates, but this is just way too often with updates that are way too large. Be more considerate of your users resources.

Please use more time testing the app before releasing multi megabyte updates. That require wifi and time for nothing.

I also have a problem with Marketplace not loading or not sending messages. I constantly have to check my settings to make sure I am connected because that searching wheel keeps turning. Please help a girl out!

title: A lot of issues recently
review:
Up until recently I never had issues with the app. Now it seems like 70-80% of photos or videos just won’t load. I’ve deleted and reinstalled the app multiple times and am using the most recent version. 

The app is mostly unusable at this point because I use it to keep in touch with a small group of friends and family and if I can’t see what’s going on in their lives then why am I even here? Please address this issue.

title: Birthdays no longer appear in events calendar
review: I’m getting so sick of these mobile app updates. They fix one thing and remove another. For the past few months, I not only no longer receive notifications of my friends birthdays, but they also no longer appear in my events calendar. And yes- I have checked my settings to ensure that birthday notifications are turned on. WTH Facebook??

title: Pages I follow
review: Before these past couple of updates I was able to click on my page, go to my “about me” section and scroll through all the pages I follow on Facebook, this is no longer a feature since the newest updates. I can’t seem to figure out a way to look up the pages I already follow either. Please make the appropriate changes. I really enjoyed being able to scroll through my list and select the pages specifically.

title: Dude
review: Oh my god this update is the worst one by far, go back to the way it was. Annoyed that I can’t swipe right to get out of a video anymore, and the audio on any video I’m watching will cut out randomly. The only way to fix it is by completely closing the app, but then when you reopen it you have to search through your timeline for the video you were previously watching 🙄 and of course, sometimes you can’t find it at all. Also why doesn’t dark mode exist yet?

title: Not okay
review:
A lot of useless updates every freaking week. Each of them uses a lot of storage every time. 
Also, I WANT TO CHOOSE WHAT I SEE. Someone replied to a comment of mine and I CAN’T read it because “most relevant is selected, so some replies may have been filtered out.” Yeah it’s not “may have been” THEY HAVE BEEN filtered and I can’t do anything. I want to choose what I see because IT’S OBVIOUS I WANT TO READ A REPLY to a comment I posted! I don’t understand why would you just do that. 

I freaking hate this app. MINUS 5stars if it were possible.

title: Is there a glitch
review: Even tho I updated my Facebook app, every once in a while when I’m watching videos the screen just goes black and takes me out of my app. It’s been doing it since yesterday when I updated it.

title: Can’t upload videos anymore
review: Since the last few updates I haven’t been able to upload videos directly from my gallery to Facebook, pictures yes but even a picture with a video won’t work. I figured I’d wait til the next update but that happened this morning and I still can’t upload. Yes, I know I could go into the app and upload from there but the video quality isn’t as great. If this in fact is a Facebook app issue, please please fix.

title: What the flip
review:
This was ruined myself. I delved it because it was too glittched
I use roblox messenger app. You can text ur friends in roblox messager. In there, you can ask ur friends, help, or play with them. I developed my favorite games to create them. I was a member of Pinewood Builders. You need to join the group into diddleshot’s name in roblox. HAAAAAAAAAVE FUN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

title: Facebook Marketplace
review: I can go to the marketplace on Facebook. Can see the pictures of what is being offered, but when I tap on a picture to see how much it is or leave a message for the seller it goes to a screen that says an error has occurred. This started to happen when I did the last update on my iPad. I have rebooted the iPad twice and it hasn’t helped. Hoping someone can help me with this problem, thanks.

title: Why bother having marketplace if you can’t post anything to it from mobile.
review: Generally, I’m about done with this platform regardless. But if you’re gonna have the option of posting things to Marketplace then the app shouldn’t crash when I try to post something. I have stopped using the page manager because it was a steaming load that barely worked, but now I’m about done with this app too.

title: Rarely see friends posts
review: Rarely see friends posts! I am connected to several hundred people on this site and rarely see their posts or pictures and other say the same for my posts etc. Push notifications are rare and group push notifications are all the more rare or even days later !!! What’s the point in keeping this app when the interaction with others is minimal?

title: STOP WITH THE POINTLESS UPDATES
review: This social media app has gone from the greatest way to connect with people to one of the most annoying things in my life. Granted some things are awesome to have as far as capabilities and functionalities are concerned, but others, like these “animated” reactions, are just pointless. No one likes them, including myself. Please take them down in your next update.

title: Its Facebook
review: Other then random times I am reading an article and it pops up with something else its facebook. No better no worse then using the web site on my computer. I gave it 5 stars because I like it and it suits my needs

title: Keeps freezing
review: I have an iPhone xsmax brand new only a few weeks old. Every time i watch a video it freezes when I’m about to leave the video then i have to close the whole app out and it’s getting annoying. And no it’s not my phone as i switched carriers and got a new phone but my other xsmax did the same thing. Fix it...

title: Bugs
review: My news feed won't refresh just shows the same feed that was there after I updated this, I logged out logged in didn't help at all wrote to somethings not work in the help center that didn't help, and also I'm constantly not being able to share something or react or like somethings out of no where a lot. All I see 24/7 is attachment unavailable on posts that were fine.

title: Facebook censorship
review: Facebook sensors what you post people can post nude pictures of women but if you post a picture of a Islamic woman in a headdress saying  defined homeland security they will boot  you off for hate speech.... but you can post things about the president that are hateful and make threats and that’s OK... Mark Zuckerberg and Facebook have a double standard they have their view and that’s the only correct one...Then your phone picks up anything you say delivers it to Facebook so they can bombard you with advertisements

title: Groups feature is broken
review: Once again, Facebook groups are rendered utterly unusable on iOS. With no way to sort a group’s feed by most recent posts first, it’s pointless to even try to navigate the group’s posts. For the buy/sell groups I belong to, I might not see some posts until well after the item has sold. I find auctions in my feed that have already closed. The whole feature of groups is broken and they really don’t seem to care.

title: Videos won’t play
review: Every time I try to watch a video on Facebook it freezes and then pops up with a message saying unable to play video. If I exit the message I can hit play and it will restart but continues to freeze and have these pop ups. I have tried in multiple different areas with different levels of service and connected to WiFi and get the same message. Please fix.

title: Video Playback
review: At first I thought it was just my phone but I realized others have the same issue.. Over WiFi the videos never want to load. They pause and act like they are loading just about every 5 seconds. Over my regular cellular data, the videos work great. I’m just not trying to stay on my cellular data for some Facebook videos when I have perfectly fine working WiFi.

title: Face book game data
review: Needs to be an option for all games that connect to Facebook to reset the progress so that way it’s easier for players who just want to start the game fresh and said of just doing it without Facebook

title: Latest Build Needs Fixing
review: I’m mobile app, upon selecting a notification for a post in a group or on a page that was either not initiated by me or not commented on by me (and sometimes some that are), the application just spins and never updates to allow me to see the post the notification refers to. This has been happening for the last several days and is incredibly frustrating.

title: App crashes since update
review:
I have iPhone SE with latest iOS update. Since Facebook mobile updated late last year (2018), it crashes within seconds of opening. All that’s shows is the first post and nothing else. The problems started before the iOS update and after, leading me to believe the app is the problem.

Update: I updated the app, still crashes like it did before. Guess I won’t be using Facebook mobile anymore.

Also, Mark Zuckerberg hates journalists.

title: Having issues every time it updates
review: Every time there’s a new update I have a new issue. 1. my Live Photo’s won’t upload as Live Photo’s. 2. App will be saying I have ten notifications and only show two but won’t go away. 3. Currently I’m having issues seeing posts on pages/groups. It’ll show me the top post but when I try to reload the page it just loads forever. Get it together Facebook.

title: Two many useless features that burdens the sole purpose of the app
review: Can’t get newsfeed, can’t load anything basically. isn’t the whole purpose of people having Facebook is staying connected? I don’t care what fancy features that no one knows about, Facebook  have when you can’t even have the most basic simple Facebook working. It’s just frustrating to see the same 5 posts for a week. Isn’t it time to get this problem fixed?

title: Prisoner to Facebook
review: I do not even have to check whether there is an update, because the app does not work properly when there is an update available. Why are we forced to update when it is working for me as is?

title: I’m not mad, just disappointed...
review:
This newest update:

You’re capable of soo much more, you have the power to do incredible things . Sadly, over the course of recent time..this has been a deteriorating relationship, I miss the moments where I could easily navigate, where I could browse my feed, and where I can message my friends easily ...I think we need some space, if you can’t reconnect and correct the error of your ways ..we might need to reconsider this path together Facebook.

title: Picture orientation wrong
review: Since the latest update for iOS, pictures always orient in the home button down position, regardless of the orientation of the phone or iPad.   Can you change it back so the picture orients the same way the device is being held?  Annoying!

title: To many issues
review: Use to be you could delete apps that was linked to your fb, now it just stays connected no matter what. Even when you don’t want to upgrade right now you don’t have a choice.  You have to no matter what or else certain apps won’t work or even let you on them. It is starting to seem like fb is turning into a virus filled with political agendas and prejudice bs instead of a fun entertaining site to whom you can connect with friends and family.

title: Notification issues
review:
I keep doing the updates on my iPhone and I have updated iOS and still have an issue where only 20 notifications load.  That’s it.  Can’t scroll any further. 

Oh and then too, the notifications will just randomly change order, and I’m looking at notifications from hours ago and the one that just came in is nowhere to be found. 😡

Please. Fix. This.

title: New facebook is awful!
review: It’s really annoying that the most recent notifications don’t show up at the top! You have to view every individual notification now it’s so annoying. And now I get notifications every time someone likes something. This is not useful! Nobody wants this!! Fix it!!! There is no way to turn this off. Basically Facebook is useless now because I will be turning off all notifications and probably just end up not using it then.

title: Totally messing up
review:
Ever since the latest update, the app either crashes or it takes forever to load. Plus all my notifications are out of order. It might show me a couple new notifications, then I’ll show me notifications from yesterday, then passed does it will show me more new notifications. Really starting to irritate me. 

And now Thank you and see that my friends have posted something but when I pull it up it doesn’t show what they posted.

title: AB testing is out of control with Facebook...
review:
....and it always seems like I’m getting the worst possible version. Clicking on notifications shows the comments with no post body, marketplace links go to safari instead of staying in the app, impossible to tag groups, etc.

Like many other Bay Area tech companies, Facebook needs to just leave it alone and stop adding in random features or useless updates if they can’t do it without breaking the rest.

title: SO annoyed by the notifications of people I don’t want
review: I’ve tried everything to stop receiving notifications of people’s activity that I don’t have specified as “get notifications”. It’s been a few months of this BS. I have no idea why these random people start showing up as “So and So posted this. So and So shared this. So and So commented on this photo”. I don’t care!!! There’s no way to stop it without unfollowing them. I’m deleting this app. FB is so shady.

title: Quit taking stuff away
review: Most recently the recent tab basically quit working. Wont show stuff newer than 12 hours. Also comments mean new post on recent? The app is okay for mobile use. Might have to go back to desk top system for the sorting. More and more adds popping up. Good point is event invites still come through. Also easier to “take a break” instead of unfriending and refriending people.

title: Frustrated
review: Beyond frustrated with FB lately, nothing will load. If I’m lucky I get a picture, but then can’t read any comments, it just keeps “spinning”. But most of the time I don’t even get pictures from my friends. But I sure get to see all of the crappy ads that I don’t want to see. The same exact posts show over and over again, barely anything new (when it actually lets me see something).

title: App keeps closing
review: My app keeps closing out   In the 10 minutes I’ve been on it has automatically closed itself at least 5 times. I have updated FB. Updated iPhone. Removed and reinstalled FB turned my phone off after removing and reinstalled. I have had my iPhone checked out by service tech. I’m out of answers and it keeps happening

title: Notifications
review: As much as I love using Facebook to store my photos I'm having a problem with my notifications I'm not sure if it's the wifi bit every time go on it o know I have new notifications but I'm not able to see them it just gives me the old ones or ones 50 min ago or 1 or 2 hours ago I keep refreshing it should I do something

title: Always been a fan... until the censoring of opposing views
review: I fully intend resolving my personal complaints with FB.   I’ve used and enjoyed the ease of communication between family, old friends, and several new friends.  However, it’s proven that FACEBOOK is biased and unfortunately has been unfair!   I know I’m not alone when I say how disappointing it is to have political tension webbed into things some ppl used to avoid ‘politics’ and being so politically correct about EVERYTHING!  Am I to assume this will also be censored

title: Saved Videos
review: I wish when I saved a videos, I could create  different categories to put them in so I could come back and find exactly the one I want later so I don’t have to go scrolling through 65 videos to find the one about cream cheese filled pumpkins all the way at the bottom.

title: My Password
review: I try to reset my password on my old page  and they kept giving me the same passcode. I correctly entered my passcode and FB kept saying it was incorrect until I entered too many of the correct. I tried to e-mail FBSecurity and I tried received no response. I tried the help desk and it didn’t help. Therefore I had to set up a new page. I don’t know if I am blocked or in FB Jail!!!

title: Problem with sharing posts
review: So last week it was that my notifications weren’t showing they were seen when they already were they just kept popping up as new ones. That’s fixed now so there’s something. Now Facebook is not allowing me to share anything? Saying I’m blocked for doing it too quickly? Says go to the help center so I do and find nothing in there to fix the problem. Sooo please fix Facebook yet again. This is getting annoying.

title: News feed
review: I can’t get past five stories in my newsfeed. There is no option to do anything other than refresh, and then I still can’t see past those five posts. The directions you sent to “manage” my feed, I already had it set up. Please stop trying to determine what it is I want to see. Your algorithms have disappointed me. I’m considering deleting the app for good. I’ve had to delete multiple times lately to troubleshoot why my news feed is broken.

title: Facebook settings not allowing me to revoke camera and mic access
review: I wanted to send a picture through Facebook messenger so I went to my settings to allow access, and when I went back to turn access off after the option had disappeared. Now the only options are to allow camera access on HD. I shouldn't be forced into signing over my camera and microphone access to Facebook.

title: Notifications
review: The update that I did on August 3rd seems to have caused a problem with FaceBook on my iPad.  I get notifications but they don’t clear when I choose the notification.  I also don’t seem to get to the post that is listed in the notification.  I certainly hope this gets fixed quickly. It’s quite annoying

title: Facebook problem
review: I can’t access fb. It’s the new version 182.0.. I tried uninstalling and switching my phone off and reinstalling. It doesn’t work. I tried all the other stuff like switching off the automatic updates but no good. Please help

title: App Continues to Crash
review: Every single time I try to upload photos to Facebook, it crashes. It’s been happening the last few months but after 8 attempts it would work.... now, not even after 23 (and counting) attempts to post even one picture. Ridiculous. And there is no one to reach out to at Facebook to help with this glitch. Frustrating, because all I use fb for is photos, anyways.

title: Crashes frequently, won’t load feed
review: Crashes constantly. Have tried deleting the app and reinstalling and the results are the same. Does not load posts to feed consistently, sometimes showing it’s trying to fetch more results while only showing me one or two posts from my last session, and doesn’t load anything new. Crashing and feed load failures occurred before and after delete / reinstall and whether or not on WiFi.

title: Facebook
review: My Facebook app on my iPhone 7 keeps closing every time I enter it. I have tried restarting my phone, logging out and back in and deleting and reinstalling the app. Nothing works. If I even get into my newsfeed, I get one post for a moment, I cannot scroll and then I am booted out of the app completely. I cannot access the report a problem feature in Facebook to alert them to the problem because once again, I’m booted out of the app. It’s quite frustrating.

title: Strict about names, personal data
review: Something I don't understand about Facebook is why, when you must create an account, it requires you to put your real name "so your friends can find you." If this really WAS the case, it should be optional to put your real name. My friends have other ways to find me than just my real name, or I can contact THEM. Facebook is honestly going downhill from what I once knew when I used to use it.

title: Freeze and crash
review: About 3 weeks ago Facebook started crashing on me, randomly closing, not loading and freezing up. I’ve tried uninstalling, deleting, restarting, hard reset on my phone, etc, etc and nothing works. I’m annoyed and irritated that the tech dept at a multi-billion dollar company can’t fix their system. I know it’s not just me, because a simple internet search offers ways to “fix” the problem...so it must be more common than just one user!

title: Crashing all the time
review: I don’t know what is happening but the past few weeks my FB has been crashing. Right in the middle of reading or posting comments.  I am not the only one in my area.  There are a few of us with various ISPs who are experiencing the same thing.  It only happens on our IPhones. FB worked fantastically when I got my phone in May.  This has gone on too long. I’ve done all the suggestions from well meaning friends and none of it has worked.

title: Marketplace isn’t working right.
review: When i message someone regarding an item, I’ve always been able to click on the details part of the message and it takes me to the original ad/post. Now it redirects me as if it’s going to and then it says click here to go to marketplace and below it says click here to download from Apple store. Neither one has worked. I’ve tried both. So the only way to find that item I’m messaging about is to search it in the marketplace.

title: More desirable features
review: It would be great to be able to share stuff from Facebook directly to Whatsapp without having to copy the link or leaving Facebook. A “share on Whatsapp” option would be great. Since you guys own both apps, it shouldn’t be difficult to do, I suppose.

title: <UPDATED>.   Old, but still valid review: JUMPY, JUMPY! STOP THE INSANITY! PLEASE!
review:
I’d LOVE to see an “Items Wanted” section on Market Place!!!!! PLEASE CONSIDER IT...

Old review:
Facebook now jumps all over the place when I'm trying to read something in the newsfeed. What's the point of the newsfeed if people CAN'T READ WHAT'S THERE??? Please fix this issue, and stop the auto-play on videos!!! Some of us don't have unlimited data available!!! C'mon, Facebook! Seriously!

title: Love it!! ❤️ ❤️ 💕 💕
review:
I love Facebook and it’s so cool to contact to my family and see what there up too! I also love the memories, I can see what I look like when I was little! The only bad side is that it glitches sometimes. but like when I try to post something! It’s still a great app!! 

-Ava Bax

title: Featured stories annoying.
review: Featured stories, used to just be a bar at the top of my page, now it’s a huge section on my feed and I can’t see the actual feed until I get through this. I didn’t watch the stories to begin with and now I don’t even feel like logging in to skip a page full of them. Please give an option to hide this feature or go back to how it used to be featured.

title: App keeps Crashing on iPhone X
review: For the last week or so, my FB app has been crashing. It states that I am not connected to WiFi when that is not the case. I constantly have to delete & reload the app to get it to work for an hour or so but then crashes again. I have confirmed that there are no issues with my WiFi connectivity. I am connected and it still crashes with that error message.

title: App updates
review:
The facebook app is the only app I have in my iPad that made updates automatic, I don’t like it because I don’t have any option to choose manually or automatic, because before to update the app donwload the new version and my iPad goes without enough storage space. And that’s occurr when I am using it and stop what I am doing.
With all those issues about intrusive marketing and violation of our privacy, we (the users) don’t have any control on our electronic devices.

title: Videos and photos aren’t uploading
review: Just got the update a week ago and I’ve been trying for over two days to post photos and/or videos and it refuses to post. It gets almost all the way and then it says “taking awhile to post” I’ve updated my phone, I’ve updated the app, Ive turned the phone on and off and nothing is working

title: On This Day Issues
review: Very good app but I have issues with On This Day memories. Most of my status updates will not show up. I will have a few show up here and there but not all of them. I have reported this problem multiple times but Facebook hasn’t resolved it. It is very frustrating.

title: Erratic, Inconsistent and Opaque
review: One never knows what one is going to get from FB. New updates frequently introduce new bugs (e.g., can no longer access Timeline Review from the iPad app), drop or modify long-established features (e.g., spinning Messenger into a separate app), and modify the ways in which features work (e.g., handling of ads, trends, etc.). FB algorithms for what postings by Friends to display on my feed are a total mystery. And FB has a long way to go to establish any level of trust after their abominable handling of Russian trolls, bots and fake accounts.

title: Fragmented feature set
review:
I’m new on iOS and have been disappointingly surprised to find out that Facebook app for iPad doesn’t have “Explore Feed” (little rocket) button on the bottom navigation track.
Also I wish that navigation track is customizable so that I don’t need to go deep in sub menus to opt for “most recent” view of timeline. It’s completely nonsense how rigid navigation UI is. It basically forces me to use website instead app.

title: Most Recent Changes
review: Prior to the recent update with putting friend recommendations on the top of the notifications rather than the notifications itself is really annoying especially since I get 5+ notifications a day as I manage two pages, plus administer a group. If I’m HONESTLY looking for friends I will search for them not having them SHOVED into my face!

title: New updates are muddled
review: Updated the app and my notifications have become completely messed up. Time stamps are in the wrong order making it difficult to find the notification that is showing up in red. And not to mention that this whole share a photo or video is more complicated now as well. Why can’t we streamline again? I thought you were better than this.

title: Crashes
review: The app just recently came out with an updated version. The previous version never crashed on me. Since I’ve updated the app 3 days ago, it has crashed on me more times than I can count. But only while watching videos. The video gets 15-20 seconds in and then the whole app crashes and it takes me back to the home screen of my phone. If you could fix that, that’d be great.

title: Ad overdose
review: Apparently Ads in the newsfeed wasn’t enough...now we have to see spontaneous ads while watching videos also. Facebook when I want to find someone I don’t have as a friend, let me look them up in the search option. STOP TRYING TO CONSTANTLY SUGGEST PEOPLE YOU THINK I KNOW OR YOU THINK I WANT TO ADD. When I want to see stories, I’ll use snapchat...it’s completely annoying the fact that now I have to see an overdose of stories in WhatsApp, facebook and instagram (copycats)...Facebook is starting to get on my nerves! 😡

title: STOP MOVING THE NOTIFICATION BUTTON
review: You moved it from within reach to all the way up in the top left corner and it disappears as we scroll and in order to see any of them we have to scroll all the way back up just to get back to it. Who ok’d this terrible idea. You just recently put it back to the bottom left and then randomly moved it back to the top. Stop moving it. Leave it in the bottom right so we can access it!

title: Using market place is big mess
review: The facebook and messenger integration is a crap, especially when using market place. It is taking me back an forth to facebook app and messenger app and ended up in nowhere. When I respond to an offer, the conversation goes to messenger and if I want look back the offer and click on the see details in messenger. It is looping me to so many places and ended opening a facebook website in safari. Why do I need to login again in safari as I have facebook app?

title: Keeps closing
review: This is so frustrating. I’m scrolling through my feed and it will suddenly close and take me back to my home screen. And it does it EVERY TIME I use it. This needs to be fixed. It’s also auto refreshing too fast. I scroll and if I get a text/email and I take a moment to respond to it, FB will decide that I’m done and refresh my feed. After just a few seconds. Please fix these issues. It’s really bad.

title: Awful. Bugs. Live is terrible.
review: I just downloaded this app to do a live contributor video with a Facebook page and the app would not display any of the comments for the entire broadcast. All it did was show me how many people are watching and said to swipe left to reveal the comments, but when I swiped left, all I could see was a few names of who was watching. There were dozens of comments the entire video but I was never able to see them. Please fix this bug!!

title: Lots of glitches now
review: I like to use Facebook when I get bored or want to sell things but now there are so many glitches. Especially for when I try to go see the stuff I’m selling I can even go into that now because the app just crashes on me everything I try. The icon isn’t there anymore either. I have to go into my message click on see detail then it crashes. I already but in report a problem a while ago but nothings still been fixed.

title: I love Facebook except for....
review: Having videos play automatically when the sound is on on my phone. I would rather go into it and have it start playing than when I go thru my feed. Literally can not go from one post to the next without something playing.

title: Don’t get it not worth it!!!!! ALWAYS FREEZES
review: I hate this app so much that I’m going to delete it and I hope people see this! It decreases picture quality BY ALOT! Literally every time I post a picture I took with my Nikon D3400 or even iPhone 7 Plus the final posted result looks like it took it with an iPhone 3GS seriously what’s up with that FACEBOOK 😡. Not to mention every time I click on a picture and try to go back it freezes my whole phone and I have to restart the app. Crashes all the time PLEASE FIX.

title: Notifications..
review: So, ever since the second to last update, I’ll show having new notifications when I actually don’t. 3 seems to be the magic number this week, and no matter how many times I refresh it, it will still show that I have 3 new notifications. That’s not the end of the world, or anything, but it’s pretty annoying.

title: Notifications not working!
review: The app has worked flawlessly until the recent update. Why did the dev team decide it was a good idea to move the Notification Center to the top left corner? Half the time the button won’t work, and the other half if I was switching from another app if I hit it in the wrong place it goes to the previous app. It was fine in the bottom row with all the other shortcuts.

title: Just a few things...
review:
When I go into a Group, I want to see all of the most recent posts. 

Please don’t refresh. I want to start where I left off, not be sent back to my feed. 

When the Photos option was upgraded, Albums was placed last. Give an option to edit so I can choose to arrange as suits me. 

I admin a Group. I love the new option to add questions. 
  However, when I enter , it shows Joined. I didn’t join this, I created it. 
  In a future update, I’d like to see an option to automatically add ADMIN to all of my posts. 

Thanks for this app. Y’all’ve added something special to my life.

title: Pretty dated
review: I’m not sure what’s going on but Facebook would dominate social media if it weren’t so dated. I love using all the features of an app and not having updated GOOD music for your reels is crazy to me. Not being able to space out your description for a reel is weird. It’s little nuances compared to others but they seem major when you’re just trying to create and go

title: Notifications are hidden
review: So, I liked the idea that the notifications were moved to the top corner, until I realized you can't see them when you're browsing and if you go back to check them, you can't go back to where you left off browsing, especially on the most recent feed. Seems a ridiculous update.

title: Note
review: The marketplace has been so buggy and unusable these past few weeks. I see nothing but "Sold" items, but the filter screen is so trash, it won't let you scroll far enough to view options to remove these items.   You have done another update and my phone keeps crashing when on Facebook getting sick of it

title: Change password
review: The last several days have had a great deal of difficulty changing my password. Says it made the change but when I try to use it the change is not made.  Also a new account is set up.  Hey I don’t want that just want to change my password!

title: Won’t work
review: Every time I open the app it just shows me stories and posts from days ago then goes blank as if it’s loading and stays like that I can’t check my notifications stories there’s nothing on my wall because it’s loading I go to my profile and it’s blank I deleted and redownloaded and I still have the same issues I’m on an iPhone XR maybe they just need to update it for the phone type idk but it will not work or refresh anything please help

title: This is why I never update Facebook.
review: I don’t know what I was thinking, but I hit the update button and now 202.0 has made the app unusable. Randomly, but consistently, all of these things are now happening: Refreshing or hitting home causes ONE post to load and no more. Hitting a notification takes you to a random comment on the post, not the new comment in the notification. Likes and comments that you’ve received notifications for do not show up on the post.

title: Identity error
review: Please it’s been months I’ve been trying to get my account back every time I complete the identity check and change my password or make adjustments it’ll give me an error saying we’ll get it fix as soon as possible and then I have to start all over again despite I’ve completely the identity check Facebook please fix this problem I’ve had my account for almost 10 years and I’m afraid of losing it please fix this problem

title: Fix the app
review: Hi so I usually don’t write a lot of reviews. But all I’m asking is PLEASE PLEASE FOR THE LOVE OF GOD FIX THE TYPING. it’s terrible now on the app and I think I possibly know why. You guys made it to where it doesn’t space after double tapping the space bar. It’s very annoying when trying to type anything. I sit there for like 10 mins just for a small post now... Please put it back to the original way before I throw my phone across the house. Thanks 🙏🏻

title: Action blocked for reacting on posts.
review: I'm frequently getting this error. It logs me out and asks me to change password and confirm my identity. Once that it done, it blocks me from reacting on any post. This is happening almost every two months now. Reporting the problem on facebook doesn't help at all. They reply after 2-3 weeks when the problem gets fixed and same thing happens again after 2-3 months. Sick of this problem and by no help from facebook.

title: Feed & Notification Problem
review: For the passed month I've had 3 notifications for messenger that I can't get rid and I don't know why. Also I can only see like 6-10 posts on my feed everytime I open the app. I've uninstalled the app but it only fixed the issues for like half a day. I would really like to see current posts and I would also like for the feed to go back to being in chronological order. All of these issues are highly aggravating

title: HATE the new update
review: Stop trying to make Facebook into Instagram. They are different platforms for a reason. I liked how when you posted photos to Facebook it showed 4 and then a +5 or however many more photos there were and they were displayed as either portrait or landscape. Now they show up as a square with how many photos there are in the top right corner. Not all my photos look good as a square and it just looks like Instagram. PLEASE change it back.

title: Still doing it
review: Facebook is still doing that thing where when you go to a notification of a status or post it doesn’t show any of the words. I really want this fixed. People will tag me in the comments of something from years back and I can’t see what it says and can’t go back that far on the page to find it. It’s very annoying. And my memories only show the past 2/3 years. Why doesn’t stuff from 4/5 years ago show up?

title: Photos
review: Just this last week photos in the newsfeed that I tap on to open them up for a better view are now being shown in portrait view instead of landscape.  This is very annoying.  It must be a fluke with this app because if I access Facebook from the internet I do not have this problem.  Hope the developers of this app correct it because it is very annoying

title: Disabled
review: At first, I using Facebook was fine. I was using Facebook for about a month or two for mainly messenger and signing into other apps. One day after not using messenger for a few days, I found out I was signed out and had to sign in. I signed in just to find out my account was disabled for no reason. I contacted Facebook several times to address the issue but my account still hasn’t been reactivated after several weeks. I’m debating to call them this time.

title: Missing words on posts
review: When I get a notification that I’m tagged in a post, someone posted in a group, etc. when I click it, it only shows the persons name and the likes. It doesn’t show the actual post. Please fix bc I can’t see what I’m being tagged in or what people say in my groups. I have to manually go to their profile and find it to read the post (if I can even find out which one it was)

title: Not refreshing after update
review:
I updated FB on two devices yesterday.  Ever since, Facebook takes forever to refresh, or won’t refresh at all, even when manually flicking the screen.  I deleted and redownloaded the app. That helped only for a few minutes.  Closing and reopening sometimes help temporarily, but mostly not.  
This happens on two different iPhones.  It will show only one post. Never reloads.  Obviously a bug in the latest update.  Please fix it.

title: App CRASHES all the time!
review: There needs to be an update, I see the same posts that I e already “liked” and no matter how many times I close out the App or even restart my phone it doesn’t change. Also, for quite awhile, my newsfeed is either only showing me a few people and groups  or completely leaving others out, as well as seeing old posts repeated. What was wrong with the old Facebook from years ago, where it was new posts from ALL FRIENDS & GROUPS?

title: Poor help
review: I have not been able to open and display vehicle ads in marketplace for about two weeks. All other ads work fine.  When opening Facebook on the web every ad including vehicles acts as it should.  When I search for a solution on Facebook, I don’t find anything.  No, I haven’t used the forum, and I am not going to.  I don’t care to hear a bunch of opinions from those that have to jump in even when they have no clue what your even talking about.

title: Update broke Facebook
review:
*UPDATE*
There have been numerous version released since these issues cropped up yet none of these updates have fixed problem. Notifications and newsfeed are still broken. Can’t tell latest updates or respond to people because I don’t know what comments or posts people have replied to or posted themselves.
********************
