Notifications disappear or do not show up so you are unaware people are responding or what to keep track of. Peoples posts are blank on newsfeed. Comments do not show up. Photo descriptions are blank.

Somehow they broke their perfectly functioning app.

title: Bring back “most recent” as a default news feed setting!!
review:
Facebook keeps getting worse with every update.  With every update, the “most recent” option for news feed order gets harder to find, and goes away with every refresh.

I love all of my friends - these are people I actually know, and not random strangers.  I want to sed what’s happening in all of their lives, not a random few who happen to have posted something popular lately!

title: Notifications feed is BULLSH*T
review: You guys have completely destroyed the FB app. The notifications feed literally gives me 3 to 6 new stories when I have know for a fact I literally hundreds because I have nearly 4K friends. What happen to being able to scroll through all the notifications as far back as you wanted???? This has made Facebook unenjoyable completely. What’s the use of checking your notifications if you can only see 5 to 6 of them??????

title: Update isses
review: As soon as I updated the app, it began to not let me see my status after I typed it. I could only see comments or likes and shares. I post a lot of info on my page concerning my business and when ppl comment hours later I have to literally sit back and think about what I said in order to respond because it’s no longer visible to me

title: Most Recent
review: What’s so hard about giving me the posts that are most recent? I don’t care about top stories, I’m logging on to see what my friends are up to recently, not a week ago, I’ve already seen that 4 times by now. I choose “most recent” every time I log in, but now I’m getting posts way out of order and seeing stuff from almost a week ago and missing posts from today. Super annoying.

title: Not working anymore
review: This app was great until recently, I can only see 11 of my notifications at a time and I can’t see any of the words in a post. Just the pictures, no words. If there is no picture in the post and it was just words I won’t see anything, this is the case for my own posts or anybody else’s posts. This has been going on now for about two months. I can’t use the app anymore.

title: New updates Sept 2018
review: I find the new suggestions for friends or people i may know annoying. I also dont like the News Feed AT ALL. i do not watch news on tv, why do i need this on social media?. And i do not like “suggestions of things i may like”. This newer version is disturbing but FB inventors and financial backers have created a new addiction. Thats the bottom line.

title: Security Features Aren't Useful
review: Can't remember my password every time I get a new Phone Device, so when I seem to try and reset my password it always gives me the same message that apparently it can't find any account related to the information I provided . Such bs to be honest. If other options were available to acquire old password or reset password then I'd change the rating but since it's been the same thing over the course of these years .

title: Notifications are messed up in this latest version
review: Just a heads up, notifications are acting wonky in this version. It gives a notice of having multiple items and there are either none or significantly less than advises upon opening the app.

title: Ditto what Tonya1216 said in her review!
review:
Please put posts into chronological order!
I hardly use Facebook or Instagram anymore because I can’t see the latest posts of the people I follow. It’s frustrating. 
I used to be able to catch up by scrolling down and when I got to a post/photo that I had already seen I would know I was caught up. Now I have no idea what’s been posted and what I have missed.
I hope another social media platform comes in to get it right for the users.

title: Limited posts
review: I really like Facebook back when it was young. Barely any ads, and you could keep scrolling through anything in your feed. Sadly that time has passed and feeds are severely limited. I’ve refreshed my feed so many times it’s grabbing posts from the future. Why can’t I scroll past the end of all of two posts on my feed? Yes, I do follow more than one page but seriously it’s annoying. Please allow Facebook to load older posts without any limits!

title: Comment section
review: I love keeping in touch through Facebook,  but PLEASE, make it so if I post something on my page and the comments get out of hand I can shut them off.  Currently only if you’re in a group is that option available.  Please make it available for everyone

title: Facebook Version 188.0
review: This latest version (188.0), just downloaded yesterday, appears to have adversely affected the “Notification” icon on the Facebook page. After pressing the Notification icon, the message “You Don’t Have Any Notifications” is displayed, when its clear (both on the main page of all icons and on my PC version of Facebook) that there are new notifications. Need some way to revert back to Facebook version 187.0 until this glitch is fixed.

title: Useless Notifications
review: Facebook is virtually useless now. It only allows me to see the past 7 hours of notifications. I’m not on FB while I’m at work so I’m missing notifications past the 7 hr mark. Seriously FB? How can I communicate if I don’t know someone has replied to my comments? I can’t see if relatives or friends that I’m connected with have responded to my comments. Talk about a bad decision. Ugh. This is a disappointing upgrade and it looks like FB won’t be my “go to” social network anymore.

title: After the update it sucked
review: I cannot see comments or gifs on my posts that other people post. It’s so frustrating. Also I’ve been posting pictures in comments and they get deleted for no reason. It’s picture of my kids so I don’t understand why there being deleted. I don’t even get a notification stating it’s going to be deleted or a reason. This app has sucked after the updates.

title: Invasion of privacy and attention
review:
They monitor your posts, private messages on Facebook messenger, Facebook pages you see and like, and even websites running on the background, and they use that information sell to advertisers. 

Their facial recognition is the creepiest 1984ish nightmare I’ve ever seen. The way Facebook’s computer algorithm can track and recognize my friends and I on any photo is simply unnecessary. 

They suppress posts. They outright ban offensive memes or words. It’s like a suppression of speech and thought. 

They track your location. No social media company ever needs to know where you are or where you’re going for any reason. 

AI generated newsfeed and notifications to keep you hooked on their website, purposely undermining people’s attention and getting them addicted.

title: Missing Friendversary videos.
review:
Previous months ago, I was able to receive friendversary videos in my “on this day” memories. However, lately I am having trouble no getting them. I am only able to message them via Facebook messenger but I want to have the friendversary videos too.
It’s not fair how my other friends Facebook has friendversary videos and I don’t.
I hope you can fix this problem soon! 😭

title: My mobile app keeps crashing
review: It’s so f’in annoying that Facebook doesn’t have any customer service help. My mobile app shows one story then crashes. I’ve contacted Facebook several times over this issue and all I get is a message that says thanks for your submission etc. etc. They need to have people dedicated to helping fix issues that arise

title: Notifications not working correctly
review: After I look at my notifications the blue dot on the right used to disappear to let me know I had viewed it, now it does not disappear.  I have tried numerous times on my iPad.  I have shut it off and turned it back on multiple times and the blue dot does not disappear.  It worked ok yesterday but not today.

title: Shuts down constantly
review: This app doesn’t work anymore on my iPhone or iPad. Both devices are running the newest OS, I have deleted and re-downloaded the app on both devices. Nothing works. It stays open for about 10-20 seconds and then just closes. When I re-open it, the post I was reading is no longer there. Over and over. I can no longer use the Facebook App. What will FB do to correct this dysfunction?

title: Too many notifications
review: Recent update isn’t a good one. It now notifies of any posts/updates from friends even you’re not involved in that post... tagged, liked or had commented on it. And these unnecessary notification floods my alerts! If someone wants to see what’s going on with friends, they can always just get on FB to see it. We don’t need to get alerted for each and every stuff that our friends posts. Pls fix!

title: Crashes and locks up every other time u use it
review:
I miss the days the fb app just worked without crashing, loaded in less than 25 seconds, and opened up where u left off after taking a call (instead of 20 second refreshes losing what u were reading; often resulting in a crash anyway)

It was so useful before, but with so many irritations, I find I only use the app now when “absolutely necessary”

title: Updates have ruined my experience
review: I don’t know what is going on, but one of the last two updates has caused FB to crash repeatedly.  I can’t scroll down past the first one or two items listed, and I have about 30 seconds to read or to type a response if I’m responding to a comment to one of my posts and the whole thing just closes out.  It happens repeatedly on all of my devices.  Super frustrating, & I hope it can be rectified quickly.

title: Last update ruined my Facebook app
review: After the last update for the Facebook app on iPhones,my Facebook won’t load any more then 1 posts at a time! I have uninstalled and reinstalled! It keeps closing out after a few seconds of trying to look at the one post it will show me!!! When you make update you should try to make sure they actually work for all the phones! I have had nothing but problems with my Facebook since 2 weeks ago!!!

title: Condone dog fighting pages
review: After a local rescue page had brought up pages actively promoting and discussing dog fighting at least 30 of us tried to report it as animal abuse. We all received the same generic reply that even though it had pictures and videos of bloodied up dogs, it didn’t violate their community standards. If a company has low enough standards to not consider this animal abuse, then I refuse to support them. Go ahead and sell my data to other companies, but don’t condone animal abuse, you’re disgusting.

title: Uploading pictures and profile picture
review: It’s been 15minutes & post is still not uploaded ... currently trying to change profile picture, it just goes back timeline when I press edit...

title: This was a down grade
review:
I just got the new update yesterday.  Since then, the back button doesn't work.  If I am in somebody's photos or reading their page, I can't get out of it with the back button.  I just reopens the same page repeatedly.  Please fix this!

Also, how hard would it be to truly let us see the posts from all the friends we haven't hidden in the order if most recent first.

title: Many problems
review:
Just list a couple
- keep asking, “Add more friends to see more photos and posts”.  Have to go around to see the new feeds.  Many folks have raised this issue for years, but Facebook has never fixed it.
- click on most recent feeds, it shows feeds posted two weeks ago first.  If click on individual friends, you will their really recent posts first.

I don’t have these problems with any web browser on a computer.

title: Making you stupid
review: This app takes up almost 70% of my time during the day when I have it installed on my phone. It keeps me from making and keeping meaningful relationships or even having a conversation with a stranger because Facebook is so addictive it’s better to put your face in your phone all day than to go out and live life. It also keeps me from having time to my own thoughts. No time to be creative when Facebook is using all my brain power.

title: Update
review: Since I ran the update when I scroll through my news feed videos play and so does their sound. I was like hmm it never used to. So I went into my settings bc I know there is a setting for that and it was already turned off, to not play video sounds while scrolling. So I toggled it on and off to see if that helped. I still have videos playing sound. Idk how to get it back to not playing sound when the option is already not selected 🤔

title: Reviews nowhere to be found
review:
Most of the customer reviews on our biz page are no where to be found. Only 5-10% show up. Same problem on desktop. Saw that many other users in the forums having the same issue. 

Notifications, even when read, keep displaying as new alerts. I end up reading every notification 2-3 times. Not to mention the two other FB apps that do the same. UX is terrible. Good lord, what are you guys doing over there?

title: Lucky Day!!!
review: I enjoy playing this game so much. I look forward to just sitting down and grabbing my I pad and playing the game. I have a couple health issues and one which is Parkinson’s so this game really helps take my mind off of it. Thank you for making this game!

title: FB slowing down & full of ads I don’t want to see
review: It seems even loading the comments to a post is dragging now. I would love to see at least 2 streams - one where my friends actually say something & one with shared stuff.  And, while we’re at it, quit looping around. I don’t need to see again what I already saw 5 minutes ago. Not really liking a lot FB these days! Guess you have me hooked since I like my friends!

title: Password reset/email
review: I changed my contact email on Facebook as my original email from middle school is no longer active. Well apparently it did not save. Last week when my Facebook was attempted to be hacked, they made me change my password. I changed it, and now it won’t recognize my new password and there’s no way for me to access the email to get a reset. There is no communication function to contact them and get help. This is utterly ridiculous.

title: It’s a great app!
review: This app helps me talk to my family all around the world. The pages that I follow are very entertaining. The only thing I wish Facebook had was an option to save videos to your camera roll. Once I post a video on Facebook, I can’t take it back into my camera roll. ); but overall, great app. :)

title: Can’t invite someone who accidentally declined
review: Many others are having this issue. I’m using fb from my phone and there isn’t a function for me to delete someone who accidentally declined the invite, so that I can be allowed to invite them again. It’s like all or nothing, which in reality, people change their minds or their plans but this feature of completely banning the invitee is quite ridiculous.

title: Who Facebook tags for you...
review: So... I roll through Facebook newsfeed on my phone, then after I’ve been on it for 20 minutes or so, I noticed that the newsfeed starts bebopping or resetting itself while I’m rolling through it. This is not fun! Please fix! I have asked others on my newsfeed if this happens to them and I have had SEVERAL of your FB clients agree. Annoying!

title: App crashes
review: App crashes anytime I click on a link to take me to a news article or outside site.  Only started to happen with the latest update. I’m using iPhone 8 Plus and have submitted a bug report for them on this.  It’s frustrating because when it crashes, it restarts the newsfeed from the beginning instead of where you left off and you can’t find the article you wanted to read because it thinks you’ve already viewed it.

title: Please block ads that take over an article you are reading
review: I at least allow mad a default to open links in my browser of choice. It pisses me off when I m trying to read a post that is a link to a site and then this ad takes over my screen saying I won something, etc.  When I take the additional step to open the link in safari this does not happen.

title: Virginia
review:
I don’t want you to notify all my friends every time I post something. There are people that I’m not that close to that don’t want to be annoyed with all these posts. 
A few months ago I got a message from Facebook that someone had accepted my friend request.  I never sent a friend request. I did not want to be a friend to this person.  How does something like this happen?  You have become too intrusive.

title: App.....what?
review: Please fix this app. There are so many glitches. I'm new to FB and the use of this app is not user friendly. It took approvingly two weeks to get my account set up. That was only possible b/c I had to use my laptop instead of this app. This app told me I was disabled. I finally get set up and this app is not syncing/updating with correct info therefore still not allowing me to use any of my other devices. Needless to say using this app has been a very frustrating experience.

title: What’s going on?
review: Normally I don’t have a ton of problems with this app, I scroll through my newsfeed daily, multiple times per day. However for the past few days, whenever I am watching a video, the app blacks out and goes to my main screen! It’s VERY annoying, can we fix this please?

title: Very poor experience
review:
Viruses and hacking as are very common here. I’m not quite sure why Facebook allows hackers to take control of accounts if they open an article or accidentally click on one of the dozens of advertisements that keep on appearing every 10 seconds.

I have the best WiFi and the latest iPhone model. The Facebook servers are very slow and gittery. It’s not fun trying to scroll your way through posts and experiencing buffering when trying to play a video.

title: Comments don’t work when you go Live
review: I used to be able to go live in my group, enjoy a cup of coffee and have a conversation with my private group instead of my whole friends list on my personal page - that is no longer happening. I have checked with other people and this is happening everywhere. Bummer, Facebook used to be the place for great social interaction and it no longer is!

title: Notification Overload
review:
STOP WITH ALL OF THE NOTIFICATIONS I HAVEN'T ASKED FOR.

Why is it every time you turn around, Upload HD is unchecked? You post a video or some pics. You check your work. Crud, it's not in HD. Delete post. Go to setting reselect Upload HD. Repost. Next time you go to repost...Repeat above. Why can't it be set & forget?

title: Photo section iPhone X won’t load and Freezes app?!?!
review: When I am on my iPhone X and go to my photo section under my profile.  The app freezes and won’t load the photos albums and won’t allow me to click on anything else at all!  Please fix as this makes Facebook and anything to do with photos or videos useless with the new iPhone X!?!?!

title: Stop Refreshing!!!
review: For god sake. I’m in the middle of reading an article, or someone’s posts, etc and then I get a text or phone call and god forbid I answer it and am out of the Facebook app for less than a minute and the whole world has changed in that minute so Facebook thinks it needs to completely refresh!!! I didn’t want it to refresh. I wanted to pick up where I left off. This has gotten to the point of being so annoying I don’t use Facebook as much anymore.

title: Scrolling issues
review: For some reason my personal and business facebook pages are having an issue with scrolling. This is ONLY happening in these two apps. When I try to scroll down it’s gets “jittery” and jumps back to the top of the page. Usually happens about 5-6 times before it will finally cooperate. Please fix this soon!

title: I want to go back to where I left off
review: I REALLY HATE that you can be looking at a particular page or post and then you briefly switch to another app and then switch back to the FB app and then it automatically takes you back to your news feed. I don’t want to go back to my news feed, I want to be able to go back to where I left off !!!

title: Ads
review:
You use to be able to watch videos freely but now every other video you watch is pumped full of ads conveniently placed at cliffhanger parts of the videos. The ads are getting absolutely ridiculous and I predict at some point they're going to bombard us with so many ads, annoy us and then release a paid version without ads. 
So eventually Facebook is going to turn into being raped and accosted by ads or you'll have to pay to not be raped and accosted by ads.

title: Keeps Crashing!!!!
review: What is going on?!!! Since Sunday the App just does not want to open. Then I have to delete and reinstall it every time to work. As soon as I close the APP complete or if too much time has passed, again the app does not want to open and the same process of deleting the app and reinstalling to be able to open. Why is this happening?!!! I have space on my phone, everything else is working.

I do not recommend this app. 

Facebook makes you think you have a community of friends, but in reality you do not have access to post to them all directly. 

The great Facebook scam is this: you post your life, sending your content into their algorithm. They display it to a subset of your friends who they calculate will give them the best engagement and return on the advertising they are pairing with your content. 

Translation: YOUR LIFE IS THE CONTENT THAT FACEBOOK IS ADVERTISING AGAINST TO MAKE BILLIONS, THEIR ONLY LOYALTY IS TO PUSH QUARTERLY PROFITS FOR WALL STREET.

It’s time to wake up and #deletefacebook

It slowed down my entire iPad plus my FB icon doesn’t work.  I’m 75 and enjoy FB to keep in touch with friends but now can’t get in Unless I use my browser.  When Ido that it doesn’t even look the same and is terribly confusing to me.   Supposedly there is a way to go back to the old method but I have no idea how to do that.

I have heart problems and must stay in my home.  I depended on FB.  Can you remove that update from my account, please.

Cheryl

title: Dique confirm name
review: Everybody knows on Facebook you don’t use your actual name well a lot of teenagers don’t so I was very surprised that Facebook asked me to confirm my name and then after asked for and ID or something to confirm but ofc I would never put all of my personal information or my address on any social media platform because of safety reasons and identity thief and I found this very very annoying because now I can’t get into my account or anything for no reason what so ever

title: No Longer Usable
review: Since the last update my newsfeed no longer shows more than a few posts. If I refresh it half the time it’s empty. This and a lack of a dark mode really makes this hard to use. Instagram has neither of these problems. In fact the feed in Instagram is light years better. It shows the entire timeline and even lets me know when I’m “all caught up”. Plus there is a dark mode. I mean it’s the same company, right?

title: FB Locked My Account
review:
After 10 years FB locks my account on my birthday. Sent me the following message: 
Your account has been locked because we need to confirm your age. Please complete the form below within 28 days to regain access to your account. If you don’t confirm your age within 28 days, your account will be deleted. Please keep in mind that you won’t be able to access your account without completing this step.
FB wants to me to send a copy of my drivers license/passport or something with my picture and date of birth. 

There is no phone number I can call to know why is this necessary after all these years without violating any FB rules. 

I have no access to the account so I’m not able to resolve this issue.

title: Can’t access wall or timeline
review: I can’t access my own wall/timeline and other people’s wall/timeline. When I login with other account on same device (iPhone X) it works fine. Tried reinstall the app but doesn’t work too. Before that happened, all I did was unfriend some inactive account in my friend list. What’s wrong with the logic behind this Facebook? I use FB since 2007 and run Ads with the same account for some pages too. Disappointed ... 👎🏻

title: Beware!! Hacked through messenger
review:
I was hacked through messenger in Oct 
Had account for over 15 years and there was absolutely NO help or support.  
My business had over 5000 friends which took years to establish 
Very disappointing.  
I no longer trust messenger and advise against anyone using it. I even have my doubts about FB security   All accounts which I signed in through FB were disabled and my social security number was also hacked at the same time. Coincidence? Probably not!!

title: Debborah wimmer
review: I am very confused I loved being on fb now I recently got hacked and the hacker was asking friends and family for money and was pretending to be me and now ever since then I can’t get back on Facebook keeps saying I’m being reviewed it’s been a week this hacker threatens my son if he sends him money he will take me off his list of people to torment I just wish I knew how to get back on Facebook and safe from hackers

title: Where the heck is dark mode?
review: Facebook is great, excellent to connect with friends and family during these trying times. Just missing one little feature. Dark mode. Would be very nice clicking over to FB from other apps and not being blinded.

title: Racist
review: Be mindful when downloading the app of even using this platform. Apparently comments that are DIRECTLY RACIST do not violate their “community standards,” so as far as Facebook is concerned, you’ll just have to deal with whatever hate speech you see on here! Tried reporting racism twice in the last month, got a canned “this is fine” response. Meanwhile I have black friends who have been reported AND blocked simply for calling out the systematic racism that continues to victimize them. Disgusting.

title: App has become very buggy.
review: I don’t know what’s going on over there at Facebook. Over the past 6 months there’s been an increasing amount of bugs. While typing comments they sometimes disappear. The app has frozen a few times and reloads at random. The app has been updated multiple times and I’ve had this problem on two separate phones.

title: Odd issues
review: When I refresh marketplace nothing happens. I have to close the app and reopen to actually refresh. Issues with group notifications. Such as getting a notification for a like or comment and when clicking on it you can’t see who liked or commented until you close the app.

title: Pages needs bug fixes and improvements
review: No overall complaints other than the Pages section. I have a business and I’m starting up another page and it has been very difficult to work with.

title: New update stinks
review: My app keeps crashing and every time I go out it completely restarts the newsfeed at the top. It never used to do those things. Also when clicking on an article to read it just kicks you out of the app. Very frustrating when trying to read or find certain posts.

title: If I could give ZERO I would. 😡
review:
Not sure what happened but I can no longer see any of my memories. It says I have them but when I go to the page it is blank.

Now I keep getting this scam/spam person commenting on my posts. I’ve deleted their comments, blocked the profile. Yet within 10 minutes they are commenting again! So I delete and block AGAIN. I also add in reporting to Facebook for a fake, spam, and harassment type account. NOTHING works!!!😡

title: Gets the Job Done BUT
review: Please fix the marketplace features. I cannot list or edit my posts without having to use the desktop site. The screen goes black and the app freezes whenever I try to view my listings or post anything to the marketplace. Otherwise the app is fine just get it together a little guys

title: An unexpected error occurred
review: I fixed an unexpected error many times but it still didn't work and I couldn't log in to my account.  can yall fix that problem for me

title: Limited options
review: The settings for timeline and tagging are the worst. You should be able to have an option for not getting tagged in a post but there isn’t one. And so I get tagged in stupid things by people that makes me not even want to use Facebook. Honestly it’s like there was so much put into making them uncomplicated that you don’t get to really change anything you want.

title: Phone App for iPad - not good.
review: This does not seem to be an app that is anything but a scaled up app from the phone to run on the iPad.   I go to the browser and load Facebook there.  I see no additional functionality written to take advantage of the increased screen size of the iPad. It is extremely frustrating to use. You can’t find posts you comment on, it crashes on you all the time. Terrible, terrible app.  Would give it zero stars if I could.

title: Doesn’t load past a certain point on my home feed.
review: The app had been working fine for a while until recently. I tried scrolling down as far as I could and it stops at a certain points. It will show that it’s loading but nothing happens. I have tried everything. Reinstalling. Logging in and out. A bunch of different trouble shooting and nothing has worked so far. Will give 5 stars when fixed.

title: Facebook
review: I love Facebook is the best thing. I have connected with long-lost friends and Facebook marketplace is terrific. You can’t blame Mark Zuckerberg for some idiot, who read something on Facebook and now thinks that we vote for our president on a Wednesday in October. Thank you Mark Zuckerberg.

title: I have problems with my Facebook
review: Since I created my Facebook I had being trying to access to Facebook marketplace but for some reason it is impossible for me to access Facebook market place I already looked up where to access and i wasn’t able to enter marketplace I wish I could get my Facebook fixed

title: It’s great to connect with friends
review: It’s a really good app to find funny stuff on and connect with friend and family with however the ads have increased and have become a bit annoying. It can also get pretty addicting I wish there was a way to daily restrict yourself without having to delete the app. Overall good app tho

title: Clunky
review:
Latest update is horrible!  App is very slow at startup. I touched "Like" on someone's post and it froze.

Get rid of the chat sidebar!!! Turning off chat doesn’t remove the bar. Some us don’t need “recent activity”. Isn’t that the purpose of the newsfeed? Just give us the option to remove the sidebar. Takes up too much room. 

When I want to read comments the keyboard opens but does not close unless I type something (On iPhone not iPad). I just want to read the comments but there's hardly any room with the keyboard box open. 

Pictures will orientate to landscape when I turn my iPhone sideways but if I touch the picture it will flip to portrait and will not change back. 

News feeds are slow freeze too much.

title: Not happy with the latest update
review: I’ve had problems with this app since I updated it yesterday.   The articles will not load, just a blank page; the app randomly reloads  mid-scroll and brings me to the top of my newsfeed and if I leave and return to the app for just a few seconds it  reloads even though it’s still open on my phone.   I haven’t changed any of my settings and my phone is up to date.   Very frustrating.

title: No integrity
review: When I go into settings and click “no notifications” for the groups I’m part of, that means I don’t want notifications. But yet, Facebook still dishes ‘em out more than once daily. PLEASE do what you say you’ll do when u turn off notifications. It clogs everything up with stuff I don’t care about which makes me hate going on the app and I check it maybe once weekly now.

title: Privacy settings changed without my consent
review:
I commented on a post and after that non friends starting to liking my old posts. 
Too bad, my settings would never let them. Only friend can see my post and I don’t have many. I tried to check safety and privacy settings, not letting me. It said it is a non expected problem and try later and it goes grey. Can’t change my settings back. This is my privacy!!!! Should be the top priority

title: Bad updates
review: With each new updates, one of the tried and true features stop working so well. Add in Facebook dating, yeah, that’s what we all need! Meanwhile, the marketplace section of the app is barely usable it’s so bad. It updates my location on its own and puts me in an entirely different state. This has been so frustrating for the past few weeks as I’ve been trying to Christmas shop.

title: Leave Facebook Marketplace alone
review: FB marketplace keeps getting less intuitive and useful. It’s getting so bad that I don’t want to use the marketplace feature anymore, the collections are useless, the saved section won’t tell you what things have sold so you have to check individually, and the plethora of ads shoves the actual listings out of the way. Facebook is a dumpster fire already, now Marketplace has joined the rest of the features in absolute mediocrity.

title: Quit Enabling Security & Privacy Settings I Disable
review: Every time I log into Facebook I have to go through and re disable Security & Privacy Settings that I had already disabled. I noticed that some of my setting were different about a week ago and since then have been monitoring it more heavily between both Messenger and Facebook. It’s alarming how many times I’ve had to go re-disable them.

title: Bug
review: When I have Facebook open if I watch a video close it and move on to the next post the audio from the video comes on in the background with no way to shut it off other than closing and restarting the app.

title: Post Bans
review: For the past three ALMOST FOUR months I haven’t been allowed to post after 6 pm through 11 pm. They refuse to give you an answer to why you’re banned and will give you a simple error message. Now all of a sudden the hour changes to 5 pm, I have sent requests for help and reasoning multiple times and got no proper response as to why I can’t post anymore. Facebook will ban your content that doesn’t harm anyone but will gladly allow hateful commentary on their app.

title: An Unorganized Mess
review: This app is practically unusable. From different buttons all bringing you to the same place, to a constant inability to find things, this app is impossible to navigate. If you are unfamiliar with Facebook already, this app will make it impossible to get familiar with the format. They constantly change the layout and location of buttons, and add and remove features every update. You’d think Mark Zuckerberg could produce a decent app, apparently not.

title: App very buggy
review: When I am looking at pictures in the app it sometimes glitchy and freezes and when looking at an album and I back out of a picture, it takes me to the top of the album instead of where I was

title: Recent update
review:
I’m not sure what happened during the last update on the iPhone but Facebook isn’t responding, and I can see I have updates but they never load.

I normally love the feature where you click one video and it loads similar videos. Now when that happens I’ll click on a video to play and it bounces me to the top of the list. Sometimes if I scroll back down I can play it, but I’ve bounced back up so often I give up

title: It’s good!
review: Like everyone else, I use Facebook a lot. Hah but I’ve been having different layouts & now when I tap a picture to see the camera just automatically comes up. It’s annoying. Had to turn off the camera for the app, but it still comes up.

title: Thank you for ur help I wanted to keep my Facebook updated thank you
review: I wanted to see all my friend on upto date this my Facebook we ofto keep things going in the right direction my name is Albert gray living in west Philadelphia over 15years I wanted my Facebook right now

title: Photos
review: i’m having a hard time finding any of my photos unless i click on them scrolling down my timeline. i cannot find them anywhere, i have albums upon albums and still can’t find them. they aren’t on the side like they used to be and there isn’t an option when first scrolling on my page. this has been happening for months.

title: Crashing
review: For some reason today Facebook has been acting up like I have not ever experienced. It keeps closing out unexpectedly and was doing this before I added the newest up date. I updated it not to long ago and it is still closing unexpectedly and I can’t do much. This app has been causing my phone to freeze and it has become very frustrating. I have definitely been avoiding using it as much as I use to because of this.

title: Getting worse
review: I’m a group admin and it’s important that I’m able to stay on top of member posts. Yet, once again, as with every other update, I no longer have the feature that allows me to sort posts and comments in order to see the most recent first. Why do you keep removing and replacing that function? Please put it back and then leave it alone!!

title: Pointless Updates
review: This app get “updated” almost every other week and is still complete and utter trash! Stop with the useless updates and actually start fixing this app please! I am tired of having to restart my search on marketplace every 15 minutes because the app is constantly crashing! It is by some miracle that this waste of storage is still on my phone!!!

title: Problem with adding an account.
review: I like so much use Facebook, I love the app, but like one week ago, I can’t really use the app like I want to, because when I trying to switch the account I can’t, it said that it have a problem, i don’t know what to do, because it’s the same that happen with Menssenger... idk what to do to solve this problem.. If u read this, I want you to help me, thanks for your time.

title: CANNOT SIGN IN- Me or anyone on my iPhone
review:
I CANNOT sign into the Facebook app or messenger ap, it’s been over a month. And anyone who tries to use my phone(fb apps) CANNOT either. This is getting ridiculous. I have reached out many times and haven’t heard anything! I CAN sign in on other peoples phones and computers. But NOT the AP on my phone ONLY. I have reset all settings and reset to factory settings on my iPhone. I have talked to apple and they are SURE this is facebooks problem. 

PLEASE fix this issue!

title: Not allowed to make new posts in any new groups
review: For whatever reason this doesn’t allow me to make new posts on groups I’ve recently been accepted in. It’ll remedy itself by me uninstalling the app but that means I’m doing this every time I’m accepted in a group. I’m able to post on my pc just fine but not on the app unless I install first.

title: Pausing
review: Whenever I go to watch a video half of the time it works, the other half of the time it keeps pausing the video every couple of seconds. Over all Facebook works well but this issue is what makes me close the app and go find something else to do.

title: No access to photos or friends photos
review: Can not access my photos on my profile unless i am trying to update my profile picture, which then i still cant even view the photo. I haven't been able to access my photos normally for months. Please help facebook. I doubt ill get a response...

title: Application
review: For the better part of the last  two days this app has crashed consistently. Once you open it then go through it it crashes and closes.

title: Consider a friend request blocker
review: Please, please, please consider allowing a setting that would prevent people from sending friend requests to me. I know I’m not the only person who has issues with this. I know that your settings currently allow me to “friend of friend” but a good 95% of “friend of friends” I don’t actually know and want no contact with. I really want a way to simply just prevent friend requests from coming in.

title: Awful.
review: I wish I could get my friends and family to abandon Facebook and move to another app. So sick of the endless ads, the invasion of privacy, and the changes to the app. I have deleted the Marketplace and Video buttons from my bottom menu more times than I can count, and you keep adding it. And now you’ve gotten rid of my profile button. Not to mention I keep seeing posts from a week ago and not new posts. Facebook is AWFUL.

title: App crashes
review: App crashes repeatedly.  Facebook was already faulty with not being able to see recent posts over something from 17 hours ago or last Wednesday for crying out loud.  But now I can’t scroll through my newsfeed without it crashing and shutting down. Although I don’t do much else, I actually do read a lot of news via Facebook since it’s all in one place.  Not even worth keeping it if I can’t even do that anymore.

title: The app keeps changing
review: Sometimes I have 4 buttons at the bottom. Sometimes I have 6. It goes back and forth. I always turn those annoying app sounds off. They keep getting turned back on. Now me menu button is messed up. Can’t find events anywhere. Please stop changing all this stuff!

title: Plz fix
review: I downloaded facebook to connect to my family.  But i barely even go on facebook i used it like once and then deleted it because my storage was full.  Once i got more storage (today) i redownload it and it said my account was disabled and i dont know how because i didnt hate on anyone i am over the age of 13 i didnt even post anything so if you could PLZ try and get my account back it would mean the world to me because i did nothing wrong

title: It Was Working Before
review: Dear Facebook, why did you change the Facebook app to the worse? With this version sometimes it is impossible to leave video player. Down swipe, up swipe, random swipe, back button, nothing... Have to kill the app to get back. Also I cannot find my Activity anymore. Prior version was working great (except its battery hunger), but the new version? Not so much.

title: Business Page
review: I really enjoy Facebook. Social media is huge for me - as it is many people. However, with the newest update when I go to schedule a post on my business page it fades it out and doesn’t like me click schedule (so I use safari to schedule) and also I am unable to find posts I already had scheduled.. very frustrating and slows down my business..

title: facebook Comment
review: I think there is a problem with a comment if I comment one time. I don’t want facebook to double my comment I want it. It just Annoying and people think I’m crazy so I get to delete one and leave one!!!! But I love facebook ❤️

title: Ads
review:
I am now seeing ads for literally every 2-3 post, some of them are for accounts I’ve never seen but because I liked a friend or family share of that post I now see it all the time. It’s a social network that I use to help keep in touch with long distance friends and family. It isn’t supposed to be an ad network. 
Show me my friends and family and not any ads.

title: Hacker Problem
review: My husband’s account got hacked and he can’t log in anymore. The has all of our family photos and our kids photos on there and I really don’t want the hacker to have access to them. Numerous people have reported the account many times but nothing has changed. Can we please get the account deleted?

title: I’m a bot apparently
review: I created my account and then I couldn’t log in because they needed my face to verify it for whatever reason and I sent them a picture of my face (which basically matched my profile picture) and it said it would take a while to verify it. After a few days of not being able to log in I try again and my account was disabled because apparently my face didn’t work for my account. Thanks Facebook.

title: Mu Favorite App
review: I love facebook app, it helps me a lot, I am member of very interesting groups and i get  lots of helpful information from there, also fb helped me to make my little startup more popular and increase sales and etc... Just love this social network ❤️

title: Did a child release the update?
review: This update is awful! It appears that a 5 year old chose the app color and also designed everything in the app it self. It’s slow, doesn’t update notifications or others interactions with your posts. Also, all the photos of an album that you can be tagged in will not all show on your timeline, only certain photos. I swear every update Facebook releases makes everything worse.

title: Update
review:
I don’t like the new background that was just put in can the developers top part of the Facebook app were the search bar is back to blue in the next update and can you get rid of the title that says the group has new post from its members just say the group name the person posted in that group 

Thanks!

Ps: I can deal with it for now

title: Update
review: So there’s an update to facebook where the news feed looks different. yet, mine seems to be the only one who doesn’t have it even though the app is updated to the latest version. I can’t understand why. it never changes but i’d like it to

title: Order of posts
review: I seriously miss having the posts show on my TIMEline in the order they were posted. I truly do not care if there are stories that may interest me more, that’s what the “favorites” is for. I want to see my posts in order of when they are posted. Otherwise, everything has been good! Keep it up! :)

title: FB would get 4.33 stars/ AutomaticUpdates brings it down to, like, a 2.8 and here's why-
review: I use FB more than any other social network, and I want to be able to use its most current version. Unfortunately, for FB TO Update on my phone, I have to be somewhere OTHER than my home w/ a stronger WiFi connect!!!!! Plz!!! NO MORE AUTOMATIC FB UPDATES!

title: Snooze feature
review: Many things I hate about this app. But right now its the snooze I hate the most. When you 30 day snooze someone, after the 30 days is up you get bombarded with their last 20 posts. And you get annoyed all over and snooze them again. Why hasn’t Facebook figured that out yet? Shuffle them back into the rest of the posts. Don’t show something they said a week ago. If we are snoozing them, we probably don’t care.

title: Can’t scroll
review: Having major issues last couple days where I open app and can scroll for enough to maybe make it to next post then it freezes up and can’t do anything. At first I thought this was my internet or because I had not updated my iOS phone but after trying several different locations and even mobile data and updating my phone I still am having same issues.

title: Old version
review:
I cannot see when my friends are active on Facebook.. I always have to switch over to messenger to see who is active.. 
This is very annoying..
I prefer the small green light on their wall when I’m on Fb ...

title: Want to read it
review: When I have a new notification I want to open it and read it... but since the last update all I get is the pinwheel turning on the page that the notification led me to. All I want is to read the post I was notified about, but the pinwheel never stops. I can reboot my phone and then read one notification, but who wants to reboot every time there’s a notification.

title: What happened to the blue interface?
review: Just the other day, Facebook turned all white. No blue interface at the top. I’ve uninstalled it and reinstalled it and it’s blue a few times, then turns white. Not sure what’s going on.  It works fine, just white.  Weird.  iPhone X on 12.1.3. Latest version of the app.

title: What the hell?
review:
After receiving no response for over a month about the disabling of my account, I decided to finally make a new one, and now this new one is disabled for no reason whatsoever. What the hell is this crap?  Why is Facebook such an awful awful awful company that has 0 customer support?  How is Facebook still in business? Absolutely unacceptable.

Update: been 2.5 months and still not even an automated response from Facebook. Pathetic.

title: Locked out
review: I got a new phone and have forgotten my Facebook password. I thought it would be a simple fix like any other time but now I’ve gone through every way there is to try to log on (trust me) and no help from anyone at Facebook. I’ve had this account for 14 years and half of those years are full of my children’s lives. I’ve even submitted my drivers license to them with all my personal info and it was for nothing. Pretty concerning.

title: Need to update but-
review: There should be an option that lets you update the app regardless if you are on using WiFi. What difference does it make how much data it takes if you have unlimited data? Duh !  It should ask you-“ Do you want to proceed “?   But no, We have to wait until whenever for a WiFi connection.

title: App Crashes So Much It’s Virtually Useless
review:
I rarely ever take the time to write a review but I’m hoping someone at Facebook actually reads these and does something with them. This version of the app is pretty bad. It hardly loads before it crashes. I tried uninstalling and reinstalling a couple times. I also tried to reboot my phone. I’ve got tons of memory so no issue there. 

Facebook please fix this. Your app is the one I use the most so it’s pretty frustrating.

title: Business page
review: WHY can’t we see who views our stories on Facebook business pages? It’s so annoying and not helpful. Why can you view it on your personal page but not on business pages? What’s the difference if they’ve liked the page or friends with you!? Fix these stupid little things and you’d get better reviews! No wonder more people like Instagram.

title: Frustrated
review: Notifications do not work on my account. All my settings are on in app and on my iPhone.  Have complained to fb three times with no response at all. I used to get badges so I can see that I have notifications. NO MORE!! Must have rebooted and deleted and and reinstalled fb five times w no improvement. They don’t care to fix this issue even though I saw lots of people online complaining of the same issue when I google the problem.

title: Broken after update.
review: Broken after update. I hate IOS app updates. Most likely the app will not work correctly after update or the reason you liked the app has been removed in update. Everything on screen shrank on update and no longer fills screen. Using new iPad Pro 12.9. Everything was fine before update. Now have mostly blank screen on sides with small narrow newsfeed. Won’t continue to use Facebook after this.

title: Finally deleted it
review: Just got tired of the app not caring about my user experience. I mean I literally used the feature a couple dozen times to tell them that the video and groups icons at the bottom weren’t relevant to me and they not only stayed there but were prompting me with little red numbers that I need to do something. No. I don’t have any interest in using those features. Just leave me alone.

title: App resets content on me
review:
I generally like the app but why do I get reset to my feed after some number of minutes away from app? 

I see other apps do this too and it all drives me nuts! I use my mobile app far more than a laptop plus often in places where I can’t use a laptop. 

I see at least weekly updates. Please give me an option to not jump to home screen and lose my place.

title: newsfeed doesn’t load. no customer support
review: I constantly get an error message saying “Posts can’t be loaded right now.” When they do load, a lot of times only two or three posts load and the newsfeed stops scrolling as if there’s nothing left to load. I’ve sent messages to customer support and never get a response. The same issues are happening on my iPhone XS Max and my 11” iPad Pro, so I know it’s not a problem with my device.

title: Too many updates
review: Please make it at least once a month. And please make it easier to update on iPhone. Ive been trying to update and i cant. Even using someone else’s wifi. App itself is great but just seems worse after every update, maybe because it gets bigger I don’t know but very frustrating.

title: Market place
review: After this last upgrade I can’t go in and view the items for sale on marketplace.  I can see the item but when trying to see details I get a blank screen. This is happening on my two iPads. What has happened here?  This is becoming very frustrating asi use this often.  Please get back to me.

title: Latest update is WORST EVER. I may even stop using it entirely.
review: iPad Pro, forces you to have chat window open all he time, even while chat is off, taking up screen space, making print smaller, and making it where you can’t scroll using your right hand. You can now only scroll on the left side. Does anyone even test these updates on an iPad? App only uses half the screen in landscape or in portrait. Horrible, horrible update.

title: Messy
review: I’ve been a faithful user for almost 10 years and I am sooo disappointed with the way this app has gone down. Unnecessary ads interrupting videos, timeline all over the place, out of 700+ friends only seeing the same few...that’s just to name a few problems. I feel as though this app is gearing up to exploit all its users. Too many glitches. I’m only a few more clicks away from deactivating and moving on. Please look into it again.

title: Plz Fix
review: I obviously love fb like everyone else but the app has recently had a lot of problems playing videos fully thru and loading content like stories and posts and it’s meaningless to have if you can’t use it so if this could be resolved in a timely manner that would be great. And also I’m having this issue in my house on my WiFi so I know it the app bcuz everything else on my phone works just fine and has no problems.

title: Videos, comments freezing
review:
Every video I try to play no matter what type of network I am on says that I need to check the strength of my signal. If I skip ahead it will play for a little while and then crash in the same manner. Also, when entering a comment, they are scrolling down below the bottom bar of the screen and I can’t see what I’m writing at all. 

This might help contribute to my goal of spending less time on social media.

title: Abysmal!
review: The pages won’t load, trying to refresh results in blanks where posts are supposed to be, when you try to scroll down to see more posts it stops after just 2-3 lines and won’t go further. When I type posts and hit the space bar, it backspaces. When i try to use the “suggestions” above my type area, often nothing happens. I don’t think I even covered all the bugs but they’re too many to remember!

title: Marketplace glitches
review: I am unable to view certain marketplace categories using my iPad Facebook app. I can use the same app on my phone & view the category I would like to view with no problems. All of my settings are the same & most categories do work in marketplace for Facebook for iPad. I also have a huge concern as to why there is so many updates for the Facebook app weekly & how much data & space is constantly used & required.

title: Bug since latest update
review:
FB never ceases to be annoying, but especially when the "updates" break something else. 
The latest is that FB keeps telling me I have 3 messages in messenger - but I don't. I get a new message, read it, and the little#3 goes away - for like 20 min - and then it pops up again. So annoying!! Especially when the messenger app doesn't have a problem - just FB.

title: No one innovates at this rate without the cure being worse than the disease.
review: Focus on quality.. focus on the consumer.  Don’t build more than is needed when your product is fragile. And give people enough switches to turn off the ego driven enhancements from an out of control coding brigade.  Click a picture and it rotates.. seriously.. click a picture and it rotates.  If you are going to do multi-platform coding, then at least do some attempts at multi-platform testing.

title: Britton wise
review: I love this app. I can check up on my good caring friends and family. There’s one thing you can improve on. Stop updating every other day. Maybe update it once a month please. Other than that I love the app. Thank you.

title: Fix Marketplace for iPad
review:
Still not resolved with latest update...

Still not fixed with newest update....

Seriously, fix Marketplace so that when I choose an ad to view on my iPad I don’t just get a white screen. This happened 2 updates ago and I doubt I am the only person experiencing this. I have completely closed out Facebook, deleted it from my iPad and reinstalled it and yet still, shockingly, nothing. Works fine on my iPhone, not on my iPad.

title: Glitch
review: For some reason my Facebook is being weird. When I go to my news feed it’ll show me about 3 posts and then it won’t let me go down anymore after that! I’ve tried restarting the app and redownloading it and it isnt working! I know it’s not my internet because I’ve always had really good WiFi and LTE idk what’s going on!

review: Once market place is opened and a post is clicked on it drops the post goes back to all posts and frozen with no response. Restarting the app and trying again does nothing to fix it does the same thing when clicking a post after restart of app. The kind of money Facebook makes they should be able to keep there app running smooth especially on iOS of all things!!

title: So tired of this app.
review: So tired of my fees feed!!!! I didn’t like the new news feed algorithm to begin with but at least FB used to have a “most recent” feature now that feature doesn’t even work. The “most recent” feed is flooded with post from hours and even days ago and half the time it locks up and won’t let you see past a handful of post. I think I’m capable of knowing what post I want to scroll past and what I actually want to see.

title: Latest update
review: What is the deal with fb not showing your posts.  You get a notification and when you click on it you can just see the people who liked it you can’t see the actual post. Half the time it’s gone from my feed too.   What is the point of that?  If something isn’t broken just leave it alone.  Not everything has to be “improved” especially when the “improved” is an epic fail.

title: Annoying
review: While Facebook has fun things on their theirs way too much political things and for people like me who see things on their that is so annoying you can’t help but to respond. I stopped Facebook because of this several times. This needs to go back to having fun sharing and getting to know new people.

review: You ever hear the saying, “If something’s not broken, don’t fix it.”? This app worked fine up until a month ago. Now my notifications are all screwed up. They disappear and the ones that do show up are out of order. I have to use my browser to see notifications which makes having the app completely unnecessary. Please fix this and only update your app when there’s a bug...LIKE THERE OBVIOUSLY IS NOW!

title: FB Algorithms
review: They need to stop thinking they know what I want to see. And when I unfollow (not unfriend) someone, WHY are they constantly in my notifications??? I unfollowed them for a reason!!! They clog my notifications!! And now I can only see so many notifications? I am missing things cuz FB decided I only need to see 20 notifications, of their choosing apparently. You’re grinding on my last nerve FB.

title: Glitchy
review:
The latest update is super glitchy. When clicking on notifications to view, you are taken to a “page not found” message every time. The only way to view comments is to go directly to the page and view the original link. 
Fix this ASAP. Super annoying.

title: Thank you
review: I would think you for Facebook but I have a little problem I have two accounts for Janice Herman and the same number but how do I put them together as one I give you a four star thank you

title: It’s really gone down hill and privacy is concerning.
review: I just wish Facebook would quit trying to guess the order I want my feed in. Just show me the people and things I follow in the order they were posted. Feels more like TV now where they tell you what to watch. And there privacy is a nightmare. Not even referring to the way they share data with advertisers. That actually does not bother me.

title: Facebook
review: When I am away from my home WiFi I cannot log on to Facebook. I get a message saying the internet is not available even though I can go on other sites without a problem. It’s very frustrating that I can only use the FB app when I’m in my home

review: So slow. Keeps showing repeat posts by friends. News feed just stops loading content and won’t refresh/load new stuff after about 25 posts. I hate how it shows same people over and over and over again. And brings stuff up from 5 days prior after completely not relevant any longer. They keep trying to make it too fancy and it makes it worse in the long run.

title: I never leave reviews but .......
review: Regardless of what’s being said in the media, Facebook is an amazing platform. They’ve connected millions... no BILLIONS of people together in to this spectacular online community. I hope Facebook bounces back and grows to a company valuation of 10 trillion!

Thank you for taking my feeds away. 
 NOT😡

You posted a notice about how we could reach them but that doesn’t work.  Also you’re saying we can subscribe to pages!! How much?  I’m telling you right now, that will be the damned day!!

title: Latest update is very sluggish

I have to actually go on the website through my mobile browser to check notifications now. Great job taking 5 steps backwards

title: Crashing constantly since these past two updates!!
review: Facebook app keeps crashing its frustrating. Ever since these 2 latest updates it’s been crashing.. you would think by now they’d have this issue corrected, but unfortunately at this time, they don’t! Hurry up and fix te crashing issue. Not sure if anyone else is experiencing this.. this is on my iPhone X

review: After an iPad update, I can still access my own page, but I’m locked out of a Facebook page I manage. I can do all of the necessary  posting, editing, etc., on my desk top, but I need to be able to work from the iPad when I’m traveling. As usual, Facebook offers no assistance either by phone, email, ‘support’ or carrier pigeon.

title: The app crashes after a few seconds of use
review: The app started crashing after a few seconds, and often loads only one or two posts then blocks. Not sure what was changed, but practically useless now. Over three months like this, three updates, no improvement. Just updated it again, now it is worse than before. Apparently more concerned with selling our info than providing a service!

title: Photo viewing fail.
review: What ever you just did to the viewing of photos, take it back. It used to flow nicely from photo to photo and if you wanted to zoom in it felt like I was bring the photo closer to me. Now it just feels twitchy and I don’t like it. Also when you’re scrolling through a deck of photos, come to the end and it automatically takes you out??!! NO!!!! Why the hell to you think you can decide that I’m done looking at those pictures??

title: Horrible
review:
The tech support is garbage. Multiple times I’ve needed to reach out to tech support to figure out issues and you get stuck in a horrible loop hole that doesn’t answer anything and only frustrates you more. The app force closes constantly if I can have the app open for more than twenty seconds then I’m doing good. Running on an iPhone X on 1 gig internet.. much needed fix. Hopefully a new social media website is born and Facebook can end up like MySpace. 
Forgotten.

title: Unreliable
review:
News feed hangs and won’t load more than 5-6 posts. When I try to report the issue, fb crashes. I uninstalled the app then reinstalled it with the same results. I’ve restarted my phone several times and got the same results. 
All the updates and the newly added features and yet the basic and most used feature fails to work properly!

title: New posts
review: Since I updated I have had to re-enter FB every time a new post appears. Also, if I am in the middle of responding to that post that also goes away. This has become very frustrating as I have to start over with every new post. I am very disappointed with not being able to check friends’ activities past the first one or two. Is there a place where I can go to stop this very annoying update feature?

title: Not letting me move photos into new album
review: Why is Facebook only giving me the option to move only a few photos and not all of them?? I made a new album and wanted to move some of my mobile uploads and time line pictures into the album and it’s not letting me. It keeps telling me to upload from my phone.

title: Truth in advertisement
review: What Facebook leave out of their advertisements are the constant bombardment of ads. You will get ad about every 3 or 4 posts and they pause videos now to run a ad during the video. Yeah they don't tell you about that part, they don't want you to know until it's to late and you have already created an account which is almost impossible to delete.

title: Can not post or like comments on a page that I run
review: I run a Facebook page that is attached to my profile. I used to be able to click the selector button for myself, or my page to decide which I wanted to post or comment as. Now the button is still there, but selecting it, does nothing. If I attempt to comment on a post on my page, it won’t allow me to switch over as me personally, only posts as my page.

title: Needs Glitch Updates
review: Like really.... I can't load my notifications and if I can, it loads 10 of them and then freezes, then proceeds to close the app altogether. I know I'm not the only one with this issue as others have told me as well. I'd like to see who's doing what and sending me stuff but I never can. Please fix this problem.

title: Smart enough to not believe Enquirer
review: So who are you to determine what is honest news? My information comes from more sources than your pablum directed news. The discussions of the people are more important than the Facebook slant. I don’t always like their views but it does give me a read on the social ideas of different people. Quite frankly, I am no longer interested in your limited views. I will go to twitter for a better unbiased read on people, friends and news.

title: Mobile Uploads album and Timeline Photos missing!!
review: The Mobile Uploads album and Timeline Photos album are not showing up in the albums. Cannot access albums on the app or on the desktop version of FB. Issue has been reported several times over two weeks time and have not received a response or resolution, even with an app update during that time. Please fix!!

title: Make a “select all” delete button for pictures and your inbox
review: I'm not understanding why its 2018 and we still Can't delete more than one photo or message at a time Facebook is the only app that refuses to update and people may have a lot of old pictures or messages that they want deleted and after all these yrs it would take too long to do them one by one

I delete the app. Reinstall and the new one is back that is until I leave Facebook and go back in to see the old layout. Frustrating

title: Comments don't load..blank screen
review:
New problem now comments do not load, even from noticfations. Can't reply or view thread. Fix this 

Also stop with autorefresh

You do this on purpose! open app, shows a popular post, I would start reading and bam! It refreshes my newsfeed and now I have scroll through everything to find that exact post. If this is your way of keeping people on the app longer then I will be uninstalling soon.

title: Marketplace
review: Facebook marketplace is one of the best features of the mobile app in years! That is before it stopped working. The past two days, I’ve been receiving a blank white screen when i select the “shop” icon in the app. This is extremely frustrating as I have multiple items of my own posted and am unable to communicate with my buyers. Please update this Facebook!!

title: Facebook photos
review: I can’t access any photos on my Facebook it’ll let me get to my profile to hit photos and then my whole app closes out on me and won’t let me in. I thought that maybe it was just a glitch so I uninstalled the app several times and even reset my device and still no way to get to them. Facebook gets this bad review because this has now been several times I’ve reported the problem and nothing fixed.

title: FB app has become a useless waste of space
review:
What happened?? I use FB daily and it goes from bad to worse. My feed never updates and even though I am attentive to my settings my feed is just the same old crap. I miss many friends posts, my pages that I follow don’t show... and what’s with the darn Snapchat photo thing that is more than annoying.
???? It’s just aggravating. I’m deleting because it takes up too much space and is barely usable.

title: Loading super slow lately
review:
The Facebook app has become all but unusable lately for me. I click on a notification and it’s taking 30+ seconds to load whatever I clicked on. I find that I’ll just go to my computer to see what I need instead of waiting for dial up speeds. 

This has only started in the past few weeks. 

Fiber internet. No internet issues whatsoever. Always on WiFi. This is the only app that this happens with. 

Additionally, since you’ve removed the groups app, loading albums in Groups is a huge pita. It limits us to 200 albums on iOS. It also limits the ability for albums to even load if there’s 1,000+ pics in each album.

title: Someone hacked my account
review:
Now I cannot get in because they are prompting me to reset my password that I have had signed into my phone for EVER and don’t know what it is, and now I am stuck in an infinite loop of guessing an incorrect password and not being able TO NOTIFY ANYONE ANY OTHER WAY BECAUSE YOU DONT INCLUDE A LINK TO HELP. 

So I am indefinitely locked out of facebook. Hopefully someone will reach out to me soon or else I am screwed for something I have no way to solve and lose like 10 years of networking.

title: Groups
review: I need to see all of my groups not 3 and whatever’s 3 random you want me to see... the improvements like announcements make it better  but then  you remove important needed features  it totally ruins the improvements.... social media had become a huge business tool Facebook is starting to cost us money.... looking for other avenues i hope someone comes up with something awesome because Facebook is  missing the mark big time now.

title: Where did my feeds go?
review: I used to use this app every morning to check in on close friends and family members, but that feed has disappeared from the feeds section, along with all the other friends lists I created. The only feed that shows up now is “Most Recent”. The other feeds still show up in the web version, but not in the app. If this functionality is not brought back, I may give up on Facebook altogether.

title: Garbage
review: Slow and buggy. No privacy what so ever. Now everyone can see everything I comment on even if they're not following the same page as I am. I don't know why I or anyone else continues to use this stupid app. Give us our tiny little bit of privacy back and fix the bugs, you multi billion dollar company you. I don't think it's very difficult for a company as big as yours to fix a few small bugs in this absolute joke of an app.

title: Fix it
review: I love Facebook and always have, but you can only see statuses from a small select few of people from your friends lists. I’d like to use Facebook to keep up with ALL my friends, not just some. This is honestly the dumbest feature about the app. I follow people so I can see their stuff but it doesn’t show up on my news feed.

title: Nothing wrong with the FB app
review: I have no issues with using FB from my Phone. If you’re having issues, it could be the phone carrier service. Love FB, it’s brought family I haven’t seen in year back into my life. Thank you FB!!!

title: Adding Emojis

review: I keep updating Facebook in the hopes that one of these updates will fix the problems. Apparently not. Even my Apple IT person is aware of the issues with FB updates. With the expertise available in-house it’s hard to believe that these updates are the best that FB can come up with.

review: The selection buttons at the bottom of the screen on iPhone X need to be pressed just right and it seems multiple times to actually work.  I think they need to be made more sensitive and the touch surface of them appears to be too small.  Please fix.

review: I love Facebook but lately it has its problems. I’ve been trying to upload pictures and videos in an album. And it keeps telling me I’m temporarily blocked because I was “going too fast.” I don’t know if maybe I’m that dumb or if that really just doesn't make a lick of sense,  but I don’t understand that. It’s never done that before nor have I ever had a problem with it. Up until now. Do a favor and fix that please.

title: Showing notifications when there isn’t any.
review:
Usually this app is great, but lately it’s been showing notifications (like 13 to be exact) and when I go into the app I have ONE notification and it’s the same one. It keeps re-notifying me about one thing.

Update: now it isn’t showing my notifications at all. I’ve been tagged in things and replied to, but have not been notified once. I have no idea if anyone is talking to me on my Facebook now. CHANGING MY RATING TO A 1 STAR.

review: Whenever I go to look at a random pic that's posted, it freezes half the time and I have to reset the app. Pretty annoying. Why does it crash when looking at articles usually or even just scrolling? Done that for awhile and no other app has that problem.

title: iOS 11 update
review: After the iOS 11 update, my Facebook app freezes non stop. I can scroll through just fine but when I click on a photo and the swipe to get rid of the photo, it’s freezes and I have to terminate the app and re-open to get it to unfreeze. Please update the app to fix this because it’s is driving me crazy!!!!

title: Ads, pages, groups!
review:
5 hands way up! Love Facebook! Actually find lots of things I want to buy through the targeted ads! 

And I love that I can use it so easily to manage all of my teams through groups and pages!!

review: Recently I noticed the FB app updated to include a shortcut at the bottom that listed things in circles. I LOVED it. Now today this is gone and there's an events shortcut, and we are back to the three lines for the menu. I want the other update back! I loved the circle menu!

title: Notification/Messenger Icons
review: Not happy with the changes to the Apple version of Facebook.  Since the most recent update when the icons have changed, the notification one doesn't always work.  Disappointed that the Messenger icon is no longer in the app.  It was better when I could go back & forth between the two without having to open them separately.

title: "Most Recent" is six feet under
review:
Facebook for a long time has preferred that you look at your news feed in the order that The Algorithm wants you to see your feed. But until recently it was fairly easy to reorder the posts into the most sensible order -- reverse chronological. No longer. They buried the "most recent"
sort deep under a long list of useless features. I hate it. Two stars.

title: Links become dead under iOS 11
review: Generally I'm a fan of the Facebook iOS app on iPad, but they've left a show-stopping bug in this latest version. Under some circumstances, all links in the app can become dead, making it impossible to read any of the stories in my feed. This has been going on for at least three versions now. The temporary fix is to force-quit the app. There’s no permanent fix; deleting and reinstalling has no effect.
