The app will often times completely freeze after I’ve searched for an item, and I’ll have to force close and reopen the app. Sometimes I can’t click on listings for whatever reason. The Facebook app team really needs to look into what’s bugging up the marketplace function...

title: Sadly terrible waste of great potential
review:
I recently shut down my old account to start a new one and a new chapter in life.

Upon starting a new account, it was deleted for doing nothing wrong. I let it go, waiter a couple days and started another one. Same story. My account was disabled for allegedly violating standards I was nowhere near violating.

Sad to see such an awesome site and app go to such waste. I miss using it but it’s going downhill due to such terrible service and experience.

title: Horrible App /corporation
review: I e been on Facebook for years. Someone made a fake page of my deceased aunt and I reported the fake page. Moments later Facebook forced logged me out and insisted on me uploading a government ID for verification purposes. I uploaded a redacted license and they never verified if they received my ID or not. If you have sentimental photos or content please back it up immediately or else you can potentially loose your photos any day whenever they decide to force log you out.

title: Lost pictures
review: I also lost everyone of my photos. I tried everything I could think of then I deleted the app and downloaded it again and walla’ they are all back. So anyone having the same problem just try deleting and downloading the app again to see if it will work for you...

title: Facebook policy
review: I made a new Facebook and right off the back I could not share posts comment on other posts said it the feature was unavailable I made a report a week ago and I still cannot do anything Facebook has done nothing to resolve this and to top it off I got blocked for no reason I wasn’t given a explanation stating why I got blocked or anything I been trying to contact Facebook support but nothing has happened

title: No longer can watch related videos
review: What I dont understand is why when the new update comes out things start changing on Facebook. I cant name a bunch of unnecessary changes off hand but still. We can longer watch related videos as before you are watching one and was able to continue to scroll down to watch related. As I’m correct that’s how people get more views something so minor can be big to others. Please consider.

title: Won’t let me log in
review: I’ve tried re-downloading this app every few months or so and it won’t let me sign in to my account. It tells me that my password is incorrect, but I can log in on my laptop/safari with out any issues, so I know my password is correct. I tried resetting my password multiple times and it still tells me it is wrong, even though I know for a fact it is right. Is anyone else having this problem?

title: Scheduled posts for pages do not work
review: After your last update I can no longer schedule posts for my page. There is no longer an option to schedule a post for a future date or time. Is that option coming back or is it gone forever?

title: Every update makes it worse
review: It is impossible to find your own comment in group posts or in threads under posts, and the iPhone version does not let me search my own friends’ profiles to find their birthdays or workplaces or any other information.  I reinstalled it to tell you this, and now I am uninstalling it again. The iPhone version of the Facebook app makes FB extremely annoying and frustrating.

title: Friends limit
review: Facebook friends limit should be more than 5k .... that will make it even more better than Twitter and others social media .. still the best but moving forward is better

title: Major issue
review:
I love your app!!!

However, there is a major issue that has cropped within the past month.  The tab for people with birthdays has stopped working. I can no longer wish my friends or family happy birthday through that tab.

title: Location selection in marketplace
review: I have the most recent app version and often times it won’t let me select a new location/search area in my phone app. So frustrating as we are trying to purchase a boat and I look on Facebook daily in the marketplace and can’t change our search zone!

title: Updates are a joke
review: Honestly, do the developers ever use the app? Do they even know what glitches or lags they need to fix? Videos are slow, even with the best WiFi connection and speed. Videos would play then buffer play then buffer, just as the video loads boom! An ad pops up and ruins everything. I’m seeing posts from 2 weeks ago at the very top and things that has just been posted a few hours ago is at the very bottom.

title: Love iPhone fb app
review: I have no problems my phone is full and it still does not close or freeze it does on my Qlink phone it really depends on ur phone not the app I love all the new feature I will keep getting all updates thank u fb

title: App keeps backing me out..... HELP!!!!!
review: Ever since the most recent update, there have been multiple occasions where the app will just back me out, taking me straight to my home screen without reason or warning. This usually within seconds when entering the app, and never happens just once at a time. Please work on figuring out the cause of this issue and finding a solution, because it has made using the app a complete hassle and annoying.

title: Bugs please fix soon as possible
review: This app says I have to verify my account when I log in it doesn’t give me any options to verify my account it’s says please try again later this is really annoying I’ve been trying to contact a couple friends but this bug is really annoying please fix it

title: No photos allowed?
review: Not sure what’s going on now, but photos are not being allowed to show. It shows until you post then it comes up white. When you click on it there is a circular arrow like you could possibly get it to download, but it just stops and does nothing. Can you please fix this?

title: Fix a privacy setting
review: Best app for Entertainment out there no doubt about it, although I gotta say; I believe the time of when you post something should be a privacy concern. Some would concern it impacts social media friendships by the bias of your free time. Such as people getting mad that their friends aren’t having or making time for them.

title: Post and stories
review: For whatever reason the share button does not appear anymore. I can only post with this new update. Then and only then can I share it to stories. The feature for sharing in stories and posting at the same time does not appear anymore. A little annoying to have to go back and share in stories after I post.

title: Can’t rotate live video
review:
It would be nice if when we do live video on Facebook that we could rotate the video so that we can turn our phone sideways and get a wider view. If I can make a video on my phone holding it sideways and then post it sideways, then why can’t they allow us on Facebook to turn phone on it’s side to get a wider video.  
Ugggggg

title: Annoying
review:
The fact I get notifications now for every time someone posts things is SO annoying. And I turned off notifications for those people and they still keep showing up. I get nearly 30 notifications every 10 mins and there’s no way to turn it off. 
Y’all took one of the only annoying features of Twitter and integrated it into Facebook to make it even worse than it already was. Awesome 😒

title: Facebook isn’t listening
review: Facebook should know what to fix as soon as we start reporting problems we never reported before . Why can’t they record our satisfaction with older updates and see what happens when they make changes with things we fell in love with ? I feel like their feedback is backwards. They only listen to what we like and add stuff on Facebook that we would utterly hate and make us believe it’s a lot better now .

title: Marketplace partially broken in version 220.0
review: For the last couple days, I have been getting a lot of generic error messages within the app on my tablet. I finally checked, and noticed that two days ago my tablet updated to version 220.0; I believe this is approximately when these problems began. I hope this gets fixed soon; otherwise I enjoy the app quite a bit.

title: Low rating for FB
review: I used to have FB and connected with family, people from school, from my hometown, church... Then I had to have a replacement cell sent to me and my FB account for Annie Croghan Stadel never loaded from iCloud. I can view it as if it belongs to someone else. FB has no one you can talk to or email. I do not think a person actually reads an email problem. I think Siri reads it and is programmed to give out the same solution that does not apply to me. Sad.

title: Videos won’t play
review: Videos will play for about two seconds and then pause themself and then I’ll play the video again and they keep pausing. It’s ridiculous that they can’t even get a simple video to play on a brand new iPhone. This is a huge issue and makes me want to uninstall your crappy app. Facebook get it together because none of these updates have fixed this issue and it’s been happening for too long!!!

title: This new design is a disaster
review: Who redid the Facebook layout? Now in each home page I have to scroll through all the useless information, then found out what I want to look at is nor there!

title: 2019 and it’s still crashing
review: I’ve been starting use Facebook a bit more recently until all of a sudden the app crashes about 5 seconds after I open it. I don’t know why this is happening, but it’s been crashing more frequently the more and more I use it. I don’t have a lot of pictures on it so I really don’t know what’s causing all of the crashing. Just beware...

title: Failure to get notifications
review: Really tired of not getting notifications when people comment on things or on posts I’ve manually turned on notifications for. This has been an on going problem for close to a year for me. Sometimes deleting the app and reinstalling helped but the last few months it has made no difference.  Either way, I shouldn’t have to continuously delete the app and reinstall.

title: Facebook pressure sensitive
review: Normally Facebook works great. With this last update for iPhone, now every time I scroll I accidentally activate the facebook emoji bar. It’s pressure sensitive now, for some reason. I have big hands, and now every time I tap to scroll, I’m responding to somebody’s post. I’m not someone who “likes”, “loves”, “laughs” or “hates” every photo I come across. Now I’m getting messages from friends asking why I hate their posts. That is definitely not what I want from this app.

title: What’s Going On?
review: Facebook is literally down. I can’t post, comment, load a screen, log on. Nothing. I’m not getting any pop up message of “maintenance” or anything whatsoever. Please explain what’s going on. It’s been going on since I got up.

title: App hangs since the update
review: Title is self explanatory. Plus there’s something wrong with group notifications. When I click on the notification, the app doesn’t take me to that activity. I have to search and manually sort my notifications inside the group feed. After I’ve set how I want my group notifications to be sorted, like recent posts first, the app goes back to its previous setting! It’s really annoying and time consuming.

title: Photos & Videos
review: My phone is set to update apps when needed & when it updated I didn’t realize till the other day and I couldn’t look at anyone’s photos. Can we please put the photos & videos back where they was instead on having to go to activity log and go through all that unnecessary crap?

title: Censorship and bugs
review:
While I enjoy what Facebook has done in the past, they have moved on from a nice flowing app and seem more concerned with policing speech. 

While, sure, it’s important to crack down on cyber bullying, that isn’t what’s happening. It’s targeted. And the app is paying for it. 

While the app crashes constantly, since the last IOS update, by simply scrolling down the timeline, they choose to move more effort to shutting down citizen watch groups. They collude with other tech giants and synchronized their moves with theirs. 

Instead of shutting down citizen watch groups, shutting down dissenting opinions, why not fix the bugs with your app? If it wasn’t necessary for me to conduct business, I wouldn’t be on here at all, for the above reasons.

title: Videos won’t ply with sound!
review:
Is anyone else having the issue I am, when I push the sound on button on videos they will
Stop playing or will just buffer and play for about 1-3 seconds the. Stop and over and over again. Soon as I push sound off they play just fine. Not sure what going on or if I’m the only one, my app is updated and I’m not having any other issues just that. It’s not a connection issue either.

title: Problems with live videos
review: For the past 2or 3 days I have been on Facebook trying to watch live videos and nothing we either get froze or a black screen we can see the person but we can’t hear nothing please fix this Facebook because this is getting on my nerves then I will change my review

title: Notifications
review: I have almost 1 year that I do not get facebook notifications to my cell phone I do not know why it is because I always go to my updated app to the most recent version, I do not receive notifications of any kind, example friend requests, birthdays, mentions in comments etc. I really need you to help me please.🙏🏻

title: Shutting off
review: Since about 1/12 Facebook is not loading properly and keeps shutting off! I never had this problem before. When I open the app there may be only one post on my feed and that will close before I’ve had a chance to read it. If there are more posts the same problem, Facebook just closes. iPhone XS Max. The app is useless to me at this point!

title: Facebook page keep blinking off when I open it it's been doing that for a couple days now
review: My Facebook page keep blinking off when I open it . it's been doing that now for a couple days please help.

title: Facebook keeps closing
review: My phone finally loaded an update. Facebook had started closing on it’s on after just a few minutes of browsing. I’ve deleted Facebook 2 or 3 times, shut my phone completely off & restarted it. It’s still shutting down & I can only see one or two stories/posts at a time then it shuts down. It’s getting very frustrating. Help

title: Posts
review: Whenever I share a post from the application, let’s call it, like omg or lol that messages you in messenger, it takes you back to the top of your news feed to see it. You know you shared it, you don’t need to go to the top of your news feed. It should be just like sharing anything else and hit share and then just move along scrolling from where you were.

title: Facebook Update Gell
review: With every Facebook update, it gets so buggy and veeeeeerrrrrryyyyy ssssssdlllllooooowww! Many favorite pages take forever to post. And when will Facebook drop its lousy analytics and let me get posts from whomever I want regularly.  That’s why I’m on Facebook after all. Facebook, please stop updating until you can get it to work!

title: Tired of every time soneone likes or comments on a post it shows at the top over and over again.
review:
When I am in FB I want to see new posts at the top. I get tired of seeing the same posts over and over again because someone else liked it or commented on it. There is not enough time in a day to find the actual new posts.
Please change this FB.

title: App refuses to hide advertisers
review: I went into my advertiser settings in the app and am still unable to hide 7 advertisers even though I am clearly choosing to. I've also gone and hid an app directly in my feed and then after logging out and back in, the first ad I saw was the one I just hid. All this stuff about letting you have control of your information is BS. They still haven't fixed it. I will be looking for other ways to not use Facebook

title: Annoying things
review: Always in the comments when I press see more It just doesnt work. And no its not a prank by the commentor. Also another thing in videos that I dont always find the option to change quality. Other than that its fine but these 2 things are frustrating.

title: Last update is horrible, why is everything tiny?
review: I’m on an iPad Pro but I might as well be on my phone with the last update since you shrunk my page! Everything is small. There’s tons of wasted space on both sides now. Trying to look through pictures to add in a comment is ridiculous because they are now minuscule. Want to see one of my dogs? Too bad, I can no longer tell them apart. What was the purpose of this really? No, really?

title: Ads
review: I’ve used Facebook since 2011 and have always enjoyed it, but all these ads in the middle of a video are really annoying. Hiding the ad doesn’t play the video either you still have to wait until the allotted time is up. I only have Facebook to keep up with friends and family I don’t see often. However, I’m really considering deactivating my account and just deleting it all together all because of the ads

title: Newsfeed loading issues
review: Latest version of the Facebook app will not load entire newsfeed. Sometimes it won’t load at all and gives me a refresh newsfeed button that does not work. Exiting and re-entering does not fix this. Uninstalled and reinstalled twice which fixed it fir a day or two at most. Super frustrating when I get a notification, open app and can’t look at what it tried to notify me of.

title: Notifications
review: Of course you’ve gotta love Facebook. Keeps everyone connected. However, it’s notifications is making me crazy. It’ll say 10 notifications, open up, 2 are there. 3 unread messenger notifications, when there’s actually none. It’s been like this for I want to say 6 months. Please oh please correct this.

title: Not scrolling correctly
review: On iPhone, when you scroll and let go. It will continue to scroll, but when I place my finger back on the screen, it doesn’t recognize the touch and stop like it used to. It isn’t my phone because other apps like Instagram work fine. Please fix as it is annoying.

title: Frustrating. So. Frustrating!!!
review: For the past two days, I can only see two posts. And it’s the same posts for hours and hours and when I pull down to refresh it’s still the same two posts. I tried deleting and redone loading the Facebook app with no success. I tried rebooting my phone and that helped for an hour or so and then it went right back to only showing me two posts. Fix it already!

title: So many changes...
review: Some of them are completely unnecessary and irritating! Like, my notifications shuffling once I turn the notifications off. Also, I’m not a fan of the change that now makes the captions on the posts disappear, but the picture or gif posted shows. I understand that changes are necessary to remain relevant, but some of these are just stupid

title: New update makes app unusable
review: The new update changed how images are displayed so they side scroll like in marketplace ads and sponsored post advertisements. When I post photos now, the text content of my post that goes along with those photos doesn’t appear. Notifications directing me to the post link me to an empty post with comments/interactions. I can see it all on desktop the way it’s supposed to be but not on mobile. I’m on a brand new iPhone X.

title: Ads IN videos...?
review: Most videos are pretty short that I view on FB, and I’ve come to accept the fact that I’ll have to view an add before my desired content starts.  But to interject an ad into the near-beginning or middle of a 1-3 minute video is beyond frustrating.  10-20 minute videos with ads are annoying, but tolerable.  What you’re doing now is pushing me to view video content elsewhere.

title: Where is my 3d photos Facebook?
review: I have a iPhone X and update my Facebook app every time there is one but I can’t do 3d photos why? All my other friends who have a iPhone X is able to do it so why can’t I. This is very frustrating cause I feel I have done everything right. Even deleted the app and reinstalled it and still nothing

title: problem
review: Hello Facebook There is a problem in the program is the ratio of views in groups and people who see the publication did not appear in the views, but only show who liked the publication or commented on it I hope to fix this error as soon as possible .. Thank you Facebook

title: Notifications acting up
review: Annoyed that I’m not getting all my notifications and consistently see days old notifications instead. I’ve deleted the app and reinstalled it, which fixed the problem for a few minutes, but then it started acting up again. Notifications will even disappear as I’m getting ready to click on them.

title: Truncated Newsfeeds
review: I do almost all my Facebooking on my iPhone. The Facebook app has been getting progressively better for years. No more. I don’t see more than a dozen or so posts at a time in my newsfeed anymore. Nothing more than 24 hours, usually less. “Most Recent” isn’t any better. If they’re trying to get me to use Facebook less, they’re doing a good job. Super aggravating. Super disappointing.

title: FB is a joke now
review: My account was black from updating my personal information I was just trying to update my work info and it kept saying that my post was identical to my last and it was not and then it said I better slow down on my account will be blocked from using this feature so I kept trying and it was blacked so I message the help center multiple times different places and they told me that they couldn’t help me.

title: No more friend suggestions!
review: I only use FB for my local garage sales.  I am not interested in sharing anymore of my personal life with FB.  That said, I don’t care about advertisements and I don’t want to see “friend” suggestions.  I encourage others to never click on any advertisements and don’t use the suggested friends feature.  Hopefully they remove these annoying features in the future.

title: See All Comments
review: You need to make it easier to get to the beginning of the comments. Instead, we have to constantly press “see previous comments”. It’s very annoying when there are a lot of comments under a post.

title: Annoying, unwanted notification
review:
Facebook sends many unwanted messages to get you to use the app more. I don’t care that some random friend posted a new profile picture unless I asked to be notified about that person. I don’t care that some random person commented in a group I follow.

I turned off ALL Facebook notifications because I couldn’t stand all this barrage of unwanted notifications. You guys lost your notification privileges with me.

title: Facebook & Messenger Updates
review: HATE THIS!!! Facebook won’t allow me to save a group to my favorites or edit my notification settings for it. Messenger keeps showing an “unread” message from someone who’s not a “friend”; when I click to show it, there’s nothing there but a list of suggested contacts to add!! I hide them all but they keep coming back! The “unread” message doesn’t appear at all!! PLEASE FIX THESE!!!!!

title: Too much tracking and sharing info
review: Don’t like the sharing of my likes or related items.  I use FB primarily to keep in touch with family and view photos.  I don’t like the sharing of anything that I like or not.  Anything thing that I do or not is tracked, don’t like that either.  Go back to the original FB platform.... designed to keep people in touch with one another, not for monetary gain.

title: Notifications
review: I used to be able to hit my notification button if I had, let’s say 9 notifications. I’d tap it once and they would show up in a light gray and the notifications would be cleared, even if I didn’t click on them. Now I have to click on each notification individually to get rid of it. Highly annoying. I’ve let them pile up over 3 days and have like 90 to go through and click for no reason

title: Multiple Notifications Since Last Update
review: Since the last update my notifications don’t go away.  After selecting the notification and viewing, the same notification will pop up again.

title: Latest update
review:
With the latest update. Notifications are coming to my phone, but are not listed in the notification menu inside the app. Newest notifications are from 3 days ago. 

It’s hard to keep track of who is commenting on what.

title: Most recent
review: I hate that the most recent option had been taken away it is very annoying to have to scroll thru my news feel for like 20 minutes to see something that was posted a couple hours ago. I don’t want to open my Facebook and the first thing I see is something that was posted 4 days ago! I will be getting rid of Facebook (as well as a lot of my friends) if the issue is not fixed!

title: Absolutely hate the emojis that came with the recent updates. Go back to the old ones!
review: I think this app could use some improvement. To many issues with it not updating when you post pics or comments. Half the time I can't even see the comments my friends make! Frustrating!

title: Please Fix!!
review:
I would be perfectly fine with the whole app if Marketplace worked!! I cannot get the icon to show up in the app and when I try to do anything to get it to show up, the entire app just crashes!! This isn’t just me either, I have talked to others who are experiencing the same problems.
Pls fix ASAP!!
(I will remove and then re-write a positive review when the mess is fixed)

title: No stars
review: I don’t know what your developers have done BUT your last few updates have definitely changed something. Your app drains the life out of my battery. Background refresh is turned off, cellular data is turned off. You MUST fix this. Also please remove or give the option of removing the story mode that is on the top of the screen. I have no interest in it and would like the option of turning it off.

title: Trouble
review: My husband and I are both having trouble with the app on our phones. Only on our phones, when you open the app, you get about 10 seconds and the screen goes black and it shuts down. Is this the app, our phones or our WiFi?

title: Crashes and Crashes and Crashes
review: Over and over again the app crashes. I basically open the app and 15 seconds later, it crashes. Tried closing it out, tried deleting and reinstalling, nothing worked - really frustrating. The thing is, the app was perfectly fine a couple weeks ago, up until the had to go and update it 1,700 times in the last month... Please get it together, Facebook..

title: Crashing app
review: I’ve used Facebook for 5 years and never had a problem, but now for some reason, Facebook only gives me 1 post and then crashes and messenger will load a conversation while you are in the middle of typing, this needs to be worked on because this isn’t supposed to be happening and I don’t understand why it is, I have plenty of space. But it crashes when I have my Data on or my Internet

title: Every update generates more user issues
review: Every time you update the app, it gets worse and worse. Now I’m to the point where I don’t even use Facebook because I can’t keep the app open. As soon as it opens I get a black screen then my phone reverts back to my home screen. Facebook has become social media for the shareholders, it’s not about the user or the users experience any more, now it’s all about the pop ups and advertising. God I miss MySpace

title: Garbage: wouldn't even give 1star
review:
Can't get the app to stay open long enough to do anything with it. Crashes almost as soon as it pops up. Won't let me post a review without giving it at least 1star.

Yup: the above is an already written response, but it says everything I need to say. Quit screwing with things that work fine the way they are.

Still agree with all of the above! Updated again, and crashes are even worse than before: GARBAGE!!!

title: App Keeps CRASHING!
review: On July 1st, I updated my Facebook software on my iPhone and since then it crashes. I open it, it crashes. I try to click on other things, it crashes. I’ve contacted Facebook support several times with no response. I’ve deleted, uninstalled, reinstalled, rebooted, soft reseted, and nothing works. I think I’m just about to cut my losses and get rid of this app. If you have the most recent iOS - don’t bother updating this app. It will crash. At least it’s free.

title: Issues
review: Sometime i was faced this issues that is, after update, not changing the new function is not amply on my current facebook. That function was occurred in my old account that is why?

title: Update is terrible
review: I hate this new update. Every time I click on a video it takes me to the discover page, then plays the video, then when I click out of the video it doesn’t take me back to my newsfeed. It brings me to the top of the discover page and starts IMMEDIATELY playing the first video which is super annoying. I really dislike this. If you’re going to do that at LEAST allow me to swipe left to get back to my newsfeed.

title: Cannot download since newest update.
review: Constant issues with Facebook weather it’s inappropriate videos, pages posting for me, lagging, starting me all the way back at the top of news feed, whole thing with pictures being cut in half and made into two separate videos. I’m just tired of the constant change in places that not need being changed

title: Why??
review: Can you please make an update that stops the new discover thing from opening every time you attempt to watch a video. This app is annoying with that feature

title: Crashtastic! Again
review:
This app blows! I can't spend more than 2-3 minutes reading articles without it crashing.  May I should just roll with it and enjoy having my life back in the real world. Zuckerburg, how the hell can someone with your resources have such a crappy, flawed app?
Update: Same. Something happened within the past 24 hours and we’re back to crashing every few minutes. I also can’t see more than 1-3 posts. Sigh.

title: Updates.
review: Surely you can do better than having costly updates to us at least once a week. We all know the security is not the securest so why so many. Cost us space. Data. And whatever else it involves. Can you do better ????   Seems like Instagram. Twitter and the other media’s are able to do less and are ranked higher now days. Just saying less so I don’t get blocked for speaking out.

title: Updated my old review
review: I was frustrated before that the app kept refreshing on its own. Then I discovered recently that in settings on the phone you change whether or not an app refreshes in the background. I think that fixed the problem.

title: Issues with updates
review: With every new update Facebook fails to fix main issues with the app and the daily crashes or errors. At times app is unresponsive with refresh screen, location updates and newsfeed updates. Even though app being refreshed/updates it shows the same old posts/videos etc. very frustrating updating this app to see it still not have fixed issues.

title: Version 173
review: I really do not care for the new addition made to watching a video. This new addition has a pop up at the bottom of the screen asking to follow the page or rate the video. This seems small but I find it annoying enough to put in this review since leaving feedback option was taken out too, or I just can’t find where they moved it to.

title: Been having issue for couple of days now
review: I don’t know why but whenever i search for anything/anyone it only loads like 5-6 things in the results and stays loading but the rest never comes up....even though it says it’s loading 😑

title: App keeps glitching
review: Maybe if you didn’t add the camera That Nobody Asked For as the intrusive nuisance it is my app would work EVERY time I open it. Why not a button like messenger? Every time I slide my finger a little odd the camera takes almost 10 seconds to load just for me to swipe back to the app. Move the camera option to the stories part of the app only. I hate it as it is now.

title: How do I stop all the notifications??!
review: Why do I get notifications (on the little bell- bottom right) for all kinds of stuff I didn’t ask to get notifications for??   It is possible to turn them off but it is cumbersome to do so and why should I have to turn them OFF since I never wanted them in the first place.    Mainly they seem to be pages I follow announcing events.   I do not want notifications about events unless I specifically ask for them.

title: 10 sec then go to main screen ‘
review: What is the purpose of feedback and reviews ? If you are not fixing them ‘ my first problem since years that many of my friends cant tag me , just the name shown without any tag or notification , the second that the news feed only loading without anything new and stuck to the same page , after 10 seconds it get out to my main screen iPhone . Thanks !!

title: Fb
review:
It’s a good app but the problem is with the iPhone X it always makes the status bar up top with the battery and time slide to the left always

title: Facebook Censorship
review:
Because of it’s scientific merit, I posted a video of a mathematical review of voting results in Michigan. It was conducted by a team of data analysts/pattern analysis experts and software engineers. (One was a democrat, one republican, and one independent.) The scientific presentation ended with the democrat welcoming opposing mathematical findings. 

When I got 0 responses in 24 hours, I suspected it was suppressed because my previous post had about 100 responses. I asked many people who engage with my content if the post appeared in their newsfeed. They checked and everyone said NO. 

This is wrong. Exercising this level of control over legitimate information sharing (censorship) manipulates users’ opinions and public sentiment. What a dangerously powerful weapon. 

Deactivating my account.

FB started out as a great SM platform but then became too involved in politics and taking one side over the other. People are afraid to post in many cases now about anything including their religion. title: Confused
review: Every since I was hacked, I’m unable to recover my original Facebook. I have a different number and email so it has been problematic. I don’t want several accounts and wish there was a way to correct this. Otherwise, it was a huge blessing to be reunited to friends and family through this app

title: Psyop, lies, filters, hatred, control
review: If you aren’t a left winger, you aren’t allowed to practice your freedom of speech.  They filter everything conservatives say and post.  They also update with lies hoping if they say it enough, ppl will believe it.  It’s called Psyop.  Unfortunately, the right isn’t as gullible as the left. Also....they should respect our President. review: I love FB. I use it daily for my business. The new version from 5 days ago is messing with my iPad or my iPad is messing with it lol. I can only use the search function in the blue leader bar. None of the other functions work from it which is making it more challenging.

I can search for things and find items, but it isn’t even in my area. I have deleted and reinstalled the app and it still did not correct the issue. Please fix!

review: The only thing I would change is when someone mentions you in a video or post, the your name is no where to be found and it lost in the comments. Its rather annoying to not be able to see your mentions.

review: I love using this app catching up with my friends and family but whenever I see my friends or families stories and I react to them it doesn’t show. I’ve tried deleting the app and reinstalling it too but it doesn’t work. Please fix this problem.

review: It might be a good idea to make the battery percentage visible during Facebook live feeds or just watching videos, so people can plug in their phone and not have a video interrupted. Other than that..... this is a fairly user friendly app.
